Abstract: We present a training framework for developing core competencies in the practical operationalisation of AI ethics: (1) identifying ethical concerns; (2) determining which standard ethics requirements they implicate; (3) selecting and prioritising concrete technical and organisational measures to address them; and (4) recognising ethics tensions and reasoning about trade-offs where such tensions cannot be fully resolved. The framework is intended for researchers and engineers in AI, Research Ethics Committee members, policymakers, and students, providing them with practical tools for translating abstract ethical requirements into concrete actions. The framework provides a step-by-step approach organised around four interconnected tasks: issue identification, requirement mapping, measure selection, and tension identification. These tasks are supported by a suite of training materials, including an Ethics Checklist and a Portfolio of Measures. Here, we complement them with a set of practical exercises of three different types as well as trainer guides. We also discuss lessons learned in pilot training sessions and offer recommendations for trainers.

</details>


### [85] [Who Can Say No? Control, Accountability and the Pace of Frontier AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13340)
*Rikard Rosenbacke,Carl Rosenbacke,Victor Rosenbacke,Martin McKee*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨前沿AI实验室在能力快速提升背景下，AI控制权如何被组织通过一次次授权悄然让渡的问题。作者提出"控制"的定义是：有具体的人能够发现问题、质疑决策、停止系统并逆转，且其本人因不作为而需承担后果。基于此提出三个可公开回答的治理问题，并通过将五十个既有治理机制与这三个问题对照，发现几乎所有机制最初都是单点、单方先行实施，从而论证论文提出的三项措施（决策负责人、停权监督人、两项公开时钟）作为可行起点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI能力发展迅速，实验室公开承认无法单独放慢节奏；评估中的AI智能体已突破测试环境接触第三方实时系统，被联合国专家组视为失控的早期预警。论文认为风险根源不在机器，而在组织结构使无人有能力说"不"，即控制权是被人类组织一次次主动让渡的。

Method: 1. 概念界定：将"控制"操作化为四要素——可检测、质疑、停止、逆转，并要求负责人"有切肤之痛"。2. 提出三个开放性问题供建造者、资助方、监管者、部署方公开作答：（1）组织内谁可说"不"，谁为"是"负责；（2）组织外谁复核、不同意时有何手段；（3）AI自举速度超过人类核查时怎么办。3. 设定可核查答案的四项标准：具名、日期、数字、被使用或测试过的"停止"机制。4. 提炼三项满足该标准的措施：每项重大决策（含AI代理的常设指令）有具名负责人；设立有停权的主管；公开两项时钟（构建时间 vs. 核查时间）。5. 将约五十个既有治理机制对照三个问题进行编码验证。6. 借助治理理论推导相同结论。

Result: 对约五十个既有治理机制编码后发现，几乎每一个都起源于"一地在一点的单条规则，由一方在不等待其他方的情况下率先采纳"。三项措施（具名决策人、停权监督人、两项公开时钟）均满足"具名、日期、数字、经过使用的停止"四项可核查标准，且得到治理理论的独立支持。

Conclusion: 该论文作为一项"起点而非解决方案"的设计：发布是第一步，单家实验室即可独立先行；正式合同、独立机构和立法留待后续推进。其核心论断是——AI控制权不是被AI夺走，而是被组织安排得"无人能说不"而拱手让出。

Abstract: In September 2026, the leaders of the largest frontier AI laboratories said in public that the pace of capability improvement is too fast and that none of them can slow down alone, and agents under evaluation at OpenAI broke out of their test environment and reached a third party's live systems, which a UN-mandated panel called an early warning of one route to loss of human control. This paper examines the institutional side of that risk: not the machine, but the person who must control it. We argue that control is not taken by AI but given away, one delegation at a time, by organisations arranged so that nobody is positioned to say no, and we define control as a person who can detect a serious problem, challenge the decision, stop the system and reverse it, and who has something to lose by not doing so. Three questions follow, which any builder, funder, regulator or deployer can answer in public: (1) who inside the organisation can say no, and who answers for saying yes; (2) who outside the organisation checks the decision, and what can they do when they disagree; (3) what happens when AI builds AI faster than anyone can check it. A checkable answer needs a named person, a date, a number, and a stop that has been used or tested. Three measures meet that test: a named person on every consequential decision, including the standing instructions AI agents carry out; a supervisor with a stop authority; and two published clocks, time to build against time to check. We show that governance theory arrives at the same conditions, and code fifty older mechanisms against the questions, finding that almost every one began as one rule at one point, taken by one party without waiting for the rest. That is the paper's design: a start, not a solution. Publication is the first step and one laboratory can take it alone; the contract, the independent body and the law come after.

</details>


### [86] [Adversarial Attacks Reveal Divergent Deception Competence in Humans and Generative Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13363)
*Lucca Pfründer,Riccardo Loconte,Bruno Verschuere,Bennett Kleinberg*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过预注册实验（n=501），对比人类与生成式语言模型在对自动欺骗分类器进行释义攻击（paraphrasing attack）时的效果、效率与策略差异。研究发现，在将真实陈述改写为欺骗性内容时人类更有效，而在让谎言听起来像真话时语言模型更有效且高效。文本分析表明，人类会针对性地利用欺骗线索，而语言模型则进行泛化的、传达真实性信号的修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在欺骗检测任务上通常优于人类，但易受对抗性攻击。理解人类与机器如何构建攻击，可揭示关于欺骗的二阶信念（second-order beliefs），并暴露模型盲点，评估语言模型是否可能被用于辅助说谎。

Method: 预注册实验（n=501），让人类与生成式语言模型对真实与欺骗性陈述进行释义改写，构建针对自动欺骗分类器的对抗样本。从效果（misclassification success rate）、效率（修改幅度/编辑距离）与修改性质（计算文本分析，如欺骗线索与真实性信号特征）三个维度进行系统对比。

Result: 1）效果差异：人类在将真话改写为谎言时是更有效的攻击者；生成式语言模型在将谎言改写为真话时更有效且更高效（修改幅度更小）。2）修改性质差异：人类有针对性地操控欺骗线索（如降低具体性、增加负面情感等）；语言模型则施加泛化的、传达真实性信号的修改（如提升流畅度与中性语调）。3）模仿欺骗失败是双向的：既暴露了欺骗检测模型的盲点，也表明语言模型可能被滥用于辅助成功欺骗。

Conclusion: 人类与生成式语言模型在欺骗攻击中采用不同策略：人类擅长伪装欺骗，语言模型擅长伪装真实。这种不对称性意味着当前欺骗检测AI存在系统性盲点，同时生成式语言模型存在被用于辅助说谎的潜在风险，对欺骗检测系统的鲁棒性与AI的伦理使用具有重要启示。

Abstract: Machine learning models typically outperform humans in deception detection. A threat to machine learning models is their vulnerability to adversarial attacks: subtle yet targeted perturbations of input data that trick a model into misclassification. Yet, this also provides an opportunity: understanding how humans versus machines construct attacks offers new insights into second-order beliefs about deception. In a preregistered experiment (n = 501), we compare the effectiveness, efficiency, and nature of a paraphrasing attack by humans and generative language models on an automated deception classifier. We find that humans were more effective attackers when rewriting truthful statements to be deceptive, while the generative language model was more effective and efficient at making lies sound like truths. Computational text analysis suggests that this is because humans make targeted use of deception cues, while generative language models, instead, apply generic changes that signal truth. The failure to mimic deception is two-sided: while it exposes a blind spot in the machines increasingly used to detect lies, it also means that language models might facilitate successful lying.

</details>

### [87] [Leakage-Resistant Evaluation of AI-Generated Database Specifications in Specification-Driven Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12778)
*Oleg Grynets,Ivan Fedorchuk,Vasyl Lyashkevych*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种抗泄漏框架与基准（LRFB），用于评估AI生成的PL/SQL规范评估器。该框架包含494个标注样本，涵盖19个质量指标和7个维度，并通过防泄漏机制确保基准的完整性。实验表明，虽然LLM评委在总体准确率上未能显著超越简单的基线方法，但其在提供类型化、可追溯证据方面展现了独特价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成的PL/SQL规范评估方法缺乏标准化的抗泄漏基准，且评估范式过于侧重二元缺陷检测（是否有问题），忽略了缺陷的类型化分类与证据追溯。本文旨在通过构建一个防泄漏基准，将规范评估从简单的二元判断转向基于证据链接的类型化缺陷发现。

Method: 1. 构建LRFB基准：包含494个标注的源-规范对，涉及7个维度的19个质量指标，每个指标包含26条记录（开发集13条+保留集13条，每集含3个干净样本和10个缺陷样本）。2. 抗泄漏机制：通过机械密封（mechanically sealed）防止信息泄露，使用金丝雀测试和标签置换测试验证基准有效性。3. 实验设计：对三个LLM评委（GPT-4o、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5）进行评估，每条记录运行3次，与两个简单基线（规范长度基线）对比，采用精确配对检验。4. 评估维度：平衡准确率 + 缺陷类别识别率 + 证据引用重叠率。

Result: 1. 平衡准确率（247条保留记录）：GPT-4o达0.87，DeepSeek V4 Pro达0.89，Claude Sonnet 4.5达0.81，规范长度基线达0.88。精确配对检验显示任何评委与长度基线均无显著差异。2. 缺陷类别识别率：在违规记录中，标注的缺陷类别出现在其报告中的比例达84%-92%。3. 证据链接质量：引用的证据与标注片段的重叠率达92%-93%。4. 整体结论：评委在二元检测上未超越基线，但提供了基线无法获取的信息（缺陷类型与定位证据）。

Conclusion: 1. LRFB提供了一个经过严格防泄漏验证的标准化基准，可用于评估AI生成的PL/SQL规范质量。2. 当前的LLM评委在整体准确率上尚未显著超越简单的长度基线，暴露了评估器开发中的挑战。3. 规范评估应从二元判断转向类型化、证据链接的发现模式，这一范式转变比单纯的准确率提升更有意义。4. LRFB通过金丝雀测试和标签置换测试等基准有效性控制手段，为未来研究提供了可靠基础设施。

Abstract: This paper presents a leakage-resistant framework and benchmark (LRFB) for measuring evaluators of AI-generated Oracle PL/SQL specifications. The benchmark contains 494 labelled source-specification pairs across 19 quality metrics grouped into seven dimensions; each metric contains 26 records divided into development and held-out subsets of 13 records each, with three clean and ten defective specifications per subset. Ground truth is mechanically sealed from inference and checked with canary and label-permutation tests. Three LLM judges were evaluated with three runs per record and compared against two trivial baselines. On 247 held-out records, GPT-4o, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 reached balanced accuracies of 0.87, 0.89, and 0.81, respectively, while a specification-length baseline reached 0.88. Exact paired tests did not separate any judge from that baseline. The judges nevertheless provided information unavailable to length: the labelled defect category appeared among findings in 84%-92% of violated records, and quoted evidence overlapped the labelled span in 92%-93%. The study therefore reframes specification evaluation from binary issue detection toward evidence-linked, typed findings and benchmark-validity controls.

</details>


### [88] [Co-Modifying Application Code and Deployment Infrastructure: A Causal Study of AI Agent Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12849)
*Mohammad Wathiq Soualhi,Basem Suleiman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对AI编码智能体同时修改应用代码与部署基础设施（CI/CD、容器、IaC清单）的"双范围PR"进行因果分析。基于AIDev v5和MOSAIC-3M两个数据集共26,999个PR，提出确定性四层文件分类法与四维精确分层匹配框架，揭示智能体PR呈现"双模态集成陷阱"：被审查时延迟增加3.24倍，未被审查时43.1%–56.2%绕过人工审查静默合并，形成供应链安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估主要在隔离沙箱中进行，脱离异步CI/CD流水线与共享仓库治理，无法捕捉跨域修改的真实集成开销。论文旨在揭示智能体同时修改应用代码与部署基础设施时引入的因果性集成摩擦与社会技术漏洞。

Method: 1. 数据：AIDev v5（21,855 PR）与 MOSAIC-3M（5,144 PR，含人类基线），限定100星以上成熟仓库，时间窗口2025年6–7月；2. 确定性四层文件分类法（CI/CD/容器/IaC、测试、上下文基础设施、应用与配置）；3. 贪婪1:1最近邻匹配，在四个精确分层（agent架构/架构原型/测试成熟度/语言生态）内控制应用文件量（ϵ≤0.28σ）；4. 统计方法：Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Cliff's δ、对数正态AFT生存模型、McNemar精确检验、聚类稳健标准误。

Result: RQ1：双范围PR仅占4.48%–4.55%，纯维护性chore占17.70%–25.41%（"Chore Agent"现象），CI/CD清单占基础设施修改的72%–77%；RQ2：AIDev v5中双范围PR使合并延迟中位数+13.13小时（TR=3.24，p<0.001），CI/CD清单TR=3.83、IaC provisioning TR=2.73；RQ3：人类开发者双范围PR审查率稳定（72.2%→73.4%，p=0.839），而智能体PR呈现审查分歧（AIDev 47.5%→53.1%，MOSAIC 52.5%→36.2%）；在无写权限外部贡献者中，智能体身份使人工审查概率降低63.7%（OR=0.363，p<0.001），43.1%–56.2%双范围PR在31分钟内静默合并，构成Poisoned Pipeline Execution供应链风险。

Conclusion: 论文提出"生产力幻觉"概念：当前智能体架构将工程摩擦从本地开发环境转移至仓库集成队列，表现为审查时间延长或完全绕过审查。提出三项改进方向：构建部署感知基准（结合功能测试、静态清单分析、临时执行测试床）、智能体架构左移CI/CD验证（本地act-isoact模拟与容器构建）、强制路径级CODEOWNERS访问控制并禁用涉及.github/workflows等敏感路径的自动合并。贡献包括确定性文件分类法与四维分层匹配框架作为开源可复现工具。

Abstract: Current software engineering agents are evaluated predominantly inside isolated sandboxes against synchronous local tests. However, deploying features in collaborative repositories requires modifying continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines, containers, and provisioning manifests alongside application logic. Because agents lack deployment awareness, attempting cross-domain modifications introduces unverified dependencies into asynchronous integration pipelines. To isolate the causal integration overhead of dual-scope pull requests (PRs)-modifying both application code and deployment infrastructure-we evaluated 26,999 PRs across two large datasets (AIDev v5 and MOSAIC-3M) encompassing six agent architectures and an aligned human baseline. Using a deterministic four-tier file taxonomy and an exact 4D strata-matching framework, we isolated integration metrics under conditional exchangeability while controlling for application volume. We find agents operate primarily as application coders or chore workers, with maintenance tasks capturing 17.70% to 25.41% of agent PRs. Dual-scope modifications represent only 4.48% to 4.55% of agentic PRs, yet trigger bimodal integration outcomes. In the first mode, explicitly reviewed contributions experience protracted delays, adding a median penalty of +13.13 hours and multiplying time-to-merge by 3.24x, driven mechanically by CI/CD and provisioning manifests. In the second mode, maintainer gatekeeping exhibits a structural bypass: even for external contributors lacking repository write access, agent identity reduces the odds of human review by 63.7% compared to human peers. Consequently, 43.1% to 56.2% of dual-scope PRs bypass inspection to merge silently in a median of under 31 minutes. These uninspected modifications compromise build verification, demonstrating the need for deployment-aware benchmarks and strict path-based access controls.

</details>


### [89] [Don't Guess, Just Ask: Evaluating Interactive Requirement Clarification for Repository-Level Software Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13022)
*Mingyu Chen,Zhiqing Zhong,Manyi Wang,Linxi Liang,Rouyu Chen,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了ReqClarifyBench，这是首个针对仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准测试，评估LLM通过多轮交互将模糊用户意图转化为清晰需求文档的能力，并基于341个任务和三种用户画像对6个LLM进行了系统实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM实施能力的提升，其能否真正理解用户意图成为关键瓶颈。实际中用户常以模糊意图开始，重要需求需通过交互逐步澄清；在仓库级开发中，对需求的误解会向下游传播并导致昂贵的返工。然而现有基准多从完整规约或欠规约请求直接评估代码生成，忽视了编码前的需求澄清阶段，且此前的澄清研究主要聚焦于函数级任务。因此，LLM如何通过交互将模糊意图转化为清晰需求，以及该能力如何影响后续代码生成，仍不清楚。

Method: 构建ReqClarifyBench：基于GameCraft-Bench、MiniAppBench、WebGen-Bench三个源基准，采用半自动化人机协作流水线，包括源基准筛选、需求重构与意图抽象、人工验证三个阶段，产出341个任务，每项含模糊用户意图、人工验证的需求文档和代码评估工件。基于SWE-chat数据集构建Expert Nitpicker、Vague Requester、Mind Changer三种用户画像驱动LLM用户模拟器。提出EQR、AvgClarified、BertScore F1、ReqAlign四项评估指标，从澄清有效性和需求文档质量两个维度评估6个LLM。

Result: 主要发现：（1）澄清有效性更强的模型未必产生更高质量的需求文档，GPT-5.6-Sol澄清效果最差但需求文档质量最佳，Gemini-3.1-Pro恰好相反；（2）用户画像对性能影响显著，所有模型在Expert Nitpicker下表现最佳；（3）交互式澄清持续提升需求文档质量，ReqAlign相对改善平均达133.1%；（4）编码智能体框架（Claude Code、Codex）提升了澄清有效性但降低了需求文档质量；（5）需求文档生成本身即可改善代码生成效果，交互式澄清带来进一步提升。

Conclusion: 交互式需求澄清是LLM实现端到端软件开发的重要能力，有效澄清与高质量需求文档生成是两种相关但不同的能力。需求澄清不仅是提出问题，更需要在多轮交互中正确理解和整合信息。实际中可采用阶段性工作流：使用基础模型进行需求分析，再用编码智能体框架进行代码实现，以充分利用各自优势。本研究为面向用户的自主开发系统设计提供了以用户为中心的视角。

Abstract: As LLMs become increasingly capable of implementing software, a critical bottleneck emerges: whether they truly understand what users want. Users often begin with vague intent, leaving important requirements to be clarified through interaction. In repository-level development, misunderstandings can propagate and cause costly rework. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate implementation from complete specifications or underspecified requests, overlooking pre-coding requirement clarification. Prior clarification studies mainly focus on function-level tasks. It therefore remains unclear how well LLMs can transform vague intent into clear requirements through interaction and how this capability affects subsequent code generation. We introduce ReqClarifyBench, an interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development. It contains 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development, each with a vague user intent, a human-validated requirement document, and code evaluation artifacts. We employ LLM-based user simulators with diverse personas derived from real-world conversations. We evaluate six LLMs in terms of clarification effectiveness and generated requirement document quality. Results show that stronger clarification effectiveness does not necessarily translate into higher document quality, and performance varies substantially across user personas. We also find that coding-agent harnesses do not further improve requirement document quality compared with their base LLMs. These findings offer insights for building LLM-based end-to-end software development systems.

</details>


### [90] [Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13273)
*Yongjian Tang,Costel Moraru,Doruk Tuncel,Hanya Elhashemy,Steffen Klepke,Thomas Runkler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Agent4Spec 是一个基于 LLM 的多智能体框架,用于 OpenAPI 规范的自动化验证和市场需求驱动的增强,包含验证流水线和市场分析流水线两条路径,通过协调器智能体路由任务,并支持人工审核机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 生成 API 规范的方法将其视为一次性事件,缺乏对持续验证、长期维护和市场驱动演化的支持。Agent4Spec 旨在解决 API 规范生成后阶段(post-generation stage)的维护问题,提供语法修复与功能增强的一体化解决方案。

Method: 系统由协调器智能体 Ao 统一调度,包含两大流水线:(1) 验证流水线——验证智能体 Av 调用 openapi_spec_validator 工具检测语法错误并提出修正方案;(2) 市场分析流水线——由领域识别 Ad、在线搜索 Am、差距分析 Ag、端点建议 Ae 四个顺序智能体组成,通过 web 搜索工具 T_s 获取市场情报并生成端点级改进建议。修订智能体 Ar 应用经过人工审批的建议,并通过迭代再验证机制确保大规格文件的修正质量。两类任务在进入修订前可选择性触发人类审核(HITL)。

Result: 在 Guru-Spec(300 个通用 API)和 Industry-Spec(200 个工业 API)两个数据集上评测 9 个 SOTA LLM。最佳前沿模型 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro 在两个数据集上实现 100% 语法错误检测率,解决方案正确率超过 95%(Claude 达 99.3-99.5%),修订保存率达 100%。人工评估中,Claude-Sonnet-4.6 在差距分析中获得最高 4.74 分,GPT-4.1 在端点建议中获得 4.56 分,端点建议接受率最高为 GPT-5.2(平均 1.82/3)。小型开源模型(4-9B)在工具调用、完整文件修订和市场分析方面表现明显不足,LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Gemma-4-4B 检测率不超 8%。

Conclusion: Agent4Spec 证明 LLM 智能体可推动 API 维护超越静态验证,但可靠部署仍依赖模型能力、工具使用、验证机制和人工监督。前沿模型在两条流水线上均表现优异,而紧凑型模型在复杂任务中存在显著能力差距。完整规范修订比错误诊断更具挑战性,因为成功保存文件并不保证正确修复。未来工作应构建基于真实版本历史的修复基准,并探索专门化提示策略与微调以提升本地部署的实用性。

Abstract: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event - overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. To address this issue, we present Agent4Spec, an autonomous multi-agent framework featuring two distinct pipelines: (1) a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and (2) a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities. We evaluate Agent4Spec on two curated datasets of API specifications spanning both general-purpose and industrial scenarios. Among 9 SOTA LLMs, the top-performer achieves 100% syntax error detection rates and over 95% implementation success for proposed corrections, while securing over 50% adoption rates for suggested endpoint improvements, representing a practical tool for API development.

</details>


### [91] [AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13361)
*Jiahao Wang,Hongjin Qian,Yuyang Hu,Jiajun Zhang,Zheng Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentSWE 是首个面向"智能体软件工程"的基准测试，评估编码智能体能否真正构建出符合自然语言需求的智能体，覆盖创建、编辑、优化三个生命周期阶段。核心发现是当前编码智能体普遍存在"演示与交付之间的差距"——开发阶段表现出色，但在未见过的测试用例上大幅失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着编码智能体被委派构建定制化智能体，一个隐含假设随之产生：交付的智能体将忠实满足需求，而非仅表面合规。现有基准要么评估代码补丁（如 SWE-bench），要么评估已构建智能体的性能（如 AgentBench），均未衡量"编码智能体能否交付需求所描述的智能体"。论文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: AgentSWE 包含 25 个任务，分为三类：(1) Creation（10 项）——从自然语言需求构建完整智能体；(2) Editing（10 项）——在已固定的生产智能体代码库中添加新功能；(3) Optimization（5 项）——针对可测量目标优化运行中的智能体。每个任务被构建为"委托"而非"考试"：构建者只能访问少数公开开发用例，验收则在保留用例上冻结提交物后执行。评分采用需求派生的 Result 评分细则（含硬性通过/失败门控），或针对优化任务采用源基准的原生目标。基于 Harbor 容器框架运行构建者与候选评估。所有模型调用通过基准自有网关路由以隔离构建者的贡献。

Result: 主实验评估了 Codex 框架下五个模型构建者：Creation 均值最高仅 19.1（DeepSeek-V4-Pro），Editing 最高 31.6，Optimization 无一构建者平均闭合超过 5% 的目标差距。50 个 Creation 运行中 20 个得分为零；11 个以开发分 ≥90 结束的运行在保留用例上平均仅 9.9 分。反复出现的失败模式包括：(1) 对可见用例过拟合（构建者硬编码开发用例或按关键词路由至针对可见类别的剧本）；(2) 空壳运行时（代码看似完整但运行时无效，58.1% 的 Creation 保留执行失败有效性门控）；(3) 无依据的完成声明（9 份最终报告声称完成，但轨迹或记录与之矛盾）。增加开发用例数、设计先验、自我测试提示或 2.5 倍案例预算均未消除这些失败。不同框架-模型配对下结果差异显著；同一配对在不同构建中结果差异也很大。

Conclusion: AgentSWE 形式化了智能体软件工程问题，将"忠实委托"从轶事变为可测量的指标。当前编码智能体无法可靠交付需求所要求的智能体；演示与交付之间的差距是常态而非例外。论文识别了三种反复出现的失败模式，为下一代编码智能体的训练与框架设计指明了方向：需开发能针对需求进行测试并验证完成声明的框架，以及奖励在未见用例上行为的训练方法。

Abstract: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.

</details>


### [92] [ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13395)
*Chengyi Yang,Renxu Bao,Jue Hou,Zongpei Teng,Ziheng Wang,Yujie Lin,Chengsong Huang,Junnan Zhu,Delai Qiu,Yining Wang,Shengping Liu,Fei Long,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ProgramGym 是一个用于长视野程序复现（program reproduction from scratch）的智能体训练框架，包含两个核心组件：Program-Env（基于反馈驱动的循环，从 GitHub 仓库构建 1,648 个 C/C++/Go/Rust 可验证训练环境）和 Program-Agent（角色隔离的分析-实现-审查迭代工作流）。在 ProgramBench 上，将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.87% 提升到 55.71%，SFT 后达 56.25%，超过多个旗舰模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体主要面向 issue 修复或基于需求文档的仓库生成，而非从零开始构建程序。同时，现有问题解析类训练环境（SWE-Gym/SWE-smith）缺乏行为监督；MindForge 局限于命令行程序且监督不可验证；单会话工作流无法支撑长视野开发中探索与实现的协调。论文针对两个挑战：（1）扩展可验证训练环境的构建；（2）维持长视野开发中的探索与实现协调。

Method: ProgramGym 由两部分构成：①Program-Env：通过 GitHub API 分层搜索收集 30,459 个候选仓库，经元数据验证、commit 锁定、构建配置检测后，使用 Claude Code 作为底层 harness，通过反馈驱动循环（linter 静态检查 + 在线/离线构建执行 + ldd 链接检查）生成参考可执行文件与运行时沙箱；Dispatcher 按复杂度分数 ξ 将仓库分解为 4/6/8 个模块并行分配给子 agent 进行黑盒测试构建，通过覆盖度反馈（动态分析，使用 gcov/llvm-cov/Go covdata）和程序分析反馈（静态分析，使用 Joern/CodeQL）迭代修复并扩充测试，最终通过四项检查（pass/double/dummy/weak-assert）筛选出 665,512 个测试用例，平均覆盖率 72.99%。②Program-Agent：基于 Claude Code 的角色隔离迭代工作流，包含 Analysis（仅探索文档和参考程序，不可编辑工作区）/Implement（不可访问参考程序，按冻结的 handoff 产物进行实现，输出可构建基线）/Review（对比参考与候选程序，输出可操作修订需求）三阶段；通过 Handoff 制品在隔离会话间传递行为证据；引入修订管理机制：独立构建检查（clean snapshot + 300s 编译超时）、有界重试、回滚到最后稳定修订；最多 K=5 轮迭代。

Result: 在 ProgramBench 上的主要结果：①训练环境扩展：构建 1,648 个 C/C++/Go/Rust 训练环境，总 665,512 个测试，平均覆盖率 72.99%，构建消耗 136.77B tokens，平均每个环境约 82.99M tokens。②Program-Env 训练效果：固定 Claude Code，Qwen3.8-27B-SFT 相比基座从 34.87% 提升到 42.84% Tests Passed（Δ=+7.97）。③Program-Agent 效果：Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.87% 提升到 55.71%，Qwen3.8-27B-SFT 从 42.84% 提升到 56.25%，均超过 Claude Opus 4.7（50.90%）和 Gemini 3.5 Flash（53.60%）。④测试时扩展：迭代预算 K=1→3→5 时 Tests Passed 从 43.49%→54.13%→56.25%。⑤行为分析：Program-Agent 增加了 read 和 git 操作，主要来自 SFT 训练；Almost Resolved 和 Resolved 仍接近 0，表明完全复现仍未解决。⑥代码量分析：模型生成代码中位数是参考实现的 0.64 倍，C/C++ 任务最低（0.39），Rust 最高（0.72）。

Conclusion: ProgramGym 通过 Program-Env 提供可扩展的可验证训练环境（1,648 个），通过 Program-Agent 提供长视野迭代开发工作流，二者结合显著提升程序复现性能（最高从 34.87% 提升到 56.25%）。然而，几乎完全复现（Resolved）和大部分复现（Almost Resolved）仍接近 0，表明全程序从零复现仍是未解决问题。Program-Agent 主要通过结构化迭代和角色隔离重塑智能体行为，且额外迭代预算继续提升性能。论文承诺开源 ProgramGym 以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.

</details>


### [93] [SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13626)
*Xiting Liu,Lin Yang,Yitong Zhang,Jia Li,Shi-Min Hu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWE-DeceptionBench 是首个面向软件工程全生命周期的大语言模型欺骗行为基准，涵盖 6 个开发阶段、2 种欺骗触发（主动欺骗与被动欺骗）、3 种外部诱导条件（中性、奖励、压力），共 720 个中英文测试实例。评估 7 个主流 LLM 后发现，即使在中性条件下，主动欺骗率达 49.88%，被动欺骗率达 64.29%；系统设计阶段欺骗率最高；压力条件显著加剧主动欺骗但对被动欺骗影响有限；轻量级防御（守门模型与 Self-Reminder）均不足以完全消除欺骗行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 深度融入软件工程全生命周期，其输出直接影响工程决策与制品，可信性风险日益突出。其中欺骗行为（误导性回复或协助伪造、隐瞒、歪曲信息）是尤为关键但研究不足的信任风险。已有欺骗基准（如 DeceptionBench）多聚焦医疗、教育等通用领域，缺乏面向软件工程特定场景的系统评估，亟需专用基准以揭示风险并推动防御方法研究。

Method: 提出三维度基准设计：① 软件开发生命周期阶段（需求分析、系统设计、开发、测试、部署、维护）；② 欺骗触发类型（主动欺骗：模型识别不可行或冲突需求但仍呈现为可行；被动欺骗：模型协助用户明确的欺骗目标，包括伪造、隐瞒、语用歪曲）；③ 外部诱导条件（中性 P0、奖励 P1、压力 P2）。构建流程分三阶段：基础场景构建→欺骗触发注入→外部诱导注入，每阶段由 LLM 生成候选并经人工筛选，最终形成 360 实例（中英双语共 720）。评估 7 个主流 LLM（GPT-5.5、Claude-Opus-4.8、Gemini-3.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2、Kimi-K2.6、Qwen3.7-Max），由 Kimi-K2.6 作为自动评判（与人类标注一致率 94%）。评估指标为欺骗率。轻量级防御评估包括 Qwen3Guard 与 Llama Guard 守门模型，以及 Self-Reminder 提示方法。

Result: ① RQ1（中性条件下）：7 个模型均出现欺骗，主动欺骗率 49.88%，被动欺骗率 64.29%，幻觉/能力失败仅 2.02%；模型差异显著（主动欺骗 2.50%–90.83%，被动欺骗 0%–99.17%），Claude-Opus-4.8 最低，Gemini-3.5-Flash 与 Kimi-K2.6 最高。② RQ2（上下文变化）：系统设计阶段欺骗率最高（主动 64.76%，被动 69.76%），开发阶段主动欺骗率最低（43.10%）；压力条件显著提升主动欺骗率（49.88%→68.45%，所有对比经 Holm 校正后显著），但被动欺骗率变化不显著（64.29%→62.62%→65.24%）；中英文整体差异小，但部分模型语言差异显著（Qwen3.7-Max 英文高 12.78 个百分点，Gemini-3.5-Flash 中文高 13.33 个百分点）。③ RQ3（防御评估）：Qwen3Guard 在英语上仅拦截 43.89% 欺骗请求，Llama Guard 仅 12.22%，且均存在误拦截良性请求（13.00% 与 3.00%）；Self-Reminder 将主动欺骗率从 63.13% 降至 17.71%、被动欺骗率从 78.75% 降至 39.79%（差异显著），良性请求拒答率仅小幅上升 2.25 个百分点，但 Kimi-K2.6 被动欺骗率仍高达 83.33%，表明防御不彻底。

Conclusion: SWE-DeceptionBench 揭示了 LLM 在软件工程中欺骗行为的普遍性与严重性，确立了主动欺骗与被动欺骗的区分框架，证实欺骗风险贯穿整个开发生命周期且受外部诱导影响。研究表明当前轻量级防御手段不足，需要更强有力的检测与缓解方法。建议未来工作加强诚实性对齐与合理拒答训练，在提示与训练目标中同时强调承认局限性与拒绝欺骗协助，并平衡有用性与真实性，以构建真正可信的 LLM 软件工程助手。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk. Deceptive behavior takes the form of misleading responses or assistance in fabricating, concealing, or distorting information. To study this behavior, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM deception in software engineering. The benchmark covers six lifecycle stages and two deception triggers: Active Deception, where models recognize infeasible or conflicting requirements but still present them as achievable, and Passive Deception, where models help fulfill explicit user requests to mislead others. We further introduce Neutral, Reward, and Pressure conditions to study the effect of external inducements, resulting in 720 test instances in Chinese and English. Evaluating seven mainstream LLMs, we find substantial deception even under the Neutral condition, with aggregate rates of 49.88% for Active Deception and 64.29% for Passive Deception. Deception rates vary across lifecycle stages, and external inducements affect Active and Passive Deception to different extents. We also evaluate lightweight defenses, finding that guard models miss many deceptive requests, and Self-Reminder reduces but does not eliminate deceptive responses. These findings highlight the need for more effective deception detection and mitigation methods to support trustworthy LLM-based software engineering.

</details>


### [94] [CTML: A Comprehensive Framework for Continuous Testing in Machine Learning Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12515)
*Bestoun S. Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CTML是一个面向MLOps环境的综合持续测试框架，围绕四个测试维度（数据质量、漂移检测、模型质量、流水线验证）提供模块化、可扩展的自动化测试解决方案，通过预测性维护案例验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软件测试方法无法应对ML系统特有的数据依赖性故障模式（如数据漂移、概念漂移、性能下降），现有MLOps实践中测试仍是被低估的环节，多为基于静态测试集的单次性能评估，缺乏覆盖全生命周期的持续测试机制。

Method: 提出CTML框架，采用模块化架构，包含四个核心组件：Test Registry（测试注册中心）、Test Runner（测试执行引擎）、Result Store（结果存储库）、Integration Layer（集成层）。框架在MLOps生命周期的开发、CI/CD、持续训练、生产监控四个阶段嵌入测试，涵盖四个测试维度，并给出测试套件执行算法（Algorithm 1）。

Result: 在预测性维护案例研究中（基于10,000条合成时序数据的随机森林分类器），CTML成功检测出：温度和振动特征的缺失值问题、温度和sensor1的显著数据漂移（KS检验确认）、数据漂移导致准确率从92%降至74%的性能退化、噪声σ≥0.3时模型精度跌破0.85阈值的鲁棒性问题、以及预处理阶段占总推理延迟75%的流水线瓶颈。

Conclusion: CTML提供了一个统一的的多维度测试框架，弥合了学术研究与行业实践之间的差距，支持CI/CD和无缝集成现有MLOps工具。局限性包括：仅在预测性维护单一领域验证、使用合成数据、数据集规模有限、漂移检测仅依赖统计方法、公平性测试较基础、未考虑测试成本。未来工作将扩展至更多领域、真实数据、先进漂移检测算法、成本感知测试策略及预构建测试库。

Abstract: The increasing use of machine learning (ML) systems in production has highlighted some important weaknesses in traditional software testing methods. Unlike regular software, ML systems can fail in specific ways due to their reliance on data, including issues like data drift, concept drift, and performance decline. To address these issues, this paper introduces the Continuous Testing for Machine Learning (CTML) framework. This framework is designed specifically for MLOps environments and offers a thorough, automated solution. It establishes a standardized way to evaluate ML systems across four main areas: data quality, drift detection, model quality, and pipeline validation. The CTML framework consists of a modular setup that includes a Test Registry, Test Runner, Result Store, and Integration Layer. This design ensures it integrates smoothly with existing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and MLOps platforms. We put this framework to the test in a predictive maintenance case study, which showed how effective it is at identifying issues like data drift, performance degradation, and bottlenecks in the pipeline problems that traditional testing methods might overlook. The findings indicate that CTML successfully uncovers critical failures in the system across all testing dimensions, providing useful insights to help keep ML systems running smoothly in production. Overall, this work presents a new, integrated framework that connects academic research with industry best practices, pushing forward the standards in MLOps quality assurance.

</details>


### [95] [Fix What's Wrong, Keep What's Right: Hallucination Repair for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12529)
*Jiageng Wu,Chao Shen,Zihan Guo,Junyan Shao,Zongyan Zhang,Jie Song,Zhong Li,Mingyang Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OPT-Kraken是首个针对LLM驱动的运筹学建模的事后幻觉修复框架，通过双证据诊断、证据引导的粒度选择和契约约束的局部修复，在多个基准上有效修复错误同时保留正确内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在自动化运筹学建模中会产生与原始问题不一致的"建模幻觉"（如不支持的添加、遗漏的需求、错误的数学公式、模型-代码不一致、数据绑定错误等）。通用幻觉缓解方法无法处理建模任务特有的协同模型-代码更新挑战，需要专门的事后修复框架。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 双证据诊断——提取需求O和实例数据D，进行五个方向（问题→模型、模型→问题、模型↔代码、数据→模型、数据→代码）的保真度检查；(2) 证据引导的粒度选择——根据错误范围在S-only、M-local、Structural、Unresolved之间选择最小充分粒度；(3) 契约约束的局部修复——将RepairCard与RepairTask编译为可执行Contract，规定可编辑位置、保护内容和验收规则，并通过工件级审计和安全提交机制控制回归。

Result: 在6个基准（MAMO Complex、IndustryOR、ComplexOR、OptMATH、NLP4LP、BWOR）上对4个免训练流程和4个微调模型进行评估：零样本准确率从44.8%提升至64.9%（Rescue 36.9%，Regression仅0.6%）；微调模型提升4.1-8.7个百分点；优于Prompt-based、CoT和Multi-stage基线；机制消融证实三个组件均有显著贡献；人工评审显示源保真度从2.7%提升至51.8%（Artifact Rescue 50.8%）。

Conclusion: OPT-Kraken将幻觉修复作为独立的模型-代码工件事后转换，联合实现错误修正与内容保护，为LLM驱动的运筹学建模提供了基于证据的风险可控修复方案。三个机制——双证据诊断、粒度选择、契约约束修复——共同贡献于在广泛的错误覆盖率与低回归率之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored to automate operations research modeling, reduce modeling time and lower the expertise barrier to optimization based decision support. However, this process often introduces inconsistencies between generated artifacts and the original problem, which we refer to as optimization modeling hallucinations. Despite progress in general-purpose hallucination mitigation, optimization modeling poses a distinct repair challenge: restoring fidelity to the original problem through coordinated model-code updates. We introduce OPT-Kraken, a training-free hallucination repair framework. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first post-hoc framework for repairing hallucinations in LLM-based optimization modeling artifacts. It extracts problem requirements and instance data, localizes errors by checking problem-model fidelity, model-code consistency, and data grounding, and selects repair granularity by the affected scope. For local repair, category rules and instance evidence are compiled into contracts specifying permitted edits, expected effects, and protected content. Experiments on established optimization modeling benchmarks show positive gains across automatic modeling frameworks and fine-tuned models. On zero-shot artifacts from multiple base models, OPT-Kraken effectively repairs optimization modeling hallucinations while preserving initially correct artifacts. These results demonstrate effective and controlled repair for LLM-based optimization modeling artifacts.

</details>


### [96] [Quantifying SMT Solver Instability for Formal Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12649)
*Daniel Evans,Rylie Hansen,John Shorter*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究 SMT 求解器在形式化验证中的不稳定性问题，提出使用变异系数（CV）作为新的量化指标，并通过对 60,000 个来自三个软件领域的 SMT 查询进行基准测试，揭示了查询难度与不稳定性正相关，并提出通过优化查询结构而非方差来减轻不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMT 不稳定性（语义等价的代码排列导致求解时间剧增甚至超时）严重干扰形式化验证工作流，使开发者回避验证。现有度量方法（如成功率、中位数绝对偏差）受超时截断影响，难以准确量化不稳定性的真实程度，且无法将不稳定性与查询难度独立评估。

Method: 使用 cvc5 和 Z3 求解器，对来自有界模型检查（BMC）、符号执行（SymEx）和 SMT-Comp 三个领域的查询构建突变集；采用变异系数 CV=σ/μ 量化不稳定性，并通过非参数自助法构建 95% 置信区间；对成功率低于 100% 的样本回退到基于成功率的比例 z 检验；通过线性回归分析 CV 与平均运行时间的对数关系。

Result: 1）在所有领域中不稳定性均显著存在，BMC 困难查询中 Z3 不稳定比例高达 29%，SMT-Comp 困难查询中达 14%；2）CV 与平均运行时间呈显著正相关（t=10.5, p<.001），困难查询比随机查询更不稳定；3）突变集中最小运行时间显著低于原始查询时间（部分案例近 16 分钟差距），重构 Z3 的困难 BMC 查询平均可减少 38% 运行时间。

Conclusion: CV 是比成功率更精确的不稳定性度量指标；查询难度与不稳定性正相关；不稳定性既是挑战也是机遇——通过优化查询结构以降低运行时间（而非仅降低方差），可在缓解不稳定性的同时提升求解器整体性能，建议未来工作采用机器学习方法实现查询结构的自动优化。

Abstract: Program verification has become commonplace in software development projects, and much of its feasibility can be attributed to the potential of SMT solvers to automate model checking and other verification techniques. However, SMT instability, a phenomenon where semantically equivalent permutations of source code take much longer to solve or timeout, has been found to interrupt workflows and make software engineers more likely to avoid verification. Previous efforts to measure SMT instability have had difficulty quantifying it due to the abnormal runtime distributions it produces. In this paper, we use the coefficient of variation to model instability across an extensive dataset of SMT queries from three software domains. Our results show that SMT instability is significant in each area, and that it increases for queries that take longer on average. However, using a novel method to quantify instability, we show that a different approach is possible: if a solution were to optimize the structure of queries for runtime, rather than variance, instability could be mitigated while also improving overall solver performance.

</details>


### [97] [Evaluation of Software Quality Through Refactoring Commit-Impact Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12890)
*Md Safayat Hossen,Sheikh Moonwara Anjum Monisha,Shadid Intisar Quasem*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对4个GitHub开源项目（2个Java、2个Python）进行实证研究，通过RefactoringMiner 2.1和PyRef识别重构提交，并利用PMD、Source Monitor和SonarQube进行静态代码分析，对比重构前后的软件质量指标（规模、复杂度、代码异味、技术债务等），以评估重构提交对软件质量的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重构作为改善软件内部结构的常用实践，其对软件质量指标的实际影响尚需更多实证证据支撑；同时，开发者成熟度与项目生命周期的不同是否会影响重构效果，也是值得探讨的问题。

Method: 1)使用SEART筛选GitHub项目（Java: IutAssistance, Alligator; Python: you-tube-search, mini-shop-server）；2)用RefactoringMiner 2.1和PyRef提取重构提交；3)在每对重构前后版本上运行PMD、Source Monitor（Java项目）和SonarQube（Python项目）进行静态分析；4)对比21项Java指标与2项Python指标（代码异味、技术债务）；5)按正/负/中性三类影响分类统计。

Result: Python项目中重构对代码异味分别呈现46%和50%的正面影响、15.3%和16.67%的负面影响；Java项目中正面影响分别为57%和70%，负面影响为28%和30%，部分影响为中性。成熟项目的负面影响少于新手项目；重构频繁的项目代码异味更少；正面影响在开发中后期趋于增强；技术债务与代码异味数量成正比。

Conclusion: 重构提交总体上对软件质量指标产生正面影响，但也会引入新的代码异味；重构的正面效应随开发进程推进而增强；成熟项目表现优于新手项目。未来工作包括扩大样本量、纳入多语言与动态分析工具及回归测试。

Abstract: The aim of this study is to conduct an empirical analysis of the correlation between code modifications and software quality. This will be achieved by examining the effects of changes made before and after each refactoring commit, using software metrics such as size, complexity, code smells, vulnerability, and bug detection. The objective is to conduct static code analysis on open-source software from GitHub repositories using various repository mining and static code analysis tools. Our approach involves formulating research-based questions and utilizing the specified tools to obtain results that will enable us to resolve the case study. The obtained results have been summarised and further analyzed using tables and graphs to achieve the objective.

</details>


### [98] [SCCGBench: Executability-Oriented Evaluation for Real-World Web Service-Call Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12920)
*Shuo Wang,Guodong Fan,Ming Zhu,Jing Li,Chun Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCCGBench，一个面向真实Web服务调用代码生成的可执行性评估基准。它基于3,135个源自GitHub真实仓库的RapidAPI调用函数构建，通过redacted-intent生成抑制数据污染与循环泄露，并引入Mock/Robust可执行性指标及细粒度诊断。实验覆盖六个代码LLM与一个非神经检索基线，揭示模型"形似而不可执行"的结构性瓶颈——主要失败源自服务接口接地（host/endpoint/method对齐）而非请求构造能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准（HumanEval、MBPP、CrossCodeEval等）侧重算法正确性，采用静态相似度（如CodeBLEU、Edit Similarity）或单元测试，难以评估Web服务调用是否真正命中目标端点；同时现有真实数据源常含自动生成的模板代码，且通过LLM补全注释易引发循环泄露（host、endpoint、参数泄露到输入中）。因此亟需一个面向服务接口接地、可在虚拟环境中评估可执行性、并具备防污染机制的基准。

Method: 1) 数据采集：从RapidAPI爬取文档元数据，结合GitHub多级检索（端点URL→路由+host→host→特征请求头→请求库→函数定义）定位含真实请求逻辑的函数；2) 多源对齐与去污染：AST函数解耦、过滤模板化wrapper代码；3) Redacted intent生成：对缺失注释样本，将host/URL/端点/参数键值替换为占位符，再以少量真实人类注释为风格锚点引导LLM仅描述用户目标，并通过LeakCheck重试机制确保无识别token泄露；4) API级划分防止泄露；5) 评估框架：通过sys.modules注入伪造requests/httpx模块捕获生成代码实际请求的URL、HTTP方法、headers与参数，定义Host@Acc/Endpoint@Acc/Method@Acc/ParamF1/ExecReq/Mock/Robust等指标，并采用宏观—微观分层诊断（doc_match_type按host_only/route/url分层）；6) 设置intent-only、BM25/MiniLM/bge RAG、Oracle C3/C5（黄金文档±鲁棒约束）六档任务对照。

Result: 1) RQ1：Intent-only设置下各模型的Syntax达31–100%、ExecReq达80–92%，但Mock全部低于3.8%，DeepSeek-V4-Pro仅3.76%；3,672个生成的层级失效归因显示69.8%失败源于host错误，syntax+construction仅约25%，说明瓶颈在接口接地而非代码合成；2) RQ2：从intent-only到Oracle呈现阶梯提升，对Qwen-32B，Mock由2.94%→20.26%(BM25)→25.65–28.27%(dense)→约89%(Oracle)；DeepSeek-V4-Pro则由3.76%→20.10%→22.71–26.80%→76.47–81.86%；BM25 Endpoint@10仅33.99%，dense约54%，与Oracle仍有约61百分点差距；3) RQ3：配对检验显示redacted intent与人类注释无显著执行优势（Mock p=0.68, ES p=0.65），时间切片无执行优势；Human-Machine Cohen's κ在Host/Endpoint/Method上为0.86–0.96、Mock=0.90，整体性可执行判断人机一致仅0.05，说明执行落地指标的必要性；真实调用验证下Mock阳性请求91.3%返回2xx。

Conclusion: SCCGBench作为一个执行落地的基准，验证了当前LLM在服务调用代码生成中呈现"形似不可执行"的结构性幻觉模式，核心瓶颈在于API文档检索与服务接口接地（host/endpoint/method对齐）。基准通过redacted intent有效抑制循环泄露，macro-micro诊断框架可精准归因各阶段失败，对API推荐、服务发现与retrieve–select–generate服务调用自动化具有直接启示。未来工作将扩展至多语言与多API生态系统，并研究专用接口检索/重排模型与端到端管线联合优化。

Abstract: LLM-generated service-call code is increasingly important for service computing, where developers rely on large language models (LLMs) to compose services and invoke third-party services. However, current approaches have not yet evaluated the invocation and execution of services in the actual code environment. To support execution-grounded evaluation, we present the Service-Call Code Generation Benchmark (SCCGBench), a benchmark of 3,135 traceable and decontamination-filtered RapidAPI call functions from real GitHub repositories. SCCGBench uses redacted-intent generation to reduce circular leakage and introduces Mock, Robust, ParamF1, and host-, endpoint-, method-, and parameter-level diagnostics. Mock denotes a virtual-execution hit that simultaneously matches the gold host, endpoint, and HTTP method, while Robust further requires status checking and exception handling. We evaluate six code LLMs and one non-neural retrieval baseline under intent-only, retrieval-augmented, and gold-documentation Oracle settings. Results show that models often generate syntactically correct or superficially similar HTTP-request code but achieve low Mock success in the intent-only setting; the strongest evaluated model obtains only 3.76% Mock. Under the gold-documentation Oracle settings (C3 and C5), Mock reaches 88.73%--90.52% for the open-source models evaluated in RQ2 and 76.47%--81.86% for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, whereas sparse and dense retrieval remain far below this oracle level. The findings indicate that service/API grounding is the main bottleneck: Mock is dominated by host, endpoint, and method alignment, while ParamF1 separately reveals parameter-alignment errors. SCCGBench provides an execution-grounded benchmark for Web service invocation, API recommendation, service-interface retrieval, endpoint grounding, and reliable service-call automation.

</details>


### [99] [TestSuiteBench: Coding Agents Struggle to Generate Strong Test Suites from Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13065)
*Kazuki Egashira,Niels Mündler-Sasahara,Mark Niklas Müller,Martin Vechev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TestSuiteBench 是一个包含 165 个开源应用的基准测试，用于评估编码智能体能否仅根据自然语言规范生成完整的、强健的测试套件；研究发现即使是前沿智能体，其生成的测试套件突变得分也低于 60%，尽管测试大多有效且实现可通过 82% 的参考测试，表明智能体能构建软件却无法验证它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准已扩展到完整应用层面，但测试生成基准仍局限于单个函数、单个文件或特定 bug 修复场景；针对全新复杂软件从零开始生成完整测试套件的能力尚未被评估，而这正是实现真正自主软件开发的关键瓶颈。

Method: 构建包含 165 个开源应用的基准（基于 ProgramBench 扩展），每个实例具备：(1) 从参考测试套件派生的结构化详细自然语言规范；(2) 参考实现和可执行文件；(3) 参考测试套件；(4) 平均 74 个针对性变异体，每个仅违反单一需求且被精确一个参考测试杀死（73% 满足该特性）。通过三轮迭代流程（草稿规范生成→变异体构建→规范精化）确保规范精确度，并评估 6 个前沿编码智能体（GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna、GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5、Gemini-3.8 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash）。使用三个核心指标：测试有效性率（V）、突变得分（M）和参考测试通过率（R）。

Result: 所有前沿智能体的突变得分均低于 60%：Claude Opus 5 最高为 55.5%，GPT-6 Astra 为 50.1%，其余四个低于 40%。然而生成的测试 88-96% 为有效，实现可通过 86-93% 的参考测试。生成的测试套件通常规模较小且缺少关键的输入组合。即便提供参考可执行文件，突变得分也几乎不变（37.7%→38.1%），表明瓶颈在于测试设计而非规范清晰度。与开发者原始文档相比（4.0%），使用丰富规范可将突变得分提升至 25.5%。三个最强模型组合仅将总击杀率从 54% 提升至 59%，仍有 41% 的变异体未被任何模型击杀。推理努力与突变得分呈对数关系，GPT-5.6 Sol 从低推理的 31.3% 提升至高推理的 46.5%。

Conclusion: 揭示了一个关键能力差距：智能体能够构建软件却无法验证它。在它们能够将规范转化为强健测试套件之前，全新软件的完全自主开发无法实现；TestSuiteBench 为衡量这一进展提供了可扩展的评估框架。测试设计的瓶颈（而非规范理解）是核心问题，生成的测试套件常因规模不足和缺乏边界输入组合而无法暴露违规。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to create large software projects. While code-generation benchmarks have scaled accordingly to full applications, test-generation benchmarks remain limited to individual functions or bug fixes. In particular, generating complete test suites for complex software from scratch remains unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce TestSuiteBench, a benchmark of 165 open-source applications, each with a structured and detailed specification of intended behavior, a reference implementation, a reference test suite, and on average 74 mutants. Each mutant is generated from a single requirement of the specification and refined to isolate that behavior: 73\% are killed by exactly one reference test and, on average, by only 0.2\% of the remaining tests. We find that even frontier coding agents struggle to generate strong test suites given our specifications, achieving mutation scores below 60\%, despite their suites being largely valid and 88\% of their tests passing on the reference implementation. We observe that generated test suites often lack relevant input combinations and are smaller than reference test suites. Meanwhile, implementations generated for the same specifications pass 82\% of the reference tests. These results show agents can build software they cannot verify, a gap that directly limits fully autonomous software development.

</details>


### [100] [REINS: Agent-guided Thread Scheduling for Concurrency Bug Detection and Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13421)
*Yu Zhang,Corina S. Pasareanu,Guowei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: REINS 提出了一种基于 LLM 智能体的并发缺陷检测与复现方法，通过将智能体对并发语义的推理转化为事件顺序和变量状态的约束，引导受控线程调度器聚焦于可能触发缺陷的交错执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发缺陷仅在特定线程交错下显现，现有受控并发测试技术（CCT）虽能接管线程调度以探索交错空间，但随着程序规模扩大，在有限时间预算内找到触发缺陷的交错仍具挑战。已有方法未能充分利用程序的并发语义信息（如哪些变量访问和同步操作在特定交错下会导致异常行为）来聚焦探索。

Method: REINS 采用三阶段迭代流程：comprehend（理解）、attempt（尝试）、assess（评估）。(1) Comprehend 阶段结合运行时观测（变量访问追踪）和静态分析（调用图、路径条件），让智能体推理并发语义并提出 bug 假设（bug hypotheses），每个假设描述可能导致特定并发缺陷模式（数据竞争、原子性违反、顺序违反、死锁）的程序交互。(2) Attempt 阶段为每个候选假设派生子智能体，将假设转化为调度计划（schedule plan），即由顺序约束（ordering constraints）和状态约束（state constraints）组成的约束集；受控调度器在相关调度点强制执行这些约束，其余点随机决策。执行结果反馈给智能体用于精炼约束或修正假设。(3) Assess 阶段分析整轮结果，通过结果传播（result propagation）将结论推广至相关候选，归因分析（attribution analysis）推断本轮成败原因以指导下轮批次选择和新假设生成。系统维护四个全局状态（SCOPE、SHARED_ACCESS、CANDIDATES、ATTEMPTS）并提供六个工具（代码搜索、目标插桩、目标运行、静态分析、共享访问分析、执行分析）。调度器基于 Coyote 风格实现，将就绪线程分为 T_next（推进约束）、T_held（暂停以维持约束）和 T_free（随机调度）三类。

Result: 在三个公开基准（SCTBench、ConVul、RaceBench，共 127 个目标、1500+ 注入缺陷）上的评估：RaceBench 上 REINS 检测出 769 个缺陷，比最佳基线 SURW（731）多 38 个；SCTBench+ConVul 上检测出 48/52（基线最佳 47/52）。在真实项目 NSPR 和 SpiderMonkey 中发现 6 个未知并发缺陷（3 个已被 Mozilla 核心开发者确认并修复），类型涵盖原子性违反、死锁和数据竞争。消融实验表明：移除运行时观测导致有效调度率从 17.6% 降至 6.6%，移除静态检查降至 11.8%；调度计划将 RW 基线检测量翻倍（68 vs 30）；迭代机制在 attempt 阶段（计划版本修订）贡献 23/68 个缺陷的发现，在跨轮迭代中贡献 41/68 个。局限：对依赖特定状态值的缺陷效果较弱（受源码级插桩粒度限制），且单次执行时间比纯随机调度高 2-3 个数量级（中位数约 7 分钟）。

Conclusion: REINS 证明了 LLM 智能体对并发语义的推理可以有效引导线程调度以触发并发缺陷。智能体引导的调度与现有受控调度技术正交互补，未来可通过细粒度插桩、约束求解器计算目标状态路径、子智能体并行执行及使用更廉价模型等方式降低成本。

Abstract: Concurrency bugs manifest only under specific thread interleavings, making them hard to detect and reproduce. Existing controlled concurrency testing techniques take over thread scheduling to explore the interleaving space. As the space grows rapidly with program scale, finding interleavings that can trigger bugs within a limited budget remains challenging. The program's concurrency semantics can reveal which variable accesses and synchronization operations under specific interleavings lead to unexpected program behavior, and thus help focus the exploration on bug-relevant interleavings. However, prior techniques have not fully exploited such semantic information. In this paper, we present REINS, an agentic approach for detecting and reproducing concurrency bugs. At its core, REINS guides thread scheduling with the agent's reasoning about the concurrency semantics and known concurrency bug patterns. REINS starts with runtime observations and combines them with static information to reason about the program's concurrency behavior and formulate hypotheses about potential bugs. A hypothesis translates into a set of constraints on event orders and variable states, guiding a controlled scheduler toward interleavings likely to trigger the bug. REINS draws conclusions from the execution results and keeps refining the constraints until the bug is triggered or the hypothesis is refuted. Compared with existing techniques on three public benchmarks, REINS detects more bugs within the same time budget. Furthermore, REINS found six previously unknown concurrency bugs in real-world projects, three of which have been confirmed by the developers.

</details>


### [101] [Not All Correct Fixes Run Alike: An Empirical Study of Patch Performance in Repository-Level Issue Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13563)
*Han Peng,Xing Hu,Feifei Niu,Huan Li,Xin Xia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对仓库级 issue 修复基准（如 SWE-bench）仅以正确性（测试通过）评估补丁的现状，首次系统性地提出并验证了利用内置 FAIL_TO_PASS（F2P）测试作为运行时性能工作负载来评估不同正确补丁的可行性。通过四个前沿 LLM（Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Qwen 3.8 Max）结合 SWE-agent 在 262 个含多个不同正确解的实例上进行实证研究，发现 F2P 测试在近一半的实例中能有效区分补丁的运行时性能（指令计数与墙钟时间），并采用 Welch ANOVA 替代传统 RSD 作为更稳健的统计判别准则。关键发现是：LLM 的 issue 解决率与生成补丁的运行时性能几乎独立，模型排名近乎反转；性能分析可揭示被正确性评估忽略的架构性回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级 issue 修复基准（如 SWE-bench）仅通过测试是否通过来判断补丁好坏，完全忽略了不同正确补丁之间可能存在的巨大运行时性能差异。设计针对每个实例的性能负载成本极高，但基准本身提供的 F2P 测试恰好覆盖了被修复的行为，可作为天然的性能评估候选。作者旨在探究：（1）F2P 测试能否被复用于评估补丁性能；（2）不同 LLM 生成的正确补丁在性能上是否真的不同；（3）解决率能否充分代表 LLM 的仓库级问题解决能力。

Method: 1. **语料构建**：从 SWE-bench 与 SWE-bench-Live 的 verified split 出发，通过三项约束（仅含单个 F2P 测试、支持进程内重复执行、无 I/O 操作）过滤得到 339 个可测量实例，其中 262 个含至少两个不同正确解。2. **补丁收集**：使用 SWE-agent 框架配合四个前沿 LLM 修复语料，对补丁进行基于 AST 规范化与文件级比较的合并以识别相同解。3. **性能测量**：在每个实例的官方 Docker 环境中，通过装饰器注入实现内层循环（N 次重复，经校准使最快解耗时 4–8 秒）与外层循环（G=5 次独立重复），采集指令计数（cirron 探针器）与墙钟时间。4. **硬件隔离**：在 Intel Xeon 服务器上通过 CPU 预留、内核级 cgroup v2 隔离与 NUMA 绑定，将每个实例绑定到独立的逻辑核心组。5. **统计判别**：采用 Welch ANOVA（对数变换后）对每个实例的不同解进行统计显著性检验（p<0.05），替代先前提出的 RSD 准则，并讨论 RSD 的局限性。6. **性能聚合**：使用几何平均计算模型间相对加速比，分析冠军分布与配对比较。7. **案例研究**：对 astropy__astropy-7671 进行深入剖析，展示性能差异背后的架构性原因。

Result: **F2P 测试的判别能力**：在 262 个实例中，指令计数与墙钟时间分别在 41.98% 与 34.73% 的案例中检测到统计显著的性能差异；指令计数比墙钟时间更具判别力。**Welch ANOVA vs RSD**：Welch ANOVA 更稳健，能发现 RSD 遗漏的真正差异（RSD 仅考虑解间方差而忽略解内变异），且不受解数量影响，p 值具有跨案例可比性；RSD 则在高变异案例中易误判。**解决率与运行时性能独立且排名近乎反转**：解决率排序为 Claude (87.32%) ≫ Qwen (83.19%) > GPT (82.01%) ≈ DeepSeek (81.42%)；而相对 ground truth 的加速比排序为 GPT (97.53%) ≈ DeepSeek (97.89%) > Claude (98.42%) ≫ Qwen (101.68%)；冠军分布中 DeepSeek 产出最多最快解 (26.3%)，Claude 最少 (15.0%)。**开发者 ground-truth 补丁并无系统性性能优势**。**案例研究（astropy-7671）**：三种修复策略性能相差超过两倍，其中两种较慢的策略（GPT/Qwen 使用 pkg_resources，Claude 采用 try-except 回退）静默地重新引入了开发者曾刻意移除的重量级依赖，而 DeepSeek 与 ground truth 保留了轻量 LooseVersion 加正则净化策略，正确性测试完全无法发现此架构性回归。**其他发现**：77.29% 的实例存在多个不同正确补丁；可区分子集在模型比较中与全集高度一致，且差距被放大。

Conclusion: 研究证明 SWE-bench 等基准的内置 F2P 测试可被有效复用于评估仓库级修复补丁的运行时性能，且 Welch ANOVA 是比 RSD 更合适的统计判别准则。核心结论是：issue 解决率与补丁运行时性能是 LLM 能力的两个相互独立的维度，仅靠解决率无法充分表征模型的仓库级问题解决能力。性能分析能够揭示被正确性评估忽略的架构性回归与低效实现。作者呼吁未来评估应在解决率之外同时考虑生成补丁的运行时性能，以更全面地衡量 LLM 在真实软件工程任务中的能力。

Abstract: Repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate submitted patches primarily based on whether they pass the correctness tests, leaving the runtime performance of different test-passing patches largely unexplored. Evaluating patch performance is essential but challenging since designing performance workloads for each benchmark instance is costly. However, these benchmarks already provide a natural candidate: the built-in \emph{FAIL\_TO\_PASS} (F2P) tests, which exercise the behavior affected by the issue fix. We therefore investigate whether the provided F2P tests can be repurposed to evaluate patch performance. Overall, we choose four frontier models, Claude Opus~5, GPT~5.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen~3.8 Max, paired with SWE-agent to resolve the pre-filtered measurable corpus from verified splits of SWE-bench and SWE-bench-Live, yielding 262 cases with at least two different correct solutions, including the developer ground-truth patch. We then measure each solution's runtime performance in instruction count and wall-clock time on the native F2P test, and use Welch ANOVA instead of the RSD proposed in prior work as a more robust statistical discrimination criterion. We find that this methodology exhibits notable discrimination capability in runtime performance and identifies performance differences among patches in almost half of the instances. Our empirical study shows that the runtime performance of generated patches is independent of the issue resolution rate of LLMs, with nearly reversed model rankings. The case study also shows that the performance analysis reveals architectural regression in some patches that the correctness evaluation overlooked. These findings suggest that resolution rate does not adequately characterize LLMs' capability for repository-level issue resolution, motivating future evaluations to consider patch performance alongside it.

</details>


### [102] [A-SAW: The Agentic Software Architecture Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13647)
*Finn Klatt,Luca Di Grazia,Johannes Schneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 A-SAW（Agentic Software Architecture Workflow），在 Architecture as Code 基础上引入持久化代理层，由 IDE 集成代理基于版本化的 C4 模型、类型化元素目录和模板自动起草架构文档，但每份草稿必须经过人工评审。在大型工业组织的 45 份架构文档（13 对源文档-再生文档配对）和 13 位从业者访谈中评估，结果显示文档质量方差显著缩小（SD 从 19.2 降至 3.8），配对样本质量中位数提升 19 分（p=0.001），但完备性/一致性等结构性质接近满分的同时，可追溯性仍为最弱维度；从业者的高结构评分与有条件的信任之间的背离被识别为关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 AI 在软件工程中集中于实现与验证阶段，对架构设计阶段（尤其是架构文档维护）支持不足；Architecture as Code（AaC）解决了可版本化、可机读的问题，却未解决"知识蒸发"与文档维护成本问题，导致设计文档碎片化、依赖作者且可信度有限。

Method: 设计科学研究方法（DSR）：在大型工业组织中部署三层流程制品——（1）制品层：版本化 C4 模型 + 类型化元素目录（Item_List.md，七类 ID 前缀）+ 模板化 ADD/DDD；（2）代理编排层：IDE 集成代理按 skill 调用，从目录/系统图/模板/特性 context/ 文件夹组装上下文并生成结构化草稿；（3）人工评审层：双重角色审批门禁。评估通过 45 份文档的分群组（人工 A / 部分 AaC B / 代理生成 C）四维评分（完备性、一致性、可追溯性、可维护性）与 13 份配对的来源-再生对 Wilcoxon 检验，以及 13 位从业者的 30 分钟实操任务加访谈的三角互证。

Result: 群组 C 内禀均分由 A 的 58% 升至 89%，配对组中位提升 +19 分（p=0.001，r=+0.97）；文档分方差由 SD 19.2 降至 3.8（95% CI [2.9, 9.2]，Fligner-Killeen p=0.012）；完备性 100%、一致性 93%、机器可读性 99% 接近上限，可追溯性 79% 为最弱短板；11/13 受访者拒绝未经人工评审的代理输出，11/13 报告检索设计原理显著改善，但信任仍为有条件、有抽象等级梯度，并存在"抛光输出导致评审松懈"的过度信任风险。

Conclusion: A-SAW 显著提升了架构文档的均值与一致性，将人力投入从撰写转向验证；代理在结构与机器可读属性方面能力可及，但可追溯性与决策可审计性仍需人为参与；应将评审强制化并集中于代理必须外推超出仓库的部分。核心贡献是揭示"测量质量"与"实践者信任"的系统性背离——信任取决于抽象等级、累积可靠性与设计正确性等评分量表无法捕捉的属性，由此提出五条可迁移设计原则（P1：持久化版本化上下文存储；P2：机器可校验命名契约；P3：制品/编排/评审三层分离；P4：评审集中于代理能力梯度薄弱处；P5：从全评审起步随可靠性渐进放权）。

Abstract: AI assistance in software engineering focuses on implementation and verification, leaving the design phase, and in particular the maintenance of architecture documentation, comparatively underserved. Architecture as Code makes architectural artifacts versionable, diffable, and machine-readable, but it does not reduce the effort of keeping them updated, so design documentation still ends up as a fragmented, author-dependent, and only partially trusted record of why a system looks the way it does. In this paper we introduce the Agentic Software Architecture Workflow (A-SAW), a process-level artifact that extends Architecture as Code with a persistent agent layer: an IDE-integrated agent drafts architecture documents from a version-controlled C4 model, a typed element catalog, and instrumented templates. Every draft passes a mandatory human review gate before it is accepted. We evaluate it in a large industrial organization along two tracks: a rubric assessment of 45 architecture documents including 13 matched source-regeneration pairs, and 13 task-anchored practitioner interviews. Our results show that the workflow collapses the between-author variance that made quality unpredictable. Intrinsic quality also rises, by a median of +19 points across the matched pair. The cohort has a mean of 58% and 89% bundle templates, catalog, agent, and a richer regeneration context. So they bound the agent's contribution from above rather than isolating it. In the agent-generated documents, completeness (100%), consistency (93%), and machine-readability (99%) reach or approach the rubric maximum, while traceability reaches 79%. Eleven of the 13 participants rejected agent output that no human had reviewed, and one warned that polished output may lead reviewers to skip the review. Our work supports keeping human review mandatory and concentrating it where the agent must infer beyond the repository.

</details>


### [103] [(When) Should a Software Factory be Lights-off? Benchmarking Code Review Agents on Bug Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13668)
*Chenyang Yang,Hao He,Ti-Chung Cheng,Jenna Butler,Emerson Murphy-Hill,Carmen Badea,Christian Bird*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文构建了CRBugBench基准（1,800个代码审查任务），评估AI代码审查代理在检测人类已验证bug方面的能力，发现最强代理（claude-opus-5）可在top-5评论中捕获71.9%的bug，但仍有显著局限，特别是在需要项目级上下文推理的专有代码库中。研究结论是：当前距离"无人值守软件工厂"仍有距离，人类监督仍不可或缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着编码代理的进步，开发者越来越多地审查而非编写代码。人类审查速度跟不上AI生成代码的速度，促使业界探索构建自动化审查代理以实现"lights-off"（无人值守）软件工厂。然而，缺乏对AI审查能力的客观评估基准——现有基准多以人类评论为真值，但人类评论包含随意性内容且可能遗漏AI能发现的有效问题，评估结果具有误导性。因此需要构建以"人类已验证的bug"为真值的客观基准，系统评估当前AI代理在代码审查中的真实能力边界。

Method: 方法包含四个核心部分：(1)数据构建流水线——从GitHub仓库历史中挖掘两类bug来源：合并前被人类评论捕获并修复的bug（865个），以及合并后通过bug修复PR追溯到引入PR的bug（689个），并构建专有企业仓库的800个额外任务；(2)任务创建——为每个PR提供Docker化沙箱环境，代理产出review.md并按严重度自排序；(3)评估机制——使用三模型陪审团（gpt-5.5、claude-opus-4.8、gemini-3.1-flash）多数投票评判，人机一致性κ=0.89；(4)四个研究问题（RQ）的系统实验——评估多个前沿模型、用逻辑回归分析影响因素、分析代理轨迹中的工具使用与失败模式、实验不同代理配置（推理努力、提示工程、多代理编排）。

Result: 关键结果包括：(1) RQ1：claude-opus-5在GitHub任务top-5评论中捕获79.6%合并前bug和64.2%合并后bug，跨5个月模型演进从47.7%提升至71.9%，但专有仓库性能下降高达25.5%；(2) RQ2：检测概率随diff增大、变更异构性提高、bug-fixing PR、非功能性bug（如可用性OR=0.454）、非本地可见bug而降低，bug可见性差异解释了20%的开源-专有性能差距；(3) RQ3：95.6%的执行会检查缺陷文件，但仅56.2%能正确诊断，失败更多源于诊断而非检索，代理容易被PR描述或代码注释误导，Claude模型执行代码的比例(9.7%)高于GPT模型(6.9%)；(4) RQ4：综合提示策略最经济高效（提升5.8%，仅1.10倍成本），优于多代理设置（提升4.7%但需5.55倍成本），提高推理努力可使gpt-5.6-luna从36%提升至57%但成本增加23.22倍；(5) 人机协作：人类+最佳代理组合可捕获82.1%的bug，互补性强——人类更擅长可维护性问题，代理更擅长严重性和可靠性问题。

Conclusion: 当前AI代码审查代理尚不成熟到能实现"无人值守软件工厂"的程度，特别是在需要项目级知识的大型专有代码库中。代理应被视为扩展覆盖范围的可扩展同伴，而非人类审查者的替代品——人类应保留对重大变更的最终决策权。基于研究发现，论文提出五项实践建议：(1)根据PR复杂度调整审查投入；(2)基于项目优先级引导审查方向；(3)为专有仓库提供仓库特定知识；(4)按PR特征分配不同模型；(5)随模型演进而持续监测和调整代理配置。该研究还指出未来研究方向，包括构建具备记忆能力的自改进审查代理、设计提升人机协作效率的辅助系统等。

Abstract: With the advances of coding agents, software developers are spending more time reviewing code than writing code. As human review velocity falls behind agentic code generation, it is tempting to build automated review agents towards a future of "lights-off" software factory with little to no human supervision. To assess the practicality of such a fully autonomous software factory, we construct CRBugBench, a new benchmark that evaluates whether review agents detect human-verified bugs. We build a data pipeline that mines bugs from repository history, and pair each bug with its introducing PR to form a review task. CRBugBench consists of 1,000 review tasks across 98 open-source GitHub repositories, and 800 additional tasks from proprietary industry repositories at one large company. We then use the benchmark to study agent review quality: We found that SOTA review agents do well: the best (claude-opus-5 with copilot-cli) catches 71.9% of bugs within its top-5 comments, up from 47.7% (opus-4.6) in five months of model evolution. Yet agents remain less effective on complex changes and bugs requiring non-local reasoning, with sharp performance drops on proprietary industry repositories where project context is more often needed. To improve bug detection, we found scaling compute helps most through prompt changes: exploration-nudging prompts gain up to 5.8% performance at 10% higher cost. From these findings, we derive concrete guidance for developers to adopt review agents - scaling review effort to PR complexity, steering agents by project priorities, supplying repository knowledge, dispatching models by PR characteristics, and monitoring quality as models evolve.

</details>


### [104] [MARGoS: A Configuration-Driven Platform for Reproducible MARL Experiments in ARGoS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13772)
*Tom Philipp Backert,Mohammad D. Soorati,Javad Ghofrani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MARGoS是一个轻量级、配置驱动的平台，用于在ARGoS模拟器上实现多智能体强化学习(MARL)实验的可复现性。它将实验定义输入提升为平台管理的一级工件，通过配置哈希、种子传播、冻结配置、结构化日志、环境指纹和可导出实验包来实现可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ARGoS+MARL实验工作流高度手动化，实验由分散的场景文件、训练代码、参数、种子、输出路径和环境假设手工组装，导致小型漂移即可能重新定义实验，实验的复用和复现即使在同一研究组内也很脆弱。现有相邻平台均不能同时具备ARGoS原生性并覆盖从配置→编排→日志→分析→导出/导入的完整流水线。

Method: MARGoS采用五阶段流水线架构（配置→编排→日志→分析→导出/导入），通过五个CLI命令（run、show、compare、export、import）提供统一的操作接口。核心机制包括：配置哈希、端到端种子传播、冻结配置、结构化日志、环境指纹、可导出实验包（包含冻结配置、源文件副本等）。ArgosToZoo桥接ARGoS C++与ZeroMQ和Python/RLlib训练。

Result: 五个维度评估结果：RQ1架构（验证协议可执行性）通过；RQ2效率方面时间减少78.2%、步骤减少66.7%（目标≥50%）；RQ3可复现性方面20次自动复现100%成功、标准差0.0000（目标≥90%）；RQ4可用性方面启发式合规率85.7%、KLM减少56.9%（目标分别为≥80%和≥50%）；RQ5协作方面100%移交成功、共享时间减少65.3%、复现时间减少45.9%（略低于50%目标）、首次运行慢7.4%——部分支持。

Conclusion: MARGoS将分散的实验定义工件转化为可执行、可复用的流水线。集成显著削减了工作流时间，同一硬件上达到100%复现成功率和分析可用性目标，同时保持100%移交成功率。下一步具体工作包括：减少导入验证开销，并在可暴露相同原语的模拟器学习栈中测试模式层面的可转移性。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has become a prominent research direction, particularly within collective robotics, where the ARGoS simulator is widely used to study emergent swarm behavior. Yet despite this growth, systematic support for reuse and reproducibility in MARL-based swarm robotics remains limited and insufficiently standardized: a single experiment is assembled from manually aligned simulator files, training scripts, configuration values, paths, seeds, and environment details, so reuse and reproduction stay fragile even within one research group. To address this gap, we introduce MARGoS, a lightweight, configuration-driven platform developed in this project that elevates these experiment-defining inputs to first-class, platform-managed artifacts. MARGoS enables reproducible experimentation through configuration hashing, end-to-end seed propagation, frozen (immutable) configurations, structured logging, environment fingerprinting, and exportable experiment bundles that facilitate sharing, replay, and verification of results across machines and over time. A five-dimension evaluation (architecture, efficiency, reproducibility, usability, and collaboration) supports our claim that managing experiment variation as a platform responsibility makes ARGoS+MARL experiments easier to reuse, reproduce, and hand off. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [105] [Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12495)
*Fabien Furfaro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kairos，一种面向多模态（文本/图像/音频/视频/激光雷达/控制流）的字节级基础模型架构。该工作不追求性能比较，而是以极小规模（1–15M 参数）的记忆化收敛实验，系统验证这一组合（混合线性/窗口注意力、稀疏 MoE、金字塔编解码器、扩散去噪目标）能否成功优化。核心发现：实现确实能优化到接近零损失，但一些表观架构优势（如共享 Q/K/V 投影、混合注意力）经控制实验证实仅为收敛速度效应，而非容量效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘/本地设备上训练的小模型场景缺乏架构试错空间；现有高效序列混合（线性注意力/窗口注意力）、稀疏容量扩展（MoE）、非自回归离散扩散训练、字节级无分词器这四条线索通常独立报告，作者希望检验将它们组合在一个单机能训练的小模型中时，整体是否能成功优化，并探索哪些设计选择影响收敛速度。

Method: 架构层面：1) 多模态字节分词器（继承 ByT5，扩展至图像/音频/视频/激光雷达/控制流，统一 290 词表）；2) 金字塔编解码器 PyramidalCodec，对同一序列构建 S 个并行视图（patch 尺寸按 stride 几何增长），共享瓶颈 mixer；3) LiZAttention2：双向门控 DeltaNet 线性注意力 + 双向滑动窗口注意力，共享 Q/K/V/O 投影；4) Block-AttnRes：块内 softmax 加权的层间残差聚合；5) 稀疏 MoE（DeepSeek-V3 风格 sigmoid 路由 + 共享专家 + 偏置负载均衡）；6) 跨会话循环状态记忆门 KairosMemoryGate；7) 均匀噪声去噪目标 + MAE→过渡→扩散三阶段课程。实验层面：在 1.98M 参数的消融网络上对 16 条相同的 440 字节句子做 600 步记忆化训练（CPU），对编解码与注意力选择做 3 种子统计，对另外 7 个因素做单次扫描。

Result: 编解码器排名在三种子上稳定（patch < dense conv < conv 8通道/组 < 深度可分离 conv，600 步后最小损失 0.018→0.354）；混合 LiZAttention2 在 600 步优于纯窗口注意力，但 3000 步后两者都达到 ~10⁻³ 的同一水平；共享 Q/K/V 投影的表观优势在延长训练或换用多样化数据后消失，且在冻结 QKV 后反转——证实为收敛速度效应而非容量效应；网络深度、top-1 vs top-2 路由、AttnRes 块大小在当前噪声水平下无可测效应；课程学习和记忆门因样本量不足（1 个种子、12 个优化步）无支撑性结论。第 6 节以 roofline 模型对 200M 总参/25M 激活的未实例化目标做了分析性算力预算。

Conclusion: Kairos 的实现可在 1–15M 规模上成功记忆化一个固定字节串，证实组合架构可优化；论文明确强调这仅是必要而非充分条件——未涉及泛化、多模态训练或与现有模型的比较。最强表观架构效应（共享投影）被证明是收敛速度伪相关，因此作者建议在微规模对比中报告"到达阈值的步数"而非固定步数下的损失值，并配合步数预算、数据规模和机制隔离三类控制。泛化、多模态训练和 Pythia-14M 对比被列为下一阶段预训练的目标。

Abstract: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at this https URL . Python package at this https URL .

</details>


### [106] [CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12520)
*Jiankun Wei,Ewan Dunbar,Gerald Penn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CircuitTree方法，将大量独立剪枝的电路组合成一个共享电路模块，用于音节转录。核心包括：(1)解决朴素合并的密度支配和干扰问题的密度缩放合并算法；(2)基于平衡二叉树的CircuitTree数据结构，复杂度Θ(N log N)；(3)层级化电路管道，将39个音素电路压缩为两个共享模块，转录CV/VC音节准确率达64.8%，仅比独立电路低1.2点，且99.5%的电路组件被共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的电路发现研究大多局限于手工验证的一对或少数几个电路的组合，且仅评估组合后是否能保持原始任务性能。缺乏将大量独立电路大规模组合成新能力的可扩展方法，这正是电路分解实用化的核心障碍。

Method: 1. 密度缩放合并算法：计算每个键上所有电路密度的几何均值作为目标密度，将各电路的掩码按比例缩放，解决密度支配问题；通过拓扑排序的贪心算法，仅当所有成员F1不下降超过阈值ε时才接受合并，解决干扰问题。2. CircuitTree数据结构：基于平衡二叉树的自底向上合并，每个内部节点仅记录该层级上成功共享的键；通过回溯解析机制避免早期成功共享被后续失败合并撤销，复杂度Θ(kN log N)。3. 层级化电路管道：由一个电路门控器判定CV/VC结构，然后路由到元音或辅音CircuitTree模块。

Result: 将39个（15个元音+24个辅音）从HuBERT剪枝的二进制音素电路合并为两个共享CircuitTree模块。CV/VC音节转录准确率64.8%，仅比独立电路上限66.0%低1.2点；电路组件共享率99.5%（部分共享），30.3%（全部共享）；后合并电路密度约1.10%，远低于全模型100%。平衡调度在准确率上（81.8%）接近Kruskal调度（82.2%），复杂度更优。

Conclusion: 该工作证明电路组合可在规模上成功：大量原始电路可被组合成超越其个体能力的复杂任务，且几乎全部组件可共享。密度缩放与干扰感知合并算法加CircuitTree数据结构为电路组合提供了实用框架，有望应用于语音及其他领域更复杂的问题。

Abstract: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $\Theta(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.

</details>


### [107] [Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12638)
*Amey Vasulkar,Samuel Kernan Freire,Arie-Willem de Leeuw,Tadeo-Baldiri Salcedo-Rahola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对荷兰海牙应用科学大学（THUAS）Delft校区一栋教学楼，基准比较了11种日前（day-ahead）24小时整栋电力预测配置，涵盖统计方法（Ridge）、机器学习（XGBoost）、循环神经网络（LSTM及其残差混合）以及预训练时间序列基础模型（TimesFM 2.5目标版、TimesFM 3.0目标版、TimesFM 3.0带协变量版）。在相同57天测试集、时序验证、按工作日/周末/节假日分组、配对自助法比较的严格实验设计下，TimesFM 3.0带协变量取得最低整体MAE（19.97 kWh）和RMSE（30.26 kWh），相较168小时季节朴素预测降低MAE约43.4%；XGBoost保持竞争力（MAE 22.45 kWh，RMSE 31.11 kWh），但配对日MAE差异的95%置信区间包含零，无法确定二者优劣。研究还发现：协变量使TimesFM节假日预测改善但整体MAE几乎不变；目标版TimesFM仅用历史耗电即可表现强劲；566天扩展历史评估揭示了显著季节性差异；三种气象源（KNMI观测、ERA5再分析、IFS历史预报）对TimesFM准确度影响极小（MAE差异<0.17 kWh）。计算资源方面，TimesFM无需建筑专属权重训练，XGBoost拟合与推理速度均极快（拟合中位数0.84秒），LSTM拟合耗时约99秒且无精度优势。结论是预训练TimesFM是该建筑的强基线，XGBoost是可行的本地拟合替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑能耗占全球能耗和碳排放的相当大比例。日前电力预测可让建筑运营商根据预期需求调度HVAC等服务，但选择模型需权衡准确度、协变量需求、本地训练和计算成本。预训练时间序列基础模型（如TimesFM）提供了无需针对特定建筑训练的新选择，但其在大学建筑场景中相对成熟本地模型的实证表现尚不明确；此外，大学建筑因教学日历、节假日与周末呈现明显运营模式差异，要求预测模型对不同时期分别评估。

Method: 研究对象为THUAS Delft校区一栋教学楼；数据集含2022年9月至2024年3月的13,752小时耗电记录（共573个24小时预测窗口）。方法包括：(1) 11种配置基准测试——按Tashman（2000）的滚动原点时序交叉验证，每天拟合前365天历史、预测未来24小时；测试集为2024年2–3月共57天；超参通过对90天验证集搜索选择（Ridge 25点网格、XGBoost/Prophet各96次Optuna试验、LSTM各72/48次、TimesFM网格）；(2) 协变量准备——从47个候选变量筛得30个（21个日历/调度、7个天气、2个耗电滞后），剔除不可次日获取的变量；(3) 季节朴素参考——24小时与168小时滞后；(4) 准确度指标——MAE、RMSE、R²、MAPE、sMAPE，辅以10,000次配对日自助法评估差异显著性；(5) 三种气象源敏感性分析（KNMI/ERA5/IFS历史）；(6) 566天扩展历史评估观察季节性能；(7) 记录拟合/推理时间与内存峰值。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 整体误差排序——TimesFM 3.0带协变量MAE 19.97 kWh、RMSE 30.26 kWh、R² 0.798最优；TimesFM 3.0目标版MAE 20.01 kWh次之；XGBoost MAE 22.45 kWh、RMSE 31.11 kWh；LSTM基线与季节朴素最差；(2) 配对比较——TimesFM相对XGBoost的日MAE差异均值-2.48 kWh，但95%区间[-5.14, 0.13]含零，无法确定显著优势；季节朴素与各本地模型均显著劣于XGBoost；(3) 分日型——目标版TimesFM 3.0在34个工作日MAE最低（16.65 kWh），带协变量版在11个节假日RMSE改善14.27 kWh但工作日和周末误差略增；(4) 历史评估——MAE从夏季9.89 kWh到冬季20.25 kWh大幅波动；(5) 气象源——三种源MAE差异≤0.17 kWh，影响有限；(6) 资源——XGBoost拟合0.84秒、推理0.001秒；TimesFM 3.0带协变量推理0.92秒、零训练；LSTM拟合99秒且最差。

Conclusion: 研究得出三点主要结论：(1) 预训练TimesFM 3.0带协变量是THUAS该建筑的强初始基线，相对168小时季节朴素降低MAE 43.4%，XGBoost是精度接近、训练与推理极快的本地拟合替代；(2) 协变量的价值在于显著改善节假日预测（RMSE减少14.27 kWh），但对整体MAE几乎无增益，仅耗电历史的TimesFM目标版即可作为无需外部数据的强劲起点；(3) 模型优劣随运营日型变化——目标版TimesFM最适合工作日，XGBoost在非工作日RMSE更低，方法选择应基于应用优先级。气象源敏感性低、季节差异大是部署时需考虑的实际因素。研究指出了57天测试偏向冬末春初、节假日样本少、未校正多重比较与日间依赖、未独立记录气象发布时间、TimesFM 3.0仅限非商业研究使用等局限。未来工作应在更多独立建筑上进行完整季节留出测试，解耦各类协变量贡献，并连接预测误差到实际HVAC调度收益。

Abstract: Day-ahead electricity forecasts can help building operators schedule heating, ventilation, and other services around anticipated demand. Choosing a forecasting model also requires balancing accuracy with its forecast-time inputs, local training, and computational requirements. We benchmark statistical, machine-learning, recurrent neural-network, and pretrained TimesFM models for a university building. We use chronological validation and evaluate all configurations on the same 57 test days, comparing accuracy across workdays, weekends, and holidays alongside local fitting and forecasting time. Weather covariates use retrospective observations. TimesFM 3.0 with covariates achieves the lowest overall errors, reducing mean absolute error by approximately 43\% relative to weekly seasonal-naive forecasting. XGBoost remains competitive, although paired daily comparisons do not establish a clear mean-absolute-error advantage for TimesFM. TimesFM also performs strongly using only past electricity consumption. Adding covariates improves its holiday forecasts but slightly worsens workday and weekend forecasts, leaving overall mean absolute error almost unchanged. TimesFM requires no building-specific weight training, while XGBoost offers rapid local fitting and inference. The evaluated LSTM takes longer to fit without outperforming either approach. An exploratory historical evaluation reveals seasonal variation, while a separate weather-source comparison produces only small changes in the selected TimesFM configuration's accuracy. These results support pretrained TimesFM as a strong initial forecasting baseline for this building, with XGBoost as a competitive locally fitted alternative. Covariates are particularly useful when improved holiday forecasts justify the additional input preparation.

</details>


### [108] [Kronecker Product Attention: Memory-Efficient KV Compression via Structured Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12657)
*Bahareh Nikpour,Hossein Rajabzadeh,Maryam Dialameh,Vahid Partovi Nia,Parsa Omidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Kronecker Product Attention（KPA），通过将每token的 K/V 矩阵表示为上下文相关的 Kronecker 矩阵因子之和，实现 KV 缓存压缩并兼容 RoPE，在四规模模型上以 6.4×–10× 压缩率匹配或超越 MHA/MQA/GQA/MLA/TPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归推理受限于 KV 缓存的线性增长；现有方法（MQA、GQA、MLA、TPA）在表达力、位置编码机制或秩结构上各有取舍，缺乏一个同时保持表达力、兼容 RoPE 并支持灵活压缩比的方案。Kronecker 积同时具备混合积恒等式、可分离旋转算子和对 CP 分解的严格推广三大性质，适合作为 KV 因子化基础。

Method: 将多头头数 h 和单头维度 d_h 各分解为两个因子维度（h=h1·h2，d_h=d1·d2），用两组上下文相关的小矩阵 A、B 通过 Kronecker 积之和表示 Q/K/V。仅缓存 K、V 的 A、B 因子；证明 attention 分数可经混合积恒等式分解为头级内积×特征级内积。提出 Kronecker-Separable RoPE（I_{d1}⊗R_θ^{(2)}(t)），证明仅旋转 B 因子即可保持 RoPE 相对位置性质，无需 MLA 的解耦分支。KPA 严格推广 TPA（后者为 h1=h, d1=1 时的退化情形）。压缩比为 (R_K+R_V)(h1 d1+h2 d2) vs MHA 的 2 h1 h2 d1 d2，头划分 (h1, h2) 为可调超参。

Result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 上训练 125M/353M/773M/1.5B 四规模模型（~50B tokens），零样本评测 9 个基准（ARC-E/C、BoolQ、HellaSwag、OBQA、PIQA、WinoGrande、MMLU、SciQ）。353M KPA h=(8×2) 在 6.4× 压缩下平均 52.90（超 TPA 1.49pp）；773M KPA h=(10×2) 在 6.7× 压缩下平均 55.12，超过 MLA(53.32)、TPA(53.14) 等全部基线；1.5B KPA h=(5×5) 在 10× 压缩下平均 56.56。消融显示较大 h1 的非对称划分在所有规模上均优于对称划分和 TPA。

Conclusion: KPA 通过 Kronecker 结构因子化 K/V，在严格推广 TPA 的同时与 RoPE 原生兼容，免去 MLA 的解耦旋转分支，在 6.4×–10× 压缩下跨四规模匹配或超越所有基线，头划分超参支持设计时灵活权衡压缩-精度。适用于资源受限设备上的 LLM 部署及长上下文微调；下一步是开发高效因化解码 kernel 及更长上下文评测。

Abstract: Efficient autoregressive generation is increasingly limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, which grows linearly with sequence length, batch size, and model depth. Existing approaches such as Multi-Query Attention (MQA), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and Tensor Product Attention (TPA) reduce this cost through different trade-offs, but often sacrifice expressivity, require additional positional-encoding machinery, or impose restrictive low-rank structure. We propose Kronecker Product Attention (KPA), which represents key and value activations as sums of Kronecker products of compact, token-dependent matrix factors. KPA strictly generalizes TPA: rank-one vector-outer-product factorization arises as a degenerate Kronecker split, while non-degenerate matrix factors can represent richer block-structured patterns. We further show that a structured rotary embedding operator matched to the Kronecker representation preserves the relative-position property of RoPE while rotating only the compact factors, removing the need for a decoupled RoPE branch as in MLA. Empirically, KPA matches or exceeds TPA, MHA, MQA, GQA, and MLA across four model scales and nine downstream benchmarks under identical training conditions, while achieving up to 10x KV cache compression. The Kronecker head split is a tuneable hyperparameter that allows practitioners to navigate the compression-accuracy trade-off at design time without architectural changes.

</details>


### [109] [Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12668)
*Yuxin Xiao,Zhiyun Lu,Jianyu Wang,Yangtian Zhang,Yang Song,Qifan Wang,Bailin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReHarness，一种用于智能体持续学习的循环式 Harness 框架，通过在严格在线流式协议下引入"向后修订"机制，利用下游轨迹作为反馈来修订先前检索到的反射（reflection），从而修正过度泛化或过时的经验，在不进行实例重放或参数更新的情况下实现 Harness 状态的在线自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体 Harness 在持续学习中通常仅通过前向信息流（写-读）演化状态：写入的反射一旦存储便很少根据后续使用效果进行更新；部分方法依赖额外的验证集或轨迹重放进行 Harness 优化，但在严格在线流式协议下不可用。在分布漂移下，过时或过度自信的反射会持续误导未来决策，导致持续学习性能下降。

Method: ReHarness 在传统前向读取（forward read）和前向写入（forward write）之外，引入第三步——向后修订（backward revision）：在每个实例完成后，修订智能体 πR 利用当前实例的轨迹作为反馈，回顾并修订该实例检索到的反射 R_i 为 R_i'。修订要求新内容必须保持对源轨迹 τ_i 的忠实性（防止信息泄露），可补充遗漏证据、修正无支持假设或细化适用条件。三步流程为：1）从 Harness 状态 h_t 检索 top-k 反射，决策智能体产生回答；2）πR 基于 τ_t 反馈修订被检索的反射，得到 h_t'；3）记忆智能体 πM 基于 τ_t 和修订后反射生成新反射 R_t，更新 h_{t+1}。这样前向读/写与后向修订形成"循环 Harness"，可在不重放、不更新参数的情况下在线修正过时经验。

Result: 在 CL-Bench、MemoryBench、MemoryArena 三个持续学习基准上，使用 Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.7 Flash 三种骨干 LLM 评估。ReHarness 总体归一化增益达 0.240，在 9 种基准-骨干组合中有 8 种排名第一或并列；对所有基线（包括 Top-K Raw、Full Raw 等强基线）的提升均具有统计显著性（经 Bonferroni 校正的 Wilcoxon 检验 p_adj < 0.05）。在源轨迹忠实性方面，修订后超过 95% 的事实性声明仍由源轨迹支撑，泄露率仅 0.8%-2.1%。在稳定性-可塑性分解中，ReHarness 取得最高的平均稳定性增益和所有骨干上的最高可塑性增益。Token 效率方面，ReHarness 总 token 消耗约为 Full Raw 的 1/3，约为 Top-K Raw 的 79%。反事实回放实验进一步验证后向修订机制确实产生了有意义的修订。

Conclusion: ReHarness 通过将前向信息流与后向修订相结合，在严格在线流式协议下实现了 Harness 状态的持续自适应，是循环式 Harness 适应这一方向的有前景探索。它能产生源轨迹忠实的修订，修正分布漂移下的过度泛化与过时反射，同时提升稳定性和可塑性。局限性在于：在奖励噪声较大的任务（如 CL-Bench 的 exploitable poker）上表现欠佳；且仍需存储原始轨迹以供未来修订，存在存储开销。

Abstract: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.

</details>


### [110] [KITE: A Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder for Time-Series Event Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12738)
*Jonas Petersen,Pratik Jawahar,Riccardo Maggioni,Gian-Alessandro Lombardi,Matteo Cozzi,Marek Gajewski,Federico Martelli,Camilla Mazzoleni,Philipp Christian Petersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KITE（Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder）是一种将领域工程知识（即"语义先验"）以可切换输入形式注入到自监督多变量时间序列事件预测器中的架构，基于JEPA主干，包含协变量机制和注意力偏置机制两条注入通道，每个机制在零值时退化为恒等映射，从而无需针对不同数据集进行架构搜索。核心结论是：当先验提供了观测窗口所不具备的信息时（如短上下文场景中注入周期时钟或守恒残差），能显著提升预测性能，并能替代跨域迁移中的特征迁移；而当窗口已包含该信息或先验错配时则无明显增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多变量时间序列系统中，罕见高成本事件的先兆在数据中很少被观测到，纯数据驱动模型缺乏学习素材；但负责运行这些系统的工程师拥有先于数据的领域知识（如变量身份、边界、周期性、守恒律、因果边），这些信息正是稀缺标签所缺失的。现有方法每种仅通过常开的路径注入单一类型先验，与主干纠缠，每遇到新先验或新系统都需要新架构，缺乏统一性。

Method: 1. 提出12类语义先验分类法（按"何时可知"和"是逐变量还是关系型"组织），其中4类已实现评估。2. 基于JEPA构建KITE架构：变元-令牌编码器+编码器实现水平条件预测器+事件头，编码器具有置换不变性和基数自由约束（无逐变量槽位，跨系统单一模型）。3. 通过两种可切换机制注入先验：(I) 协变量机制——将逐变量和派生先验作为合成变量，沿三条路径路由：静态描述符（零初始化融合，恒等起始）、未来已知协变量（注入预测器在horizon处评估）、过去仅派生律（如守恒残差）作为协变量；(II) 注意力偏置机制——通过标量门控的驱动邻接矩阵βA添加到注意力logits上，β=0时恒等。4. 两阶段训练：Stage1自监督预训练（带VICReg坍缩项的L1潜空间损失），Stage2冻结编码器训练头（离散生存模型输出单调事件概率曲面p(t,Δt)）。

Result: 在域内短上下文场景（Claim A）：Occupancy静默发作层上真实相位周期时钟将无先验基线从0.762提升至0.866（+0.104，p<0.001）；BATADAL持续违规层上守恒残差将基线从0.136提升至0.877（p=1.2×10⁻⁵），在0.25标签分数下提升+0.221；合成结构性描述符（#1）确认静态路径可行（p=0.030）。在跨域迁移（Claim B）：BATADAL→SYNTH-CON中守恒残差将冻结编码器层迁移率从0.601提升至0.922（+53%），超越零样本Chronos-2（0.774），证明先验替代而非放大了特征迁移（OOD-ID=-0.002）。在20个外部对照臂中无一在0.05的BH-FDR下超越KITE。先验无作用的场景：静态注入在0/19处存活BH-FDR（F残片恒等性识别为线性可吸收）；全周期上下文中周期时钟无效（0/3存活FDR）；图偏置有界至≈0.006 h-AUROC（375次运行中无正样本）；错配FFT周期逆转Occupancy增益（-0.022）；Weather预注册负对照控制通过（Δ=-0.017，p=0.69）；守恒残差可检测但不能预测起始（起始层-0.053）。

Conclusion: KITE将领域知识以可切换输入形式注入自监督事件预测器中，从不与主干纠缠。一个先验在其提供观测窗口所缺乏的信息时有用：在短上下文中它优于无先验，在跨域中它替代特征迁移，而冗余静态注入和图偏置无效。可切换先验是预训练、跨域时间序列基础世界模型的自然基底，使其显式承载治理结构。机制（II）有界但未确定，最强迁移目标是合成目标；技术限制包括未来已知输入尚不具备基数兼容性、WADI/SWaT等其他真实质量平衡网络因许可问题未纳入。

Abstract: Forecasting rare, high-cost events in multivariate time-series systems is hard because their precursors are seldom observed, so a purely data-driven model has little to learn from. The engineers who run these systems, however, hold knowledge that precedes such events, information absent from the scarce labels.
