We call this a semantic prior and inject it into a self-supervised event forecaster through two switchable mechanisms, a covariate mechanism and an attention-bias mechanism, each the identity at its null, so one architecture serves every prior type with no per-dataset architecture search. A prior helps when it supplies information the observed window does not already contain: in a short context an informative prior beats no prior in-domain (pooled h-AUROC over the no-prior baseline: a periodicity clock +14%, p<0.001; a conservation residual +47% at a 0.25 label fraction), and a working prior transfers out-of-domain (+53%), substituting for feature transfer, while priors the window already recovers stay inert and the attention-bias mechanism shows no measurable gain. KITE is a switchable, attributable route to contextual conditioning, and a substrate for scaling toward cross-domain, pretrained time-series foundation world models that carry their governing structure explicitly.

</details>


### [111] [REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12769)
*Joshua Maccoby,Wendy Hui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REDaCT是一个针对大型推理模型（LRM）的推理时遗忘框架，通过泄漏检测器（RoBERTa分类器）和纠正嵌入（embedding optimization）实现"检测-重生成"过程，在不修改模型参数的前提下有效移除遗忘集信息，同时完全避免现有方法普遍存在的"推理崩溃"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LRM遗忘方法面临两难：R-TOFU无法完全移除推理链（CoT）中的遗忘信息；R²MU虽然遗忘有效但会导致严重的"推理崩溃"（模型陷入重复token循环、无法终止CoT），在95-100%的遗忘集prompt上出现崩溃。需要一种既能有效遗忘又能保持推理连贯性的方法。

Method: REDaCT包含两个核心组件：(1) 句子级二分类泄漏检测器（基于RoBERTa），结合查询和前两句上下文判断每句是否泄露遗忘集信息；(2) 纠正嵌入优化模块，离线学习一个嵌入向量（k=16, d=4096），通过包含refusal loss、forget hinge和retain hinge的三项损失函数训练。推理时采用"检测-重生成"迭代过程：检测到首个泄漏句子后，截断CoT并附加纠正嵌入，引导模型生成连贯的拒绝回答。无需修改目标模型参数。

Result: 在R-TOFU基准测试（forget01/05/10）上，REDaCT在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型上取得AFE=1.000（完美答案遗忘）、CFE=0.977-1.000（近乎完美CoT遗忘）、Utility=0.771-0.786（最接近预遗忘模型的0.787）、Refusal Rate=1.000（完全连贯拒绝）、Collapse Rate=0.000（零崩溃）。在Qwen-7B模型上同样验证有效。对间接问题的遗忘也能泛化（AFE=1.0）。推理开销仅增加5.9%（遗忘集）、0.8%（保留集）。

Conclusion: REDaCT是首个在推理时干预LRM推理链内部的遗忘方法，完全避免了推理崩溃问题，在遗忘有效性、推理保持和响应连贯性三个维度上均优于现有SOTA方法。论文还指出了R-TOFU原始CFE/AFE指标的两个系统性偏差（"选择性干预被惩罚"和"推理崩溃被奖励"），为后续评估提供了重要参考。未来方向包括：扩展到更多内容控制与安全应用、支持顺序遗忘场景、应用于多模态LRM。

Abstract: Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process. To address this challenge, we propose REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning), an inference-time unlearning framework for LRMs. REDaCT consists of two key components: (1) a binary leak detector that identifies sentences in the reasoning trace that leak forget-set information, and (2) an embedding optimization module that learns a corrective embedding offline, such that when injected at the first detected leak during inference, it guides subsequent reasoning towards sentences that do not leak forget-set information. Experimental results show that REDaCT completely avoids reasoning collapse, substantially improving reasoning preservation compared to state-of-the-art unlearning methods while maintaining perfect answer forgetting and near-perfect CoT forgetting. Our code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [112] [Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12794)
*Seung Won Wilson Yoo,Chang Zeng,Aditi Somayajula,Sahithi Ankireddy,Rohan Kosalge,Avishree Khare,John Mitchell,Aditya G. Parameswaran,Rajhans Samdani,Anupam Datta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍CoCoEvolve，一种基于"元反思"的进化优化器，通过编码智能体（Cortex Code）选择性检索历史演化证据并探测实时系统，在生产AI系统优化上显著优于GEPA、Meta-Harness、OpenEvolve、AdaEvolve等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化优化方法（如GEPA、AlphaEvolve、OpenEvolve）采用"父代局部、单次LLM调用"的变异接口，仅基于当前选中父代的反馈生成子代。这种范式在生产AI系统中失效，因为：(1)孤立失败无法揭示复杂的隐藏交互；(2)局部有益的编辑可能在别处造成回归；(3)变异器无法与环境交互、验证假设。生产系统（数据代理、SQL管道、数据工程工作流）的正确性依赖于与实时系统的交互，而非纯提示词文本。

Method: 核心方法：元反思（Meta-Reflection），将变异接口从"父代局部+单次调用"扩展为两个补充输入：(1) 从搜索历史中策展的紧凑上下文包 c_t（策略账本、活跃范式、岛屿精英）；(2) 增强环境 E_t（基础执行工具 + 可按需查询历史档案的结构化接口）。变异器为编码智能体，可调查、编辑、自验证子代后再提交。关键组件：(1) 策略账本检测停滞并选择继续/新策略/无方向；(2) 实时环境交互（SQL执行、scratch agent部署）；(3) 历史查询工具（get_program、get_lineage、get_question_solvers等），可检索特定任务的首解程序、恢复丢失能力的变异、共回归任务。搜索策略默认MAP-Elites；引入预算化的ℓ^p名册（互补覆盖优先），用于AI函数场景；引入相似性引导的稀疏评估（基于Nadaraya-Watson核估计和信息增益评分）用于DABStep智能体优化。算法1形式化整个循环：选择父代 → 策展上下文 → 增强环境 → 智能体调查 → 评估 → 更新历史 → MAP-Elites准入。

Result: 主要结果：(1) DABStep智能体优化：92.8% 留出hard准确率（vs GEPA 30.4%、Meta-Harness 78.4%），登顶公共排行榜。(2) 6个AI函数管道工作负载：全面超越最强基线，最大提升10pp；Lockpicking诊断6次迭代达100%准确率。(3) data-eng-bench：测试集解决率从59.1%提升至77.4%（vs GEPA 73.6%）。(4) HotpotQA：比GEPA高11pp（0.793 vs 0.683）。(5) 数学与系统基准（Sonnet-5/GPT-5.6-terra）：在44个Avg/Best单元格中25个最佳或并列最佳，与AdaEvolve相当。消融实验：(1) 变异执行消融——A1静态/A2智能体但无测试/A3完整：DABStep 47→98→137/150；Heilbronn Convex 0.0260→0.0270→0.03066；(2) 历史访问消融（Signal Processing）：B1父代仅0.6614，B2账本0.7074，B3工具0.7487，B4完整0.7681；DABStep模式不同，需两者结合；(3) 相似性流形定位（C3信息增益 vs C1均匀 vs C2打乱）：286 vs 95 vs 113（训练集）。元反思各部分（账本+工具+环境交互+ℓ^p名册+稀疏评估）均对最终增益有贡献。

Conclusion: CoCoEvolve通过元反思机制——将变异从"父代局部单次调用"升级为"全局历史检索+实时环境探测+编码智能体推理+预提交验证"——有效解决了生产AI系统中孤立失败难以诊断、易回归、需与环境深度交互的核心挑战。该框架将策展的历史证据、按需查询工具和编码智能体变异器相结合，为改进真实AI系统的提示词、代码、工具、数据模型和管道提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve (Cortex Code Evolve), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection, wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. On DABStep, CoCoEvolve tops the public leaderboard, reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy compared to 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA under matched conditions. Across six LLM data pipeline workloads, it outperforms every evaluated baseline. On data-eng-bench, CoCoEvolve lifts test-set solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%, past the best baseline of 73.6%. It also has 11 percentage points higher accuracy than GEPA on HotpotQA while remaining competitive with specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains, demonstrating the value of meta-reflection for optimizing production AI systems.

</details>


### [113] [When Generative Models Act as Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12847)
*Sevan Brodjian,Michael Hobley,Pietro Perona*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨生成模型是否可充当"模拟器"，即能否通过编辑模型潜变量来精准预测环境下一步状态。提出可编辑性（editability）概念，在Othello棋盘和Rayworld连续物理世界两种环境中对比探针引导法与逆映射法的效果，发现环境特性决定哪种映射方式有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型虽能学习环境表征但缺乏内置的"状态读写"接口；而传统模拟器虽可读写状态却不学习表征。论文旨在弥合二者鸿沟：在仅依赖观测训练的前提下，找到生成模型潜变量与模拟器状态间的映射，实现对生成模型的外部驱动与编辑能力。

Method: 1）形式化"可编辑性"：考察改变模型潜表征后产生的下一帧输出是否与直接修改模拟器状态后的输出一致。2）提出两类从观测-状态配对数据中学习的映射：(a) 探针引导法——训练线性/非线性探针解码模拟器状态后沿该方向编辑潜变量；(b) 逆映射法——直接学习从模拟器状态到模型潜空间的映射函数。3）构建两类对比环境：离散环境 Othello 棋局；连续环境 Rayworld（自建的部分渲染移动圆盘物理场景）。4）通过消融实验比较规则简化、探针可解码性、不同映射方式对可编辑性的影响。

Result: 1）所有变体下模拟器状态均可从模型潜变量中解码出来，但可解码性≠可编辑性。2）Othello 中：编辑性随游戏规则简化平滑下降，即便极小的规则改动也会带来显著后果；探针法与逆映射法在多数情形下均可行。3）Rayworld 中：探针法无法沿模拟器连续状态有效引导潜变量，但逆映射法仍能成功将模型从指定状态中设置出来。4）映射有效性高度依赖环境特性，而非通用。

Conclusion: 生成模型可被训练期间从未接触过的外部模拟器驱动；可编辑性是可解码性的更严格条件。哪一种映射方式能奏效取决于环境本身的结构（离散 vs. 连续、对称性等），而非模型规模或训练量。探针法和逆映射法应被视为互补工具，而非通用替代方案。

Abstract: A simulator summarizes an environment in a state that users can read and change. Generative models learn representations of the world without explicit specification, but offer no built-in way to edit that world's state. We investigate the conditions under which a generative model can act as a simulator through $\textit{editability}$: whether changing a model's latent representation produces the next-step outputs we get by editing a simulator's state. Plainly stated, our goal is to find a mapping between a generative model's latent state and the simulator state, where the model is trained on observations alone and the mapping is learned afterward. We test two kinds of mappings, both learned from observations paired with simulator states. In one, we train probes to decode the simulator state from the model, then steer along them. In the other, we learn the mapping directly with an inverse map, which can succeed even where steering fails. We study both in two contrasting environments: the discrete board game Othello, and Rayworld, our own continuous world of moving discs seen through partial renderings, closer to physical scenes and video. We find that which mapping succeeds depends strongly on the environment, even though the state is decodable in every variant. In Othello, editability falls smoothly as the game is simplified, and even small rule changes have large consequences. In Rayworld, probes fail to steer along the simulator's continuous state, yet an inverse map sets the model from that state anyway. A model can therefore be driven by a simulator it may have never learned.

</details>


### [114] [Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13015)
*Zhicheng Cai,Xinyuan Guo,Hanlin Wu,Weinan Dai,Yuyan Zhou,Wei-Ying Ma,Ya-Qin Zhang,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出广义近端策略优化（GPPO）框架，从散度（divergence）视角统一了LLM强化学习中的PPO及其变体算法，通过引入{f散度 × 估计器}的二维设计空间，实现了在八个数学和编码竞赛基准测试上的最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流的PPO算法依赖几何退化的裁剪代理，无法自适应地调整对策略偏移的抵抗力，导致过早裁剪和探索退化；现有变体（DAPO、DPPO、RIPO）虽部分缓解问题，但缺乏统一的第一性原理框架来解释这些启发式修改之间的联系及其优化原理。

Method: 1. 建立基于Vajda不等式的广义f-散度信赖域理论，证明了在任意f-散度水平集约束下的单调性能改进保证；2. 分析四种f-散度（TV、χ²、Hellinger、KL）的几何特性及其对策略更新动态的影响；3. 提出两种新的散度估计器拓扑——Atomic估计（概率加权原子贡献估计）和Binary估计（二值化分布级散度估计），替代传统的单样本蒙特卡洛估计；4. 构建{Divergence × Estimator}二维设计空间，将PPO、GRPO、DAPO、DPPO、RIPO统一为该框架下的特殊情形。

Result: 在8个竞赛级基准（AIME24/25、BRUMO25、SMT25、Codeforces、CodeContests、TACO、APPS）上的实验表明：最佳GPPO实例化（KL散度 + Atomic估计）在数学推理任务上比标准GRPO平均提升49.82%，在代码生成任务上提升13.93%，达到当前最优水平；两个维度（散度几何和估计器拓扑）对性能均至关重要，Atomic估计在所有评估散度上均优于单样本MC估计。

Conclusion: GPPO提供了一个原理性的二维设计空间（散度几何 × 估计器拓扑），统一了现有近端策略优化算法，并为未来LLM强化学习算法的设计提供了系统化基础；散度的曲率和估计器的概率感知特性是有效策略优化的关键因素。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. Extensive experiments on eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks show that both dimensions are critical. The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% and 14% on math and coding, delivering SOTA performance.

</details>


### [115] [Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13113)
*Woosung Koh,Hyunsoo Lee,Kyungjae Lee,Haeju Park,Dahyun Lee,Dasol Hwang,Moontae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SynthSelf（合成自蒸馏）方法，通过将任务外包给同系列稍大的对齐模型，并结合离线监督与拒绝采样，在小模型上实现高效的持续后训练，解决能力获取与灾难性遗忘的双重挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏微调（SDFT）在持续后训练中虽有效，但依赖强上下文学习与指令跟随能力，在小模型（0.5B–3B）上失效。小模型对低延迟、设备端部署至关重要，亟需解决其持续学习难题。

Method: 1. 发现分布偏移与遗忘线性相关（Spearman ρ=-0.85），证明分布内学习是持续学习的关键；2. 提出 SynthSelf：用同系列稍大模型作为对齐器，对原始示范进行分布内改写；3. 采用离线监督并通过拒绝采样过滤；4. 形式化对齐器选择目标，最小化 NLL 同时保证改写质量高于基模型。

Result: 在 4 个获取数据集（科学、工具使用、医学、科学混合）和 14 个保留基准测试中，SynthSelf 在 0.5B/1.5B/3B 三种规模上一致优于 SFT、SDFT、DFT、ASFT 及离策略/在策略蒸馏等 6 种方法，获取性能提升 +5.7%p 至 +16.9%p；同系列对齐器相比强 OOD 模型节省 62.9%–76.9% FLOPs。

Conclusion: SynthSelf 通过将分布内改写外包给同系列稍大对齐器，结合离线拒绝采样，为小模型持续学习提供了有效方案；证明分布匹配比对齐器能力更重要，且计算成本更低。

Abstract: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. Coupled with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, this provides the high-quality supervision small models require without breaking their original distribution. Evaluations spanning 4 acquisition datasets (including a mixture) and 14 retention benchmarks show SynthSelf consistently outperforms 6 methods (including off- and on-policy distillation) across 3 small model scales. Extensive further analyses confirm SynthSelf paves the way toward effective small-model continual learning.

</details>


### [116] [Does Learning Recurrent Networks Matter in Partially Observable RL?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13197)
*Zekang Wang,Zhe He,Gaojie Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测强化学习（POMDP）中循环网络是否必须学习的问题，提出冻结循环网络作为记忆模块的方案，证明了在多种POMDP任务中可大幅减少可训练参数同时保持竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习通常联合训练循环记忆模块与策略/价值函数，但循环记忆是否必须学习尚不明确。Reservoir Computing等研究表明固定循环网络可能足以提供记忆能力，因此作者探究冻结循环网络能否有效替代未学习的记忆模块。

Method: 提出简单架构：冻结的GRU/LRU循环网络作为固定时序特征提取器，配合可训练的非线性MLP读出器（readout）和mixer。使用PQN/PPQ算法训练可选的CNN编码器（视觉任务）和读出器。理论上分析Frozen LRU满足ESP为线性水库，Frozen GRU通过广义水库计算（GRC）即使不满足状态ESP也可通过非线性读出器获得输出ESP。

Result: 在MemoryChain（延迟回忆）、POPGym（18个向量离散POMDP）、MuJoCo Playground（连续控制POMDP）、POPGym Arcade（视觉POMDP）四个基准上，冻结循环网络与可训练对应版本性能相当。Frozen GRU/LRU仅需30%-53%可训练参数；在POPGym上Frozen LRU甚至略优于LRU（0.464 vs 0.458）；训练mixer可分别带来18.5%和13.2%的性能提升。

Conclusion: 学习循环记忆模块并非部分可观测强化学习的必要条件。冻结循环网络提供简单、参数高效且性能强劲的基线，可广泛应用于向量与视觉、部分可观测强化学习任务。该发现挑战了"循环RL必须训练记忆"的普遍假设。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) under partial observability typically re- lies on recurrent networks to encode temporal information, with the recurrent module trained jointly with the policy or value function. This raises a natural question: is learning the recurrent network actually necessary? In this paper, we investigate whether a frozen recurrent network can provide sufficient memory for solving par- tially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). Motivated by the theoretical foundations of Reservoir Computing (RC) and Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC), we study a simple archi- tecture that combines a fixed recurrent network with a trainable nonlinear output module. We evaluate this approach across tasks with varying memory demands, observation modalities, and action spaces. Surprisingly, frozen recurrent networks support recall over hundreds of steps and achieve competitive control performance across diverse POMDPs, while using less than half the number of trainable parameters required by their fully trainable counterparts. These results suggest that learning the recurrent memory module is not always necessary for solving POMDPs. Frozen recurrent networks therefore provide a simple, parameter-efficient, and sur- prisingly strong baseline for partially observable RL. Our source code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [117] [ReSFlow: Rectifying Categorical Flows on Statistical Manifolds for One-Step Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13225)
*Xiaohuan Jia,Renzhe Xu,Xiao Wang,Jiayun Wu,Shaohua Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReSFlow 提出在概率单纯形的 Fisher-Rao 统计流形上,通过平方根映射将问题提升到超球面正交象限,在该球面上进行迭代 reflow,实现沿测地线的"一步"离散数据生成,并在 MNIST、Text8、启动子 DNA 等任务上验证其高效的单步生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统计流匹配（SFM）在离散数据上需要多步数值积分才能采样，原因是独立耦合产生的条件向量场混合了多条相交的测地线，在边际化后形成高度弯曲的轨迹，无法直接做单步生成。该工作的核心动机是把连续空间中 Rectified Flow 的"直且快"思想推广到非欧几里得的统计流形上。

Method: 首先利用平方根微分同胚 π 把概率单纯形 Δ 映到单位超球面的正交象限 S+，使得 Fisher-Rao 度量与球面标准度量等距。然后在 S+ 上用 slerp 球面线性插值定义测地线条件路径，训练切空间上的速度场 v_θ（通过切空间投影保证流仍在流形上）。接着进行迭代 reflow：用已学 ODE 从 t=0 到 t=1 模拟得到新端点对 (Z_0, Z_1)，再用 slerp 重新训练速度场，使轨迹逐步"拉直"为互不相交的测地线。推理时仅需一次速度场评估，通过球面指数映射 Exp 直接映射到目标点，再逆映射回 Δ。理论上证明 marginal preservation、球面传输代价单调下降以及 O(1/N_reflow) 的拉直速率。

Result: 在四个基准上验证：(1) 2-单纯形上的 Swiss-roll，ReSFlow NLL=-2.25，介于 LinearFM(-1.88) 与 SFM(-2.38) 之间，但 ODE 采样时间最短（0.0361s）。(2) 二值化 MNIST：单步 FID 5.973（最佳），时间仅 0.452s/1k 样本，相比 SFM 在 NFE=34 才能达到相近质量。(3) Text8 字符建模：ReSFlow BPC=1.261，远优于 SFM(1.830)、LinearFM(2.154)、R-LFM(3.267) 和依赖 GPT-2 tokenizer 的 ReDi(2.306)。(4) 1024bp 启动子 DNA 条件生成：单步 SP-MSE=0.028718，与 ODE 采样结果持平，速度从 67.94s 降到 0.409s/1k。附录还给出 Fisher-Rao 传输代价和黎曼测地线直度随 reflow 次数单调下降的实验证据。

Conclusion: ReSFlow 验证了在统计流形的内蕴球面几何上做 reflow 既能保留 Fisher-Rao 度量带来的离散生成优势，又能通过迭代拉直使 ODE 轨迹接近常速测地线，从而实现离散数据的高质量一步生成。理论上给出了边际保持、传输代价收缩以及 O(1/N_reflow) 拉直速率的形式化保证。其局限在于 Fisher-Rao 度量对类别语义一视同仁，未引入预训练语义先验，对依赖语义层次的离散任务可能受限。该方法有望推广到其他球面型数据如单位向量嵌入和方向统计。

Abstract: Generative modeling for discrete data has been significantly advanced by learning continuous vector fields on the statistical manifolds to transport simple priors to target discrete distributions. However, because these continuous-time flows are not constrained to follow geodesics on the statistical manifold, thereby requiring multi-step numerical integration for simulation and leading to substantial computational costs during inference. In this work, drawing inspiration from the "straight and fast" properties of Rectified Flow in continuous Euclidean space, we propose the Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow) model, which enables one-step categorical generation on statistical manifolds by explicitly learning geodesic trajectories that adhere to the intrinsic Riemannian geometry. By rectifying the flow on the statistical manifold, we theoretically guarantee that trajectories between prior and target distributions approximate geodesics. This rectification significantly reduces the transport cost by aligning the learned trajectories directly along geodesics on the statistical manifold, allowing the model to map pure noise to target discrete data in a single step. Through extensive experiments on diverse real-world generative tasks, ranging from image and text to biological domains, we demonstrate ReSFlow's superior one-step generation quality, which truly embodies geodesically optimal and rapid categorical generation. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [118] [Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13253)
*Irene Cannistraci,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种闭式、无标签的仿射映射（affine translator），用单个线性层替换多达96%的表格Transformer块，在171个分类数据集上8个前沿表格基础模型中，证明这些模型存在严重过参数化。半深度压缩平均仅损失≤0.002 AUROC，单块TabPFN-3可减少6倍内存并加速2.4倍而几乎无性能损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然以零样本推理便利著称，但其12-24层Transformer架构带来高昂的计算与内存成本，限制了在资源受限场景（如本地临床服务器）的部署。同时，浅层的GBDT在这些任务上仍具竞争力，提示表格任务或许并不天然需要深度架构。因此亟需回答：能否在保留性能的前提下削减TFM的架构冗余？

Method: 设计闭式无标签仿射翻译器（ridge regression），用于绕过连续窗口的Transformer块。对单轴注意力模型使用共享(W, b)，对双轴模型（如TabPFNv2、LimiX）为每个特征token拟合独立的(W_f, b_f)。窗口选择通过最小化校准集上前向KL散度（分类）或R²（回归）实现，完全无监督。可通过KL容忍度ε自动选择压缩深度。当窗口邻接分类头或编码器时，仿射映射可被吸收为零额外参数。

Result: 在8个TFM、6个模型家族、171个分类数据集上：半深度压缩损失≤0.002中位AUROC，半深度TabFM仍优于所有其他完整TFM和调优GBDT。不同家族过参数化方式不同：TabPFN-3依赖其编码器（保留任意单块性能相当）；其他单轴模型计算分散于首块；双轴模型集中于单一块。压缩节省高达15亿参数，GPU推理加速达6×（中位成本0.03 AUROC）。单块TabPFN-3缓存查询加速2.4×、内存减少6.1×、性能几乎无损。在nanoTabPFN受控预训练中，压缩12层至k层与从头训练k层性能相当（差距≤0.011），6层从头训练即匹配12层基线，证实该规模下深度冗余。

Conclusion: TFM存在显著架构冗余，可通过无标签闭式仿射映射高效压缩至浅层架构而几乎不损失性能。仿射映射能奏效是因为后层将表征投影至预训练分类头所期望的空间，而非进一步精炼决策边界。该方法支持跨相似schema数据集（MIMIC-III与eICU）的零样本迁移。这些发现激励设计自适应架构：仅在确实需要时才分配深度，循环复用单块权重可在不增加参数下提供深度。开放问题包括该冗余性是否随生产级规模扩展，以及回归任务为何需要更多深度。

Abstract: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.

</details>


### [119] [In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13411)
*Matteo Rufolo,Dario Piga,Filippo Pura,Marco Forgione*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer编码器-解码器的统一概率元辨识框架，用于系统辨识的上下文学习。该方法通过合成数据预训练一个元模型，能够在零样本条件下从上下文输入-输出序列直接预测新系统的输出，并提供校准的不确定性估计。通过序列分块和加权集成策略处理长序列问题，并利用元模型生成的不确定性感知合成数据增强经典系统辨识。在Wiener-Hammerstein基准测试、级联水箱、耦合电驱动以及CSTR分布外场景中均取得了与最先进方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统系统辨识方法针对每个系统需重新选择模型结构、调谐参数，且无法在不同系统间复用知识。当每个系统的训练数据稀缺时，复杂参数模型容易过拟合。现有方法缺乏类级别的零样本预测能力，且Transformer的自注意力机制对长序列处理存在平方复杂度问题。

Method: 1. 采用编码器-解码器Transformer架构，编码器将上下文数据处理为系统隐式表示ζ，解码器通过交叉注意力机制结合查询输入生成概率预测（高斯分布的均值和方差）；2. 训练阶段采用循环分块网络（基于RNN）将长上下文分割为多个patch，降低注意力计算复杂度；3. 推理阶段采用加权集成策略，对多个重叠上下文子序列的输出按预测不确定性的倒数平方加权融合（推导证明为最小方差无偏估计）；4. 利用预训练元模型生成合成数据，通过最大似然框架将合成样本的不确定性σ²作为损失权重倒数整合到经典参数辨识的正则化目标中，对真实数据稀缺场景下的参数模型进行正则化。

Result: 在320个Wiener-Hammerstein系统分布内测试中，RMSE均值为0.038-0.048；在WH基准测试上RMSE为0.0014（优于dynoNet的0.0017和ARX的0.0434）；在级联水箱基准上RMSE为0.429，与dynoNet的0.421相当；在CED基准上RMSE为[0.068, 0.055]，与dynoNet的[0.062, 0.047]接近；在CSTR分布外场景中，仅通过输入微调（无需改变训练系统类别）即可将零样本RMSE从1.249降至0.242（接近全微调的0.115）；在CED基准中，使用元模型生成的合成数据增强后，R²中位数从0.70/0.88提升至0.88/0.93，且变异性显著降低。

Conclusion: 该框架成功证明了上下文学习在系统辨识中的可行性，消除了逐系统辨识和专家干预的必要性，在零样本条件下实现了与最先进方法相当的精度，并在分布外场景中展示了强大的泛化能力。未来研究方向包括：1. 扩展到大规模（数十亿参数）元模型以覆盖更广泛的系统类别；2. 开发蒸馏架构以提高边缘设备的部署效率；3. 探索替代Transformer的架构（如状态空间模型和扩散模型），并利用LLaMA、DeepSeek等开源模型进行低秩适配。局限性在于：训练计算量大、推理时模型较重、缺乏可解释的参数化表示。

Abstract: Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. Third, we systematically evaluate the framework on standard nonlinear system identification benchmarks and on a challenging out-of-distribution scenario, demonstrating competitive accuracy with state-of-the-art methods and strong generalization, including cases where input-only adaptation is sufficient to handle significant distribution shifts.

</details>


### [120] [Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13504)
*Oriol Corcoll,Qiyao Wei,Ciarán Mark Gilligan-Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了解释性世界模型（Explanatory World Models, EWM），一个通过语言模型生成解释来识别导致结果的早期事件，并将奖励重新分配到这些相关事件而非时间临近事件的归因框架。该方法在长视野强化学习基准（Crafter、WordCraft）、公开推荐基准（KuaiRand）和工业级生成式推荐器上显著优于PPO、LaRe等基线，在奖励延迟越严重时增益越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准强化学习通过时间临近性（折扣回报）传播奖励，但这种时间先验对距离远但重要的行动分配了过弱的信号，导致样本效率低下。在长视野决策问题（如推荐系统中用户行为可能在数百到数千次交互后才出现）中，这种基于时间临近的信用分配成为关键瓶颈。作者受认知科学中解释作为学习机制的研究启发，将长视野信用分配重新定义为基于解释的归因问题。

Method: （1）EWM框架：以前序事件（证据）和观察事件（现象）为输入，输出加权因果假设（解释图）；（2）保守分层重分配算子（CHO）：递归地将奖励沿解释图重新分配到相关前序事件，保持未折现情景回报守恒，支持最大深度D、阈值η等参数；（3）三种解释变体：基于Halpern实际因果（HP）、Lombrozo解释广度/简洁性（LS/LB）、Deutsch难变解释（D），以及中性基线（B）和集成变体（LI）；（4）使用前沿语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5）实例化EWM，利用预训练先验识别轨迹中事件间的因果关系；（5）作为归因层集成到在线/离线RL中，不修改环境交互协议或策略架构。

Result: （1）Crafter：EWM在全部8种折扣因子和情景长度组合上优于PPO，差距随长度L增大而扩大，在L=1000时约为LaRe的2倍；（2）WordCraft：在更难3-mix拆分上EWM-LLM接近oracle分数，PPO和LaRe表现接近随机；（3）KuaiRand离线：LB变体获得最大AUC提升（1.99pp）和对数损失降低，优于SFT和LaRe；（4）KuaiRand在线：EWM（无界）平均回报从3.773提升至13.249，接近oracle的15.653；（5）工业生成式推荐器：EWM Reach RLFT使Recall提升3.75倍，下游参与度指标提升约3-4倍。

Conclusion: 解释能够为延迟结果的学习提供结构化且可重用的信用信号。EWM通过将奖励重分配从时间临近性转向解释相关性，有效解决了长视野信用分配问题。解释与奖励函数解耦的特性使得同一解释图可在不同奖励函数间复用。该工作为将认知科学中的解释理论引入RL信用分配提供了可行路径，并在受控环境和真实工业推荐场景中验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

</details>


### [121] [SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13644)
*Bastian Schäfer,Dominika Matus,Lennart Purucker,Ricardo Knauer,Erik Rodner,Frank Hutter,Anton Sokolov,Arnaud Liefooghe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SelectArena 是一个面向真实世界表格数据的现代特征选择基准测试，涵盖 15 种广泛使用的特征选择方法在 71 个手动筛选的真实数据集上的表现，使用标准化评估协议和先进的表格基础模型进行系统评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征选择基准测试存在三大局限：依赖过时模型、采用临时性评估协议、以及使用人工生成或非代表性数据，导致科研与实际应用之间存在显著差距，无法为从业者提供有效的方法选择指导。

Method: 研究团队从 368 个候选数据集和 296 种特征选择方法中，通过严格的筛选协议精选出 71 个高质量真实世界表格数据集（涵盖二分类、多分类和回归任务）和 15 种方法学上独立且广泛使用的方法。采用 5 种下游模型（包括表格基础模型 TabICLv2）和 5 种基数约束进行标准化评估，并在 Elo 评分体系下从预测性能、运行时间、稳定性和有效性四个维度进行全面比较。

Result: 研究揭示了清晰的方法权衡：基于树的方法（CART 和 RFImportance）及 F-Test 在预测性能和运行时间方面处于 Pareto 最优；F-Test、信息论和距离方法在稳定性和有效性方面领先；F-Test 在所有四个评估维度上表现最为均衡。搜索类方法（SBE、SFS、LOCO）速度慢且性能与稳定性较低。整体而言，没有单一方法能在所有维度上占优，因此实践者的选择取决于其优先考虑的优化目标。

Conclusion: SelectArena 作为迄今为止最大的通用特征选择基准，填补了科学评估与实际应用之间的鸿沟，不仅为从业者提供了实用的方法选择指导，还作为可扩展的开源平台支持未来特征选择研究的发展，强调性能、稳定性与计算成本之间的关键权衡考量。

Abstract: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection. We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models. Our results reveal clear trade-offs across predictive performance, runtime, stability, and validity. Tree-based methods, CART and RFImportance, along with F-Test are Pareto-optimal when taking into account predictive performance and runtime. F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics. Search-based methods are slow, unstable and achieve low performance. SelectArena turns these findings into practical guidance and, as an extensible platform, supports future feature selection research.

</details>


### [122] [Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13660)
*Adrien Deliege,Marc Van Droogenbroeck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一的归纳式(inductive)协议下,系统地交叉控制了VARC和TRM两种ARC模型在预训练与测试时训练(TTT)两个阶段的预算(任务变体数V和样本展示预算B),发现TTT的样本展示预算对两个模型都一致有益,而TTT任务变体数主要帮助TRM,VARC对预训练的依赖显著弱于TRM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC模型(VARC与TRM)的原始工作在架构、预训练数据(RE-ARC)、增强方式以及TTT设置上差异很大,仅比较最终pass@2难以判断性能差异究竟来自架构还是训练/评估资源。本文旨在把"预算"这一常被忽视的变量显式化、可控化,以便公平地解读架构层面的收益。

Method: 1) 定义"协议"(protocol)与"预算配置"(budget configuration):预算由任务变体数V和样本展示预算B = D×V×P刻画;2) 在ARC-AGI-1(400评测任务)上,采用统一的归纳式设置(去掉VARC的RE-ARC外部数据,去掉TRM的转导式设置),对VARC(18M,ViT-based)与TRM(7M,递归式)分别进行5×4的预训练×TTT预算交叉(5种预训练预算含"无预训练",4种TTT预算);3) 报告pass@1/pass@2/oracle,并对比A100上的GPU小时数;4) 保持各自模型原有的表示、优化器与解码流程不变,以隔离预算效应。

Result: 1) TTT样本展示预算从15.3k增至300.3k,在所有设置下都提升pass@2(VARC中位+6.13,TRM中位+5.38);2) TTT任务变体数从51增至1001:对TRM的10组对比中9组提升(中位+0.82),对VARC仅3组提升(中位-0.37),VARC更偏好较少变体;3) 预训练:TRM所有16格均受益(无预训练最佳19.63%→加预训练最佳37.50%),VARC仅13/16格受益(无预训练最佳35.50%→加预训练最佳40.00%),且VARC在预训练变体数增至1001时全部8组对比均下降;4) 算力:整套实验约4904 A100 GPU小时,其中TTT约占76%,高样本展示预算的TTT单独占TTT总开销的约93%。

Conclusion: TTT预算(尤其是样本展示量)是ARC评估中不可忽略的因素;不同架构对预训练与任务变体的敏感度不同(TRM更依赖预训练与大量变体,VARC更轻量且能仅靠TTT取得有竞争力结果)。因此未来ARC论文应在可比、可报告的预算下进行基准测试,代码与配置已开源。

Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increasing the TTT task-variant count consistently helps only TRM, whereas VARC often performs better with fewer variants. VARC also remains competitive without pretraining, while TRM benefits much more from it. These results show that pretraining and TTT budgets affect ARC evaluation and motivate reporting at comparable budgets.

</details>


### [123] [Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13692)
*Leonardo Cesani,Matteo Papini,Marcello Restelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LVR-PG框架，将PAGE-PG和STORM-PG等循环方差约减策略梯度方法与防御性重要性采样相结合，在弱梯度控制条件下使用纯一阶更新实现了$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$的末迭代全局收敛样本复杂度，并通过扩展下界证明达到最小最大最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方差约减策略梯度方法虽能缓解蒙特卡洛估计的高方差问题，但现有最优样本复杂度的证明要么依赖于重要性权重方差有界等限制性假设，要么依赖不切实际的二阶运算。需要一种仅用一阶方法、不依赖有界重要性权重假设即可达到$\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$下界的框架。

Method: 提出Loopless Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient (LVR-PG)统一框架，抽象一类整合循环递归更新与防御性重要性采样的一阶估计器，包含PAGE-PG和STORM-PG作为特例。证明在WGD假设（弱梯度控制）和均方光滑性条件下，最优混合系数$\xi=1/2$，刷新概率$p$与动量参数$\alpha$满足$p+\alpha=\Theta(B\epsilon^2)$时，算法达到最小最大最优样本复杂度。同时构造二元MDP硬实例，采用Le Cam两点法将Azar等(2013)的下界扩展到连续参数化策略。

Result: 在CartPole-v1、Swimmer-v4、HalfCheetah-v4和Hopper-v4上的实验表明，DEF-STORM-PG（$\alpha>0, p=0$配置）以更少轨迹达到高回报，优于GPOMDP、DEF-PAGE-PG和N-PG-IGT等基线。在CartPole-v1上使用$(\alpha, p)=(0.9, 0.5)$混合配置获得最高平均AUC 453.5±7.2。梯度变异性诊断显示DEF-STORM-PG和LVR-PG的逐轨迹梯度方差低于基线。

Conclusion: LVR-PG框架确立了一类最小最大最优的一阶策略梯度算法（至多相差对数因子），无需重要性权重方差有界假设或二阶正则性。理论上将样本复杂度$\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$与匹配的$\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$下界统一起来，证明了在策略优化中梯度控制条件本身并不能消除由随机转移动力学引起的不可约估计方差。实验验证了动量型递归方差约减配合防御性重要性采样的实证优越性。

Abstract: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.

</details>


### [124] [Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13693)
*Nektarios Kalampalikis,Pablo M. Olmos,Isabel Valera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COG（Calibration in One Go）框架，将后验校准重构为双层Stackelberg优化问题，在单次端到端训练中同时优化模型精度与校准质量，仅需额外引入一个校准器学习率超参数。其中COG-FC变体直接以最终分类层作为校准器，无需任何额外参数，在多个数据集和架构上达到或超越现有最优校准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验校准方法需要单独校准集、额外参数和分阶段优化，在多任务学习等场景中开销大且流程复杂；训练时校准方法又需特殊损失函数。亟需一种统一、轻量、可端到端联合优化的校准方案。

Method: 将后验校准建模为双层优化（BLO）问题：领导者为校准器，跟随者为分类网络。采用Stackelberg博弈视角，通过一阶梯度下降-上升（GDA）策略，使用同一小批量数据在单次前向/反向传播中以不同学习率联合更新两类参数（约束λ_c < λf以维持Stackelberg层级）。框架支持温度缩放、矩阵缩放、神经网络层等多种校准器，其中COG-FC直接将最终分类层作为校准器，引入零额外参数。

Result: 在SVHN、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100及CelebA（多任务）上的实验表明，COG-FC在精度、NLL和Brier分数的综合排名上与SOTA校准器相当或更优，且无需额外参数或校准数据。OOD检测中COG变体表现突出，协变量偏移下COG+LS鲁棒性更佳。ViT和WRN-28-10上的实验验证了方法的架构无关性。

Conclusion: COG将后验校准转化为端到端训练过程，大幅简化校准流程并消除对独立校准集的依赖，推荐COG-FC作为精度与校准兼顾的轻量级默认方案。未来工作可探索乐观/悲观BLO形式、多任务校准指标设计以及跨模态扩展。

Abstract: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.

</details>


### [125] [Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13724)
*Hendrik Stumpf,Francesco Quinzan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP)，一种端到端的反事实推断框架，无需先验因果图知识即可直接从观测数据回答反事实查询。该方法结合Graph Neural Processes与GNN对偶图结构约束，在合成和图像基准上均优于现有方法，并具备跨图规模和OOD特征的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统反事实推断方法依赖已知的因果图，但在许多实际场景（医学、生物学、社会科学）中因果图不可知或估计错误，进而导致误差传播。因此需要一种无需显式因果图发现即可进行反事实推断的端到端方法。

Method: CFGNP基于Neural Processes框架，将观测样本作为context集合，通过GNN利用对偶图（dual graph）的结构约束。具体架构包含三阶段：(1)观测上下文编码——通过聚合节点和全连接子图压缩观测信息；(2)事实信息融合——将上下文表征与事实单元结合；(3)反事实分布估计——通过对偶图上限制跨世界消息传递（仅对应的事实-反事实变量间通信），预测反事实分布的混合高斯参数。训练采用负对数似然目标。在完全连接内生图的条件下，证明可消除显式外生节点，用单向GNN近似双向GNN（Proposition 1）。模型具有置换等变/不变性和图规模可迁移性（Propositions 2-3）。

Result: 在Triangle、M-shape（LIN/NLIN/NADD变体）和German Loan合成基准上，CFGNP几乎全面优于BGM、VACA、CFM基线，German Loan上MSE从4.51×10⁻²降至0.19×10⁻²。CheXpert图像反事实任务中，CFGNP年龄MAE从10.88降至2.71，疾病ROC-AUC达0.77。Graph-size实验中，仅在10节点图训练的模型可零成本迁移至30节点图。在CheXpert上测试了4种OOD特征设置的鲁棒性。Transformer消融实验证实CFGNP架构明显优于普通Transformer。两节点SCM实验验证了在可识别和非可识别设置下的收敛行为。

Conclusion: CFGNP是一种无需因果图知识即可进行反事实推断的有效端到端框架，在多种基准上取得最优性能，并具备跨图规模、跨OOD特征的泛化能力。局限性在于计算成本较高（需观测上下文），且在反事实分布不可识别时无法恢复真实分布。未来工作可结合因果图的先验知识（如边的存在性或经摊销因果结构学习方法获得的边缘分布）。

Abstract: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. CFGNP uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to exploit the dual-graph structure by restricting cross-world message passing to corresponding factual--counterfactual variables. Across synthetic and image-based benchmarks, CFGNP achieves stronger predictive performance than existing approaches, including on the German Loan benchmark, where it reduces MSE from $4.51 \times 10^{-2}$ to $0.19 \times 10^{-2}$. Furthermore, on synthetic causal graphs, a model trained only on 10-node graphs maintains strong predictive performance on graphs with up to 30 nodes, without retraining.

</details>


### [126] [Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13735)
*Yuhong Chou,Zehao Liu,Yuqi Pan,Qian Liu,Xianwei Chen,Zhongzhu Zhou,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Orthros 是一种面向长场景的高效注意力机制，核心思想是将单层内的自注意力按序列处理的"预填充-解码"两阶段进行解耦：所有位置均执行滑动窗口注意力以维持线性复杂度，而仅在需要预测下一 token 的输出位置上额外执行对历史 KV 缓存的全局交叉注意力。该设计在严格保持训练与推理一致性的前提下，无需跨层注意力或 decoder-decoder 等结构性改动，可即插即用替换已有 Transformer 模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性或滑动窗口注意力虽将复杂度降至线性，但因 KV 淘汰或状态压缩在长上下文任务上严重损害 in-context recall；当前主流的 hybrid Transformer（在不同层交替使用线性与全注意力）仅获得常数级加速，整体渐近复杂度仍被全注意力 O(T²) 瓶颈限制，难以满足长上下文场景下 prefill 重、decode 轻的实际负载特征。

Method: 将序列划分为负责下一 token 预测的输出位置 T_out 与其余上下文位置 T_in。在统一的 Orthros 层中，所有 token 通过共享 KV 缓存执行窗口大小为 W 的滑动窗口自注意力；同时仅对 T_out 位置的 token 用一组额外的可学习 query 投影（带 element-wise scale-offset 变换）执行对完整历史 KV 的因果交叉注意力输出，并将两路输出沿序列维拼接后线性投影。预训练时 T_out=T，SFT 时 T_out 等于回复长度，Prefill 时 T_out=1（仅最后 prompt token 复制一次用于起始生成），Decode 时 T=1（单个生成 token 复制一份分别用于更新 KV 和全局交叉预测）。

Result: 在 160M–6.8B 的受控 token 预算下，Orthros 在常识推理平均分上与 Transformer 相当或更优（6.8B 时 53.10 vs 50.31），且 SO 变换带来一致的提升；1.3B/100B token 从零预训练在 7 项常识推理基准平均 53.98，超过 Transformer、GDN、GLA、RetNet、SWA 等所有对比架构；将 Llama3.1-8B 与 Qwen3-8B 通过 80B token 持续训练转换为 Orthros 后，平均性能（67.26、68.37）同时超过原始 base 和同等数据量的 Base CPT；1.3B 模型在 DROP/NQA/SWDE/TQA/FDA/SQuAD 等 in-context recall 基准上平均 34.4 分，与 Transformer（33.9）持平并显著优于其他高效注意力架构；8B Orthros 在 128K needle-in-a-haystack 上达到近完美检索准确率；单卡 8K–128K 及 8 卡 64K–1M 的 prefilling 延迟一致低于 Qwen3，最大加速达 21.9×；端到端 SGLang 推理在 128K 输入/128 输出下，Orthros E2E 24.6s、TTFT 17.0s 较 Transformer 84.9s/77.2s 显著降低，decode-only 吞吐保持相当。

Conclusion: 通过将计算复杂度分配从"结构维度"（层间混合）转移到"阶段维度"（prefill vs decode），Orthros 在长上下文 prefill-heavy 负载下取得低于标准 Transformer 的渐近复杂度，同时不依赖 KV 淘汰或状态压缩从而保留全注意力级别的 in-context recall。其作为自包含模块保持训练-推理一致性并支持对已训练模型即插即用转换，是 Transformer 在工业长上下文场景中有潜力的替代架构。

Abstract: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.

</details>


### [127] [SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13737)
*Hongrui Zheng,Aditya Singh,Rahul Mangharam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SafeDiSTL 提出了一种在共享团队级约束下进行多智能体信用分配的约束型 MARL 框架。它利用 STL 鲁棒性梯度和可微动力学将每个运行最大成本增量按时间和智能体进行分解，同时保留原始约束用于对偶更新。该框架在协同运输、连通导航和网络化交通控制三个任务上对共享约束处理和任务完成之间的权衡表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在合作式多智能体任务中，针对共享约束（如机器人共同运送的负载避免碰撞障碍物）的全局团队违规成本无法区分哪个智能体的行为对违规贡献最大。现有的约束型 MARL 方法（如 MACPO、MAPPO-Lagrangian）通常在不分解违规的情况下向所有智能体广播相同的成本信号，导致冲突的更新或学习进度缓慢。需要一种原则性的机制来分解共享约束，分配智能体特定的学习信号，并协同考虑个体责任的变化，以实现有效的协作。

Method: SafeDiSTL 利用信号时序逻辑（STL）鲁棒性来衡量整个回合内约束违规情况。它通过运行最大值增量构建回合级成本：每个增量代表瞬时违规超过先前峰值的部分。方法利用平滑的全程鲁棒性近似和可微动力学，通过反向传播至各个智能体在决策时刻的动作来计算动作灵敏度（灵敏度定义为对负鲁棒性的动作导数的范数）。这些灵敏度在每个决策时间对智能体进行归一化，以分配成本增量，同时保留总成本。最终，每个智能体的归因成本被输入到集中训练、去中心化执行的 MAPPO 风格限制策略优化中，使用基于 PPO 的裁剪目标，并加上共享的拉格朗日乘数更新。

Result: 在三个合作多智能体基准上评估 SafeDiSTL：协同有效载荷运输（1-3 个障碍物）、连接导航和网络化交通控制。与 MACPO、MAPPO-L 和无约束 MAPPO 等基线相比，SafeDiSTL 在安全成功率方面达到 1.6-5.1 倍的改进，导航中安全成功率提升 11.1%，交通运输吞吐量提升 50-68%。消融研究表明，责任分配机制至关重要——均匀分配（无责任归因）会导致性能不佳，并且全程鲁棒性运行最大值增量成本优于逐步成本。该方法在保留无约束策略性能的同时，表现出显著改进的共享约束处理能力。

Conclusion: SafeDiSTL 引入了一种新颖的责任归因机制，使用 STL 鲁棒性梯度将共享团队级约束分解到智能体和时间步，同时保留总成本。它支持集中训练、去中心化执行的策略优化。在三个多样化的协同任务中的实证评估表明 SafeDiSTL 在处理共享约束方面优于现有约束型 MARL 基线。局限性包括对动力学分梯度的依赖以及在接触密集型场景中梯度计算的难度，当前方法仅考虑影响的大小而未考虑方向。未来工作可以探索无梯度信号和真实机器人平台验证。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

</details>


### [128] [Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13755)
*Chenxu Zhang,Yaorui Shi,Wenlong Zhang,Jianchao Tan,Zihan Wang,Yiming Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MCGPO 是一种面向长视野 LLM 智能体训练的辅助偏好学习方法。它在已有的同组 rollout 内部，通过匹配"前动作状态摘要 + 任务规则标注的 rubric 进度"来构建二元动作对的偏好标签，使用固定折分离候选决策与提供标签的对侧结果，并按"双动作支持度"对损失加权，作为附加项叠加在 GraphGPO 任务目标上，全程无需评论家。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，6 个环境–基座组合（3 个训练种子）均相对 GraphGPO 取得均值成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野智能体训练面临稀疏终末反馈下中间决策的信用分配难题。现有基于重复状态/转移的分组方法（如 GiGPO、GraphGPO）会出现"同一状态摘要对应不同剩余决策子问题"的表征错配，导致前期有用动作获得弱反馈、后期动作继承高成功率，对比结果混淆了先验进度与当前动作贡献。如何在有限同组 rollout 中筛选"上下文支持充分"的动作对并合理加权其影响，是本文要解决的核心问题。

Method: MCGPO 三步流程 Match–Label–Learn：①Match——以"前动作状态摘要 h(s) + 已观测 rubric 进度 C + 任务规则导出的 frontier F"作为匹配键，在同一候选折内对决策分组，并依次尝试精确→粗化匹配规则，直到找到两个动作都有支持证据的上下文；②Label——用对侧固定折（4 条 vs 4 条）的终末结果为动作对定向，按 |û|·n_p/(n_p+κ)·q_ℓ 计算支持度折扣后的证据权重，仅保留 |û|≥ϵ 的对；③Learn——将上述加权对偏好作为附加 pairwise 损失与 GraphGPO 任务目标共同优化（λ_pair=0.05），全程复用已有 rollout 与原始历史，保留 critic-free 训练。每个任务每个方向最多接受 2 个不相交对。

Result: 在 ALFWorld（1.5B/7B）与 WebShop（1.5B/7B/4B/8B）共 6 个环境–基座组合、各 3 训练种子的对照实验中，MCGPO 三种子平均成功率较匹配 GraphGPO 提升 0.47–1.46 pp（Qwen2.5 ALFWorld/WebShop）与 3.96/5.16 pp（Qwen3-4B/8B WebShop）；ALFWorld 起点已 >92%，剩余空间有限。3-seed 因子实验支持"对侧折证据"与"证据加权"两条设计；表示消融中联合 state–rubric 匹配在 4 个设置中均取得最高均值。配对 95% Student-t 区间在部分设置跨越 0，小幅提升存在统计不确定性。WebShop 偏好与候选终末结果一致率约 69–74%。

Conclusion: MCGPO 提供了一种在已有 rollout 组内构造"上下文有支持"的动作级偏好监督的实用方案。固定折分离与证据加权是关键设计，联合状态+rubric 进度匹配优于单一表征。与同评分器信号下的 reward shaping 相比，完整的 MCGPO 偏好学习方案更具优势。局限：仅在两个文本环境与 Qwen 系列评估，依赖人工定义的 rubric 通道与任务规则图；偏好为同组观测估计，证据加权仅能缓解小样本问题；3 种子下小幅提升的统计不确定性较大，泛化与显著性仍需更多模型、种子与独立任务验证。

Abstract: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

</details>


### [129] [When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13765)
*Adarsh Jamadandi,Nicolas Keriven,Aline Roumy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了离散图扩散模型中Erdős–Rényi (E-R) 先验的根本局限性：在无条件、无节点特征生成中，边独立噪声与可交换性要求共同迫使终端先验为E-R图，导致任何GNN去噪器在E-R图上近似输出E-R图，产生固定点病态，丧失节点异质性。作者提出潜在社交性先验(LSP)与联合扩散框架，通过将连续潜变量（节点社交权重）与离散边结构协同演化，在保留可交换性的同时打破边独立性，无需复杂编码器即能恢复高阶结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散图扩散模型（如DiGress）依赖边独立的Markovian噪声过程，结合可交换性约束后，终端先验被迫为Erdős–Rényi随机图。理论证明与实验均表明，在大图极限下，任何GNN去噪器在E-R输入上近似输出E-R图（固定点病态），导致生成图同质化、缺乏高阶结构。此前工作将此归因于GNN表达能力不足，通过加转而加入辅助结构/谱特征，但未审视先验本身的根本缺陷。

Method: 1) **理论分析**：证明交换性+边独立→终端先验必为E-R（引理4.1）；证明GAT/GCN/GIN去噪器在E-R图上输出近似常数（定理4.2，E-R为不动点）。3) **LSP设计**：引入节点正权 w_i，解释：边概率 p_ij=1−exp(−w_i w_j)，通过对数重参数化 u_i=log(w_i) 施加高斯先验；该模型源自非齐次随机图，保持可交换性且打破边独立性。4) **联合扩散**：潜变量 u 经DDPM加噪；边转移矩阵以清洁潜变量 u^0 为条件（而非噪声版 u^t），保留闭式前向分解；反向过程由网络预测 û^{0,t} 引导，按对计算配对特定转移矩阵。5) **训练损失**：u^0 近似闭式表达（基于度数），无需编码器；交叉熵+λ_u MSE联合损失。

Result: 在CoraChameleon新基准（基于Cora/Chameleon采样）上，JointLSP+DiGress在三角形数、聚类系数、度相关性等高阶统计上优于DiGress（无特征）和多数k≤10结构特征配置，且固定点病态得到缓解（节点倾向性方差在整个扩散轨迹上保持非零）。在Ego和Community数据集上，JointLSP+SparseDiff同样优于基线。额外实验表明，度数辅助特征或随机节点特征均无法解决E-R病态，而LSP通过将异质性内嵌于先验本身解决该问题。

Conclusion: 本文识别出离散图扩散模型在无条件无节点特征生成场景下因E-R先验导致的根本性固定点病态，提出潜在社交性先验(LSP)与联合扩散框架作为解决方案。LSP无需复杂编码器即可通过内在诱导节点异质性避免E-R病态，使生成图恢复高阶结构。未来工作包括将LSP扩展至社区感知变体以捕捉群落结构，以及与谱特征结合。

Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.

</details>


### [130] [DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13767)
*Mahsa Salmani,Sayeh Sharify,Hesham Mostafa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DualQuant提出了一种无需校准数据的双尺度（行+列）后训练量化框架，通过变量分裂与块坐标下降最小化权重重建MSE，获得行/列尺度直接用于激活重缩放，统一支持INT4、MX家族和NVFP4格式，在Llama和Qwen模型上匹配或超越需要校准的SmoothQuant，且在RTX 4090上W4A4推理实现2.61×内存缩减和2.46×吞吐量加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM的低比特推理需要同时量化权重和激活才能充分利用4-bit硬件加速，但激活量化面临通道异常值问题。SmoothQuant等方法需要校准数据，在隐私敏感或设备端场景中受限；现有校准无关方法（如QuaRot、SINQ+）在MX/NV块浮点格式上效果不佳或完全失效，缺少一种统一支持现代4-bit格式的校准无关W+A量化方案。

Method: 将双尺度权重量化建模为非凸非光优化，目标为权重重建MSE。采用变量分裂将每个尺度分为内部副本（控制量化网格分配）和外部副本（控制反缩放），通过块坐标下降（BCD）交替求解，各子问题均有闭式解。每次更新后将尺度投影到格式允许集（如E8M0、FP8 UE4M3）。关键观察：由权重MSE最小化得到的列尺度天然可用于激活重缩放（公式3），等价于SmoothQuant的形式但无需校准数据。算法统一支持INT4、MXINT4、MXFP4、NVFP4，并给出收敛性证明（单调下降+坐标平稳点）。

Result: 在Llama（2-7B/3.1-8B/3.2-1B）和Qwen（2.5-7B/3-0.6B/3-14B）家族的WikiText-2、C4困惑度及MMLU、HellaSwag、PIQA、ARC-Easy、WinoGrande零样本任务上：DualQuant在大多数模型和格式上匹配或超越需校准的SmoothQuant，显著优于校准无关基线QuaRot和SINQ+，尤其在NVFP4上后者完全失效。消融实验表明行+列尺度互补，β对激活量化SQNR有独立的正向贡献（平均+0.33dB）。在Llama-3.1-8B的真实打包W4A4部署（RTX 4090）上，WikiText-2困惑度6.74（与伪量化6.73仅差0.01），相比BF16实现2.51–2.61×内存缩减和1.39–2.46×吞吐量加速，激活量化（含β预缩放）仅占总GPU时间4.3–6.1%。

Conclusion: DualQuant是一种统一的校准无关PTQ框架，通过BCD闭式更新最小化权重MSE，同一算法支持INT4、MX家族和NVFP4格式。权重驱动的列尺度自然充当激活重缩放因子，使其在大多数设置上匹配或超越SmoothQuant而无需校准数据。真实W4A4部署验证了在内存和吞吐量上对BF16的显著优势，为LLM低比特推理提供了一种实用且数据无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.

</details>


### [131] [ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13778)
*Ze-Wei Liou,Harris Nover,Amey Naik,Andrii Skliar,Igor Shovkun,Ido Shahaf,Tri Dao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReplaySSM提出了一种新的SSM状态管理策略，通过将状态表示为检查点+近期输入缓冲，将输出计算与检查点更新解耦，在标准解码、推测解码和低精度状态存储三种场景下显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SSM解码在每一步急切地读写完整状态，导致三个核心问题：(1)内存流量大、算术强度低，状态I/O在服务批量大小下成为瓶颈；(2)推测解码中状态回滚代价高（每草稿token需存储快照）；(3)量化误差通过递归累积，破坏生成长序列的精度。

Method: 核心方法是将SSM状态重新表示为：检查点S_ckpt（存储于HBM）+ 有界输入缓冲B（近期SSM输入）。通过展开递归推导得出S_t = γ_h·S_ckpt + Σγ·v_j·k_j^T。非flush步仅追加输入到缓冲并从检查点+缓冲计算输出，不存储状态；flush步（每L步一次）才将缓冲输入折叠入检查点。应用于：(1)标准解码——约减半状态内存流量；(2)推测解码——回滚变为缓冲区指针操作，并支持output-only验证（不物化中间状态）；(3)低精度状态——采用双精度检查点（低精度用于读取，高精度用于递归更新），使舍入误差不进入递归。

Result: 在vLLM中为Mamba-2和GDN实现。标准解码：在B=256、四个混合模型上相比调优后的vLLM基线加速1.20–1.47倍；SSM核加速1.46–1.80倍。推测解码：在两个120B级MoE模型上达到vLLM推测解码吞吐量的约1.8倍；B=512时达2.10–2.16倍。低精度状态：128K token下，NVFP4读+FP32递归使KL散度降低36倍；NVFP4共享检查点导致GPQA-Diamond平均下降13.05点，而分离精度（NVFP4读+FP16+SR递归）仅下降2.36点，显著减少输出分布失真和下游精度损失。

Conclusion: ReplaySSM通过解耦输出计算与检查点更新，将每步状态写入减为每L步一次，使大部分步骤无需存储状态，同时使推测回滚变为廉价指针操作，并允许低精度读检查点与高精度递归检查点分离，从而避免量化误差累积。该方法已集成到TensorRT-LLM、vLLM、SGLang、FlashInfer等生产推理系统，并被GLM-5.3-Flash和Kimi-K3等大模型采用。未来工作方向是基于衰减跳过检查点读取以进一步降低流量。

Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

</details>


### [132] [Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13786)
*Adarsh Jamadandi,Nicolas Keriven*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了离散图扩散模型（GDM）存在一种此前未被察觉的"条件记忆"现象：通过分析在二区块随机块模型（SBM）上训练的单图扩散模型的逆向扩散轨迹，发现去噪器几乎完美地恢复被破坏的训练图，而对测试图的恢复能力则接近仅学习生成律的参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的样本级度量（如边重叠和WL核相似度）以及等变性分析均认为单图训练的图扩散模型不会记忆训练数据，这与图像扩散模型中观察到的数据集规模影响泛化的现象形成对比。然而，作者认为这些度量可能在推断中无法探测到潜在的记忆偏差，对隐私保护部署构成风险。

Method: 采用"Garnier-Brun 等人提出的U-turn 实验设置：以训练图和测试图为种子，对干净图施加前向破坏过程，再运行逆向去噪过程重构原图，并通过边召回率衡量去噪器对训练图与测试图的恢复能力差异。同时对比仅学习生成律（区块分配与区块概率）的参考去噪器作为无偏基线，并在 n ∈ {64,128,256,512} 的二区块 SBM 上，使用 EDGE 框架进行训练与评估。

Result: 实验显示，在 n=256、ρ=0.60 时，去噪器恢复训练图 96.9% 的被破坏边，而对测试图仅恢复接近参考基线水平（约 7.7%）。这一训练数据偏差贯穿全部四种节点规模。同时，记忆起始点 τ_mem 一致先于社区结构涌现点 τ_struct，早停无法将两者分离：所有生成具有正确社区结构的检查点都已越过记忆起点，而此前所有检查点生成的均为无结构图。训练损失下降而测试损失退化，泛化差距持续扩大。

Conclusion: 条件记忆在单图图扩散模型中真实存在：去噪器在逆向动态中能精确恢复训练图，但仅在该动态被训练图的破坏版本初始化时显现，常规无条件采样无法触及该区域。这意味着仅依靠样本级度量评估泛化会得出过早且错误的结论，对隐私敏感的部署具有潜在危害；同时，由于结构涌现必然发生在记忆之后，测试损失最小值无法作为合适的模型选择准则。

Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.

</details>


### [133] [FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13806)
*Vishnu Arun,Adam Obeng,Tianyou Wang,Zilin Ren,Mukuntha Narayanan Sundararaman,Han Wang,Shivin Thukral,Zhixiang Wang,Saurabh Vishwas Joshi,Darren Reger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FORTE是Pinterest提出的一种模型无关的工业级特征评估与下线（deprecation）框架。它通过高效的批量扰动推理（pooled perturbation inference）实现每日特征重要性评估，利用分组扰动（grouped perturbation）验证候选特征集合，再通过重训练、在线A/B测试和特征血缘追踪（lineage tracing）实现端到端特征下线。框架已在Pinterest的两个大规模推荐系统（Search Relevance和Pin Ranker）上验证，分别移除了模型43.2%和一定比例的特征，带来显著的训练/服务效率提升且无在线回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统存在特征生命周期不对称问题：新增特征只需在某项指标上有提升即可，而下线特征却需要确保任何指标都不退化。此外，特征下线过程受限于在线A/B测试带宽、数据漂移、模型版本变更、特征交互、多模型协调等多种障碍，使得低价值特征难以被清理，持续占用训练和服务资源。

Method: FORTE的核心方法包括：(1) 通过"数据集虚拟化（dataset virtualization）"和"池化执行（pooled execution）"，将原始数据和扰动数据同时加载为类型感知的特征字典，所有扰动实验共享单次物化与推理主流程，使边际扰动成本极低（300个实验仅增加4.5倍时间）；(2) 每日运行特征级排列/消融实验，计算时序特征重要性并基于均值、排名稳定性和趋势构造候选集；(3) 对候选集合执行分组扰动（grouped perturbation）以捕获特征交互；(4) 通过重训练+离线评估+在线A/B测试多层验证；(5) 特征血缘追踪（feature lineage）自动识别下游消费模型，实现特征从模型、特征存储到采集管线的完全下线。理论上证明了单次排列在大规模评估集下已具有O(1/n)的有界方差，为日级评估提供理论支撑。

Result: 在Search Relevance模型（111个特征）中，FORTE识别出32、48、59三个嵌套候选集。离线评估显示三者均为中性，但59特征集因在线次级护栏被拒绝，最终下线48个特征（占模型43.2%特征），训练参数减少2.3%，服务吞吐提升2.0%。在Pin Ranker模型中，FORTE识别出8个候选特征，下线后训练参数减少29.9%，服务吞吐提升19.8-25.5%，每年节省数十万美元的基础设施成本，且无在线指标回归。分组扰动验证显示：单一特征排序的叠加价值（6.554%）远超组合实际效果（3.084%），证明分组验证的必要性；且存在跨head方向不一致的特征，表明单一指标筛选的局限。

Conclusion: FORTE是首个完整的工业级特征下线框架，验证了"扰动重要性+组合验证+重训练+在线A/B+血缘追踪"漏斗的有效性。其池化推理实现使日级特征评估在工业规模下可行，分组扰动弥补了边际置换无法捕获特征交互的缺陷，特征血缘追踪释放了完全下线的全部收益。该工作也揭示了特征下线对公平性的潜在风险——聚合指标中性可能掩盖子群体伤害，因此需要更细粒度的分段评估作为伦理约束。

Abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.

</details>


### [134] [Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13909)
*Danil Rudenko,Georgii Bulgakov,Nikolay Kartashev,Ivan Rubachev,Daniil Krasylnikov,Artem Babenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地重新评估了18种表格数据回归目标函数，在41个数据集和多种骨干网络（MLP、TabPack、RealMLP、TabM）上进行实验，发现大多数目标函数相对精心调参的MSE基线无一致增益，而分位数损失（quantile loss）表现最为稳健且跨骨干网络一致优于MSE。进一步识别出表格回归中"全局早停"的固有限制：不同噪声水平区域倾向于不同的训练epoch，单一checkpoint在异方差数据上会形成折中。最后提出AdaQR（自适应分位数回归），通过联合学习的输入相关标签平滑来缓解该问题，在多个骨干网络上优于标准分位数损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 现有表格回归目标函数研究多在不同数据集、骨干网络和调参协议下进行，难以公平比较实际收益；2. 量化损失虽强，但表格数据的异方差性意味着不同噪声区域的理想训练停止epoch不同，单一全局早停checkpoint会形成折中，限制了目标多任务优化效果。

Method: 1. 大规模基准测试：在41个BeyondArena表格数据集上，使用MLP（100次Optuna TPE调参、Muon优化器）评估18种回归损失；并将关键目标推广到TabPack、RealMLP、TabM-mini三种先进骨干网络。2. 合成实验：构造异方差(homoskedastic/异方差)合成数据集，研究最优停止epoch随噪声水平的变化。3. 提出AdaQR：用输入条件高斯分布N(y, σ_l²)替代分位数损失中目标y处的Dirac点质量，并通过正则化项λσ_l; 理论证明在贝叶斯最优条件下σ_l² ∝ σ_t²（即所学平滑尺度与真实数据不确定性成比例）；对RealMLP额外引入辅助CRPS尺度正则化（AdaQR†）。

Result: 1. 多数目标函数（含NLL、β-NLL、MDN、多种binning、decoder、representation regularization等）相对调优MSE基线无一致增益；2. 在MLP上HL-Gaussian和quantile loss突出，但quantile loss在TabPack、RealMLP、TabM上表现更一致（每个骨干网络都给出正的中位数RMSE提升，W/T/L胜场多于败场）；3. 合成与真实数据cohort实验均证实：不同噪声水平区域的最佳epoch不同，按不确定性分组选择checkpoint比全局选择提升0.18%（K=5，7大数据集，无败场）；4. AdaQR在所有4个骨干网络上相对MSE有正的中位数提升，并在MLP/TabM/RealMLP上优于quantile loss；cohort实验显示AdaQR下按组选择checkpoint的收益减小（验证了其减缓停止冲突的能力）。

Conclusion: 1. quantile loss是表格深度回归中MSE的一个实用且一致的替代；2. 异方差表格回归中存在"停止epoch冲突"——不同噪声区域需要不同的训练时长，单一全局早停存在局限；3. AdaQR通过输入条件自适应标签平滑为该问题提供了一种可能缓解方案，在多个骨干网络上改善预测，但仍不能完全消除停止时间差异；4. 未来进展需同时关注"优化什么"与"不同数据区域如何随时间学习"。

Abstract: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [135] [Deploying RDMA for Large-Scale Inference and Training Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12815)
*Yibo Huang,Yi Cui,Yukai Huang,Huaping Zhou,Jiancong Tong,Zhaoyu Wu,Gen Miao,Haoran Wei,Boyan Ding,Zhuo Jiang,Jianxi Ye,Yibo Zhu,Chuanxiong Guo,Yang Xu,Jie Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ByteDance在生产环境中部署的RDMA通信层ByteExpress（BE），将其集成到基于参数服务器（PS）的推理和训练系统中。论文分享了三大经验教训：跨应用层和传输层的缓冲区管理、连接/接收容量/未完成数据的协调管理、传输层之上的服务恢复机制。生产部署中，推理的平均和P99参数获取延迟分别降低35.7%和43.7%，CPU使用率降低10.69%；训练中P99参数推送延迟最高降低74.0%，且未观察到PFC暂停。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式推理和训练中，参数服务器架构下worker与PS之间的通信是关键瓶颈。GPU加速了计算，但内核网络栈的CPU开销、拷贝和调度延迟成为瓶颈。RDMA虽已在数据中心部署（RoCE），但如何将其集成到生产级推理/训练服务中以同时保证可扩展性和可用性仍是挑战。论文针对变长消息、大量并发连接、突发incast和服务故障等实际负载特性，给出软件通信层的完整解决方案。

Method: ByteExpress构建在硬件RNIC之上，应用程序通过Archon RPC框架以socket-like接口调用BE。核心机制包括：(1) bemalloc——基于rpmalloc扩展的RDMA感知分配器，O(1)查询MR，复用大块注册内存；(2) 零拷贝传输——大消息使用RDMA WRITE分片传输，末片用WRITE_WITH_IMM通知；(3) QP多路复用——相同远端地址的逻辑socket共享一个engine（QP），轮询调度+分片缓解HoL阻塞；(4) 接收信用流控——避免RNR，分批补充接收请求；(5) 软件发送窗口——在DCQCN/PFC之上对每个engine的未完成字节数设上限；(6) 线程域（TD）——将provider资源与I/O线程所有权对齐，消除provider侧spin lock竞争；(7) RPC辅助恢复——Archon保留超时、重试、副本选择、TCP回退等机制，结合keepalive和故障域复制。

Result: 微基准测试：BE在25G/100G/200G链路下与eRPC、perftest对比，延迟和吞吐量均达到可比或更优水平；100G/200G下RC显著优于UD。分配器benchmark中，bemalloc与rpmalloc操作速率和峰值内存接近，MR注册开销分摊到块级别后稳态可忽略。生产推理（300 PS + 124 ranker，Toutiao推荐）：参数获取平均延迟从12.6ms降至8.1ms（-35.7%），P99从63.1ms降至35.5ms（-43.7%），总CPU使用率从57.45%降至51.31%（-10.69%），软件中断降低90.6%。生产训练（124 PS + 346 trainer）：仅硬件拥塞控制时P99延迟高于TCP且出现PFC暂停；加入4KB软件窗口后，P99 fetch从1.04s降至338ms，P99 push从1.03s降至268ms（-74.0%），未观察到PFC暂停或NAK。合成incast实验中，软件窗口将触发PFC的服务器数阈值从63提升至1218（4KB窗口）。

Conclusion: 在生产ML系统中部署RDMA需要跨层协同设计：应用/传输层的缓冲区所有权契约、QP多路复用与线程域对齐的provider资源管理、独立的接收信用与软件发送窗口、以及传输层之上的RPC级恢复。BE已在ByteDance数十个数据中心集群稳定运行两年以上，支撑今日头条、TikTok等业务，显著降低参数交换延迟和CPU开销。核心启示是：为每一层指派明确的职责（硬件offload、provider资源、应用层拥塞控制、RPC恢复），并在目标工作负载的并发与故障模式下端到端评估通信路径。论文也坦承局限：软件窗口为配置式而非自适应算法，恢复机制的端到端可用性保证未完全量化，TCP基线未涵盖所有调优选项。

Abstract: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assisted recovery. In production inference, ByteExpress reduces mean and P99 model parameter fetch latency by 35.7% and 43.7%, respectively, and total CPU usage by 10.69% compared with kernel TCP. In training, ByteExpress reduces P99 model parameter push latency by up to 74.0% compared with TCP, with no PFC pauses observed at runtime.

</details>


### [136] [Sustainable Cloud-Fog-Edge Systems for Smart Buildings: Algorithmic Adaptation under Memory Constraints and Dynamic Orchestration Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13307)
*Mamadou Sow,Christophe Cerin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套面向智能建筑的可持续云-雾-边(CFE)系统架构与算法方案,核心创新是在低成本微控制器(如Arduino/ESP32)上实现GHA-PCA在线学习,并提出了KOptim编排框架,验证了"建筑即数据中心"的边缘智能理念的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICT行业能耗持续增长(数据中心电力消耗预计2030年达3%),传统集中式云架构存在延迟高、隐私风险大、能耗高等问题。智能建筑需要实时响应能力,亟需将计算下沉到边缘,实现本地化、可持续、隐私保护的智能系统。

Method: 三大支柱:(1)基于Arduino Uno R4 WiFi + BME280传感器的数据采集链,使用Node-RED/MySQL进行安全持久化,Python/rsync/SSH实现远程安全传输;(2)提出轻量级KOptim编排框架,与FIWARE标准互操作,通过动态SLA范围值管理容器资源;(3)将广义Hebbian算法(GHA)适配到微控制器上做PCA降维,提出一种显式多样性管理的块处理策略——对缓冲区按特定变量(如accMotion)排序后保留两端极值样本,时间复杂度O(W log W)。在Tour Perret高维传感器数据和CampusIOT LoRaWAN数据集上进行了GHA-PCA降维和K-Means聚类实验验证。

Result: GHA-PCA降维在Tour Perret数据集上可靠识别出两种不同运行状态;带显式多样性管理的块处理策略的聚类结果在KDE可视化上与全内存处理参考方法视觉等效,优于简单块处理;ESP32可处理1024条消息流(最优批次128)。但与Python批处理相比,C++在线版本在归一化列选择、空行处理等方面存在差异。

Conclusion: 在低成本微控制器上实现边缘智能在技术上可行,优化的迭代学习策略(GHA-PCA + 多样性管理)能在严格内存限制下保持高质量分析结果,可靠识别建筑隐藏动态。整套架构(自主嵌入式采集→安全持久化→动态编排)建立了有韧性的去中心化生态系统,特别适合资源受限的人道主义场景。未来需解决微控制器生态算法开发滞后、更多数据集验证以及与集中式云的全局能效对比问题。

Abstract: The escalating environmental footprint of the Information and Communication Technol- ogy (ICT) sectorwith global Data Center electric- ity usage potentially reaching 3% by 2030 and the imperative for real-time responsiveness in smart buildings demand a foundational shift towards Edge Computing. This article proposes a holis- tic architectural and algorithmic approach for cre- ating autonomous, resilient, and privacy-preserving learning systems within smart buildings, advancing the core concept of the building itself as the data center. Our contributions, demonstrating originality compared to conventional centralized systems, are structured around three main pillars: 1) Validation of resilient data acquisition chains using the af- fordable Arduino ecosystem (Uno R4 WiFi/BME280) and secure persistence solutions including centralized archiving (Node-RED/MySQL) and secure remote transfer (Python/rsync/SSH). 2). The proposal of a lightweight, KOptim orchestration framework, inter- operable with the FIWARE standard, for the dynamic management of Service Level Agreements (SLA). 3) The adaptation and experimental valida- tion of the Generalized Hebbian Algorithm (GHA) for Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on low- power microcontrollers,We introduce and compare an iterative learning strategy using data buffers, featuring sorting and explicit preservation of extreme samples to maintain diversity. Experimental results on the high-dimensional Tour Perret sensor data confirm that this novel method, despite introducing a necessary temporal complexity of O(W log W ) due to sorting, achieves convergence and final result quality that is visually equivalent to processing the entire dataset in full memory, reliably identifying two distinct operational states.

</details>


### [137] [Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13841)
*Daniel Thi Graviet,Tanmay Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于完整 Daytona 快照的 Go-Explore 式搜索方法，用于编码智能体（coding agent）的失败恢复。研究发现，编码任务中的关键进展往往存储于仓库之外的状态（如数据库、服务、运行时状态），而完整的快照搜索在涉及多服务、状态无法从单一 diff 重建的长程编码任务中最为有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体在最终失败前通常已经取得了部分有效进展，但传统的从头重试机制会丢弃这些中间机器状态（包括代码仓库以外的运行时状态），导致恢复效率低下。论文试图解决如何有效恢复和利用智能体失败前已取得的进展这一问题。

Method: 采用 Go-Explore 风格的搜索策略，对完整的 Daytona 快照（full Daytona snapshots）进行搜索与分支操作，而非仅基于代码仓库的 diff。该方法将整个环境状态视为可恢复的检查点，从而在失败后从有意义的中间状态继续探索。

Result: 实验表明，较高且更高效的解题率（solve rates）主要依赖于仓库外部的进展，例如数据库内容、后台服务状态以及其他运行时状态。这意味着仅仅恢复代码仓库是不够的，必须恢复完整的环境快照才能有效利用中间进展。

Conclusion: 当长程编码工作跨越多个服务、且其状态无法从单一 diff 重建时，完整快照搜索（full-snapshot search）是最有效的方法。该结论强调了将环境状态视为一等公民的重要性，对编码智能体的失败恢复策略设计具有指导意义。

Abstract: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

</details>


### [138] [Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12494)
*Anthony Kostal-Vazquez,Vassil Dimitrov,Branden Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出代数整数量化(AIQ),利用二次整数作为LLM权重的低比特压缩格式,并设计基于纯整数算术的无误差矩阵乘法引擎,在AMD MI300X上达到了接近INT8/BF16/FP8 GEMM性能的3-5倍以内,同时在5个LLM模型和4个基准测试上验证其精度与行业标准MX格式相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM推理严重依赖低比特量化(MX、FP8、INT8),但浮点和定点格式在参数选择、零的精确表示、子正规数密度等方面缺乏灵活性。代数整数具有天然的无误差乘加、可设计的基底选择空间等独特优势,但在ML领域未被充分挖掘。本文旨在将代数整数重新引入LLM压缩计算。

Method: 1. 提出代数整数数制AINF:用整数对(a,b)表示实数,加法和乘法通过多项式π(x)=x²-π₁x-π₀的约化实现纯整数无误差运算。2. 设计矩阵乘法引擎:将n×n代数整数矩阵乘法分解为三次或四次n×n整数矩阵乘法(借助Karatsuba),映射到现有MMU(Matrix Multiply Unit)的INT8 tensor core。3. 定义AIQ:采用块级max scaling的fake quantization,二次基为√2。4. 在5个LLM和4个基准上与MXFP8/MXFP6做等比特参数对比。

Result: 性能:AMD MI300X上QINT₈(Karatsuba)相比FP8慢约3-7倍,相比INT8慢约3.5-5倍;QINT₁₆-Karatsuba相比BF16慢约2.8-7.4倍,小尺寸时差距大,大尺寸(n=16384)时差距收敛至约2.8-4倍。LLM精度:8.25-bit时AIQ在4/5模型上匹配或超过MXFP8,最大单基准下降仅0.38;6.25-bit时AIQ在3/5模型上优于MXFP6,Mixtral-8x7B损失仅-0.11% vs MX的-0.48%,但Llama-3.2-1B上AIQ(-0.73%)弱于MX(-0.38%)。

Conclusion: AIQ在等比特参数下与MX格式的精度竞争力相当,证明了二次整数作为LLM权重量化格式的可行性。代数整数具备独特的优势:零的精确表示、无符号位、动态范围与子正规密度可由基底选择灵活调控。高阶与多维代数整数、与余数数制的结合、专用VLSI设计是未来方向。主要短板是除法与比较运算代价高,因此最适用于LLM推理中以矩阵乘法为主的场景。

Abstract: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats.
