Result: 实验表明该框架具有良好的可复用性：(1) 在二维流形上通过无散向量流形将 S² 上的二十面体十二面体变形为 Z₅ 手性风车，将双曲盘 H² 上的 {3,7} 铺贴变形为 D₇ 齿轮；(2) 通过曲率损失加 Gauss-Bonnet 项训练流将正方形卷成球面（χ̂ ≈ 1.97），无需 Gauss-Bonnet 项则塌缩为球冠；(3) 隐式曲面学习在共维一和共维二情况下恢复准确极小曲面（Chamfer 距离约 0.01）；(4) Cl(1,3) 中从稀疏 Faraday 双向量观测恢复粒子螺旋轨迹（位置误差 6×10⁻⁴）；(5) 同时在 CGA(3) 的 T(3)⊂SE(3)⊂Sim(3)⊂Conf(3) 四个转子子群上向量化优化点云对齐，保形群匹配教师至 6×10⁻¹²，并能穿越 g=-1 共轭点。

Conclusion: 几何微分算子可以作为可重用的 AD 变换来暴露，而不是为每个坐标系或应用单独重新推导。同一套多向量导数、外导数和切空间投影算子通过选择不同的索引集 ℐ、多向量场以及切伪标量 I_M，在流形学习、时空逆问题和转子群优化等截然不同的工作流中复用。几何作为代数数据输入，几何结构（度量、方向、切空间）通过代数数据进入计算，而非针对每个具体空间重新推导。

Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. Since all AD frameworks implicitly fix a basis of Euclidean space to define gradients and Jacobians, they natively process mathematical objects that are arrays of a fixed set of coordinates. This makes it awkward to express objects such as rotations, volume forms, and curvatures that arise, for example, in applications of AI to science. Bespoke workarounds lack reusability. We show that (i) a single, basis-independent derivative operator can represent many geometric differential operations, and (ii) this operator can be expressed entirely in terms of existing AD primitives. This reusable transformation can be composed with JAX batching, compilation, and hardware acceleration. Geometry enters as algebraic data. We experimentally demonstrate its reuse across different manifold operators, its composition through a spacetime inverse-problem pipeline, and its use in optimization over different rotor subgroups.

</details>


### [167] [The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12809)
*Robert R. Nerem,Mitchell Black,Antonis Vasileiou,Christopher Morris,Yusu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了带随机节点特征的消息传递图神经网络（MPNN）在不同图规模上的表达能力，提出了一个群体级框架，将连续随机特征量化为有限随机颜色，并证明此类 MPNN 不是大小均匀通用的，揭示了颜色数与试验次数之间的权衡关系及其与 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法的不可比较性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的随机特征 MPNN 理论分析不够精细，无法捕捉其在跨图规模逼近或固定随机比特数下的局限性，尤其是在大小均匀逼近（size-uniform approximation）方面的不足，这限制了对其表达能力与随机比特数依赖关系的理解。

Method: 构建了一个基于群体预测器的形式化框架，要求 MPNN 在初始特征上具有与图规模无关的 Lipschitz 界（包括均值、最大值和阶归一化和聚合等标准架构）。核心方法是将连续随机特征通过量化映射（quantization map）替换为有限调色板上的离散随机颜色，利用紧致性论证将量化误差控制在任意小范围内且与图规模无关。然后通过随机颜色 Weisfeiler-Leman（random-color WL）方法将有限颜色可区分性的限制转化为连续随机特征大小均匀逼近的限制。具体技术包括：使用 Cai-Fürer-Immerman (CFI) 图族构造需要指数次试验才能区分的图对；通过奇偶校验小工具（parity gadget）证明颜色和试验次数的严格层次结构；利用颜色编码（color coding）算法实现大小独立的树子图同构检测；并通过 Lipschitz 伪度量建立从有限训练集到大小均匀泛化的条件。

Result: 1) 证明了均匀 Lipschitz MPNN 的连续随机特征可被量化为有限颜色，量化误差与图规模无关（定理 3 和推论 4）；2) 证明了此类 MPNN 不是大小均匀通用的，即使在有界直径或有界度图上也成立（具体指 CFI 图族对应的推论）；3) 建立了随机颜色 WL 统计可区分性的严格颜色和试验层次结构（定理 7 和推论 25），证明了额外颜色可指数级优于额外试验；4) 证明了随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法不可比较（定理 2）；5) 给出了树子图同构的颜色编码 MPNN 构造和局部 MST 边检测任务，两者资源需求均与图规模无关（定理 9 和命题 10）；6) 建立了从有限训练集到大小均匀泛化的充分条件（定理 11）；7) 实验验证了在桥边预测和树子结构检测中增加颜色数和试验次数能提升性能，且推理时量化保留了大部分性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出的框架将连续随机特征 MPNN 的表达能力研究归结为有限随机颜色 MPNN 的分析，揭示了其在大规模图上的固有局限性——无法实现大小均匀通用逼近。颜色和试验次数是两种本质不同的离散资源，增加颜色数可指数级提升表达能力，而试验次数的影响呈对数级。同时，随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 WL 方法不可比较，表明前者代表了一种独立的表达能力层次。尽管存在限制，有限颜色仍可有效实现如树子图检测和局部 MST 边检测等大小均匀算法任务，且从有限训练集可获得均匀泛化保证。这些结果为实践中使用随机特征提供了理论基础，阐明了随机特征在大小泛化中的能力边界与资源权衡。

Abstract: Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.

</details>


### [168] [Inverse Synthesis of Shock Time Series from Shock Response Spectra Using Ensembles of Conditional Variational Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12820)
*Adam Watts,Charles Young,Ryan Bowering,Andrew Jeon,Destry Newton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的集合模型，用于从冲击响应谱（SRS）反向合成加速度时域波形。该方法采用循环小波解码器预测多尺度小波系数，并通过逆离散小波变换重建信号。在四个基准数据集上的评估表明，该方法在平均和中位谱误差方面均优于传统衰减正弦求和（SDS）方法及先前的直接时域CVAE方法，且推理速度显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冲击响应谱（SRS）到加速度时域波形的映射是多对一的，传统方法（如衰减正弦求和SDS）需要针对每个目标谱进行耗时优化，且受限于预设的基函数族。研究者旨在通过学习式生成模型直接从目标SRS合成兼容波形，并克服单模型潜在空间采样多样性不足的问题。

Method: 方法核心是CVAE架构，包含：1）卷积编码器；2）循环小波解码器（BandBlock序列），从粗到细预测小波系数，经逆离散小波变换（IDWT）重建信号；3）使用Hadamard或拼接方式编码目标SRS条件；4）由104个独立训练的模型（不同母小波和分解层级）组成集成，以提供多样候选解；5）复合损失函数（波形形状、时序、PSD、SRS和KL散度）。

Result: 在四个保留基准数据集（A: 963个操作冲击、B: 890个操作冲击、C: 815个地震记录、D: 1000个合成冲击）上，db10/8层小波CVAE将平均RMSLE较直接CVAE降低23.0%–34.7%，较SDS降低31.6%–59.2%。单模型推理时间0.1–0.6 ms，较SDS的5–8 s快约4个数量级。与Brake (2011)公布目标的对比中，CVAE在四个目标中三个上具有更低的MAE/RMSE。

Conclusion: 循环小波解码器有效提升了逆SRS合成的谱精度和推理效率，集成策略缓解了单模型后验坍缩导致的多样性不足问题。频谱一致并不保证物理适用性，未来工作将量化候选波形的多样性及时域/频域特性，并探索单模型内多样化生成及冲击时序合成的基础模型。

Abstract: The shock response spectrum (SRS) characterizes the peak responses of single-degree-of-freedom systems to transient acceleration. Because the mapping from an acceleration time series (waveform) to its SRS is many-to-one, inverse synthesis seeks candidate waveforms consistent with a prescribed spectrum. We extend an earlier conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) framework with a recurrent decoder that predicts multiscale wavelet coefficients and reconstructs waveforms through an inverse discrete wavelet transform. Individual models exhibit limited variability under latent sampling, motivating an ensemble of independently trained models spanning different mother wavelets and decomposition levels. Each member produces a separate candidate waveform for the same target SRS. Evaluation on four held-out benchmark datasets shows lower mean and median spectral errors for the illustrated wavelet model than for the earlier direct time-domain CVAE and a sum-of-decayed-sinusoids (SDS) baseline. A conditioning study examines frequency-grid and encoding choices. Comparisons with published inverse-SRS methods demonstrate superior performance across four holdout benchmark datasets (two operational shock datasets, one earthquake dataset, and one synthetic shock dataset) and competitive performance on synthetic targets reported by Brake. Single-model inference requires approximately 0.1-0.6 ms per waveform during batched inference compared with 5-8 s for SDS, excluding offline training. This low inference cost enables rapid generation of distinct SRS-compatible candidate waveforms across the ensemble, although their physical suitability requires assessment beyond spectral agreement.

</details>


### [169] [TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12828)
*Debajoy Mukherjee,Jeremy Carleton,Sushil Vemuri,Srinivas Shakkottai,Dileep Kalathil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TreeHCA，通过将"后视引导的探索"与"后视信用分配"统一在同一后视变化测度框架下，解决多轮LLM智能体训练中GRPO对所有token赋予相同优势、无法进行精细中间信用分配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等基于结果的策略优化方法为轨迹中每个token分配相同的优势值，无法区分有用和无用的中间决策；现有的后视信用分配（HCA）方法依赖采样轨迹中包含足够多的信息性替代方案，但在关键历史节点此类替代方案往往稀缺，导致信用分配信号不足。

Method: 1. 后视引导探索：使用参考答案似然变化作为后视分数，识别低分决策的父历史并从中采样N个候选替代延续，按归一化后视分数选择一个继续执行；2. 后视信用分配：推导后视倾斜采样的逆权重恒等式（含精确有限池恒等式），并通过归一化树备份将终端结果反向传播至回合级优势；3. 探索与信用共享同一后视变化测度原则，使用GSPO-token目标优化。

Result: 在7个问答基准（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle、NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA）和3个Qwen骨干（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B）上，TreeHCA在聚合精确匹配（EM）指标上超越所有基线；组件消融实验表明，后视探索+TreeHCA信用规则的组合在HotpotQA上达到51.76 EM和65.88 F1，优于其他组合；Qwen3-8B上比最强基线AEPO在多跳QA上提升1.63个百分点，单跳QA提升0.81个百分点；训练时间增加约9-11%。

Conclusion: TreeHCA通过共同的后视变化测度将探索与中间信用分配联系起来：后视分数引导替代延续的选择，逆权重补偿该采样偏好以估计优势。在问答任务上的评估和组件消融实验证实了该配对设计的有效性，验证了探索与信用共同设计对多轮LLM智能体训练的重要性。

Abstract: Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. We use this structure in a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages. This shared hindsight structure is TreeHCA's central design principle, linking informative exploration with hindsight-guided credit assignment. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three Qwen backbones, TreeHCA outperforms all baselines in aggregate exact match, validating the effectiveness of paired exploration and credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agent training. Our code is available at this http URL .

</details>


### [170] [Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization: Unified Learning from Offline Demonstrations and On- and Off-Policy Rollouts via a Shared Regression Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12830)
*Du Cheng,Junyu Lu,Jingfan Zhang,Yuzhuo Zhang,Haoxuan Jia,Shichao Weng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization（CBPO）的方法，通过共享固定参考目标的回归损失，将离线演示、在线策略和离线策略回放统一为单一优化目标，无需依赖行为策略概率、重要性采样或评论家网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的推理后训练采用两阶段流水线（冷启动SFT后接RLVR），将离线演示和强化学习回放分配给不同目标，导致离线数据无法持续复用、负样本演示被排除、早期回放在奖励仍然有用时被替换，造成优化路径迂回。

Method: CBPO基于KL正则化最优策略的闭式解，构建设计出的回归目标仅为：log π_ref(y|x) + r(x,y)/β - log Ẑ_ref(x)。该目标与生成补全的行为策略μ无关，因此不同来源（正负离线演示、参考响应、当前及历史回放）可采用统一的奖励标记记录格式存入共享重放缓冲区，通过单一平方损失优化。根据可用数据源的限制可派生出CBPO-Offline、CBPO-OnPolicy、CBPO-OffPolicy和CBPO-Unified四种变体。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B两个模型规模上，针对AIME25、MinervaMath、AMC23和MATH500四个数学推理基准测试，CBPO-Unified均达到最优的avg@32和pass@32指标。在Qwen3-1.7B上，CBPO-Unified较SFT→DAPO在基准平均的avg@32和pass@32上分别提升2.33和4.44个百分点；保留历史回放较无历史配置再分别提升1.87和3.72个百分点。相比SFT→DAPO在投影参数空间中368.75°的累计转向和1.2207的路径比，CBPO-Unified仅需58.20°和1.0205的路径比，以更直接的路径抵达更高奖励区域。

Conclusion: CBPO为推理后训练提供了一种无需行为策略概率、重要性权重、评论家网络或目标切换的统一替代方案。固定参考回归目标、冻结的提示级归一化估计器与统一重放缓冲区相结合，使所有数据源被持续复用。各受限变体在对应数据机制下均优于同匹配基线，而统一变体在两种模型规模上均取得最优性能。

Abstract: Reasoning post-training draws on offline demonstrations and policy-generated rollouts, yet conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) separates their objectives and limits continued reuse of collected responses. We propose \textbf{Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization} (CBPO), which makes these sources compatible with one regression loss through a fixed-reference target. Because the generating policy does not enter this target, positive and negative offline completions, reference responses, and current and historical rollouts can share a common reward-labeled record format and replay buffer. As new responses enter the buffer, optimization retains the same regression objective without coordinating separate SFT and RL objectives or requiring stored behavior-policy probabilities, importance weighting, or a learned critic. Restricting the available sources gives offline, on-policy, and off-policy variants, while CBPO-Unified combines them. Across two model scales and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CBPO delivers leading \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} performance across benchmarks and data regimes. On Qwen3-1.7B, CBPO-Unified improves benchmark-averaged \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} over SFT DAPO by 2.33 and 4.44 percentage points, respectively. In the replay ablation, retaining historical rollouts improves these metrics by 1.87 and 3.72 percentage points over the no-history configuration.

</details>


### [171] [Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12848)
*Denis Blessing,Onur Celik,Gerhard Neumann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出固定点流匹配（FFM），一种无需数据的训练方法，可用于在强化学习中训练和微调流策略。FFM通过将评论家的动作梯度作为回归目标，将演员更新构建为固定点迭代，并证明最优策略是该迭代的不动点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在最大熵和行为约束强化学习中，最优策略为Boltzmann分布。由于该分布通常复杂且多模态，传统方法限制使用高斯策略以保证优化和似然计算的易处理性。流策略虽能表达复杂分布，但其训练通常依赖数据集，在在线RL中无法获取。此外，现有在线RL中训练流/扩散模型的方法面临内存消耗大、重要性权重方差高、需将流转换为扩散模型等局限。

Method: 1. **目标流恒等式**：将Boltzmann目标的流速度场表示为关于评论家动作梯度的条件期望，无需样本即可获得回归目标。2. **目标流匹配**：基于上述恒等式构建回归目标，与传统流匹配共享最优速度场。3. **固定点流匹配**：用当前策略的样本（而非最优策略的样本）评估该目标，形成固定点迭代，证明最优策略是不动点。4. **扩展**：包括速度空间中的信赖域损失、行为约束微调中的参考分数损失、时序相关的先验探索。5. **两个RL实例化**：最大熵RL（在线）和离线到在线的行为倾斜微调。

Result: 1. **离线到在线RL**（OGBench，50个任务）：FFM在线阶段1.5M步后平均成功率达0.95，超过最强基线TRQAM（0.93），在HumanoidMaze-Large等困难任务上优势明显（0.99 vs. 0.76）。2. **在线最大熵RL**（MJX Playground及人形机器人，24个任务）：FFM在低维Playground任务上与基线相当，在高维人形机器人任务上比TRUDI更快收敛到更佳性能。3. **消融实验**：验证了插值器类型、积分步数、动作压缩映射、确定性评估、相关探索等设计选择的有效性。4. **无发散**：所有种子上均无训练发散。

Conclusion: FFM为数据无关地学习表达性流策略提供了原理严谨的方法，无需通过采样链反向传播、无需重要性权重、无需将流转换为扩散模型或伴随模拟。实验证明该方法在最大熵在线RL和行为约束离线到在线微调中均具有竞争力或更优表现，确立了其在RL领域训练流策略的重要地位。

Abstract: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.

</details>


### [172] [Robust Langevin Sampling under State-Dependent Heavy-Tailed Noise with Applications to LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12865)
*M. Berk Sahin,Ege C. Kaya,Arda Fazla,Behzad Sharif,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的Langevin采样方法，用于在状态依赖的厚尾噪声和广义平滑条件下进行非对数凹采样，并将其应用于大语言模型的贝叶斯微调。核心贡献包括：1) 提出BG-p oracle，将Blum-Gladyshev条件和厚尾噪声模型统一推广，允许无限方差；2) 设计了三种方法R-LMC、A-LMC和RA-LMC，分别处理噪声、平滑度以及两者的联合挑战；3) 在Fisher信息度量下建立了非渐近收敛保证，无需耗散性或函数不等式假设；4) 在LLM和VLM的贝叶斯LoRA微调实验中验证了oracle模型并展示了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非对数凹采样的SG-LMC收敛保证通常假设全局Lipschitz梯度和均匀有界噪声方差，但这两个假设在实际应用（如LLM贝叶斯微调）中常被违反。需要同时放宽这两个限制以适应现实场景。

Method: 1) 提出BG-p oracle统一状态依赖噪声增长与有限p阶矩(p∈(1,2])；2) R-LMC通过几何中位数中心化和残差裁剪处理厚尾噪声；3) A-LMC通过自适应步长控制广义平滑下的离散化误差；4) RA-LMC集成鲁棒估计与噪声感知步长，同时处理两个挑战；5) 使用Fisher信息作为收敛度量，无需耗散性或函数不等式假设。

Result: 1) 在合成实验中验证了三种方法的FI收敛；2) 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的LoRA微调中，经验证明梯度误差呈厚尾分布且随距离增长（支持BG-p oracle）；3) RA-LMC在OpenBookQA和SLAKE数据集上以预测准确率和不确定性量化指标匹配或超越9种基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作通过提出统一的oracle模型和三种鲁棒采样算法，扩展了非对数凹Langevin采样的理论框架，使其能够处理实际深度学习应用中常见的厚尾噪声和非光滑势函数。理论保证和实验结果均支持所提方法的实用性和有效性。

Abstract: Existing convergence guarantees for non-log-concave sampling with stochastic gradient Langevin Monte Carlo (SG-LMC) typically assume globally Lipschitz gradients and uniformly bounded noise variance. Both assumptions can fail even in elementary sampling problems, and relaxing them better reflects practical applications such as Bayesian fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). We relax both assumptions through generalized smoothness and our proposed state-dependent heavy-tailed oracle with finite $p$-th moments, $1<p\leq 2$. The oracle permits infinite variance when $p<2$ and includes the Blum-Gladyshev (BG-0) condition. We study these relaxations separately and jointly, proposing three methods. Under globally Lipschitz gradients, robust LMC (R-LMC) handles the proposed oracle through geometric-median centering and residual clipping. With exact gradients, adaptive LMC (A-LMC) controls discretization error under generalized smoothness. Robust adaptive LMC (RA-LMC) addresses both relaxations through robust estimation and a noise-aware step size. For all three methods, we establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees in Fisher information (FI) without assuming dissipativity or a functional inequality. Synthetic experiments demonstrate FI convergence and the benefit of each mechanism. Bayesian fine-tuning experiments with LLMs and vision-language models support our oracle model and show that RA-LMC matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy and uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [173] [HART: Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time series Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12883)
*Qingwen Lin,Boyan Xu,Shifeng Xie,Zhifeng Hao,Keli Zhang,Ruichu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HART（Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model），一种交替堆叠Transformer和RWKV模块的时间序列基础模型。研究发现RWKV-7在非自回归多步预测（NAF）设置下存在长远的性能退化现象，机制分析将其命名为"占位符空转衰减"（Placeholder Idling Decay, PID）。HART以仅36M参数在GIFT-Eval和TIME-Benchmark上取得了与Toto-2.0-1B相当的长远预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RWKV-7作为强大的循环神经网络语言模型，在非自回归多步预测（NAF）场景下表现出长远的性能退化问题。NAF要求模型在预测区间内仅依靠历史信息进行预测，预测区域的占位符缺少新观测值，导致RWKV的循环状态通过占位符驱动的状态转移时出现历史信息衰减的现象。论文将此现象命名为"占位符空转衰减"（PID），并寻求通过混合架构绕过此问题。

Method: 1. **PID机制分析**：基于广义差分规则（GDR）分析RWKV-7的循环状态更新，推导出预测区域中历史状态传播的数学形式，证明当write的补偿不足时历史信息会衰减。通过层级范数测量验证：写矩阵K_t的预测/历史范数比在大多数层小于1（0.60-0.87），而转移矩阵M_t的比值始终在1.00-1.03之间，与PID假设一致。2. **HART架构**：交替堆叠L个Transformer块和L个RWKV块（共2L层）。Transformer块采用RMSNorm、门控自注意力和SwiGLU FFN；RWKV块采用RWKV-TimeMIX（广义差分规则）和SwiGLU FFN。这种设计使得预测位置的RWKV输入已被前序Transformer块上下文化，可通过注意力直接获取历史信息。3. **训练**：使用连续patch掩码（CPM）预训练任务和Pinball损失函数，36M参数，使用Muon优化器训练220k步，预训练数据约8670万序列。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval（97个评估条目）和TIME-Benchmark（98个任务-频率组合）上：
- HART-36M的GIFT-Eval MASE：Short 0.689, Medium 0.727, Long 0.752, All 0.710
- HART-36M的TIME-Benchmark MASE：Short 0.618, Medium 0.716, Long 0.723, All 0.666
- HART在中长视野上显著优于纯RWKV（Medium和Long的95%置信区间不含零），并保持了相当的短视野性能
- HART在聚合指标上优于同等规模的纯Transformer（GIFT All 0.710 vs 0.721，TIME All 0.666 vs 0.670）
- 仅用36M参数（约Toto-2.0-1B的1/28），HART在GIFT-Eval上取得与Toto-2.0-1B相当的长视野MASE（0.752 vs 0.754）
- 合成信号实验显示架构排名与信号结构相关：RWKV在多成分SE4信号上表现最佳，HART在SE3（AM+相位跳跃）上表现最佳，表明两种建模方式互补。

Conclusion: 论文分析了RWKV-7在NAF设置下的PID现象，验证了循环模型在预测区域因占位符导致历史信息衰减的机制。基于此提出的HART混合架构有效结合了循环时序建模与注意力全局检索，在中长视野任务上显著优于纯RWKV，并在聚合指标上优于同等规模纯Transformer，验证了注意力与循环组合的优势。局限性在于：机制分析仅限于RWKV-7；范数诊断不直接测量保留的历史信息量；是否其他循环架构也存在相同机制需进一步验证；论文采用1:1的堆叠配置，其他比例与排列的效果尚未探索。

Abstract: Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. Motivated by this analysis, we propose HART, a Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model that alternates attention and RWKV blocks, combining direct access to historical tokens with recurrent temporal modeling. Controlled experiments on GIFT-Eval and TIME-Benchmark show that HART improves over pure RWKV at medium and long horizons while maintaining comparable short-horizon performance, and achieves better aggregate performance than a comparably sized pure Transformer. With 36M parameters, HART achieves long-horizon MASE comparable to Toto-2.0-1B on GIFT-Eval (0.752 vs. 0.754), using approximately 1/28 of its parameters.

</details>


### [174] [CoGameReg: Cooperative-Game-Based Collaborative Semi-Supervised Regression for Seismic Reservoir Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12884)
*Zhiyu Guo,Jiwei Jia,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoGameReg，一种基于合作博弈的半监督回归框架，用于地震储层属性预测。该方法通过Tri-Game Shapley机制结合秩-MSE性能博弈与成对一致性博弈，为异质回归器估计非负权重，并据此构建共享伪标签，用于稀疏井标定下地震储层属性的精确预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在地震储层属性预测中，井日志标签稀缺但三维地震观测丰富，导致标签与未标记数据严重不平衡。传统监督学习方法难以在稀疏井控制下有效整合密集地震属性，限制了其空间泛化能力。因此，亟需一种能利用无标签地震样本的半监督回归框架，并合理处理伪标签构造与回归器组合的问题。

Method: 1. Tri-Game Shapley机制：结合秩-MSE性能博弈（v_Perf）与成对一致性博弈（v_Con），通过零界L1归一化聚合，生成固定的初始融合权重w^(0)。2. 协作训练：使用k-NN局部均方误差缩减准则进行模型特定的候选伪标签筛选，采用混合未标记池初始化与渐进扩展策略。3. 固定权重伪标签生成：在协作训练期间，伪标签始终通过固定权重w^(0)与各回归器当前预测的加权和生成，确保每个回归器的影响在伪标签构造和最终预测融合中显式且一致。

Result: 1. 公共基准测试：在10个公共回归数据集上，CoGameReg在30个数据集-比例设置中最低或并列最低RMSE占18个，在2.5%标签比例下优势最显著，对所有9个对比方法均有统计显著性优势（Holm校正后）。2. 合成三维地震实验（Stanford VI-E）：RMSE=0.4137，R²=0.5065，SRC=0.5747，为所有对比方法中最优。3. 油田应用（西部致密气藏）：在3口盲井的合并指标上，R²=0.5942，RMSE=5.7441个百分点，Pearson相关系数=0.8265，为四种方法中Pearson相关系数最高者。

Conclusion: CoGameReg验证了在稀疏井控制地震储层属性预测中，将Shapley衍生权重同时应用于伪标签构造和最终预测融合的有效性。该框架在标低比例最低时优势最大，并随监督增加而缩小。油田应用证明了其在薄层横向变化致密砂岩储层中的适用性，但性能因指标和井位而异。

Abstract: Accurate estimation of reservoir properties from seismic data remains challenging when well-log labels are sparse but three-dimensional seismic observations are abundant. We present CoGameReg, a cooperative-game-based semi-supervised regression framework that uses contribution-weighted predictions of heterogeneous regressors to construct shared pseudo-labels. This design makes each regressor's influence explicit in the learning targets generated for unlabeled seismic samples under sparse well control. The Tri-Game Shapley mechanism combines a rank-MSE performance game with a pairwise consistency game to estimate nonnegative regressor weights from labeled training data. These weights remain fixed during collaborative training and are reused for final prediction fusion. Candidate pseudo-labels are screened using a common local k-nearest-neighbor error-reduction criterion before retraining. We evaluate CoGameReg on 10 public regression datasets, a synthetic three-dimensional P-wave velocity prediction task, and a field water-saturation application. The benchmark advantage is most pronounced at the 2.5% labeled-data ratio and decreases as supervision increases. CoGameReg obtains the best blind-well metrics in the synthetic experiment. In the field application, predictions clipped to 0-100% yield a pooled coefficient of determination of 0.5942, a root mean square error of 5.7441 percentage points, and a Pearson correlation of 0.8265 across three blind wells. CoGameReg has the highest Pearson correlation among the four field methods. The results support the use of CoGameReg to integrate sparse well labels with dense seismic attributes, with performance varying across metrics and well locations.

</details>


### [175] [Personalized Federated Direct Preference Optimization via LoRA Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12885)
*Zhanhong Jiang,Soumik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出个性化联邦直接偏好优化（pFedDPO）框架，通过在共享全局基模型上为每个客户端维护私有LoRA适配器，在不增加通信开销的情况下解决联邦DPO中因客户端偏好异质性而产生的收敛性问题，并用紧致收敛界和实证验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FedDPO理论假设所有客户端收敛到单一共享策略，但在实践中客户端偏好分布往往是异质的（如医疗专业人员与普通用户偏好不同），这导致标准FedDPO收敛界中含有一个由梯度多样性κ²决定的下界，无法通过更多通信或更长训练降低。该不可约项正是偏好异质性的体现。

Method: 1. 提出pFedDPO算法：每个客户端在共享全局基模型θ上维护私有LoRA适配器ϕᵢ；基模型通过FedAvg同步，适配器不上传。
2. 理论分析：定义残差异质性κ²，揭示LoRA适配器通过吸收客户端特定梯度方向（由包络定理和投影引理刻画），使基模型更新梯度与适应后的最优梯度一致（∇Fᵢ = Πᵢ⊥∇Fᵢ），从而在共享子空间对齐、交叉曲率较弱条件下，κ² ≤ κ²成立。
4. 收敛界（定理1）：将FedDPO界中的κ²替换为κ²，增加适配器偏差项Cεₐ，该偏差随适配器收敛而消失。
5. 通过Proposition 1刻画κ² ≤ κ²的精确条件（适应模块内异质性、适配器切空间容量、δ小），分析LoRA秩r的非单调权衡。
6. 实验：采用DistilGPT-2在SHP和hh-rlhf数据集上，N=5客户端，120对/客户端非IID分布，r=8默认，进行秩消融和参与率消融研究。

Result: 1. pFedDPO梯度范数在80轮训练中始终低于vanilla FedDPO，SHP上从初始≈1降至≈0.02（FedDPO约0.2），hh-rlhf上从≈1降至≈0.2（FedDPO约0.4-0.6）。
2. SHP经验梯度多样性κ²从约1500降至150-200（85-90%下降），hh-rlhf从约900降至400-500（45-55%下降）。
3. SHP上r=8获得最低梯度范数，r=4获得最高奖励准确率（约0.82），r=16性能下降；hh-rlhf上梯度范数随r单调递减至r=16未饱和。
4. 所有5个客户端偏好准确率从0.30-0.60提升至0.75-0.85（SHP）和0.88-0.97（hh-rlhf）。
5. S=5时pFedDPO梯度范数约比FedDPO低2×；S=1时两种方法均受ζ²/S方差主导，个性化优势不明显。
6. 训练损失和奖励准确率与vanilla FedDPO相当，但梯度范数显著降低。

Conclusion: pFedDPO通过将个性化能力封装在私有LoRA适配器中，同时保持基模型共享，成功将FedDPO收敛界中的梯度多样性项κ²替换为更小的残差异质性κ²，代价是可量化的适配器偏差项Cεₐ。理论分析表明，在异质性主要位于适应模块、客户端适配器子空间对齐且交叉曲率较弱的条件下，该方法提供严格更紧的收敛界。实证证明pFedDPO在梯度范数上一致优于vanilla FedDPO，训练损失和奖励准确率相当，且不增加通信开销。未来工作应包括：扩展到7B+模型、域差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒聚合、异步更新分析以及秩选择的封闭形式指导。

Abstract: Federated Direct Preference Optimization (FedDPO) enables privacy-preserving alignment of language models across distributed agents without centralizing sensitive preference data. However, existing FedDPO analysis assumes all clients converge to a single shared policy, which is fundamentally at odds with the heterogeneous preference distributions present in practice. We propose Personalized FedDPO (pFedDPO), in which each client maintains a small private LoRA adapter atop a shared global base model. In pFedDPO, the base model is synchronized via FedAvg each round, while LoRA adapters remain local and capture client-specific preference patterns. We prove that this decomposition replaces the gradient diversity $\kappa^2$ in the FedDPO bound with a residual heterogeneity $\kappa^2_{\mathrm{eff}}$, which is no larger than $\kappa^2$ when adapters absorb client-specific directions, at the cost of an additive adapter-bias term that vanishes as adapters converge. Experiments on preference datasets show that pFedDPO consistently attains a lower gradient norm than vanilla FedDPO while remaining competitive in training loss and per-client reward accuracy.

</details>


### [176] [GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12904)
*Zhangyang Peng,Jingze Shi,Tongyi Zhang,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GIST提出了一种基于生成器状态的条件监督框架，通过利用合成任务生成过程中保留的标签不确定性信息，对查询损失在条件标签分布上进行平均，从而减少预训练中的采样方差，同时保持群体目标不变，并在不改变架构和推理的前提下提升表格基础模型在多个基准上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于PFN的表格基础模型在预训练中通常使用采样的硬标签进行监督，这会在有限合成任务预算下引入不可避免的采样方差。生成器在生成过程中保留的中间状态实际上包含了超越单个采样结果的标签不确定性信息，但未被利用。论文旨在回答：能否利用任务生成过程中保留的信息来减少查询标签采样带来的变异性？

Method: 方法包含三个核心设计：(1) **生成器状态知情监督规则**：当条件标签分布可计算时，用条件期望（Rao-Blackwell化）替代硬标签查询损失，对查询标签不确定性进行平均。(2) **高斯编码机制**：对于标签依赖型分支，将类别编码添加高斯噪声并通过该编码路由所有下游特征计算，使局部似然可直接计算后验目标，无需遍历下游图。(3) **熵预算校准**：基于Bhattacharyya界推导条件标签熵的上界，通过二分搜索选择满足熵预算的最大噪声尺度，控制编码通道中保留的标签信息量。不支持条件目标的分支退回到硬标签监督。整个设计不改变模型架构和推理流程。

Result: 在TabArena（38数据集）、TALENT（188数据集）和BeyondArena三个基准上，对TabICLv2、TabSwift和TabPFN-2.5三种架构的实验表明：在匹配的预训练计划下，GIST在所有六种IID架构-基准组合中均改善了平均排名；在数据集级配对比较中以62.1%的胜率击败对应的硬标签控制。TabSwift在BeyondArena上获得最高胜率（83.3%）。梯度方差诊断显示，在可处理任务上截断梯度方差减少6.80%-34.41%，其中预测头的相对减少最大（37.70%-47.23%），但编码器和主干组件贡献了净减少量的72.0%-91.5%。熵预算敏感性实验表明β∈{0.05, 0.15, 0.30}均优于硬标签基线。

Conclusion: 合成生成器可以通过其保留的条件标签信息支持预训练。GIST通过联合设计任务生成和查询监督实现了条件损失平均，在固定生成分布下保持群体目标并降低梯度协方差。在不改变模型架构或推理的前提下，三种TFM架构在TabArena和TALENT上的改进验证了该设计的实用价值。结果表明，在考虑合成生成器产生的任务的同时，也应考虑其能提供的监督信息，分布偏移下的迁移仍是开放方向。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks and architectures, GIST wins 62.1% of paired dataset-level comparisons against the corresponding hard-label controls.

</details>


### [177] [Controlled-Minimax: Stabilizing Adversarial Optimization via Control Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12915)
*Tianjiao Luo,Jianfei Chen,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Controlled-Minimax框架，通过将极小极大优化建模为受控二阶ODE系统，设计反馈控制器来保证局部指数稳定性，有效抑制对抗训练中的振荡和发散问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极小极大优化（尤其是GAN训练）常因梯度下降上升法（GDA）的旋转动力学而出现持续振荡、极限环甚至发散，导致训练不稳定。现有方法（启发式正则化、动量调整等）缺乏理论保证，且可能引入归纳偏置。论文从动力系统视角出发，探究不稳定的根本原因并提出理论严谨的解决方案。

Method: 1）将极小极大优化的梯度流沿时间求导，构建二阶ODE模型；2）通过分析平衡点处雅可比矩阵的谱（特别是交互矩阵M的Hessian块结构），证明不稳定性源于Hessian的特征结构；3）引入辅助控制输入，设计线性速度反馈控制器，包含阻尼项（λ_θ, λ_φ）和交叉耦合项（β·A_c）；4）使用二次Lyapunov函数证明当min{λ_θ, λ_φ} > 2C时，闭环系统局部指数稳定；5）离散化为Controlled-Minimax算法，在标准GDA更新中注入控制项。

Result: 在Dirac-GAN上，基线持续振荡，Controlled-Minimax快速收敛到Nash均衡(0,0)；在2D高斯混合实验中，基线出现严重模式坍塌，而方法成功恢复全部8个模式；在Swiss Roll上，方法生成连续光滑的螺旋流形；在StyleGAN2-ada大规模实验中，CIFAR-10 FID从3.37降至2.91，LSUN-Cat从10.48降至8.18，FFHQ从7.81降至5.46，同时振荡幅度显著减小。

Conclusion: Controlled-Minimax通过控制理论视角为对抗训练不稳定性提供了理论严谨的解决方案，其反馈控制器设计能保证局部指数稳定性，与底层Hessian谱无关。实验在从病态基准到高分辨率图像生成的多个任务上验证了方法的有效性。未来方向包括自适应控制器设计（以获得全局稳定性保证）以及离散时间稳定性的严格分析。

Abstract: Minimax optimization is fundamental to adversarial learning yet suffers from severe stability challenges, often manifesting as persistent limit cycles or divergence. This paper investigates these instabilities through the lens of continuous-time dynamical systems. By modeling training dynamics as a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), we rigorously identify the root cause of non-convergence: the problematic eigenstructure of the loss function's Hessian near equilibrium points. To address this, we introduce Controlled-Minimax, a novel stabilization framework that reformulates the optimization trajectory as a controllable physical system. Unlike heuristic regularization techniques, our approach derives a specific feedback controller that provides theoretical guarantees of local exponential stability, regardless of the underlying Hessian spectrum. Consequently, our method stabilizes general minimax problems where traditional gradient descent-ascent methods fail. Extensive experiments on pathological benchmarks including the Dirac-GAN, 2D Gaussian mixtures, and Swiss Roll datasets, as well as high-resolution image synthesis with StyleGAN2-ada, demonstrate that Controlled-Minimax effectively suppresses oscillatory behavior while ensuring fast and robust convergence.

</details>


### [178] [DataCupid: Stable Matching Repair for Training Data Acquisition with Delayed Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12960)
*He Sun,Junyuan Mao,Wenhao Jiang,Mingjun Xiao,Shinan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究稳定匹配场景下训练数据获取中的延迟反馈修复问题。提出了残差负载修复（RLR）框架，利用二分配额调度和结果证书进行匹配修复，证明了关键的轮次界（系数c_b<1.607）。进一步提出前缀监控RLR（RLR-P），在保证安全的前提下利用完整前缀进行提前认证。在优先星市场结构上，Priority-Search方法在未知间隙条件下达到了信息论下界。实验验证了RLR-P在测量反馈重放下具有较低的均值封顶更新认证时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据市场中，买家竞争获取卖方的数据集，但效用更新后需重新学习不确定偏好。传统的稳定匹配算法（如DA）无法处理效用变化后的不确定性，且反馈仅在评估完成后可用（延迟反馈）。当数据集版本变更时，旧版本的评估结果失效，而未变更部分的观察可保留。文章研究如何在已知失效范围、有界且可能与奖励相关的报告延迟条件下，利用保留的有效观察和新评估来认证更新后的匹配。关键挑战包括：匹配容量限制、异步评估、不同端点缺失证据的位置差异、以及延迟可能依赖奖励导致的偏差风险。

Method: 1. RLR（Residual-Load Repair）：结合声音结果证书与分批匹配调度，使用倍增计数目标（1,2,4,...）和每阶段单一反馈屏障，将不等样本赤字打包为可行匹配。完全二分配额调度的轮次界为c_b * L(D_h)，其中c_b<1.607。<br>2. RLR-P（Prefix-Monitored RLR）：监控完整问题顺序前缀，不在预认证阶段修改采样计划，通过确定性纯预言机耦合保证单次修复不增加认证时间、观察数或检查点就绪时间。<br>3. Priority-Search：在优先星市场结构（每个请求者有已知私有后备提供者，竞争组内共享提供者）上，按公共优先级顺序测试候选测试，达到该结构下的信息论常数（ε<δ下认证时间的一阶常数）。<br>4. 信息论下界：通过变化测度方法推导出新观察的KL散度约束，结合端点容量约束给出必要的时间下界。

Result: 理论结果：<br>1. T-Prefix定理：使用完整问题前缀的区间在自适应采样和奖励依赖延迟下同时覆盖真实均值，置信度1-δ。<br>2. T-Monitor定理：在共同耗尽初始状态下，RLR-P在认证时间、发出观察数、检查点就绪时间上均不超过RLR。<br>3. T-Residual-Load定理：RLR-P修复满足τ^cert ≤ τ^ready ≤ min{c_b*L(D_h), b_h*Δ_E} + d*B_h。<br>4. T-Star定理：在固定优先星市场结构上，Priority-Search达到历史调整后的信息论常数L*(p,c)。<br>实验结果：<br>1. 在E5同实例有限预算比较中（N=3,30k预算），RLR-P完成18/30，Width-P完成16/30，PCOS-A4完成13/30。<br>2. 在固定优先级簿两度预算（30对配对轨迹）下，RLR-P比Width-P在更新认证时间上少4437轮（95% CI [-8856,-148])，但累积预言机CPU多4.48秒（CI [1.35,7.49]）。<br>3. 在测量延迟回放下，RLR-P均值封顶更新认证时间低于监控宽度基线，但预言机CPU成本较高。<br>4. 在标记质量修订实验中，保留策略比重置策略的配对均值差为-6,275（CI [-9,374,-3,463]），保留策略显著优于重置。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地研究了稳定匹配场景下的修复问题，主要结论包括：<br>1. 端点拥塞和报告屏障决定了残差证据如何转化为修复时间，RLR在完整二分调度上达到了c_b<1.607的锐利执行系数。<br>2. RLR-P能够在完整前缀上安全行动，监控完成后在排空后输出检查点。<br>3. Priority-Search在结构化的未知间隙类（优先星市场）上达到了信息论常数。<br>4. 通用匹配实例最优性仍是开放问题，需要未来研究解决。<br>本文的贡献将匹配容量、延迟反馈和保留证据这三个维度系统地整合到了稳定匹配修复的理论框架中，对数据市场和众包数据交易中的实际应用具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: Matching repair after utility changes can reuse valid observations, but new evaluations must respect matching capacity and may return out of order. We study announced invalidations with bounded, possibly reward-dependent reporting delays and pending evaluations that do not occupy future matching capacity. Residualload repair (RLR) combines sound outcome certificates with batched matching schedules for unequal sample deficits. Its complete dyadic quota schedule admits a sharp issue-round bound with coefficient cb < 1.607 relative to the terminal residual endpoint load, together with separate delay and evidence-lifetime bounds. RLR-P monitors complete issue-order prefixes without changing the sampling plan before acceptance. With a deterministic pure oracle, a single-repair coupling from the same drained initial state guarantees no increase in certification time, issued observations, or time to a reusable checkpoint. We also derive an information-load lower bound. On fixed priority-star markets with unknown Bernoulli gaps, PrioritySearch attains the history-adjusted first-order constant for expected certification time as {\delta} {\sim} 0, under hypothesis-independent linear history scaling and sublogarithmic reporting delays. Paired simulations and measured-feedback replay quantify the trade-offs: in the replay, RLR-P has lower mean capped update-certification time than a monitored width-based baseline, at higher oracle CPU cost.

</details>


### [179] [Diffusion Precipitation Generation with Medium-range Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12976)
*Guowen Li,Yang Liu,Mengxuan Chen,Jiashun Cheng,Haoyuan Liang,Shilei Cao,Yujie Wang,Juepeng Zheng,Fang Wang,Yerong Feng,Meng Jin,Hong Cheng,Yutong Lu,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"动力-降水解耦"框架，通过训练一个条件扩散生成器，将冻结天气基础模型（WFM/NWP）输出的非降水大气状态映射为与IMERG卫星-雨量计观测对齐的24小时累积日降水。该生成器可在多个骨干模型（Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES）间即插即用，无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有天气基础模型（WFM）基于ERA5再分析数据训练，而ERA5降水存在区域性和强度依赖性偏差，导致局地极端降水被平滑或欠表示。直接用观测数据重新训练WFM代价过高（如GraphCast需在32块TPU v4上训练约四周），因此需要一种低成本方案来获得与观测对齐的降水预报。

Method: 1. **动力-降水解耦框架**：利用冻结的NWP/WFM提供非降水大气场（温度、风、湿度等），由独立训练的条件扩散生成器产生24小时累积降水。训练时使用ERA5状态配对IMERG降水，推理时直接使用预报场。2. **多尺度大气编码器**：采用ConvGRU门控机制和层级下采样，将t-12h和t时刻的大气状态压缩为多尺度时空潜表示。3. **交叉注意力去噪器**：在U-Net各分辨率层级引入交叉注意力机制，将降水特征与对应尺度的大气条件进行空间对齐。4. **训练目标**：标准扩散去噪损失，1000步训练，DDIM推理缩减至100步。

Result: 1. **全球1.5°确定性预报**：在Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES三种骨干上均提升ACC和RMSE，GraphCast+Ours平均ACC提升0.103，RMSE降低0.623，CSI和HSS在{0.1, 1, 4}mm阈值上均获改善。2. **全球概率预报（50成员）**：GraphCast+Ours在所有预报时效（1-7天）的BS和CRPS均优于ENS和GenCast；Day 7 CRPS为2.180（ENS 2.484，GenCast 2.368）。3. **区域0.25°评估**：美国、南部非洲、澳大利亚均表现稳健，能恢复更锐利的局地累积结构。4. **中国华北暴雨案例**（2,288个站点）：改善了日累积量空间分布和事件检测能力。5. **消融实验**：ConvGRU优于ConvLSTM，交叉注意力优于门控融合，完整配置（ConvGRU+交叉注意力+扩散）表现最佳；100步采样即可饱和；直接复用优于预报场微调（微调导致RMSE增加0.26-0.43）。6. **鲁棒性**：对高斯扰动输入敏感性可控，额外开销为110.3M参数、0.33秒/样本、~8GB GPU显存。

Conclusion: 动力-降水解耦框架通过独立的条件扩散生成器实现了观测对齐的日降水预报，同一生成器可跨多种冻结骨干复用，无需端到端重新训练。全球和区域评估显示确定性技能和概率性能均获提升，消融实验验证了时序编码和空间对齐的互补贡献。局限性包括：跨骨干复用仅在验证的预报系统上确认；两种分辨率需分别训练模型；ERA5训练状态与实际预报之间存在分布偏移（通过噪声扰动和微调实验探测）；IMERG检索不确定性和扩散采样成本仍是限制因素。

Abstract: Accurate daily precipitation forecasts are important for weather-sensitive decisions. Although recent Weather Foundation Models (WFMs) have achieved significant progress, they are trained on reanalysis data, which exhibit regional and intensity-dependent biases. Since retraining WFMs on observation-based targets is costly, we study Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a separately trained generator to map non-precipitation forecasts from a frozen weather model to observation-aligned daily precipitation. Its key challenges are to capture heterogeneous rainfall distributions and align daily accumulations with atmospheric signals that evolve across space and time. To address them, we train a diffusion generator conditional on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge estimates of precipitation. A multi-scale recurrent encoder summarizes atmospheric evolution, while cross-attention aligns atmospheric and precipitation features during denoising. Extensive evaluation of various backbones, including Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES, on global and regional forecasting shows improved daily precipitation accuracy and event detection, with better representation of localized accumulation patterns. Global ensemble evaluation shows lower Brier scores than ENS and training-from-scratch GenCast at all reported lead times, with lower CRPS in most comparisons. Remarkably, a heavy-rainfall case study using 2,288 stations in China further supports improved daily accumulation patterns and event detection against ground observations.

</details>


### [180] [Gaussian-Width Bounds for Offline-to-Online Linear Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12990)
*Kushagra Chandak,Volodymyr Tkachuk,Xiaoqi Tan,Csaba Szepesvári*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究离线数据如何辅助随机线性老虎机的在线学习，重点关注部分覆盖场景（$d$维特征中仅$k$个方向覆盖不足）。通过改进奖励预测误差的分析方法，提出具有 $\widetilde O(k\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾的阶段消除算法，并在欧几里得单位球上证明了匹配的上下界，同时研究了固定设计和自适应算法下的纯探索问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于阶段消除和乐观主义的算法在部分覆盖离线数据下产生 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ 的遗憾依赖，这源于对奖励预测误差的宽松控制。作者希望通过更精细的误差分析来获得更紧的界限。

Method: 1. 利用高斯向量Lipschitz函数浓度的分析工具替代传统的奖励预测误差界；2. 设计基于阶段消除的算法，在部分覆盖条件下获得 $\widetilde O(k\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾；3. 分别在单位欧几里得球下证明部分覆盖和均匀覆盖场景的匹配上下界；4. 研究纯探索（pure exploration）问题，针对固定设计算法和自适应算法分别提供简单遗憾的算法和匹配的上下界。

Result: 1. 在部分覆盖离线数据下，主算法实现 $\widetilde O(k\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾，相较于现有 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ 改善了 $\sqrt{d}$ 因子；2. 单位欧几里得球下部分覆盖遗憾下界匹配 $\Omega(k\sqrt{T})$；3. 均匀覆盖下也给出了匹配的上下界；4. 纯探索任务中，在部分覆盖和均匀覆盖场景下分别为固定设计和自适应算法提供了匹配界。

Conclusion: 本文通过更紧的浓度不等式分析，显著改进了离线辅助随机线性老虎机的遗憾界，将依赖从 $d$ 降至 $k$，并完整刻画了部分覆盖与均匀覆盖场景下的最优遗憾。这些结果扩展到纯探索设置，为利用离线数据的线性老虎机提供了系统的理论基础。

Abstract: We study how offline data can help online learning in stochastic linear bandits. We focus on partially covered offline data, where only $k$ of the $d$ feature directions are poorly covered. Existing analyses of algorithms based on phased elimination and optimism give regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ in this regime. We show that this dependence arises from loose control of the reward prediction error, and obtain tighter bounds using concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors. Based on this analysis, we develop a phased elimination algorithm with regret $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$. For the unit Euclidean ball, we prove a matching regret lower bound under partial coverage, as well as matching upper and lower bounds under uniform offline coverage. We also study pure exploration with offline data, providing algorithms and matching upper and lower bounds on simple regret for fixed-design algorithms and also for adaptive algorithms under partial and uniform coverage of offline data.

</details>


### [181] [Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13013)
*Muhammad Usama,Yeoreum Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EMT-DS（Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion），一种用于多模态情感识别的方法，通过证据深度学习（Subjective Opinion/Dirichlet分布）和Dempster-Shafer融合规则，形式化地量化认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）和跨模态冲突（conflict），解决了softmax方法在传感器故障或模态矛盾时过度自信的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准softmax多模态情感识别方法在传感器噪声或模态语义冲突（如面部表情显示正效价、声学韵律显示负唤醒）时仍会输出高置信度预测，缺乏对不确定性和跨模态冲突的显式量化能力，这在临床等安全关键场景中不可接受。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：（1）模态特定的Transformer编码器（Wav2Vec2、ViT、BERT/KoELECTRA、1D-CNN）提取特征；（2）证据输出层用Softplus激活和L1投影（Emax=1000）生成Dirichlet分布参数，输出Subjective Opinion三元组(信念质量b, 不确定性u, 基率a)；（3）可微Dempster-Shafer融合层，通过冲突系数1/(1-c)归一化联合信念，将冲突作为监督信号和弃分信号。训练采用Bayes风险损失（含Dirichlet方差项）+ KL散度正则化（鼓励OOD样本接近Dirichlet(1)）+ 冲突辅助损失。理论上证明了架构证据帽保证无条件Lipschitz稳定性，DS融合在条件独立下具有贝叶斯一致性，KL正则化器的唯一极小值是空意见。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上取得最优结果：IEMOCAP（4类，A+T）准确率84.3% vs 最佳基线DCT 81.7%（+2.6，p<0.01）；DEAP（EEG+生理，留一被试）82.4% vs TMC 78.1%（+4.3）；KEMDy20（严重不平衡，A+T+P+V四模态）96.8%；CMU-MOSEI 54.8%，超过最强证据方法TMC 2.4点。ECE从0.153降至0.042；在音频σ=1.0高斯噪声下保持71.2%准确率（注意力基线跌至45.3%）；模态完全缺失时优于基线；融合复杂度O(MK²) vs 注意力O(M²d²)；冲突信号审查20%样本可捕获80%错误（Spearman ρ=0.57与人工跨模态不一致标注相关）。

Conclusion: EMT-DS通过Subjective Logic的Dirichlet参数化和可微Dempster-Shafer融合，在多模态情感识别中同时实现精度提升、校准改善、噪声与缺失鲁棒性，且具备可部署的冲突信号用于选择性预测与人工审查。证据帽与冲突裁剪通过构造保证了数值稳定性。局限性在于条件独立假设（残差相关性|ρ|=0.16±0.09），未来工作可探索copula耦合、时序动态建模和自适应传感器故障融合。

Abstract: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.

</details>


### [182] [Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13020)
*Zhicheng Cai,Weinan Dai,Yuyan Zhou,Wei-Ying Ma,Ya-Qin Zhang,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TAPO（Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization），通过修正长horizon自回归生成中状态分布偏移来提升LLM强化学习训练的稳定性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM RL算法（如GRPO、GSPO）仅在token/序列层级校正策略失配，未考虑长horizon轨迹中累积的状态分布偏移，导致KL散度增大乃至训练崩溃。

Method: 从off-policy策略梯度出发推导状态分布校正项；用几何均值估计器降低方差（方差O(1/t) vs 乘积的指数增长）；设计长度感知的动态裁剪边界（按1/√t缩放）。

Result: 在8个竞赛级基准上（数学推理与算法编程），TAPO平均比GRPO分别提升48%和12%，超过现有最佳方法（RIPO/GMPO），训练过程稳定无崩溃。

Conclusion: TAPO提供了一个原则性的框架来桥接状态分布差距，在长horizon自回归策略优化中实现持续稳定的训练改进。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.

</details>


### [183] [Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13028)
*Minjong Cheon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 KAFlow（Kolmogorov–Arnold flow），一种用于学习物理算子的生成器网络。其核心思想是利用变系数算子符号的低秩分离结构，结合 KAN 单变量函数、精确指数积分器和自动符号蒸馏，在保持可解释性的同时显著提升分布外泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KANO 等方法学习稠密的伪微分符号，计算复杂度随分辨率平方增长，且闭式解需人工读取符号模板。物理算子本身具有分辨率无关的低秩分离结构，因此可以设计更紧凑、可解释且泛化性更强的算子学习框架。

Method: 1. 理论证明：有限阶变系数算子的符号分离秩与分辨率无关，KANO 上任一基准算子及其学得的符号秩均为 2。2. 架构：KAFlow 将生成器表示为平移不变谱乘子 ℓ(ξ) + R 个可分离项 a_r(x)m_r(ξ) + 规范固定（gauge-fixed）的 KAN 非线性。3. 效率：利用 FFT 实现精确低秩量化，计算复杂度从 O(m²) 降至 O(Rm log m)。4. 动力学：使用 Lawson 指数积分器或 Strang 分裂法精确积分刚性线性部分。5. 自动蒸馏：通过稀疏拟合（沿 BIC 路径和最佳子集选择）自动恢复闭式算子。7. 规范固定通过零均值位置函数和去除线性项的投影实现，保证每个项在架构中有唯一的位置。

Result: 在 KANO 全部基准测试上：(1) 合成位置依赖算子：OOD 损失比 KANO 低 3.4–11 倍，所有系数恢复至 10⁻⁴ 精度（达到数据精度下限）。(2) 长时间长程量子动力学：90 步外推状态不保真度降低多达 6 个数量级；仅用位置和动量测量时降低 30 倍。(3) 变阶分数算子：精度比现有算子网络高 15 倍。(4) 非局部色散动力学：5 个方程（带 Burgers、分数 Burgers、Benjamin–Ono、KdV、Whitham）上均优于 FNO 和稀疏回归（Whitham 上比最优稀疏回归方法高 7.4 倍），自动恢复分数阶、Hilbert 型和色散关系闭式解。计算成本：m=1024 时前向传播速度提升 690 倍（5.2 ms vs 3.6 s）。

Conclusion: KAFlow 证明了物理算子的低秩结构与生成器表示可以同时实现卓越的分布外泛化和完全自动的闭式可解释性。该框架将时间演化委托给精确积分器（刚性线性部分精确），并通过稀疏回归自动恢复符号闭式解，无需人工模板。这一方法适用于一大类数学物理算子（变系数扩散、输运、Schrödinger 算子），未来工作可拓展至二维和三维系统。

Abstract: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.

</details>


### [184] [Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13034)
*Ning Wang,Claire Cardie,Sainyam Galhotra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TCP是一种用于轨迹外推的框架，通过从相关已完成轨迹中转移有限视界端点信息来改进自由预测。它通过均匀池化和匹配增量池化两种互补信号估计端点，再通过目标一致性投影、强度校准和降级感知加权将其转化为对自由预测的修正，在多个领域上显著降低RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹外推从部分观测的目标轨迹预测未观察到的延续部分，本质上是不适定问题。虽然相关的已完成轨迹提供有价值的信息，但如何将跨异构单元的信息有效汇聚以提升预测精度仍是一个基本未解决的问题。现有方法在控制哪些源参与汇聚以及汇聚强度方面已有研究，但对于如何汇聚相关轨迹的信息以改进轨迹预测这一更基础的问题仍未解决。

Method: TCP框架包含五个关键组件：(1) 延续分解，将有限视界端点V_T与延续形状h(r)分离；(2) 端点估计，使用均匀池化（捕获最终响应水平）和匹配增量池化（在对齐源-目标状态后捕获剩余变化）两种互补信号；(3) 代表性源选择，基于高斯核herding和MMD准则压缩供体池；(4) 目标一致性投影，将端点估计投影到由响应方向定义的目标一致区域；(5) 端点引导预测修正，通过残差桥和约束等距投影将端点转化为对自由预测的修正，再通过单独的强度校准和降级感知加权组合两个修正分支。

Result: 在来自五个领域（gCSI、CTRPv2、GDSC2、OLMo 2、LCDB）共25,245个目标的两个预测方向上的实验中，TCP将所有十个目标独立预测器的平均RMSE降低了35.8%至42.1%，并在所有100个预测器、数据集和方向比较中均有所改进。关键发现包括：自有群组端点比替代群组端点贡献更大；均匀和匹配增量池化提供互补信息，组合优于任一单独使用；代表性源选择在仅使用12.7倍更少供体输入和138.8倍更少匹配距离的情况下，保持了完整供体池99%以上的端点信息；目标一致性投影在方向条件成立时提升7.3%至19.3%；强度校准将总降级减少34.4%至40.4%。

Conclusion: TCP建立了一种有效且高效的轨迹外推机制，通过从已完成的相关轨迹转移有限视界端点信息来约束自由预测。实验表明，相关的源群组提供更强的端点信息，均匀和匹配增量池化贡献互补信号，其组合优于单独使用或随机替代方案。MMD-based代表性选择以大幅降低的计算成本保留了几乎所有端点信息。目标一致性投影在方向条件成立时效果最佳，强度校准和降级感知加权控制端点信息对自由预测的影响程度。

Abstract: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction comparisons. The two endpoint signals consistently outperform either alone, while representative selection remains within 0.64% to 1.02% of the full donor pool using 12.7x fewer donor inputs and 138.8x fewer matching distance computations.

</details>


### [185] [Towards Easier-to-Tune Training Algorithms: New Results from AlgoPerf](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13036)
*Priya Kasimbeg,Ahmed Khaled,Aahlad Chandrabhatta,Yifan Wang,Andy Liu,Niccolò Ajroldi,David Tweedle,Xingyu,Yang,Isaac Patole,Frank Schneider,George E. Dahl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文报告了 AlgoPerf v1 基准测试在 self-tuning 规则集下的最新结果，在 9 个跨领域深度学习工作负载上评估了 13 个 PyTorch 和 JAX 训练算法提交。Schedule-Free AdamW v2 (PyTorch) 排名第一。文章分析了步效与墙钟时间之间的权衡，指出矩阵预处理方法（如 Muon）和双循环方法（如 DiLoCo）虽步效好但需计算优化才能在运行时有竞争力；同时通过超参数显著性（基于 1D Wasserstein 距离）和保留率分析揭示学习率和动量是最敏感的超参数，且不同工作负载的最优区间常常不相交，强调开发易于调参且跨域鲁棒优化器的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习优化器的真实算法性能常被超参数调优的脆弱性、优化器-模型协同设计等混杂因素所掩盖；现实中大规模训练往往无法负担逐任务调优，因此需要一个能在多个工作负载、单一超参数配置下可靠运行的优化器评估基准。

Method: 采用更新后的 AlgoPerf v1 基准：硬件由 8×V100 升级为 4×A100，新增 Decoder-only 语言建模（FineWeb-Edu 10B）工作负载，共 9 个跨域任务。在 self-tuning 规则集下，要求所有提交使用单一超参数配置跨所有 9 个工作负载运行，以墙钟 time-to-target 评分。使用 1D Wasserstein 距离定义超参数重要性指数 ℐ(θ)，并在 4 个优化器（DiLoCo、NAdamW、Muon、AdEMAMix）上以 N=100 Halton 序列扫描进行调优难度和保留率分析。同时补充步效评分、放松目标后的松弛排行榜，以及三个案例研究（Schedule-Free AdamW BN 校准、Muon 分布式分片、AdEMAMix warmup 坍缩）。

Result: 1) 自调排行榜：Schedule-Free AdamW v2 (PyTorch) 第一（0.5679），AdEMAMix (AdamW equiv.) 第二（实际为调优良好的 AdamW）；2) 步骤效率：Muon、DiLoCo 等矩阵预处理/双循环方法步效好但墙钟慢，需参数分片等系统优化才能进入墙钟前列；3) 超参数显著性：学习率 η 在所有算法和工作负载中均为最敏感的 1–2 个超参数之一，动量（β1 或 Muon 的 β）次之，top-5% 最优学习率区间在 NAdamW、AdEMAMix 上常出现不相交；4) 调优开销与保留率（halton N=100）：DiLoCo 失败率仅 1.0%（最稳健），NAdamW 保留率 65.5%、DiLoCo 61.4% 最高，Muon 47.0%，AdEMAMix 41.5% 最低；5) 案例研究揭示了关键实现细节：Schedule-Free 的 BN 协变量偏移修复、Muon 的分片加速（Matrix-dominated 工作负载收益巨大）、AdEMAMix 的 50 万步暖启动使其坍缩为 AdamW。

Conclusion: AlgoPerf v1 显示在单一通用配置下跨多个深度学习工作负载时仍存在巨大改进空间；超参数调优（及其缺失）仍主导着优化器的实际表现。Schedule-Free AdamW 凭借 BN 校准修复保持榜首；Muon 类方法虽能给出强步效，但其每步延迟需借助分布式张量分片与异步通信重叠等系统工程才能转化为墙钟优势。同时亟需对超参数更鲁棒、且能跨任务泛化良好的训练算法。

Abstract: Evaluating deep learning optimizer is challenging because confounding factors such as hyperparameter tuning and optimizer-model co-design often obscure true algorithmic performance. We present results of the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark, in which we evaluate a new set of training algorithms on wall-clock time-to-target across nine workloads on fixed hardware. This report focuses on the results of the benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, which requires submissions to use a single configuration across all workloads. Out of the 13 submissions in PyTorch and JAX, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first. In addition to the wall-clock scores, we also analyze the trade-offs between step efficiency and wall-clock execution, revealing that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in runtime. Finally, our hyperparameter saliency and retention analyses show that the learning rate and momentum are highly sensitive across domains and algorithms, highlighting the need for methods that are more robust against hyperparameter tuning and can generalize well to new tasks.

</details>


### [186] [CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13064)
*Jiahang Sun,Zhiwei Shang,Zhipiao Liu,Hongwei Yang,Guoqing Xie,Shuang Qiu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CB-Orchestrator提出了一种两阶段框架，将LLM智能体工作流的生成与选择解耦：先通过执行引导的进化搜索构建多样化的工作流池，再将查询条件下的工作流选择建模为上下文老虎机问题，使用混合神经-线性UCB策略实现样本高效的自适应路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体工作流自动化优化方法存在两大瓶颈：(1) 训练阶段反馈收集产生高昂的API成本；(2) 缺乏对高质量工作流的自适应复用机制。任务级方法（如AFlow）使用固定工作流缺乏灵活性；查询级方法（如MaAS）为每个查询从零生成工作流，学习目标过于困难且无法积累复用知识。本文的核心洞察是"选择比创造更容易"——应构建可复用工作流池并将学习预算用于自适应选择而非重复生成。

Method: 方法分为三个阶段：(1) **工作流池构建**——基于训练集，通过LLM初始生成、执行反馈引导的进化和跨查询迁移三步构建多样化工作流池𝒲，满足有效性和完备性准则；(2) **上下文老虎机选择**——将查询嵌入φ(q)和工作流嵌入φ(w)（由冻结文本嵌入模型对查询文本和工作流源代码编码）的拼接x(q,w)=[φ(q);φ(w)]∈ℝ^{2d}作为特征，提出**混合神经-线性UCB**选择器：3层MLP（2d→2048→64→1，含LayerNorm和GELU）作为神经奖励预测器，线性UCB组件在原始特征空间计算探索奖励u(x)=√(xᵀA⁻¹x)，总分UCB(q,w)=f_θ(x)+α·u(x)；训练采用先均匀探索后UCB选择的两阶段策略，禁止重复评估同一(查询,工作流)对，批量并行执行；(3) **推理阶段**——选取预测奖励最高的工作流，并用Wilson得分置信区间（z=3.891, 99.99%置信度）过滤不可靠工作流。可选在线学习模式通过覆盖率缺口检测动态扩展工作流池。该方法依赖三个假设：语义嵌入保留相似性、奖励函数的Lipschitz平滑性、特征空间的可实现性。

Result: 在五个基准测试（GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MBPP、GAIA）上均取得最佳性能，使用GPT-4o-mini骨干的平均得分为81.37%，超越MaAS（79.79%）和AFlow（78.76%）。具体结果：MATH 53.87%、GSM8K 93.19%、MBPP 84.05%、HumanEval 94.35%；GAIA平均21.0%（L1任务28.6%）。在MATH数据集上，训练阶段token开销降低至少40.55%，端到端训练开销降低至少29.73%。消融实验表明：移除进化机制降至68.03%，GreedyNN（无探索奖励）68.28%，HybridUCB最优68.96%；在允许重复采样设置下，探索奖励的作用更加显著（差距从1.24%扩大到2.14%）。跨域迁移实验（M→G和G→M）展示了良好的零样本迁移能力，在GSM8K→MATH设置下重训后达到54.94%。使用Llama-3.1-70B骨干时平均64.24%，验证了跨模型可扩展性。工作流池覆盖率在GSM8K达98.0%、HumanEval 93.9%、MBPP 95.3%、MATH 72.3%。

Conclusion: CB-Orchestrator通过将工作流构造与自适应选择解耦，提供了一种实用且成本高效的LLM智能体优化路径。混合神经-线性UCB选择器在原始特征空间计算探索奖励，牺牲了形式化的遗憾界保证，但获得了计算效率、训练灵活性和稳定性方面的实际优势。三个关键假设（语义嵌入、奖励平滑性、可实现性）通过实证得到验证：K近邻奖励预测准确率84.75%（随机基线51.08%），成功工作流在嵌入空间中显著聚类。框架支持通过自然融入先验知识和在线学习模式扩展到现实部署场景，是构建多功能、成本高效LLM智能体的重要实践方向。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.

</details>


### [187] [Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13073)
*Vakul Raghavan,Utkarsh Grover,Mingyang Mao,Chengwen Wang,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大块测试时训练（LaCT）中固定大小快权重记忆的局限性，提出 Double-Take（DT）方法，通过多步未固定更新、跨位置局部混合和双向变化敏感写入三个机制，分别解决容量、绑定和选择性三个核心需求，使记忆在超长基因组上下文中保持可用，并在长程外推和跨物种零样本迁移上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文建模的核心挑战不是处理多远，而是记忆能否在使用时保持可用。现有大块测试时训练（LaCT）存在两个基本缺陷：单步写入导致大量关联相互干扰而限制容量；自联想写入无法在不同位置之间建立绑定。此外，即使解决了这两个问题，将所有关联均等传输也使记忆无法区分重要与不重要的结构。因此，需要识别并解决构建可用长程记忆的三个独立需求：容量（capacity）、绑定（binding）和选择性（selectivity）。

Method: 在 LaCT 的快权重记忆基础上，Double-Take 引入三项关键修改：(1) 多步未固定部分更新（multi-step unpinned updates）——对每个块执行多次 Newton-Schulz 正交化的内层更新，但不进行逐行重归一化，从而在不覆盖已有状态的前提下提高记忆容量；(2) 跨位置局部混合（cross-position mixing）——在写入记忆前对查询、键、值流施加宽度为 3 的深度因果卷积，使跨位置关系能够直接进入记忆写入项，实现绑定；(3) 双向变化点写入（bidirectional change-point writes）——从正反两个方向查看每个位置的上下文，将两侧摘要之差作为写入目标，从而强化结构性变化而抑制平凡内容，提升选择性。整体架构为一个 87M 参数的十二层编码器，每层结合深度卷积、滑动窗口注意力和快权重记忆，记忆头维度为 32。

Result: 在受控实验中，DT 在 32 维记忆头下存储 32 对关联时仍保持 0.93 的召回率，且在跨位置检索任务上将端到端召回率从随机水平的 0.10 提升至 0.92；在长程距离上，DT 几乎不衰减（0.859→0.827），而滑动窗口注意力从 0.142 急剧降至 0.019。在基因组 TAD 边界判别任务中，仅用 32kb 上下文预训练的 DT 在 131kb 上下文上达到 0.927 AUROC，并在接近 1Mb 时仍保持 0.856，显著优于 Stock 记忆及 HyenaDNA、Caduceus 等长上下文基线；在 eQTL 变异效应预测九种 GTEx 组织上取得 0.728 的平均 AUROC；在选择性实验中，双向变化点写入将 boundary/random 比从 1.06 提升至 1.15（控制边界）、从 1.01 提升至 1.09（gnomAD 结构变异），并将稀有受约束缺失产生更大传播效应的概率从 0.42 提升至 0.67；在人类到小鼠零样本迁移中，DT 在 32kb 至 1Mb 全程保持领先。该研究将容量、绑定和选择性确立为可用长程记忆的三个必要条件。

Conclusion: Double-Take 证明，在大块测试时训练中，仅靠处理更长的序列并不足以让信息变得可用；必须同时满足容量、绑定和选择性三个要求。通过多步部分更新、跨位置局部混合和双向变化敏感写入三项机制，DT 的快权重记忆在远超训练上下文（30 倍以上）的长度上保持有效，并实现了人类到小鼠的零样本迁移。该工作将长上下文建模的核心问题从"能处理多远"重新定义为"能保留、关联并使用多远"，为构建跨模态、跨架构的可用长程记忆提供了清晰的设计原则。其局限性在于目前仅在基因组序列上验证，且缺乏与最新 TTT 方法的可复现实现进行比较。

Abstract: Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.

</details>


### [188] [Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13082)
*Mohammed Azeez Khan,Aaron Dsouza,Ashutosh Mishra,Ummul Faiz Z. Bibi,Neha K. Nair,Amar Kumar Behera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在 AMI 会议语料的 199 个情境匹配对上，对比了人类项目经理（PM）的引导发言与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 生成的引导发言在五个行为维度上的差异：人类在上下文语义距离和共情/模糊语密度上更高，LLM 在主题发散度、词汇精细度和阶段词汇对齐度上更高。研究明确不将这些差异解读为引导质量的优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注 LLM 引导系统的构建、何时介入以及对群体结果的影响，而对于 LLM 与人类在相同情境下所产生的引导话语在语言行为层面上的差异缺乏刻画。该研究旨在通过情境匹配的计算行为比较，填补 LLM 引导与人类引导在语言形式上的对比空白。

Method: 基于 AMI 会议语料（遥控器设计场景）中的 199 对情境匹配，提取 PM 候选引导句，并使用 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct（4-bit 量化）在三个温度（T=0.3/0.7/1.0）下生成对应引导回复。比较五个验证性维度：上下文语义距离（MiniLM 嵌入余弦距离）、词汇精细度（命名实体密度+类符/形符比+词长）、共情/模糊语密度、主题发散度（LDA Jensen-Shannon 距离）、阶段词汇对齐度。统计方法为配对 Wilcoxon 检验（Bonferroni 校正）。

Result: 在 T=0.7 下：人类 PM 发言在嵌入空间语义距离上更高（r=0.644），在 hedge-empathy 词密度上更高（r=0.203，但主要由 hedge 词贡献，中位数为零）。Llama 发言在 LDA 主题发散度上更高（r=0.703），在词汇精细度上更高（r=0.288，受长度混淆），在阶段词汇对齐度上更高（r=0.382，指令条件性）。温度对各维度无显著影响。长度匹配、去除重复情境、不同表征（TF-IDF 不复现嵌入结果）、混合效应模型等鲁棒性检验均支持主要方向，但直接性维度因人工验证 κ=-0.02 被排除。

Conclusion: LLM 与人类引导具有可区分的行为特征，但该差异不构成引导质量的优劣排名。差异高度依赖于表征方式（嵌入 vs TF-IDF vs LDA）。词汇精细度受长度混淆，共情差异实为 hedge 词差异，阶段对齐为指令驱动而非自发阶段感知。该行为画像为未来 LLM 引导研究提供了参考点，但限于语言层面的可测属性，不可推广为创造力、共情或通用智能的评价。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). A secondary no-phase check left the Llama-higher phase contrast in place. The system prompt still requested a facilitation move, so that check is not evidence of spontaneous phase awareness. These differences should not be interpreted as a ranking of facilitation quality. The resulting behavioral profile provides a reference point for later comparisons of LLM facilitators, human facilitators, prompts, models, and collaborative settings.

</details>


### [189] [Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13105)
*Do Nguyen-Thanh,Junlin Fang,Bing Li,Zhen Fang,Sean Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Soap框架，用于在无逐步标注的失败轨迹中定位LLM智能体决策中的关键错误步骤。该方法通过构建频谱参考空间进行基础错误评分，并利用注意力引导的依赖传播来应对"下游污染"问题，在多个基准上显著优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体被部署到复杂任务中，识别失败轨迹中的关键错误步骤对调试和改进至关重要。然而现有方法存在以下局限：(1)基于提示的方法推理成本高且对长轨迹不可靠；(2)需要昂贵的逐步错误标注；(3)OAT等方法仅使用成功轨迹，缺乏失败信号。本文探索能否仅利用失败轨迹本身（无需逐步标注）进行失败归因，并解决"下游污染"问题——后续步骤因继承早期错误而表现出更强的失败信号，导致独立评分器错误地将归因指向下游后果。

Method: Soap框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 频谱步进评分：从失败轨迹的步骤表示构建参考矩阵R，执行SVD分解，选择特定频谱带C，对每个步骤计算其在该带上的平均平方投影q_C(v_t)，取倒数作为基础错误分数（失败相关步骤投影能量较低）；(2) 依赖感知重评分：从LLM注意力模式推导步骤间的软依赖关系，聚合每个步骤t对前驱步骤i的注意力质量m_{i,t}，归一化为依赖权重w_{i,t}，然后计算下游基础分数的依赖加权平均B_i，最终得分 S̃(s_i) = S(s_i) + γ·B_i。该方法建模为无标签污染混合 P_unlabeled = (1-φ)P_ord + φP_err。

Result: 在Who&When、Correct-Error、TraceElephant等5个基准上，使用Qwen3.5-9B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B两个骨干网络，Soap在所有子集上均达到最优步级准确率。例如：Qwen3.5-9B上WW-AG达47.62%（vs ErrorProbe 39.68%），DeepSeek-8B上TE-Cap达42.64%。在含真值答案的设置下同样保持最优。消融实验验证：(1)频谱带评分优于随机子空间、顶/尾子空间、ℓ1/ℓ2范数、困惑度等7种替代评分；(2)注意力引导重评分优于均匀聚合、时间位置启发式等替代方法；(3)仅需6-12条参考轨迹即可接近全数据性能；(4)参考语料选择中，失败轨迹优于成功轨迹；(5)计算效率高，单次前向传播比多数提示方法更快。

Conclusion: Soap是一种有效且轻量级的LLM智能体失败归因框架，无需逐步标注或成功轨迹参考集。其频谱评分与注意力引导传播机制能够有效分离错误根源与其下游后果。在多个基准、骨架网络和实验设置下均优于基于提示和基于训练的基线方法，且对参考数据量需求极少，具有很强的实用性。

Abstract: Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. Importantly, later steps may exhibit stronger failure signals because they inherit an earlier mistake, causing independent scorers to favor downstream consequences over the decisive error. To address this downstream contamination, SOAP derives soft step dependencies from attention patterns and propagates downstream error evidence toward its likely upstream sources. Extensive experiments show that SOAP consistently improves attribution performance over competitive baselines.

</details>


### [190] [Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13106)
*Pengan Chen,Liang Hong,Xinyuan Liu,Han Huang,Ziqian Lin,Jiayang Chen,Yimin Fan,Jiyue Jiang,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Eco-RNA，一种 80M 参数的 RNA 基础模型，通过学习迭代精炼实现可调推理深度。共享的输入条件 Transformer 核心以反复应用方式精炼序列表示，迭代次数在训练后选定。在 70 项 RNAGym 基准测试中，4 次迭代时以少 500 倍的参数超越 Evo 2 40B，并在 RNA 家族分类、二级结构预测和化学探测任务中均取得最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 RNA 基础模型将参数容量与推理深度耦合于固定架构，每次推理采用固定计算图，限制了用额外计算换取更好预测的灵活性。RNA 功能依赖从局部 motif 到远程结构依赖的多尺度信息，需要在推理时灵活分配计算资源的能力。

Method: 模型架构由前奏（prelude）、输入条件共享 Transformer 核心 R_θ、尾声（coda）三部分组成。前奏编码序列一次，共享核心以 K 次迭代更新隐状态，尾声映射到预测。状态更新为 s^(k) = N_r(R_θ(α⊙s^(k-1) + δ⊙Be))，其中 α、δ 为可学习通道向量参数化的保留系数和输入尺度，e 为前奏表示，b 为可学习输入投影。训练目标 ℒ = ℒ_MLM + λ_fp ℒ_fp + λ_a ℒ_anchor，包含三个组件：（1）掩码语言建模，在采样终末深度 K_i 处监督；（2）相对终末位移正则化，惩罚最终状态更新相对于前一状态的尺度；（3）单边重建锚定（one-sided reconstruction anchor），当深层端点的重建损失超过浅层参考时施加额外梯度。深度采样采用 Poisson-对数正态分布，截断反向传播保留最终 W_bwd 次迭代的梯度。模型参数量 80M，隐藏维度 768，前馈维度 3072，上下文长度 8192。

Result: （1）预训练重建：在 50k-300k 更新阶段检查点上，K 从 1 增至 4 始终将掩码重建损失降低 0.040-0.042，从 4 增至 8 增益低于 0.001。（2）RNAGym 适应性预测：70 项测试中，K 从 1 增至 4 将聚合绝对 Spearman 从 0.242 提升至 0.286（18% 相对提升），MCC 提升 22%，增益持续至 K=8。K=4 时，Eco-RNA 在三项聚合指标上均超越 Evo 2 40B（0.286 vs 0.276 Spearman），参数少 500 倍，前向 FLOP 少约 200 倍。（3）K=1 至 4 构型推进了估计前向 FLOP 与性能间的 Pareto 前沿。（4）下游任务（K=4）：nRC 家族分类 98.69%（最优），bpRNA-TS0 二级结构 F1 75.40%（最优），Ribonanza 化学探测平均 AUC 0.864、F1 0.782、MAE 0.158（均最优）。（5）饱和模式：粗粒度家族分类在少量迭代后饱和，细粒度核苷酸级与配对级预测在更深迭代仍有增益。

Conclusion: Eco-RNA 确立了内部推理计算作为 RNA 基础模型的有效缩放维度。单一循环检查点提供多个计算-性能操作点，推进了 RNAGym Pareto 前沿。复用学习参数提升预测的能力使模型用户能在训练后直接控制执行深度。深度依赖增益在预训练重建与任务适配后均存在，粗粒度标签早期饱和而细粒度输出在更大深度保留更小修正机会，为不同预测任务按需选择计算深度提供了统一接口。

Abstract: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.

</details>


### [191] [WaSA: Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders for Unsupervised Offline Detection of Malicious Clients in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13186)
*Alessandro Licciardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 WaSA（Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders），一种面向联邦学习的完全无监督、离线恶意客户端检测框架。客户端在训练前上传基于小波散射变换（WST）的隐私保护频谱摘要，服务器使用仅在干净辅助数据上训练的降噪自编码器学习良性流形，通过归一化重构误差识别偏离该流形的恶意客户端，并引入玻尔兹曼采样策略进行客户端选择。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上面对高达 90% 恶意客户端的多种攻击场景下，WaSA 在检测精度和全局模型准确率上均优于有监督基线 Waffle 及鲁棒聚合方法，且通信开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习（FL）在不暴露原始数据的前提下实现协同模型训练，但仍易受到恶意客户端投毒数据集的攻击。现有防御方法多为训练期间的被动反应式，或依赖已知攻击类型的有监督分类器，难以适用于开放的物联网部署场景，亟需一种在训练开始前就能识别恶意客户端且无需任何攻击标签的离线防御框架。

Method: 1. 客户端侧：通过截断 SVD（Eckart-Young-Mirsky 定理）将本地数据方差加权叠加为单张"频谱原型"，再经小波散射变换（WST，仅一阶系数）获得稳定、对局部形变具有 Lipschitz 稳定性的低维嵌入向量 z_k。2. 服务器侧：利用辅助干净数据集 D_aux 合成 WST 嵌入训练降噪自编码器 f_φ，学习良性流形；在"第零轮"前计算各客户端归一化重构误差 ε_k（公式 4）。3. 客户端过滤有两种方式：（a）确定性阈值法，ε_k ≤ τ（默认 τ=1）即视为良性；（b）玻尔兹曼采样策略，将 ε_k 视作能量，按 Gibbs 分布 π_k ∝ exp(-ε_k/T) 概率性选取客户端，温度 T→0 对应硬剔除、T→∞ 对应均匀采样。WST 的不可逆性结合 SVD 截断天然防止数据反演攻击。

Result: 在 K=100 客户端、n_k=200 张图像、10% 参与率、共 500 通信轮的设置下，覆盖 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 及 60%/90% 两种恶意比例（含高斯噪声、高斯模糊、随机像素掩码、全黑图像四类攻击）：（1）WST 骨干相比 FT 骨干在所有攻击类型下都能给出清晰的异常分数分离；（2）客户端检测上，WaSA-Boltzmann 在 40% 恶意时 CIFAR-10/100 均达 98.8% F1、100% 召回，90% 恶意时 WaSA-Deterministic 在 CIFAR-10 上达到完美的 100% F1、在 CIFAR-100 上达到 99.6% F1，全面超越有监督的 Waffle-FT 和 Waffle-WST 基线；（3）全局模型准确率上，WaSA-Boltzmann（T=1.0）在多数场景下接近甚至超过 Oracle 上界，特别在 CIFAR-100 90% 恶意情况下（24.10%）同时超越 Oracle 与 FedAvg。通信开销可忽略。

Conclusion: WaSA 将联邦学习的客户端筛选从"有监督、威胁特定"的范式推进到"完全无监督、攻击无关"的范式：基于学习到的良性 WST 流形几何而非攻击标签，可在未见复合型腐败下泛化；同时，玻尔兹曼采样策略解耦了防御性过滤与硬剔除决策，在干净客户端稀缺时仍能支撑模型收敛。整体推动离线 FL 防御研究进入无需任何攻击先验知识的新阶段。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data, yet remains vulnerable to malicious clients injecting poisoned datasets. Existing defenses are typically reactive (operating during training) or supervised (requiring prior knowledge of attack types) - assumptions that rarely hold in open-ended IoT deployments. We propose WaSA, a fully unsupervised, offline framework for malicious client detection. Before training, each client transmits a single, privacy-preserving spectral summary of its data to the server. A denoising autoencoder, trained solely on clean auxiliary data, scores clients based on their deviation from the learned benign manifold, identifying corruptions regardless of the attack type. WaSA requires no attack labels, generalizes to unseen anomalies, and introduces a Boltzmann sampling strategy for client selection that smoothly interpolates between hard exclusion and standard aggregation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under diverse attack scenarios (up to 90 % malicious clients) demonstrate consistent improvements over supervised baselines and robust aggregation methods, with negligible communication overhead. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [192] [S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13202)
*Yuhang He,Hongyu Ge,Zihan Lin,Siyi Liu,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: S³R（Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts）是一种面向RLVR长上下文场景的快速且保真的强化学习rollout框架。它使用稀疏注意力进行提案生成，再通过全注意力验证与精确投机采样恢复密集响应组的分布，从而在加速生成的同时保持策略分布的一致性。在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B上分别实现了1.39倍和1.35倍的端到端训练吞吐加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中的rollout生成是主要瓶颈。在长上下文自回归解码中，注意力占用72–76%的kernel时间。直接使用稀疏注意力采样会改变行为策略并导致训练崩溃；而训练端的逐响应重加权无法恢复密集策略更新，因为GRPO的优势依赖于同组其他响应。需要在不改变响应组分布的前提下降低KV-cache流量。

Method: 1. 理论证明：基于精确投机采样定理，证明即使采用精确的响应级重要性权重，由于GRPO优势依赖组内其他响应，直接稀疏采样无法恢复密集策略期望更新（S³R通过保留密集响应组分布解决此问题）。2. 自稀疏投机框架：使用稀疏注意力（budget s=0.05）从共享策略快照提案tokens，再通过全注意力验证和精确投机采样恢复密集分布。3. KV感知的AIMD调度器：通过监控GPU KV利用率和恢复积压来动态调整并发限制，减少KV-cache抖动。4. 软硬件协同：稀疏drafting与全注意力验证共享策略权重，无需训练单独的drafter；CUDA Graph捕获与跨步状态管理支持策略同步。

Result: 在数学推理数据集DAPO-MATH-17k上：Qwen3-1.7B端到端训练吞吐3213.8 tokens/s/GPU（1.39× AR），Qwen3-8B为1302.6 tokens/s/GPU（1.35× AR）。任务性能（pass@1）与AR相当，且训练动力学轨迹匹配。稀疏预算扫掠（s=0.03~0.50）表明s=0.05是在LLM-NPU混合工作负载下的实用权衡点。KV感知AIMD调度器在256并发限制下额外带来5.8%的吞吐提升，并将每千token传输页面从18.0页降至1.3页，消除了KV-cache抖动。在s=0.05的激进稀疏预算下，S³R训练稳定，而直接稀疏采样+训练端修正出现spike-and-collapse模式。

Conclusion: S³R将稀疏性限制在提案生成阶段，通过精确投机采样在验证步骤恢复密集响应组分布，从而在加速长上下文RLVR rollouts的同时保持策略保真度。无需训练或维护单独的drafter，显著降低了系统开销。动态KV感知调度进一步释放了计算潜力。未来的工作将探索自适应稀疏预算与上下文选择，以及向MoE和线性注意力模型的扩展。

Abstract: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

</details>


### [193] [Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13205)
*Rong Wu,Daocheng Fu,Yu Yang,Xuemeng Yang,Siqi Li,Shu Zou,Yao Zhu,Botian Shi,Bo Zhang,Cong Zhang,Pinlong Cai,Jianbiao Mei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了 On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 中"相对策略差异"作为监督信号的有效迁移条件，提出统一形式化框架 A²-OPD，揭示了任务导向训练差异、专家-参考互补角色以及目标兼容性三个关键决定因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 OPD 要求教师模型显著强于学生，限制了其应用范围和后训练成果的复用。近期工作提出迁移"相对策略差异"（专家与参考之间的差）替代绝对分布匹配，但何种差异有效、何种目标能受益仍不清楚。

Method: 将代理专家与代理参考之间的 log-probability 比值解释为 KL 正则化策略优化中的隐式奖励；推导 Any-to-Any 策略迁移目标 (A²-OPD)；通过系统实验比较 RL/SFT/规模扩展产生的策略差异在不同代理参考与目标模型上的迁移效果。

Result: 三项主要发现：(1) 任务导向训练（RL/SFT）产生的差异迁移一致有效，而仅由模型规模引起的差异迁移弱或不稳定；(2) 专家提供可迁移能力，参考过滤共享行为并隔离相关残差；(3) 有效差异并不普适可迁移，需诱导更新将目标推向专家并泛化至样本外；原始策略距离不可预测迁移性，合适的参考可挽救失败的迁移；上述模式在数学与代码任务上一致。

Conclusion: 本文形式化了相对策略差异迁移并刻画了有效监督的条件：任务相关方向、参考的过滤效应、目标兼容性是决定迁移成败的三大关键因素，为代理对与目标的选择提供了实践指导。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. Our systematic experiments yield three findings. First, a stronger expert is not necessarily a better source of supervision: differences induced by task-specific training, including reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, transfer consistently, whereas those arising from model scale alone transfer weakly or not at all. Second, the expert and reference serve complementary roles: the expert provides the capability to be transferred, while the reference filters out shared behavior and isolates the relevant residual. Third, even a useful difference does not transfer to every target: success requires the induced update to move the target toward the expert and generalize beyond sampled rollouts. Raw policy distance does not predict transferability, whereas an appropriate reference can rescue otherwise unsuccessful transfer. These results characterize when relative policy differences provide effective supervision for OPD.

</details>


### [194] [How Much Computation Does Every Forecast Need? Structured Block Skipping in Two Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13208)
*Max Bourgeat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列基础模型（Chronos-Bolt 和 TimesFM 2.5）在推理时跳过整个 Transformer 块的可能性，发现适度稀疏化可在 A100 上减少 11-13% 延迟且质量变化有限，但未能提出可部署的动态推理方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时间序列基础模型对所有输入都使用相同的网络深度，但不同预测窗口在结构与难度上存在差异。研究者希望探究：是否每个输入都需要执行相同的结构化子网络？这为条件计算（conditional computation）寻找机会。

Method: 在两个冻结预训练模型（Chronos-Bolt 的 1-11 块、TimesFM 的 0-19 块）中通过旁路（bypass）跳过整个 Transformer 块。基于校准窗口用边际重要性和反向贪心法选择掩码，在 ETTh1/Traffic/Weather/Exchange 共 1088 个保留窗口上评估。同时使用回溯 oracle 估计上界，并用 Chronos 冻结表示和手工特征测试可路由性。

Result: 在中等稀疏度下（Chronos 7/11、TimesFM 16/20）平均预测质量变化很小，A100 batch-1 延迟分别降低 11.2% 和 13.4%。更激进的 TimesFM 跳过在 Traffic 和 Weather 上严重退化。Oracle 比最佳静态掩码在所有数据集上提升 3.2-21.7%，但数据集特定掩码迁移不稳定，Chronos 表示不支持可靠的未见域路由。

Conclusion: 研究证实了跨架构的结构化冗余和输入依赖的机会，但未提供可部署的动态推理方法。块跳过的节省是计算而非模型内存，且需要架构和领域特定的校准。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models use the same network depth for every input, although forecasting windows differ in structure and difficulty.
