We test whether whole Transformer blocks can be removed at inference time in two pretrained models: Chronos-Bolt and TimesFM 2.5. Our bypasses avoid the original block computation and preserve the dense model exactly when all blocks are enabled. Masks are selected only on calibration windows and evaluated on 1,088 held-out windows from ETTh1, Traffic, Weather, and Exchange. At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. Across both models, different equal-budget masks win on different windows, and a retrospective oracle significantly improves over the best static mask on every dataset. However, dataset-specific masks transfer inconsistently, and Chronos representations do not support reliable unseen-domain routing. These results establish cross-architecture structured redundancy and input-dependent opportunity, but not a deployable dynamic inference method.

</details>


### [195] [Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13215)
*Xi Zhang,Boyu Diao,Zesen Chen,Ruiqi Liu,Hangda Liu,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Monarch-MoE，一种用于多模态持续指令微调的结构化专家架构。它将LoRA专家中的稠密因子替换为通过固定置换连接的块对角因子（基于Monarch矩阵），实现块级梯度隔离——单个块对的更新仅影响一个输出块，同时保持所有输入输出块之间的连通性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态持续指令微调中，模型需在不重放历史数据的情况下依次学习新任务，容易发生灾难性遗忘。现有多专家LoRA（如MoELoRA）通过多个低秩专家分散学习过程，但单个稠密低秩专家中，更新一个输入因子可能通过共享权重影响多个输出特征，使新任务更新有可能干扰旧任务特征。

Method: 核心方法是Monarch-MoE，将LoRA专家M=BA中的稠密因子替换为两个块对角矩阵L和R，通过固定置换P连接形成M=LPR。每个输入-输出块对有独立的内维度为r的通道。结构性质：(1) 块级梯度隔离——单个块对的ΔL和ΔR更新仅直接影响对应输出块；(2) 置换维持所有输入-输出块对的连通性。系统层面，结合批处理计算、融合前向算子和定制反向传播以提高效率。实验在LLaVA-1.5-7B上进行，使用MLLM-DCL（5任务）和UCIT（6任务）基准，集成CL-MoE、O-LoRA和DISCO三种持续学习方法。

Result: 主要结果：在MLLM-DCL和UCIT上，Monarch-MoE将适配器参数量降低约75%和50%，首任务遗忘降至0.52pp和0.10pp。容量匹配对比显示结构（而非容量）解释保留优势。多种子实验（n=3）验证可重复性。主成分角度分析显示Monarch的相邻任务更新子空间接近正交。单体GPU测量显示训练吞吐量提升19.5%（1.606 vs 1.344 samples/s），可在24GB RTX 4090上完成微调和推理。存在方法依赖的获取-保留权衡：UCIT上DISCO+Monarch的MFN下降2.08点换取遗忘大幅改善。

Conclusion: Monarch-MoE通过结构化专家参数化在多模态持续学习中有效减少跨任务干扰，在显著降低参数预算的同时改善首任务遗忘。结构优势在容量控制和子空间分析中得到支持。该方法使结构化专家在内存受限硬件上成为持续适应的实用选择，但获取与保留之间的权衡、方法依赖的性能差异以及在更广泛骨干和更长任务序列上的验证仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.

</details>


### [196] [Tensor-based Fusion of Multi-modal Data for Predicting Cancer Risk Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13221)
*Ali Anaissi,Yuanzhe Jia,Qishun Peng,Weidong Huang,Ali Braytee,Junaid Akram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督机器学习框架,通过整合特征提取、张量分解和聚类算法,融合异构基因组与临床多模态数据,用于癌症风险分层预测。在LinkedOmics数据(11,158名患者,32种癌症类型)上的实验表明,tSVD+GMM组合在多种临床基准上表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癌症诊断中多模态数据(基因组与临床)虽富含病理信息,但具有高维度和异构性,常规机器学习方法难以提取有意义的跨模态特征,限制了患者风险分层的精度。诊断错误率在美国临床环境中高达15-45%,亟需更有效的综合分析框架。

Method: 框架包含三阶段流水线:(1) 特征提取——使用PCA、tSVD和MDS将高维特征矩阵(维度从823和335,854不等)降至500维,保留至少95%方差;(2) 张量分解——将降维后的特征矩阵堆叠为三阶张量(患者×特征×方法),通过CORCONDIA确定最优秩为2,采用CP分解提取潜在因子;(3) 聚类——使用K-means、K-medians、GMM、DBSCAN、层次聚类和CLIQUE进行聚类,结合内部指标(Silhouette、Calinski-Harabasz)和外部指标(Fowlkes-Mallows、准确率)进行评估,以病理T分期、N分期、病理分期和肿瘤纯度作为临床基准。

Result: 在LinkedOmics乳腺浸润性癌数据上(整合临床注释、DNA甲基化、miRNA表达、RNA-seq和拷贝数变异5种模态),tSVD+GMM组合在多种临床基准上一致优于其他配置。在病理T分期上准确率最高,在病理N分期上准确率达0.661,病理分期评估中Silhouette得分达0.3-0.6,tSVD增强算法Calinski-Harabasz得分超过1000。DBSCAN聚类结果不稳定,层次聚类最高准确率仅45%。

Conclusion: 张量融合结合tSVD+GMM的框架能实现高/低风险患者的有效分层,为精准肿瘤学提供可靠的无监督方法。未来工作将扩展至更多癌症类型,并引入生存建模和外部验证。

Abstract: Cancer diagnosis and treatment increasingly rely on multi-modal diagnostic technologies that generate high-dimensional datasets. Although these datasets are rich in pathological information, they pose considerable challenges in interpretation, dimensionality reduction, and clinical applicability. Conventional machine learning approaches often fail to extract meaningful cross-modal features, thereby limiting predictive accuracy in patient risk stratification. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework that integrates feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering to improve cancer risk prediction. The framework employs tensor decomposition to fuse heterogeneous genomic and clinical data, enabling the extraction of latent, biologically meaningful features that outperform unimodal feature sets. Multiple feature extraction strategies are investigated, and the resulting features are subsequently clustered using a range of clustering algorithms. Comparative evaluations based on internal and external metrics are then used to identify the most effective configurations. The framework is validated on LinkedOmics data comprising 11,158 patients across 32 cancer types. For patient risk stratification, clinically relevant attributes such as tumor purity, pathological stage, and survival outcomes serve as ground-truth indicators. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of tSVD+GMM, which consistently outperforms other configurations across clinical benchmarks.

</details>


### [197] [Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13234)
*Sukru Caglar,Sena Kalabalik,Abdullah Umut Hamzaogullari,Arkadas Ozakin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次成功将拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）应用于Schwarzschild测地线运动学习，提出了解耦位置-速度归一化方案和ISCO约束的对数均匀采样策略，实现了高精度轨道预测与守恒量保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Schwarzschild测地线动力学具有显著的区域多样性（如圆轨道、近心点进动、强引力场高偏心率轨道等），且坐标与速度尺度差异巨大，使得现有稳定化LNN框架难以收敛。需要在六维相空间中进行有效的物理感知采样，并解决多尺度优化难题。

Method: 在稳定化LNN基线（包含Lorentzian先验与Sylvester正则化）上引入两项改进：(1) 解耦的位置-速度归一化方案，独立缩放每个坐标及其时间导数，并对加速度目标做逐通道权重调整以平衡各通道贡献；(2) 基于ISCO（最内稳定圆轨道）结构的能量约束对数均匀采样策略，通过拒绝采样筛选束缚态轨道，将有界样本比例从27.3%提升至92.3%。

Result: 模型在近（r∈[50,90]）、中（r∈[90,200]）、远（r∈[200,300]）三个区域共8种轨道场景中，准确再现了近日点进动和相对论时间膨胀效应；平均径向偏差约为4.77±4.41个rₛ单位；在τ/M=5×10⁴的长时间积分中，能量与角动量守恒误差保持在几个百分点以内。消融实验表明解耦归一化和混合速度采样是性能提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: 本文是LNN在Schwarzschild测地线上首次成功训练的工作，证明了通过物理启发的归一化与采样策略，LNN能够可靠学习弯曲时空中的测地线动力学。然而所学习的拉格朗日量为归一化坐标下的隐式标量函数，并不严格收敛于物理度规的纯动能形式（其Hessian出现非零非对角元，并存在残余势能项V(r,φ)），因此直接从学到的拉格朗日量中提取时空度规仍需额外的结构约束。该工作也为强场与弱场联合建模提供了数据驱动的新方向。

Abstract: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.

</details>


### [198] [State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13238)
*Zhentao Zhang,Yanzhao Zheng,Yanlin Liu,Yuanqiang Yu,Tianze Xu,Chao Ma,Jihuai Zhu,Lelun Wu,Baohua Dong,Hangcheng Zhu,Ruohui Huang,Gang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出State-OPD框架，针对多轮智能体场景中的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）问题，通过将教师监督锚定于交互状态（interaction state，即任务指令与已执行的动作-观察序列）而非学生推理历史，解决学生推理对教师监督的"扭曲"问题，同时通过在高响应熵状态重采样完整推理-动作响应来增加动作多样性。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop三个基准上，Qwen3-4B学生宏平均成功率从26.07%提升至31.74%，并在ALFWorld Seen上超越其Qwen3-32B教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）扩展到多轮智能体环境时面临挑战：学生生成的累积历史同时用于构造教师目标和采样后续学生响应，使推理对监督的影响难以区分。已有方法通过课程或教师辅助重塑rollout历史，或重新分配rollout和loss预算，但尚未从交互状态的角度系统分析学生推理在教师监督和学生响应采样中的非对称作用。

Method: 1) 形式化定义交互状态 s_t = (g, o_0, a_0, o_1, ..., a_{t-1}, o_t)，即任务指令与已执行动作-观察序列的组合，排除学生推理。证明命题1：s_t 保留了 h_t 关于潜在环境状态 ξ_t 的全部信息。2) 通过配对干预实验发现：移除继承的学生推理可提升教师后续成功率和改变token级监督目标（深度越深增益越大）；重采样完整推理-动作响应比在固定推理下仅重采样动作产生更多动作多样性。3) 提出State-OPD框架：(a) 状态锚定监督——教师仅以 s_t 为上下文，学生保留完整 h_t；(b) 状态中心响应分配——在高响应熵的 P_i 个状态各采样 n=β(M-1) 个完整响应，预算与参考OPD的M倍rollout匹配（β=2）。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop三个基准、五种评估设置上，Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B学生均取得最高宏平均成功率。Qwen3-4B平均成功率从最强基线Vanilla OPD的26.07%提升至31.74%；ALFWorld Seen达43.39%，Unseen达45.71%，在Seen上超越Qwen3-32B教师（38.39%）。消融实验显示两个组件均贡献增益（状态锚定+9.31点，响应分配+2.93点，联合+12.13点）。在更少监督轮次响应下保持优势（~286k vs 302k），大幅减少失败动作循环（8次连续重复率0.07% vs 4.29%）。推理链更长（638 vs 336 tokens/轮），定性案例显示学生更善于根据观察反馈修订决策。

Conclusion: 在固定交互状态下分析agentic OPD揭示了学生推理的非对称作用：继承的推理削弱教师指导，而重采样当前推理可增加动作多样性。State-OPD将教师目标锚定于已执行的动作-观察记录，并在高熵状态重采样完整响应，在保留完整历史学生生成的同时改进监督质量。实验证明该方法在三个基准上以更少监督响应和显著减少的失败循环取得最高成功率，建立了交互状态作为agentic知识迁移组织单元的有效性。Qwen3-4B学生在ALFWorld Seen上超越Qwen3-32B教师，表明该方法具有实际的知识压缩价值。

Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging. We study agentic OPD through interaction states, distinguishing the objective task and executed action-observation record from the internal semantic trajectory of student reasoning. Through this lens, we identify two roles of student reasoning in multi-turn OPD: prior reasoning distorts teacher supervision, while current reasoning shapes the action alternatives sampled at the same state. Specifically, at matched interaction states, removing prior student reasoning improves teacher continuation success and changes the teacher's token-level targets, with larger continuation gains at later turns. Meanwhile, resampling complete reasoning-action responses yields greater action diversity at the same state than resampling actions under a fixed reasoning trace. We introduce State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation, a framework that grounds teacher supervision in interaction states and reallocates the sampling budget to generate multiple complete reasoning-action responses at states with high response entropy, while retaining full-history student generation. Comprehensive evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop demonstrate that State-OPD achieves the highest macro-average success rate among the evaluated methods for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students. Notably, for Qwen3-4B, State-OPD raises macro-average success from 26.07\% with the strongest baseline to 31.74\% and surpasses its Qwen3-32B teacher on ALFWorld Seen. Further analyses reveal that State-OPD achieves higher task success with fewer supervised turn responses and substantially reduces persistent failed-action repetition; qualitative traces illustrate decision revision based on interaction feedback.

</details>


### [199] [CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13257)
*Jingru Yang,Jinhang Wu,Minjing Shi,Shengfeng He,Xuyan Li,Man Tan,Biye Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring) is a shift-or-stay framework for cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) that addresses credit alignment: it redistributes each aligned chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness (exactly solving a KL-regularized allocation), and selectively anchors unaligned positions to the SFT initial policy via a KL penalty. It improves six-benchmark averages by 2.45/1.32 points for Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B/Llama-3.1-8B cross-tokenizer transfer and 2.10 points for shared-tokenizer Qwen3-1.7B transfer, with consistent gains across seeds and fewer training collapses.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cross-tokenizer OPD methods (e.g., DPCA) achieve chunk-level alignment via decoded-text matching, but leave two coupled problems unresolved: (1) how to distribute a chunk's aggregate advantage across individual student tokens, since uniform propagation ignores student uncertainty and local teacher-signal variation; and (2) how to constrain student drift at unaligned positions that receive no teacher supervision but share parameters with supervised ones. These issues must be solved to convert span-level signals into effective token-level updates.

Method: CAST uses DPCA-style decoded-text alignment to form K-token credit chunks. For aligned chunks, weights w_i = u_i·s_i / Σu_j·s_j combine student entropy (uncertainty prior) with inverse local teacher-score variation (smoothness), exactly solving min_w∈Δ {KL(w‖p^u) + Σw_i logρ_i} where ρ_i = 1+δ_i/ε_g, with bounded relative distortion (1 ≤ ρ_i ≤ K_g+1); this preserves each chunk's total advantage. For unaligned positions, selective token anchoring applies a clipped KL penalty d_i = exp(z_i)−z_i−1 toward π_0 (SFT init), constraining drift only where teacher supervision is unavailable. The full objective is L_PG (PPO-style clipped) + λ_KL·L_anchor, with multi-rollout sampling (n=2) and student training on its own on-policy trajectories.

Result: Cross-tokenizer (Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B): 47.22 Avg-6 (+2.45 over ULD's 44.77, +5.82 over DPCA's 41.40). Cross-tokenizer (Qwen3-8B→Llama-3.1-8B): 43.87 Avg-6 (+1.32 over ULD's 42.55). Shared-tokenizer (Qwen3-8B→Qwen3-1.7B): 48.68 Avg-6 (+2.10 over DistiLLM's 46.58). Three-seed Mistral: 47.01±0.28 vs uniform 44.81±0.22 and uncertainty-only 45.21±0.64; Llama: 43.72±0.16 vs ULD 42.08±0.43. Ablations show smoothness recovers code performance (LCB 17.0→27.7), selective anchoring beats global (+2.92) and no anchoring (+3.22), and CAST has higher gradient SNR (0.256 vs 0.111 at SFT init) and more consistent training/held-out gradient directions. Collapse rate across 6 seeds: CAST 1/6 vs uncertainty-only 2/6 vs uniform 3/6 vs DPCA 0/6 (but lower scores).

Conclusion: CAST converts span-level supervision into structured token-level updates via uncertainty–smoothness credit assignment and selective token anchoring, with a principled KL-regularized characterization and bounded smoothness distortion. The approach generalizes beyond tokenizer mismatch to shared-tokenizer settings using punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks, consistently outperforming strong baselines (ULD, DPCA, GKD, DistiLLM) across mathematics, science, and code benchmarks with improved gradient consistency and fewer training collapses. Limitations include evaluation on a limited model family set, reasoning-oriented data focus, and varying training compute across methods.

Abstract: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.

</details>


### [200] [Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13258)
*Burla Nur Korkmaz,Petro Moilanen,Ari Salmi,Harsha Vardhan Tetali,Arto Klami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为 LU-NO 的神经代理模型，将傅里叶神经算子(FNO)与局部积分重采样结合到 U-Net 架构中，用于异质介质中的超声波传播建模，能够在有限数据上训练并跨空间尺度泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声波在异质介质中的传播模拟计算成本高昂(传统有限元方法需要数小时甚至数周),而现有的神经代理模型(FNO 和 U-Net)各有局限:FNO 由于吉布斯现象难以捕捉界面反射等不连续特征,U-Net 缺乏跨空间尺度的算子化能力。需要在非破坏性成像和医学成像等应用中实现快速、准确、可分辨率无关的波传播代理模型。

Method: LU-NO(Local-Integral Resampler U-shaped Neural Operator)采用 U 型编码器-解码器架构,关键创新包括:(1)在每个分辨率层级内集成傅里叶层以捕获全局依赖;(2)使用基于距离的局部积分重采样机制替代传统池化/插值,通过 M 个三角基函数的加权和构建学习核,核半径 r 表示物理域的一固定比例从而实现分辨率无关;(3)将 T 个输入帧直接映射到下一个 T 个非重叠帧以更好捕获长期时间动态。模型将输入 (压力场历史、介质波速图、时空坐标、源位置) 映射为未来压力场。

Result: 在二维水-铝结构超声波传播实验中,LU-NO 在高分辨率(301×301)上的相对 L2 误差为 0.305±0.083,显著优于 U-NO(0.453±0.047)、FNO(0.405±0.073)和 U-Net(1.160±0.025),且在跨尺度泛化(训练分辨率121×121 → 测试301×301)时性能保持一致;在内存消耗(11.91GB vs U-NO 16.66GB/FNO 17.32GB)和训练时间(34s vs 61s/59s)上也更高效;对初始噪声的鲁棒性强于纯 U-Net。模型仅在 14 个模拟的低分辨率数据上训练即可泛化到未见结构和更高分辨率。

Conclusion: LU-NO 是首个能够正确模拟异质介质中反射和折射且可跨空间分辨率泛化的神经代理模型,验证了它学习到了底层连续系统的算子本质而非特定分辨率的离散化映射;虽然其在训练分辨率上的精度略低于简单卷积 U-Net(后者仅学习特定分辨率下的场),但在分辨率泛化和噪声鲁棒性方面具有显著优势,为后续逆问题求解提供了更可靠的代理模型基础。

Abstract: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions. Despite recent progress, the current surrogates are not yet sufficient for the needs of ultrasonic sensing, characterized by high frequency and heterogeneous propagation media. We show how methods building on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) fail to capture essential signal features, such as reflections, whereas U-Net -based methods learn the wave fields well but lack the ability to transfer information across different spatial scales. We then propose a new surrogate that captures the best of the two worlds, by integrating FNOs and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture. We show it can be trained on limited data, and that the predictions are robust to input noise and work across spatial scales.

</details>


### [201] [Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13261)
*Zhenke Duan,Xin Li,Jiqun Pan,Dong Xiaofei,Hanwen Ning,Xinyuan Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAMCHA（Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention），一种通过度量学习视角推广多头注意力（MHA）的新型注意力机制。它通过学习完整的跨头度量矩阵（包括对角块和非对角块）并将其参数化为输入依赖函数，使注意力几何能动态适应数据流形结构。同时引入堆栈级参数共享等正则化策略控制复杂度。该机制可作为MHA的直接替代品，在多种Transformer架构中以可比或更低的计算开销实现更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MHA存在三个固有结构缺陷：(1) 块对角约束假设头之间条件独立，忽略跨头交互；(2) 相似度度量在训练后固定，无法适应推理时的输入变化；(3) 查询-键分解形式导致低秩瓶颈。这些限制使MHA难以表示耦合的多子空间几何结构，也无法匹配数据分布中常见的非线性和局部各向异性流形结构。现有改进方法（THA、DCMHA、ColMHA、MoA、MMA）均未从度量学习角度统一解决跨头交互与输入自适应问题。

Method: 核心方法包含三个关键设计：(1) 跨头度量矩阵（CHM）：学习完整的h×h块矩阵，包含对角块M_{i,i}（头内相似度）和非对角块M_{i,j}（跨头交互），通过行求和（RowSum）聚合为每个头的有效度量m_i(X)=Σ_j M_{i,j}(X)；得分矩阵通过广义二次型S_i(X)=(1/√d_k)·X·m_i(X)·X⊤计算。(2) 输入自适应参数化：使用可学习前馈网络f_θ（MLP或超网络）将输入X映射为自适应CHM，即f_θ(X)→M(X)。(3) 堆栈级参数共享：f_θ在所有堆叠层间共享参数，控制模型复杂度并防止过拟合。理论证明：DAMCHA的得分函数类严格包含MHA（S_MHA⊊S_DAMCHA）；在异构数据下，DAMCHA的度量学习风险上界不超过MHA（R*_DAMCHA≤R*_MHA）。

Result: 在四个任务上验证：(1) 解码器Transformer图像/文本生成：CIFAR-10上FID@Top-50从91.43降至63.03（31.1%相对降低），CIFAR-100上达到53.76；WMT翻译BARTScore从-8.47提升至-5.45。(2) GPT-2预训练：Mix数据集交叉熵损失较MHA降低5.19%，较DCMHA降低3.70%。(3) ViT-S/16 ImageNet-1K分类：500 epoch时Top-1达82.10%，Top-5达96.23%。(4) 合成任务：当跨子空间交互较强（λ≥0.2）或特征维度较高（d_e≥8）时优势显著。消融实验证明完整CHM优于仅对角或仅非对角设置，9层MLP优于浅层，f_θ和共享机制均为关键组件。计算开销与MHA相当或更低。

Conclusion: DAMCHA通过统一框架同时解决了MHA的块对角约束、固定度量和低秩瓶颈三个核心缺陷，将注意力从独立的逐头点积相似度提升为联合头空间上的数据自适应Mahalanobis类度量。该机制具有理论保证（严格函数类包含、风险上界更优）和实证支持（在语言建模、图像生成、分类、跨域预训练等任务上一致优于MHA及THA、DCMHA、ColMHA、MMA、MoA等基线），且计算成本相当或更低。高质量生成样本上的提升尤为显著，表明动态跨头协调对建模复杂多因素依赖至关重要。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention (DAMCHA), a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention (MHA) through the lens of metric learning. Standard MHA implicitly learns a static, head-wise Euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix, discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. DAMCHA addresses this limitation via two key innovations. First, it learns the full cross-head metric matrix, inducing a Mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of MHA. Second, it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function, enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. We further introduce principled regularization strategies, most notably stack-wise parameter sharing, to ensure computational efficiency and stable optimization. DAMCHA serves as a drop-in replacement for MHA and its variants in various Transformer architectures, delivering superior expressive power and learning performance with comparable or reduced computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAMCHA-based Transformers consistently outperform competing baselines across a range of benchmark tasks. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [202] [CopRoute: Dependence-Aware Conformal Routing for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13276)
*Siva Rajesh Kasa,Santhosh Kumar Kasa,Karan Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CopRoute是一种依赖性感知的保形路由策略，通过按模型对未回答查询的增量贡献进行排序来选择互补模型子集，在保证全误风险有界的同时最小化推理调用次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风险控制路由策略（如RACER）独立地对每个候选模型进行评分，忽略了模型失败之间的相关性。共享训练数据或架构的模型往往会在同一查询上失败，导致两个独立强的模型可能存在冗余，而一个较弱但互补的模型可能覆盖它们遗漏的查询。

Method: CopRoute包含三个核心组件：(1) 贪心计数排序（Greedy Tally Ordering）：在设计集上按"每个模型能正确回答多少之前遗漏的查询"依次选择模型，等价于最小集合覆盖问题（Theorem 1给出因子4近似保证且此因子在P≠NP下不可改进）；(2) 两种停止规则：独立性残差 r^ind 和依赖性残差 r^dep（用设计集依赖比率 d_k 修正）；(3) 分割保形校准：选择满足 (n/(n+1))R̂_n(λ)+1/(n+1)≤α 的最小截止值（Theorem 2保证分布自由的误风险控制）。该框架作为一族"即插即用"策略，支持不同的排序估计器和停止规则。

Result: 在RouterBench和RouterEval的10个数据集上（模型池规模11–500），CopRoute在α=0.05时10个数据集中9个上达到最少调用，在α=0.10时8个上达到最少。相比SOTA风险控制策略RACER-G，调用次数最多减少79%（中位数24%）；端到端推理成本降低46.6%且最终答案精度不降低；路由器更换时调用次数变化最小（≤0.6次）。主要性能增益来自共失败排序而非停止规则修正（设计边际排序替代可使调用增加多达27次）。

Conclusion: CopRoute通过将依赖性感知引入到路由层次结构化中，弥合了"认证风险但忽略依赖性"与"利用依赖性但无认证保证"的方法之间的差距。计数排序具有理论最优近似保证，校准步骤提供分布自由的有限样本风险保证。在保持认证全误风险的同时显著减少调用次数和推理成本，且对路由器选择具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Set-based language model routing aims to increase the coverage of the event where at least one model answers a query correctly while controlling the number of inference calls made. Existing risk-controlled routing policies bound the all-miss risk (the probability that every model in the selected set fails) by calibrating a single conformal threshold and applying it to a nested family of model sets. Because each model is scored in isolation, these policies ignore the dependence structure of model failures. Models that share training data or architecture tend to fail on the same queries, so two individually strong models can be jointly redundant while a weaker but complementary model covers the queries that the others miss. To account for this dependence, which existing risk-controlled policies ignore, we propose CopRoute, which orders models by how many new queries each one answers correctly beyond those already selected, decides per query how far down that order to go, and then picks the smallest cutoff that still meets the target risk. We show that CopRoute's ordering attains, on the design data, the best guarantee any efficient fixed-ordering algorithm can give for the average number of calls to the first correct model, and that a separate calibration step certifies the all-miss risk of the deployed sets. On RouterBench and RouterEval, CopRoute attains the fewest certified calls on nine of ten datasets at a target risk of 0.05 and on eight of ten at 0.10, making up to 79 percent fewer calls (median 24 percent) than the state-of-the-art risk-controlled policy at the same certified all-miss risk.

</details>


### [203] [MHR-Router: Multimodal Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing for VLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13278)
*Wenjuan Zhu,Zheming Yang,Yunqing Hu,Qi Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MHR-Router提出了一种多模态异构检索增强的自适应路由框架，用于在推理前为每个图像-问题查询分派最合适的VLM专家，通过融合冻结的多模态特征表示与专家特定的成功/失败记忆库检索证据，实现了优于固定单一专家和检索无关基线的路由精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM路由方法依赖文本线索或静态全局模型profile，无法捕捉细粒度视觉证据和专家特有的失败模式，导致在异构多模态输入下难以准确选择最优专家。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 多模态路由表示——使用冻结的SigLIP/CLIP融合图像与文本的ℓ₂归一化特征构建查询表示z_i；(2) 异构检索增强自适应路由——为每个专家构建成功记忆P_m和失败记忆N_m，通过余弦top-k检索提取均值/最大相似度及对比差异等6维检索统计量r_{i,m}，经one-hot专家身份嵌入后由共享MLP打分器g_θ评分，采用listwise+pairwise组合损失训练。

Result: 在6,400查询×8种视觉能力×8个开源VLM的基准上，路由准确率达71.58±0.02%，超越开发集最优单一专家7.36%，超越匹配的无检索多模态路由基线1.22%；细粒度识别提升21.60pp，缺陷异常检测提升8.54pp。

Conclusion: MHR-Router通过结合冻结多模态表示与专家特定的检索增强证据，实现了无需能力或源任务标签的查询级自适应专家选择，证明了局部检索证据比静态全局profile更能反映专家的细粒度能力。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit complementary capabilities, yet selecting the most suitable expert for a given image-question query remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal inputs and varying expert strengths. Existing routing approaches rely on text-based cues or static model profiles, failing to capture fine-grained visual evidence and expert-specific failure patterns. To address this, we propose MHR-Router, a multimodal heterogeneous retrieval-enhanced adaptive routing framework for VLM inference. It accurately dispatches each multimodal query to the most suitable VLM expert via local retrieval evidence. MHR-Router consists of two stages: (1) Multimodal Routing Representation, which fuses frozen multimodal features into a comprehensive query representation; and (2) Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing, which retrieves expert-specific success and failure memories as local evidence and employs a shared scorer to adaptively select the optimal expert. Experiments show that MHR-Router effectively achieves heterogeneous modality routing and consistently improves accuracy over traditional baselines.

</details>


### [204] [Recovering Irreducible Three-Body Interactions with Lagrangian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13292)
*Sena Kalabalik,Sukru Caglar,Abdullah Umut Hamzaogullari,Arkadas Ozakin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）结合领域特定结构与信号感知采样策略，仅从轨迹数据（加速度）即可恢复不可分解的三体相互作用——Axilrod–Teller三偶极相互作用，并在LJ+AT复合系统中界定了该三体项可被动力学辨识的耦合阈值。进一步通过符号回归从训练后的网络中提取出与解析AT势结构一致的闭式表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LNN研究仅涉及可加的两体相互作用，未证明其能否从运动数据中恢复不可表示为两两叠加的不可约多体相互作用。本文以物理上典型的Axilrod–Teller三体项为探针，验证LNN学习真正多体结构的能力，并探讨真实稀有气体耦合下三体修正的可辨识性。

Method: 采用固定动能项（精确已知）＋神经网络学习势能的部分参数化拉格朗日结构；输入采用对称适配的特征（两两距离＋内角余弦）；设计"密集/稀疏"对数均匀混合采样以保证强相互作用区有足够数据；网络通过加速度匹配训练（MAE损失）；用PySR对学习到的势做无先验形式的符号回归提取闭式定律。

Result: 对孤立AT系统，势能面与加速度场均与解析值高度一致（势L1≈1.3%，加速度≈1.1%）；径向r⁻⁹标度与角向Φ因子的符号反转均被复现，轨迹滚动中心位置中位误差1.9%，能量相对漂移中位11.5%。在LJ+AT复合系统中：放大耦合ν̃=1.0下三体项可被恢复（残差2.5×低于两体模型），而氩类物理耦合ν̃≈0.1下三体信号低于两体误差底噪，无法辨识，标定了可辨识性边界。符号回归恢复出V≈ν·(1+3cosθ₁cosθ₂cosθ₃)/(r₁₂r₂₃r₃₁)³，耦合常数ν≈1.0，含角因子与径向律完全正确。

Conclusion: 结合领域结构与物理感知采样的LNN能够从轨迹中恢复不可约三体相互作用为闭式物理定律。已知结构（动能）可被编码而不必重新学习，符号回归将神经网络表示转化为可解释的解析形式。该框架为结构未知的相互作用定律的发现提供了一条可行路径，但其适用性受限于位势仅依赖位置、常质量矩阵等假设。

Abstract: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn mechanical systems from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving the dynamics through the Euler-Lagrange equations, biasing the model toward motion that respects the variational structure of mechanics. The interactions studied so far have been pairwise-additive, leaving open whether LNNs can recover an irreducible many-body interaction from motion alone. We address this using the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole interaction, the leading three-body dispersion term, whose dependence on the collective geometry of three particles cannot be represented by any sum of pairwise terms. We prescribe the kinetic energy exactly and learn only the potential, as a function of interparticle distances and angles. Combined with a signal-aware sampling strategy that concentrates training data where the three-body signal is strongest while preserving broad coverage of configuration space, this recovers the interaction from accelerations alone. The learned potential reproduces the radial scaling, angular dependence, and characteristic sign reversal of the Axilrod-Teller interaction, and generates stable trajectories. Embedding it within a pairwise Lennard-Jones potential lets us examine its observability: the three-body term is recovered once its dynamical signature exceeds the residual modeling error, which it does cleanly at amplified coupling but not at the coupling of a real noble gas, bracketing the transition between the two. Finally, symbolic regression on the trained potential, with no assumed functional form, returns the Axilrod-Teller expression with angular numerator, radial law, and coupling constant intact. An LNN with domain-specific structure can thus recover an irreducible three-body interaction from trajectories as a closed-form law, pointing toward learning interaction laws whose structure is not known a priori.

</details>


### [205] [DAG Structure Learning with Node-Varying Heavy-Tailed Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13304)
*Robin Francis,Sundeep Prabhakar Chepuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出节点变化 Student-t DAGMA 方法，将 DAG 结构学习扩展到节点级异质重尾扰动场景，通过高斯尺度混合表示实现迭代重加权最小二乘算法，并联合估计图结构、节点尺度参数和自由度参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DAG 结构学习方法通常假设各节点扰动为同方差高斯分布，但实际场景（如金融网络）中不同节点可能具有不同的扰动幅度和尾部行为。传统 DAGMA 使用平方损失对极端残差惩罚过重，Huber-DAGMA 等方法虽减少极端值作用但未显式建模节点尾部参数，CoLiDE 仅适应尺度但不捕获尾部行为差异，因此需要一种同时建模节点尺度和尾部异质性的连续 DAG 学习框架。

Method: 核心方法包括：（1）将 Student-t 分布表示为高斯尺度混合，推导出 EM 算法框架下的迭代重加权 DAGMA；（2）在 DAGMA 的 log-determinant 无环约束和中心路径优化策略内嵌套广义 EM 迭代：E 步计算潜在精度后验期望得到可靠性权重 a_{mj}，M 步交替更新权重矩阵 W（加权 DAGMA 子问题）、尺度参数 σ_j（公式9）和自由度参数 ν_j（通过求解公式11的标量方程，二分法）；（3）利用 ICA 和 LiNGAM 的可识别性结果，建立 Student-t SEM 模型参数的可识别性理论（Proposition 1）。

Result: 在 d=10 节点、平均节点度 2 的 Erdős–Rényi DAG 合成实验中（节点扰动 ν_j ∈ {3,5,10}, σ_j ∈ {1,6}），所提方法在 SHD、TPR、FDR、F1-score 各项指标上均优于 DAGMA、Huber-DAGMA、CoLiDE-NV 和固定 DoF 变体。在 49 个行业组合的金融数据（2000-2019 日收益）测试中，所提方法获得最低测试 NLL（26.40），优于 DAGMA（32.84）、Huber-DAGMA（31.61）和 CoLiDE-NV（32.17），同时保持稀疏图结构（15 条边）和有竞争力的 NRMSE（0.465）。

Conclusion: 节点变化 Student-t DAGMA 成功扩展了连续 DAG 学习框架以适应节点级重尾扰动异质性，通过联合估计图结构、扰动尺度和自由度参数，在合成和金融数据上均显示出优越的结构恢复和预测能力。可作为异质扰动场景下 DAG 学习的有效工具。

Abstract: DAG structures can be learned from observations by incorporating acyclicity via smooth constraints, such as DAGMA's log-determinant function. Typically, observations and the underlying DAG are related through linear structural equation models, with Gaussianity assumption on the disturbances at each node. Extending DAG learning methods that account for scale and tail behavior of disturbances that vary across nodes remains a challenge. We propose a node-varying Student-$t$ DAGMA that jointly estimates the graph structure, node-specific disturbance scales, and the degrees-of-freedom parameter. A Gaussian scale-mixture representation yields an iteratively reweighted formulation that down-weights large standardized residuals. Building on existing results, we also establish identifiability of the graph and disturbance parameters. Synthetic experiments demonstrate improved structural recovery under heterogeneous heavy-tailed disturbances, and experiments on real finance data show that the proposed method yields lower test negative log-likelihood than the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [206] [MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13305)
*Jixin Tang,Ji Guo,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MORAD框架，首次将在线强化学习应用于RNA反向设计，通过共享策略和多目标奖励机制，在RIDE预训练模型基础上显著提升了RNA三级结构、二级结构配对及热力学性能，刷新了多个基准指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RNA反向设计的强化学习方法要么为每个目标骨架单独优化策略（无法复用），要么依赖离线偏好优化，缺乏对可复用骨架条件模型的在线后训练探索；且现有奖励信号主要关注三级结构，忽视了二级结构配对、集合行为和序列组成等多维设计目标。

Method: MORAD将BERT式骨架条件扩散采样、分组相对奖励归一化（Group-relative normalization）和前向过程扩散目标（DiffusionNFT）三者整合到统一的共享策略在线后训练框架中。奖励由六个测量项通过有界适宜性映射（clipped raised-cosine desirability mapping）和加权几何平均（weighted geometric mean）聚合而成，覆盖三级几何（GDT-TS、TM-score、RMSD）、碱基配对（MCC）、集合行为（NED）和序列组成六个方面。策略更新使用正负两支分支的目标函数，并加入参考正则化项。

Result: 在153个评估目标上，基于RIDE后训练后，GDT-TS从0.3300提升至0.3827（+16.0%），配对MCC从0.6110提升至0.7295（+19.4%），归一化集合缺陷（NED）从0.3906降至0.2830（-27.5%）。MORAD在16个有偏好方向的评估指标中的14个上达到最佳，全面超越RiboDiffusion、gRNAde和RDesign，成为结构条件RNA反向设计的新SOTA。多目标奖励（相比仅三级结构奖励）在11个有优先方向的指标中改善了10个。

Conclusion: MORAD建立了RNA设计的共享策略在线后训练工作流，整合了目标相对反馈、六维奖励和前向过程扩散优化。该框架通过模块化接口兼容更大的骨架条件模型，使用了质量-多样性的权衡。局限性在于实验仅在单一10.2M参数的RIDE骨干上进行，奖励计算和结构评估依赖RhoFold+预测器，且缺乏实验性结构验证。

Abstract: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones. Structure-conditioned RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences compatible with a target three-dimensional backbone, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches either optimize a separate policy for each target backbone or rely on offline preference optimization, leaving online post-training of a reusable backbone-conditioned model largely unexplored. MORAD combines backbone-conditioned group sampling, group-relative reward normalization, and a forward-process diffusion objective. Beyond existing RL rewards that primarily target tertiary structural quality, MORAD jointly optimizes six measurements spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition. To aggregate these heterogeneous objectives despite differences in scale and optimization direction, MORAD maps each measurement to a bounded desirability score and combines them with a weighted geometric mean. Compared with a tertiary-structure-only reward, this multi-objective formulation improves 10 of the 11 evaluation metrics that have a preferred direction. Applied to pretrained RIDE, MORAD improves GDT-TS by 16.0% (from 0.3300 to 0.3827) and pairing MCC by 19.4% (from 0.6110 to 0.7295), while reducing normalized ensemble defect by 27.5% (from 0.3906 to 0.2830). On the test set, MORAD outperforms RiboDiffusion, gRNAde, and RDesign across tertiary structural accuracy, secondary-structure pairing, and thermodynamic quality, establishing a new state of the art in structure-conditioned RNA inverse design.

</details>


### [207] [Structure-Aware Numerical Stabilization for Half-Precision Proximal Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13306)
*Linxuan Wu,Liang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PPO-FP16 提出了一种面向结构感知的三模块数值稳定化方案，使 PPO 在消费级 GPU 上以原生 FP16 精度稳定、高效训练，无需重新调参，并在六项连续控制任务中取得了最佳平均 Return-AUC 排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限平台上的在线训练需要降低计算和存储开销，但直接将 PPO 转为 FP16 会因数值误差通过策略更新和数据采集回路反馈而失稳；同时 PPO 反复比较当前策略与固定行为策略，对小概率比值极度敏感。需要一种算法感知的 FP16 PPO 训练方案。

Method: 设计 PPO-FP16，包含三个结构感知模块：模块 A 全局标量保护（FP32 归约优势统计和梯度 L2 范数，采用缩放范数防止溢出）；模块 B 策略变化残差保护（通过高斯参数残差直接构造 log-ratio，结合 expm1、对偶补偿求和、采样参考修正和在 log 域内做裁剪判定）；模块 C 高效持续更新保护（提出 SHARP 结构化 FP16 Adam，以根二阶矩形式存储并按参数组共享，配合 log-std 的小更新补偿）。

Result: 在六个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务、五个随机种子上，PPO-FP16 的平均 Return-AUC rank 为 1.90，30 组环境–种子对比中 17 组第一；八个性能配置实现 1.16–2.03 倍 PPO 更新加速；优化器状态内存相比 Full FP32 Adam 减少 71.7–74.9%，峰值 GPU 显存最多降低 44.5%。消融实验验证三个模块互补；BF16 与缩尾精度边界实验揭示了指数位扩展无法替代尾数精度。

Conclusion: 保护结构上关键的少量数量即可实现稳定高效的 FP16 PPO 训练，无需重新调参。该方法在消费级 GPU 上验证了 FP16 PPO 的数值可行性与计算优势，但部署到嵌入式加速器、更大模型以及更通用的低精度方法仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Local online training on resource-constrained platforms requires low computational and training-state overhead. We study the numerical stability and computational efficiency of half-precision proximal policy optimization (PPO) on commodity GPUs. Directly converting PPO training to FP16 is unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and subsequent data collection, while PPO repeatedly compares a current policy with a fixed behavior policy. We propose PPO-FP16 with three structure-aware modules. Global scalar protection stabilizes statistics shared across a minibatch or parameter update. Policy-change residual protection extracts and preserves small differences between the current and behavior policies. Efficient persistent-update protection stabilizes optimizer state and parameter writeback while reducing state storage. These changes preserve the PPO objective, hyperparameters, and training budget. Across six continuous-control tasks and five seeds, PPO-FP16 achieves the lowest mean return-AUC rank (1.90) among the four methods and ranks first in 17 of 30 environment-seed comparisons. Eight of nine performance configurations yield PPO update speedups ranging from 1.16 to 2.03 times. Relative to Full FP32 Adam, optimizer-state memory is reduced by 71.7 to 74.9 percent, and peak allocated GPU memory is reduced by up to 44.5 percent. The results show that protecting a small set of structurally important quantities can deliver stable, efficient FP16 PPO without retuning.

</details>


### [208] [SBNO : Schrödinger Bridge Neural Operator for the Forward and Inverse Problems under Missing Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13317)
*Jaehyeon Park,Inhyeok Jeong,Noseong Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SBNO（Schrödinger Bridge Neural Operator）是一个用于在缺失/部分观测条件下求解PDE前向与反问题的统一框架。它基于固定端点耦合的扩散Schrödinger桥匹配，通过学习一对时间依赖的drift网络实现双向重建，推理时通过概率流ODE进行确定性点重建，无需超参调优。在5个PDE基准上仅用5%观测即可达到优于或与引导扩散基线相当的结果，并具备显著更低的测试误差离散度，同时推理速度提升至少9.7倍、显存降低至少4.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对PDE替代建模中两个普遍存在但常被分别处理的不利条件：一是观测稀疏且部分缺失（传感器/覆盖有限），二是物理方程未知或仅部分已知。现有神经算子（FNO/DeepONet等）在密集观测下表现良好，但稀疏观测下性能显著下降；近期引导扩散方法虽能处理部分观测，但需要推理时引导权重调优且推理开销大。因此亟需一种无方程、统一处理前向/反问题、稀疏观测下高效稳定的PDE算子学习方法。

Method: 1) **状态表征与端点耦合**：将离散场通过提升映射 ℰ_s(x)=[m_s⊙x; m_s] 拼入掩码通道，构造统一共享空间 ℝ^{2D}。对前向任务，端点为 (ℰ_s(a), ℰ_1(u))；对反问题为 (ℰ_1(a), ℰ_s(u))，二者以1:1混合构成固定的经验端点耦合 Π_{0,T}，保留输入-解样本配对。
2) **Schrödinger桥匹配学习**：固定端点耦合 Π_{0,T}，构造参考Q-桥混合路径测度 P̃^Π = Π_{0,T}Q_{|0,T}，并回归学习Markovian投影的对偶drift网络 (v_θ, v_ϕ)，训练损失为对Q-桥条件得分的MSE，无需辅助score网络（高斯参考下可得解析闭式）。
3) **确定性推理**：对学习所得前向/反向drift构造概率流ODE，用RK4（默认32步）积分得到确定性点重建，无需任何推理时观测或PDE引导权重调优，同时支持前向与反问题两个任务。
4) **方程自由 (equation-free)**：训练和推理阶段均不依赖PDE方程或物理约束，仅使用成对输入-解样本。

Result: 在Darcy Flow、Poisson、Helmholtz、非定界Navier-Stokes、Gray-Scott五个基准数据集（128×128网格，5%观测，即819点）的前向与反问题上：SBNO在10个任务中均取得最佳或次佳的平均相对L2误差，显著降低测试实例误差离散度（相对FunDPS平均降44.91%）。对比扩散类基线（DiffusionPDE、FunDPS），推理速度至少快9.7倍、峰值显存至少降低4.3倍（0.28秒/样本 vs 2.71-46.65秒/样本，886 MB vs 3846-5429 MB）。附加实验表明：1) 对推理随机种子不敏感；2) 在高频谱重建上优于扩散基线；3) 掩码通道对性能至关重要；4) 在APEBench的KdV/KS/Kolmogorov流上仍具竞争力；5) 多种噪声水平观测下保持稳健。局限性：仅支持格点表示（离网格点需投影插值）、确定性推理不表示多模态不确定性、对训练时未见的极低观测率鲁棒性下降、统一双任务训练相对单任务专精化存在权衡。

Conclusion: SBNO提出了一种基于固定端点耦合的扩散Schrödinger桥匹配框架，统一解决了稀疏观测、方程未知情况下的PDE前向与反问题，无需推理时调优。掩码感知的提升状态表征+统一的端点耦合混合+概率流ODE推理，使得单对drift网络即可在双向任务中提供具有竞争力的重建精度、低误差离散度以及明显优于引导扩散的高效率，是稀疏观测下可扩展PDE替代建模的有力工具。未来方向包括：支持任意离网格传感器位置的非格点架构、明确的多模态不确定性建模、动态观测率训练以提升跨观测率鲁棒性。

Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) surrogate modeling often relies on either dense observations or access to governing equations/physics constraints. In practice, observations can be sparse and partial, and the underlying physics may be partially specified or unavailable. We introduce SBNO, an equation-free paired-data diffusion bridge matching framework that learns conditional operators for both forward and inverse PDE problems under partial observations. SBNO uses diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching to learn a pair of time-dependent drifts from a mask-aware endpoint coupling that preserves empirical input-solution pairing during training and supports both PDE-task directions within a single framework. At inference time, SBNO produces a deterministic point reconstruction by integrating the probability-flow ODE constructed from the learned drift pair, without inference-time observation or PDE guidance-weight tuning. On five PDE benchmarks with 5% observations, SBNO achieves superior or comparable accuracy to baselines while demonstrating lower test-instance error dispersion. Furthermore, SBNO is at least $9.7 \times$ faster and reduces GPU memory by at least $4.3 \times$ compared to guided-diffusion baselines.

</details>


### [209] [DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13328)
*Mengqi Guo,Zhe Wei,Yuan Yuan,Jiunn Bin Lim,Boyi Pan,Michael Bi Mi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DuoRate，一种用于混合专家（MoE）模型推理服务的双速率精度分配方法。它将MoE专家权重的精度代价区分为存储速率和按路由加权的解码速率两个独立的功能函数，通过"存储一次、按负载读取"的策略，利用前缀可读的权重流（StagQ）实现一个部署工件同时承担预填充和解码两种用途。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，以2.3 bpw的读取速率大幅超越2比特级基线，以2.9 bpw匹配读速率高出1.4–1.6 bpw的4比特格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE逐专家分配器只约束存储速率（所有可路由专家的驻留足迹），但解码时仅访问被选中的专家，产生了"存储-读取差距"。以BitsMoE为例，其存储为2.54 bpw，解码流量却高达7.50 bpw，存在2.95倍差距。仅约束单一速率无法捕捉这一关键不对称性。

Method: DuoRate采用两阶段流水线：(1) 离线阶段存储统一p4层（4.27 bpw）并预计算每个专家每个层级的畸变张量；(2) 在线阶段对工作负载的预填充进行无标签分析，通过一次点积计算每个专家每个层级的畸变表，并以拉格朗日速率-畸变分配在共享乘子λ下选择每专家读层，由二分法满足读取预算。核心理论贡献是证明路由频率从逐专家解码分配决策中消去——频率以正比例同时乘入畸变和读速率，在逐专家argmin中相消，仅通过预算设置影响分配。同时识别出频率仅通过两个通道生存：存储功能下的隐式加权，以及跨校准域合并时的专家特定域混合π_{d|e}。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base上，DuoRate以2.3 bpw读取速率将平均准确率较2比特级基线提升6.3–47.0分；以2.9 bpw匹配读速率高出1.4–1.6 bpw的4比特格式（如NF4、FP4、MXFP4、NVFP4、HIF4）；在GSM8K长解码场景下，2.9 bpw时匹配或超越所有4比特格式，与BF16仅差0.25分。同格式对照实验显示分配本身等价于0.07–0.11 bpw的读速率收益。

Conclusion: DuoRate揭示了MoE权重精度应被形式化为两个独立的速率功能函数（驻留速率与路由加权解码速率），并展示了利用前缀可读权重流将二者解耦的方法。路由频率在解码分配中退化的证明使按工作负载分配成为可能而无需标签。论文倡导MoE检查点效率声明应同时报告存储速率与解码速率，单纯优化存储可能导致解码流量远高于预期。局限性包括仅评估一个MoE模型、效率数字源自存储布局而非实测、预填充运行于读取深度而非存储层。未来工作方向包括前缀读取内核构建及其他路由方案的扩展。

Abstract: Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads per workload. Offline, it stores one uniform tier of a prefix-readable weight stream and bakes a distortion tensor. Online, it profiles a workload's own prefill without labels and solves a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation under the decode functional; routing frequency provably cancels from every per-expert decision, and the solve costs one dot product per expert and a bisection. A deployment therefore keeps a single artifact that prefill reads at the stored rate and decode reads at the workload's own rate. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, DuoRate reading 2.3 bpw exceeds every 2-bit-class baseline by 6.3 to 47.0 points of average accuracy, and at 2.9 bpw it matches 4-bit formats that read 1.4-1.6 bpw more. The advantage is largest under long decoding: on GSM8K, DuoRate at 2.9 bpw matches or exceeds every 4-bit format and trails BF16 by only 0.25 points, and at 2.6 bpw it still matches or exceeds the 4.5-bit NF4 and FP4. Against controls in its own format, the allocation alone is worth 0.07-0.11 bpw of read rate. Code will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [210] [PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13334)
*Jaehyeon Park,Mingu Kang,Dongseok Lee,Woojin Cho,Kookjin Lee,Anthony Gruber,Youngjoon Hong,Noseong Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PDE-PFN是一种基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）架构的PDE求解器，通过Transformer的自注意力和交叉注意力机制，利用PINN生成的近似解作为先验进行预训练，实现了PDE解的上下文学习预测。该方法在2D CDR方程、浅水方程和可压缩Navier-Stokes方程等任务上展现出零梯度更新的推理能力、对噪声先验的鲁棒性以及跨PDE迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的科学基础模型（SFMs）虽然能够跨多种PDE进行泛化，但仍存在对噪声输入鲁棒性不足、输入刚性（要求均匀网格或固定空间位置）等问题。受大语言模型在噪声预训练数据上展现的鲁棒性以及PFN通过上下文学习进行后验预测均值推理的启发，本文旨在开发一种无需任务特定梯度更新、对不完美先验数据具有鲁棒性、支持灵活上下文和查询表示的PDE求解方法。

Method: 1. **理论基础**：建立在贝叶斯后验预测分布（PPD）和后验预测均值（PPM）框架之上，证明在均方误差损失下，群体最优确定性预测器即为条件后验预测均值（Theorem A.2），并证明存在性结果（Theorem A.1）。2. **模型架构**：基于PFN架构进行改进，包含Fourier特征嵌入（FFE）编码器、采用Attentive Graph Filter（AGF）的Transformer块（结合自注意力和交叉注意力）、MLP解码器，并使用有理激活函数。3. **PINN先验生成**：使用物理信息神经网络（PINN）生成近似解作为先验数据，平均L2相对误差为0.02280。4. **目标函数**：使用MSE损失近似PPM，并添加AGF正交性正则化项。5. **集成训练**：通过随机混合时间步对内的数据点来同时支持时空插值和时间外推任务。

Result: 在2D CDR方程家族（含2,187个独特方程）上预训练后，PDE-PFN在多个任务上均优于基线：在时空插值和时间外推任务上，针对已见系数和未见系数（含插值和外推）均取得最佳L1/L2/L∞误差。对浅水方程（SWE）微调后，在时空插值和时间外推任务上均优于DeepONet、FNO、F-FNO、A-FNO、LNO、Poseidon和DPOT等基线。对可压缩Navier-Stokes方程（CNSE）的算子学习任务，PDE-PFN在L2和L∞相对误差上优于所有基线，包括预训练数据中已包含CNSE的DPOT。在Airfoil（不规则网格）和Darcy Flow数据集上也表现优异。在3D Gray-Scott方程上，所有指标均显著优于基线。敏感度分析表明预测误差随上下文点数增加而降低。

Conclusion: PDE-PFN通过PFN式先验拟合实现了PDE解场的无方程上下文预测，展示了类内任务和系数泛化能力、微调后的跨PDE迁移能力、无需符号方程的灵活上下文/查询输入、以及评估的噪声先验设置下的鲁棒性。这些发现支持PFN式先验拟合作为PDE解场预测的一种有前景的方法。未来工作将探索连续系数先验、更广泛的初始/边界条件分布、以及随模型规模、先验规模、多样性、上下文大小和分布距离的系统扩展，并结合物理一致性和概率预测研究。

Abstract: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. PDE-PFN achieves competitive or improved predictive accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines while supporting flexible context and query representations.

</details>


### [211] [AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13335)
*R E Zera Marveen Lyngkhoi,Abhivansh Gupta,Vidushee Vats,Ram Mohan Rao Kadiyala,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AgentTune是一个源可用Python库，提供统一的轨迹接口（EventLog），将智能体构建、训练、评估、蒸馏和恢复整合到单一生命周期中，核心是两层级EventLog表示法及围绕其构建的工具调用强化学习、智能体RAG、决策工作流和自愈修复模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具链在智能体开发生命周期的各个阶段（RL训练rollout、决策工作流状态、评估轨迹）采用不同的表征，使得评分、损失掩码、失败检测和审计逻辑需要反复重建。这种接口碎片化阻碍了工具使用LLM智能体的端到端优化与维护。

Method: 核心方法论围绕两层EventLog架构——light层（观测性）和full层（带token跨度与logprobs）展开。该模式提供6种投影在RL rollout、DECIDE状态、评估字典与SFT行/审计记录之间转换。基于该统一接口构建五大组件：(1)智能体运行时（含ReAct/Reflexion/PlanExecute/MemoryReAct/TreeOfThoughts五种策略与三种记忆后端）；(2)基于TRL的共享RL核心，通过create_agentic_trainer工厂统一GRPO/PPO/DPO/RLOO/BCO五种算法并集成多轮工具调用rollout；(3)智能体蒸馏——筛选教师轨迹后做分段感知、仅完成部分的SFT；(4)六阶段RAG合成管道（基于GRADE/RAGAS/MHTS原语）；(5)DECIDE决策工作流（YAML→LangGraph）与自愈闭环（FailureDetector→Classifier→TrainingExampleGenerator→RetrainingTrigger→DeploymentGate）。损失掩码作为架构层面策略集成于EventLog中：工具调用双倍重要性、工具结果与观测掩码为权重0。

Result: 实证结果包括三项GPU冒烟测试（单卡RTX PRO 6000）：SmolLM2-360M的SFT蒸馏损失3.60→0.25、GRPO平均奖励0.03→0.66、自愈DPO奖励准确率0.50→1.00；DECIDE闭环在bfsi/kyc_triage模板上6次loop_collapse失败后DPO重训练使准确率从0.33升至1.00并部署LoRA适配器。最强任务级证据为法律合同搜索：Qwen3.5-9B + GRPO + LoRA在CUAD多跳问答上将精确匹配率从60.0%提升至69.0%，同时每题搜索次数从3.00降至2.90；冻结策略在三个未见LegalBench-RAG语料库（ContractNLI、MAUD、PrivacyQA）的Doc@8均改善、搜索次数均下降。智能体蒸馏消融实验显示分段掩码轨迹训练在CUAD达到45.8 Pass@1（较非掩码+4.8、较QA+推理+9.3），在LexGLUE ECTHR达到55.4 Pass@1。

Conclusion: AgentTune证明单一轨迹架构能够跨越智能体开发的五个阶段，避免最多15个成对格式转换器。其与TRL/verl/LangGraph是互补关系而非竞争——前者解决"如何让一条轨迹在五个阶段中保持可用"，后者解决优化器吞吐量与编排语义。局限性在于：继承TRL单节点扩展限制、CLI缺少工具调用训练接口、核心SFT路径未端到端连通、缺乏外部智能体基准校准（τ-bench、ToolBench、AgentBench、WebArena均未接入）、LSAL许可证非OSI开源。

Abstract: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines. We demonstrate the framework across agentic tasks including legal contract search and domain-specific applications, illustrating its use for trajectory-based optimization, tool-use evaluation, and cross-task agent development. AgentTune is released as a source-available library at this https URL

</details>


### [212] [Understanding Mamba-3 Through Oscillatory Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13341)
*Shutian Liang,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Mamba-3中输入依赖的旋转变换解释为欠阻尼二阶动力学系统，揭示振荡机制在循环状态计算中对状态追踪和长上下文语言建模的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba-3引入了输入依赖的旋转来更新循环状态，但旋转对状态保留之外的具体计算贡献尚不清晰。本文旨在通过动力学视角回答振荡机制在序列建模中扮演什么角色这一问题。

Method: 将Mamba-3的衰减-旋转转移重新参数化为二阶系统，引入参数κ_t统一描述欠阻尼、临界阻尼和过阻尼三种阻尼状态；通过控制对比实验、预训练实验（187M/444M在100B tokens FineWeb-Edu上训练）以及对预训练1.5B模型进行相位干预（移除、反转、置乱）来分析振荡的作用。

Result: 1) 在状态追踪任务中，欠阻尼动力学显著优于过阻尼和临界阻尼（Parity 100% vs 3.22-3.27%）；2) 振荡模型在两个规模上均实现更好的长度泛化（PG-19 perplexity在超过2K训练上下文后更低），444M规模下LongBench-E平均分从10.61提升至13.22；3) 相位干预（特别是相位反转在64K处使perplexity恶化74倍）证明学习相位对长上下文预测至关重要；4) 移除相位会增大保留历史与新输入的余弦相似度和状态范数，表明旋转调节了建设性累积。

Conclusion: 欠阻尼二阶动力学为理解Mamba-3提供了有价值的框架：衰减控制信息保留量，而相位控制已保留信息如何与新输入组合并在时间上被访问。振荡是循环架构的一个有用设计维度，可扩展到线性注意力和其他循环模型。

Abstract: Mamba-3 introduces input-dependent rotations into recurrent state updates, but their contribution beyond state retention remains unclear. We interpret these ro- tations as underdamped second-order dynamics, providing a framework for in- vestigating the role of oscillation in sequence modeling. Controlled comparisons show that underdamped dynamics outperform non-oscillatory damping regimes on state-tracking tasks, while language-model pretraining demonstrates benefits for long-context prediction and length generalization. Interventions in pretrained models further establish the importance of learned phase, and state analysis sug- gests that rotation regulates how retained information combines with incoming up- dates. Taken together, these findings identify underdamped dynamics as a useful mechanism for recurrent computation and suggest that oscillation supports long- context processing by regulating how information accumulates.

</details>


### [213] [Hidden Data Challenges in Clinical Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13350)
*Carolin Cissée,Dennis Fast,Raneen Younis,Alexander Löser,Wolfgang Nejdl,Zahra Ahmadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以MIMIC-IV为案例，系统识别并量化了电子健康记录(EHR)机器学习预处理流程中三类对齐违规问题（时间、语义和群体对齐），表现为时间泄露、特征-任务失对齐和有偏插补。研究发现这些预处理选择可能在聚合性能指标上表现不明显，但会显著改变模型依赖的信号。作者通过实证案例研究验证了这些影响，并提出了实用的预处理建议清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广泛复用的EHR预处理管道隐含关于信息可用时间、临床事件标签定义和缺失值含义的假设，但这些假设很少被系统审计，导致错误在整个研究文献中传播。MIMIC数据集的多模态复杂性使其预处理特别容易出现细微错误。

Method: 本文提出三类互补的对齐框架：(1)时间对齐（事件发生vs信息可用）、(2)语义对齐（特征证据vs终点声明）、(3)群体对齐（观察亚群vs目标群体）。基于MIMIC-IV 3.1，通过分析图表、时间戳语义、事件边界、模块覆盖范围和缺失值模式来量化对齐违规。在MIMIC-IV上对院内死亡率和25种表型预测任务进行了实证研究，比较不同时间戳选择（charttime vs storetime）、插补策略（统计vs临床静态值）和缺失值指示符的影响。

Result: 研究表明聚合性能指标（AUROC差异<0.5%、AUPRC差异约2.22%）几乎无法检测预处理错误，但SHAP特征重要性分析揭示了模型依赖信号的实质性变化。统计插补下storetime模型对身体高度的依赖显著增加，但这种依赖实际上与身高文档状态相关而非身高本身。多模态表型预测显示，尽管图像特征占平均SHAP值的40.9-74.8%，但其加入对性能的提升有限甚至为负，表明高聚合特征重要性不等于临床有意义的模态贡献。

Conclusion: 提出了六项核心建议：(1)优先考虑透明度；(2)确保时间有效性；(3)确保终点和特征-任务有效性；(4)应用上下文感知插补；(5)避免无根据的插补或排除；(6)验证多模态贡献。提供了详细的预处理管道检查清单，覆盖研究设计、群体构建、时间对齐、工作流特定表示、出院笔记处理、数据分区、缺失值处理和验证评估。这些预处理失效模式很可能影响MIMIC之外的EHR数据集。

Abstract: Widely reused preprocessing pipelines for electronic health records can encode assumptions about when information became available, what clinical episode a label represents, and what missingness means. These assumptions are rarely audited systematically and may propagate across subsequent studies when preprocessing pipelines are reused or adapted. Using MIMIC-IV as a case study, we identify and quantify violations of three complementary forms of preprocessing alignment, i.e., temporal, semantic, and population alignment, which manifest as temporal leakage, feature-task misalignment, and biased imputation. We show how ambiguities in timestamp semantics, episode definitions, endpoint construction, modality selection, and missingness handling can alter the information available to a model and affect the interpretation of its predictions. Through analyses of MIMIC-IV data and empirical case studies, we demonstrate that such choices may remain largely invisible in aggregate predictive performance while changing the signals on which models rely. We derive practical recommendations for temporally valid, clinically aligned, and reproducible preprocessing of MIMIC-IV and related electronic health record datasets. The code for our experiments, including our proposed preprocessing, is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [214] [Opening the Black Box of Classifier-Free Guidance via Information Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13369)
*Jiayang Gao,Tianyi Zheng,Jiayang Zou,Fengxiang Yang,Luyao Fan,Lv Tang,Bo Li,Jia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）理论视角分析了Classifier-Free Guidance（CFG）在扩散模型中的作用时机问题。作者推导出了Fisher信息平衡条件，证明了条件信息的有效性在生成过程中并非均匀，而是在某个关键阶段之后才显著增强。基于此，提出了一种无需训练的动态CFG激活策略，通过监测得分函数统计量来自适应地决定何时启用CFG，并在多种架构上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CFG方法大多在整个推理过程中采用固定的激活策略，或依赖手工设计的动态调度策略，但缺乏理论指导来回答"条件信息何时最有用"这一基本问题。理解条件信息在生成轨迹中何时变得最具影响力，对于设计更有效的引导策略至关重要。

Method: 1. 将扩散轨迹建模为时变信息瓶颈问题，建立条件引用与数据条件之间的互信息演化方程；2. 推导出OU扩散过程和流模型的Fisher信息平衡最优条件；3. 提出超参数重缩放策略以改善求解的数值稳定性；4. 基于条件与无条件得分范数差异构建随机过程，通过阈值跨越规则在线确定CFG激活时间；5. 该方法在批次级统计量集中时可退化为固定区间引导。

Result: 在ImageNet类条件生成（DiT-XL/2、SiT-XL/2）和文本到图像任务（SD3、FLUX.1）上取得了持续的改进，FID从2.71降至2.06（DiT-XL/2），从1.80降至1.41（SiT-XL/2）；FLUX.1 1024分辨率下HPSv2.1从20.13提升至30.73。多种子稳定性验证显示FID标准差仅0.06，激活时间τ近似服从Weibull分布，均值约0.68，验证了与固定区间引导的理论联系。

Conclusion: 本文从信息瓶颈理论出发，首次为CFG的激活时机提供了理论解释。Fisher信息平衡条件揭示了条件信息在生成过程中存在一个临界阶段。提出的训练免费动态CFG策略在多种架构和任务上一致提升了生成质量，同时为间隔引导等现有方法提供了统一的理论解释。未来工作需要将理论框架扩展到确定性流耦合（如n≥2的整流流），并开发更稳健的单样本激活准则。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard technique for improving conditional generation in diffusion models, yet its activation schedule is usually selected heuristically. In practice, most existing CFG-based methods rely on a pre-defined activation policy throughout inference, while recent dynamic variants often depend on hand-designed schedules without a principled theoretical explanation of when conditional information is most useful. In order to understand how the informational relevance between conditioning inputs and the score function evolves over the course of generation, we explore when guidance should be activated from an information-theoretic perspective. In this work, we formulate the diffusion trajectory as a time-dependent information bottleneck and show that the effectiveness of conditional information is not uniform throughout sampling, but becomes significantly stronger after a critical stage characterized by a Fisher-information balance condition. Motivated by this insight, we propose a training-free dynamic CFG strategy for inference. Rather than prescribing a fixed schedule in advance, our method constructs a stochastic process from conditional and unconditional score statistics and activates guidance when the estimated guidance gain crosses a prescribed threshold. This yields an adaptive activation rule that aligns condition injection with the underlying generation dynamics, while also recovering interval-based guidance as a limiting special case. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks, demonstrate that our method is effective, robust, and broadly applicable. Beyond empirical improvements, our framework provides an interpretation of dynamic guidance methods and a principled foundation for inference-time control in conditional diffusion models.

</details>


### [215] [BLOKS: Scaling Kernel Solvers with Sketched Block Preconditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13382)
*Giordano Vitale,Giacomo Meanti,Marco Rando,Blanca Ayuso de Dios,Lorenzo Rosasco*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BLOKS，一种基于共轭梯度法的 Nyström 草图核岭回归求解器，通过结合块 Jacobi 近似与草图技术设计新颖的预条件子，使内存开销独立于数据集规模 n 和模型规模 m，从而支持大规模模型训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核岭回归（KRR）在处理大规模数据时面临 O(n³) 时间与 O(n²) 内存的瓶颈；现有近似求解器依赖迭代方法、草图/分批和预条件子，但预条件子通常带来 O(m²) 的内存开销，迫使 m 取值较小，限制了模型的表达能力和精度。需要一种既能扩展到大规模参数又能保持快速收敛的求解方法。

Method: BLOKS 采用 Nyström 草图将 KRR 降至 m 维问题，使用预条件共轭梯度法（PCG）求解；核心是设计了一种草图块 Jacobi 预条件子 M = diag(H̃₁⁻¹, …, H̃_q⁻¹)，将 m 个 Nyström 中心划分为 q = m/m₀ 个大小为 m₀ 的不相交块；每个块通过双重就地 Cholesky 分解高效求解；选用左预条件 PCG 以避免双侧预条件带来的重复计算开销；提供 GPU 加速实现。

Result: 在 Taxi、Higgs、Airlines、CIFAR10-5M、COMET MC 等大规模数据集以及 MillionSongs、Benzene、MiniBooNE、FashionMNIST、SVHN 等中等规模数据集上的实验表明：BLOKS 在内存预算固定的情况下可扩展至 3.2M 参数，训练时间线性增长，精度随参数量持续提升；在所有大规模数据集上达到或超过现有最优核方法的精度，同时保持与 Falkon 等方法有竞争力的训练时间；Falkon 在 m ≈ 10⁵ 时即内存溢出，而 BLOKS 不受此限制。

Conclusion: BLOKS 通过草图块 Jacobi 预条件子成功解耦了模型规模与内存需求，在保留 PCG 快速、无需调步长收敛优势的同时，将核方法扩展到大规模参数；为核方法在大数据上的应用提供了新的解决方案；未来可拓展至其他损失函数（如逻辑损失）、不同分块策略以及引入粗校正捕捉块间相互作用。

Abstract: Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) is a theoretically sound algorithm for nonparametric learning, which is also often used to investigate properties of deep learning. However, the exact KRR formulation incurs time and memory costs preventing applicability to large datasets, motivating the development of approximate solvers. These algorithms rely on (i) iterative methods, to avoid the computational burden of direct solutions; (ii) sketching or batching, to reduce the problem size; and (iii) preconditioning, to accelerate convergence. While crucial for fast convergence, preconditioning incurs memory costs that can be managed by lowering the number of free parameters of the model, potentially at the expense of expressivity and hence accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose BLOKS, a Conjugate Gradient-based solver for Nyström-sketched KRR built around a novel preconditioner that combines a block Jacobi approximation with sketching. The BLOKS preconditioner has memory cost independent of both the dataset size and the number of parameters, allowing scaling to large models. We provide a memory-efficient, GPU-accelerated implementation and show that BLOKS achieves excellent accuracy while retaining favorable time/memory complexity. Indeed, on standard large-scale datasets used to benchmark kernel solvers, BLOKS achieves comparable or better performances than state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [216] [PlacePulse: Learning Transferable Place Representations from Structural Geographic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13390)
*Lucía García-Duarte,Miguel Álvarez,Diego Vicente,Javier Pérez Trufero,Javier de la Torre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PlacePulse，一种基于结构性地理数据（H3分辨率7号分区域上的572个属性特征，通过邻域聚合扩展为2288维输入）的地理空间基础模型，生成美国范围内约106万个单元的256维单位球嵌入，并提出一个可复用的双轴基准来评估表示质量。在74个外部下游任务中，该模型在结构相关领域（健康、经济、选举、社会脆弱性）上与Google的人口动态基础模型（PDFM）相比具有竞争力或更优，确立了结构组成作为地理空间基础模型的独立互补模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的地理空间基础模型主要依赖动态行为信号（移动性、搜索活动）或视觉信号（卫星图像），但很少有模型能将地点的静态结构组成（人口、商业、环境风险等）编码为细空间分辨率下的可迁移嵌入。本文试图验证结构性数据能否作为一种独立的模态来支持可迁移的地理表示学习。

Method: 使用掩码自编码式（masked autoencoder）自监督学习方法，通过密集全连接架构（对称编码器-解码器，[1024,512,384]→256→[384,512,1024]）将2288维标准化特征（572个自有特征+1716个H3环形邻域聚合特征：k=1和k=2环均值以及k=1环标准差）压缩为256维L2归一化嵌入。训练目标采用30%掩码率重构损失，并对自有特征权重×2.0、环形特征权重×0.571颗粒/环形贡献平衡至约50:50。评估协议包括内在评估（重构保真度、嵌入空间健康与维度、空间结构）和外在评估（74个来自12个外部源的跨域下游回归任务，使用LightGBM和州分块5折交叉验证）。

Result: 内在评估：2288维输入的平均重构R²=0.853（所有特征R²>0），251/256个维度近似去相关，PCA参与率从6.6提升至12.6，主成分上Moran's I=0.93，空间自相关超越输入环形半径持续存在，55.6%的单元处于统计显著的局部簇中。外在评估：在原生H3分辨率下，PlacePulse在POI（R²=0.772 vs 0.724）和人口活动（R²=0.801 vs 0.788）上优于维度匹配的特征选择基线，但健康目标略逊。在ZCTA分辨率下，PlacePulse在公共健康（R²=0.610 vs 0.573）、经济状况（R²=0.633 vs 0.605）上优于PDFM，但在POI（R²=0.784 vs 0.906）、自然地理（R²=0.628 vs 0.744）和创业（R²=0.765 vs 0.822）上落后。在非原生分辨率（选区/人口普查区）下，PlacePulse在所有三个类别上均优于PDFM：选举（0.737 vs 0.709）、经济流动性（0.546 vs 0.508）、社会脆弱性（0.435 vs 0.302）。

Conclusion: PlacePulse证明结构性属性可以独立支持可迁移的地理空间基础模型，与依赖动态信号或视觉信号的模型相比是互补的模态。紧凑的256维嵌入可作为多种空间尺度下通用特征使用，提高了空间复用效率并消除了下游任务中重复的特征工程瓶颈。结构性和动态性表示在不同的下游领域展现出互补优势：前者擅长社会经济、人口学和制度结构相关的成果，后者擅长土地使用、POI强度和直接可观察的地理特征。未来工作应探索多模态融合、输入系列归因、时间扩展、跨国家可迁移性以及更均匀的嵌入几何。

Abstract: Geospatial machine learning often depends on task-specific feature engineering over large collections of sociodemographic, business, and environmental variables. Geospatial foundation models offer reusable representations of place, but leading approaches typically encode dynamic signals, such as mobility and search activity, or visual signals from satellite imagery. Few models represent the static structural composition of places (who lives and works there, which businesses operate there, and which risks they face) as transferable embeddings at fine spatial resolution. We introduce PlacePulse, a structural geospatial foundation model that compresses 572 attributes, expanded to 2,288 inputs through H3 neighborhood aggregates, into 256-dimensional unit-norm embeddings for 1,055,537 H3 resolution-7 cells in the United States. We also introduce a reusable two-axis benchmark that separates intrinsic representation quality from downstream predictive utility across multiple targets and spatial supports. Intrinsically, the embeddings reconstruct standardized inputs with mean $R^2 = 0.853$, use 251 of 256 approximately decorrelated dimensions, and show strong spatial organization, with Moran's $I = 0.93$ on the leading principal component and autocorrelation persisting beyond the input radius. Extrinsically, across 74 held-out targets from 12 external sources and four spatial supports, PlacePulse outperforms a dimensionality-matched feature-selection baseline on targets unrelated to the training inputs and is competitive with Google's Population Dynamics Foundation Model, leading on health, economic, election, economic-mobility and social-vulnerability outcomes, with relative strengths that vary by domain. These findings position structural composition as a distinct and complementary modality for geospatial foundation models, not simply a fallback where behavioral or imagery data are unavailable.

</details>


### [217] [Why Linear Models Can Still Work in a Complex and Changing World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13404)
*Fangzhou Lin,Dengzhe Hou,Yinxing Li,Kazunori D Yamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解释了为何在机制高度非线性的复杂领域中，线性模型反而可能比灵活模型在新环境（分布外）中表现更好。其核心论点是：世界的复杂性可能超出有限、部分观测数据所能可靠学习的能力。灵活模型容易学到依赖特定环境（医院、时期、人群、设备等）的非线性曲率、阈值与交互项，而当环境发生变化时，这些规则可能失效。线性模型虽表达能力受限，但若不稳定部分主要落在非线性成分中，则限制反而能提供保护。论文综合了简单线性规则、偏差-方差与正则化、最优线性预测、测量误差、分布偏移、不变性、Rashomon 集合与 underspecification 等文献，并通过命题 1 给出一个平方误差下的简洁数学论证：当源环境中学到的非线性规则在目标环境中的方向重叠度 $A_{s,t} < 1/2$ 时，线性模型在目标环境中的均方误差更小。有限样本下的估计误差可进一步扩大线性模型的优势区间。论文还指出该论点的边界：非线性规则若跨环境稳定应予以保留；线性伪相关同样可危害线性模型；最佳线性近似本身也随 $X$ 分布而变。最后，论文建议以跨环境稳定性（而非仅训练准确率）为依据来选择模型复杂度，并讨论了实证研究应如何设计验证方案，包括保持整组环境、分环境报告误差、记录测量变化与决策后果等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗、行为与社会科学等复杂领域中，线性预测模型常可匹敌甚至超越更灵活的方法，这与"现实非线性→应使用灵活模型"的直觉相冲突。本文旨在给出这一现象的条件性、可操作的预测解释，回答：线性模型在哪些条件下因何优于灵活模型？

Method: 1. **文献综合**：将简单线性规则（improper linear models）、临床 vs 统计预测、偏差-方差与正则化、最优线性预测（best linear prediction）、测量误差、协变量偏移与捷径学习、不变预测、Rashomon 集合与 underspecification 等研究串接为单一论证。2. **命题 1（数学证明）**：在源/目标环境 $X$ 分布相同、$m_e(X)=\ell(X)+g_e(X)$ 分解、$\langle g_e,q\rangle=0$ 等假设下，比较柔性预测器 $f_F=\ell+g_s$ 与线性预测器 $f_L=\ell$ 在目标环境的均方误差，得 $R_t(f_F)-R_t(f_L)=\|g_s\|^2-2\langle g_s,g_t\rangle$，从而 $A_{s,t}<\frac{1}{2}$ 时线性占优。3. **有限样本分析**：引入估计误差 $V_F, V_L$，推出线性占优条件放宽为 $A_{s,t}<\frac{1}{2}+\frac{V_F-V_L}{2\|g_s\|^2}$，表明高方差灵活模型扩大线性优势。4. **机制构造**：以未观测因子 $U$ 为例，说明 $E_e[U|X]$ 随环境变化时，可产生 Proposition 1 所需的跨环境不稳定的非线性分量 $g_e$。5. **实证设计建议**：主张按复杂度阶梯比较、按整组环境评估、分环境与最差环境报告、检查变量意义变化并记录实际决策后果。

Result: 1. **命题 1**：若源环境非线性分量在目标环境与自身的方向重叠比 $A_{s,t}<1/2$，则线性模型在目标环境均方误差严格小于使用源环境 $g_s$ 的柔性模型。2. **有限样本加强**：在合理简化下线性占优区间为 $A_{s,t}<\frac{1}{2}+\frac{V_F-V_L}{2\|g_s\|^2}$，柔性估计误差 $V_F$ 越大，线性优势越显著。3. **机制可行性**：存在未观测因子 $U$ 且 $a E_e[U|X]$ 的非线性部分 $g_e=q_e-q_L$ 跨环境变化时，可同时满足 (a) 真实机制非线性、(b) 线性成分 $\ell$ 跨环境稳定、(c) $X$ 与 $U$ 的关联跨环境变化。4. **文献结论**：表 1 整合各传统研究方向，说明支撑点与其单独无法推出的部分。5. **边界条件**：非线性稳定应使用复杂模型、线性伪相关可同样损害线性模型、协变量偏移改变最优线性近似、正则化得当的灵活模型可逼近线性、从多环境数据可学得跨环境稳定规则。

Conclusion: 线性模型之有效性并非源于世界线性，而源于"世界的复杂性"与"有限、部分观测数据所能可靠支持的复杂性"之间的鸿沟。当不稳定规则集中于非线性分量时，限制为线性可避免将不可迁移的复杂度带入目标环境。论文通过综合多支文献与一个简单平方误差下的数学结果（命题 1）给出了这一条件性解释，并据此主张以**跨环境稳定性**而非仅训练准确率为依据来选择模型复杂度。线性模型应被视为复杂度连续体上的一个选项：知多环境变化且数据充足时可用灵活模型；对环境变化知之甚少时线性模型为谨慎之选，但仍需检验其线性关系本身的稳定性。最终标准是：所发现的复杂结构有多大比例会在实际部署环境中保持有效。

Abstract: Linear models can predict well in complex domains even when underlying mechanisms are nonlinear. We argue that this can occur because the complexity of the world exceeds the complexity that can be learned reliably from finite, partially observed data. Flexible models can exploit curvature, thresholds, and interactions that fit one hospital, period, population, policy setting, or measurement process but fail elsewhere. When this instability lies mainly in the nonlinear component, omitting it can give linear models lower prediction error in a new environment. We connect this claim to work on simple linear rules, bias and variance, regularization, best linear prediction, measurement error, distribution shift, invariance, Rashomon sets, and underspecification. Proposition 1 gives a simple squared-error case in which a nonlinear rule learned in the training environment raises target error because it transfers too weakly; finite-sample estimation error can strengthen this result. Partial observation alone is not enough: the link between observed variables and unobserved factors must vary across environments. Stable nonlinear structure favors flexible models, and linear models remain vulnerable to linear spurious relationships. Model complexity should therefore be chosen by cross-environment stability as well as training-data accuracy.

</details>


### [218] [Accelerating Linear Bandits with Persistent Candidate Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13407)
*Bingkui Tong,Daria Korovaitceva,Marina Sheshukova,Sergey Samsonov,Junpei Komiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PC-LinUCB，通过维护 k 个持久候选动作并在每轮从剩余动作中均匀采样 q 个挑战者，将线性老虎机每轮评分复杂度从 O(K) 降至 O(k+q)，在保持与 LinUCB 可比遗憾的同时显著加速计算。理论方面给出了与 horizon 无关的发现问题代价上界及匹配的下界，实验在合成与多个真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性和可推广性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模线性老虎机（如推荐系统、在线广告）中，动作集 K 可能达百万级，传统的 LinUCB 每轮需要对全部 K 个动作进行乐观评分，评分成本 O(Kd²) 成为计算瓶颈。现有工作要么降低单次评分成本（如随机投影、矩阵草图），要么减少评分动作数（如子线性搜索、消除法），但部分候选访问本身会引入不可避免的遗憾代价，需要在加速与遗憾之间取得权衡。

Method: 提出 Persistent Candidate LinUCB (PC-LinUCB)：每轮维护大小为 k 的活跃集 A_t，从剩余 K-k 个非活跃动作中均匀采样 q 个挑战者 R_t，候选集 D_t = A_t ∪ R_t 大小为 k+q。引入"裁剪分数"(clipped score) 机制：每个候选的分数更新为历史值与当前 UCB 的最小值，保证分数单调不降且在置信事件上保持乐观性。选择裁剪分数最高的动作，并将候选集中裁剪分数最高的 k 个动作组成下一轮活跃集。该机制将每轮评分成本从 O(Kd²) 降至 O((k+q)d²)，且模型更新与候选维护不增加对 K 的依赖。

Result: 理论上：①问题无关的高概率遗憾上界为 Õ(√(Td log(1+TL²/(λd)))) + O((K-k)/q · log(K-k))，发现问题项不随 horizon 增长；②问题相关的遗憾上界含 O(d/Δ_min · log(...)) + 同一发现问题项；③均匀挑战者采样下，证明 Ω((K-k)/q) 的遗憾下界，表明部分候选访问本身引入不可避免的代价。证明核心技术：定义"活跃动作"集 S_t 和"空候选轮"指标 Z_t，构造势函数 W_t = ρ^{-N_t^empty} · m_t 并证明其为非负上鞅，再用极大不等式约束空候选轮数。实验上：在合成 (K=10000) 与四个真实数据集 (MovieLens-20M、UCI SGEMM、NAS-Bench-101、DOCKSTRING) 上，PC-LinUCB 相比 LinUCB 加速 5.1×~77.9×，最终遗憾变化不超过 ±1.6%，优于 RS-OFUL、CBSCFD、PSI-LinUCB、Sub-Elim；并成功推广至 SpectralUCB。消融实验表明加速与候选预算 B=k+q 成反比，且预算在 k 与 q 间的分配对 d=16 情形有影响、对 d=100 情形几乎无影响。

Conclusion: PC-LinUCB 通过持久候选集与裁剪分数机制，有效降低大规模线性老虎机的动作选择成本，同时保持与 LinUCB 相近的遗憾性能。理论结果揭示了加速与发现代价之间不可避免的权衡（Ω((K-k)/q) 下界），且该持久候选机制具有算法无关性，可推广至 SpectralUCB 等其他方法。局限性在于依赖固定动作集与固定特征，不直接适用于上下文老虎机。

Abstract: Exhaustive optimistic scoring can make action selection costly in linear bandits with a large fixed set of $K$ actions, requiring $\mathcal{O}(K)$ score evaluations per round. We introduce Persistent Candidate LinUCB (\textsc{PC-LinUCB}), which maintains $k$ active actions and samples $q$ challengers uniformly from the remaining $K-k$ actions at each round. By scoring only these $k+q$ candidates, \textsc{PC-LinUCB} reduces the number of score evaluations per round to $\mathcal{O}(k+q)$. We establish problem-independent and problem-dependent high-probability regret bounds consisting of a standard linear-bandit learning term and an additive discovery cost of order $\mathcal{O}\left((K-k)\log(K-k)/q\right)$ at fixed confidence. Notably, this additional cost does not grow with the horizon. For fixed gaps and sufficiently long horizons, we establish an $\Omega\left((K-k)/q\right)$ regret lower bound under uniform challenger sampling, showing that partial candidate access itself imposes an unavoidable regret cost. Experiments show that \textsc{PC-LinUCB} substantially accelerates LinUCB while maintaining comparable regret, and that the persistent candidate mechanism can extend beyond LinUCB.

</details>


### [219] [PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13435)
*Arvasu Kulkarni,Mahir Jain,Aditya Ray Mishra,Sandeep Singh,Siddharth Panwar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PPG-Bench是一个统一的开放源代码基准测试，用于评估光电容积脉搏波（PPG）基础模型。它在9个公开数据集的26个任务上评估5个公共PPG基础模型，并使用四种下游适应机制和三个对照组（随机/常数基线、确定性脉率变异性特征集PRV和通用时间序列基础模型MOMENT）。结果表明，当前PPG基础模型尚未提供优于简单替代方案的泛化和可迁移表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可穿戴和临床设备大规模记录光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号，越来越多的PPG基础模型被开发出来用于各种下游任务的可重用表征。然而，这些模型难以比较：不同的评估使用不同的数据集、任务定义、预处理、下游头、超参数调优和基线。因此，需要一个统一的基准来解决这些问题。

Method: PPG-Bench评估了5个公共PPG基础模型（AnyPPG、PaPaGei-S、PaPaGei-P、PulsePPG、SigmaPPG），在9个开放访问数据集上评估26个任务（17个主要任务和9个次要任务），涵盖心血管状态估计、活动、睡眠、筛查和识别。使用四种下游评估机制（线性探测、随机森林、冻结MLP探测和端到端微调），并进行模型特定的超参数优化和受试者不相交的交叉验证。还设立了三个对照组（随机/常数基线、确定性PRV特征集和通用时间序列基础模型MOMENT）进行比较。

Result: 在所有68个任务-机制组合中，35.3%没有显示出PPG基础模型相对于随机/常数基线的有意义优势，83.8%的任务中没有任何PPG专用基础模型同时优于PRV和MOMENT两个控制。AnyPPG是整体上最强的PPG专用模型。主要异常任务包括年龄估计和生物特征识别，其中PulsePPG表现特别强。增加下游头容量通常会提高表现，但如果模型在机会/常数水平运行，则可能导致显著退化。在机会水平下，从线性探测到MLP的平均变化为-17.5%，从线性探测到微调的平均变化为-29.9%。

Conclusion: 当前PPG基础模型尚未提供PPG信号的泛化和可迁移表征。该领域的未来评估应包括针对简单、非学习控制的检查。PPG-Bench为此提供了一个标准化的评估框架。该基准表明，当前PPG基础模型在许多任务上不能提供相对于随机机会/常数基线、简单生理特征或通用时间序列基础模型的有意义优势。增加下游模型容量在有用的任务信息已经存在时有所帮助，但无法可靠地挽救弱表征。这些结果表明，当前PPG基础模型尚不构成强大的通用表征，领域的进展不仅应通过相对于其他基础模型的改善来判断，还应通过这些模型是否相对于更简单的替代方案提供稳健价值来判断。

Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is increasingly recorded by wearable and clinical devices at enormous scale, and a growing number of PPG foundation models (FMs) have been developed to compute reusable representations for various downstream tasks. These models are difficult to compare: different evaluations use different datasets, task definitions, preprocessing, downstream heads, hyperparameter tuning, and baselines. We present PPG-Bench, a unifying open-source benchmark evaluating five public PPG FMs across nine open-access datasets and 26 tasks spanning cardiovascular state estimation, activity, sleep, screening, and identification. We evaluate models under four downstream regimes of increasing adaptability (linear probing, random forests, frozen MLP probes, and end-to-end finetuning), with model-specific hyperparameter optimization and subject-disjoint cross-validation. We also evaluate against three controls: random/constant baseline, a deterministic pulse-rate-variability (PRV) feature set, and a generic time-series FM (MOMENT). Across all 68 task-regime combinations, 35.3% show no meaningful FM advantage over the random/constant baseline, and in 83.8% no PPG-specific FM outperforms both PRV and MOMENT. We also find that added downstream head capacity generally improves performance, but can cause significant degradation if the model is performing at chance/constant level. Current PPG FMs therefore cannot yet claim to provide generalised and transferrable representations of PPG signals, and future evaluation in this field should include checks against simple, non-learned controls. Code for the benchmark and instructions to evaluate more models can be found here - this https URL .

</details>


### [220] [FedPCD: Priority-Constrained Federated Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13508)
*Yousef Irshaid,Dara Varam,Mohamed I. AlHajri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedPCD（Priority-Constrained Federated aggregation），一种基于优先约束下降（PCD）框架的联邦学习优化方法。该方法将传统的联邦聚合（FedAvg）作为主目标，将个体客户端更新作为次要约束，仅在需要满足客户端级别约束时引入最小修正。在异构联邦学习基准测试中，FedPCD在全局精度、最差10%客户端精度和通信效率方面均优于10种最先进的公平感知联邦学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中，客户端数据分布异质会导致模型在不同客户端之间产生不公平的性能差异。现有的公平感知联邦学习方法通常通过客户端重加权、梯度修正或通用下降公式来改变全局优化方向或对称处理客户端目标，可能不必要地偏离全局目标方向。

Method: FedPCD将优先级约束下降（PCD）框架适配到联邦学习场景。将FedAvg聚合方向作为主目标，个体客户端更新方向作为次要约束，构建凸二次规划（QP）：求解最接近主目标方向且满足各客户端最低进度阈值（参数τ控制）的方向。若主方向已满足所有约束，则不引入任何修正；否则进行最小修正。为处理部分参与问题，引入客户端历史缓存机制，保留最近H轮内观察到的客户端伪梯度作为额外约束。理论上证明了确定性完全参与下的O(1/T)收敛率。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Fashion-MNIST三个数据集上，使用Dirichlet划分（α∈{0.01, 0.1, 1}）和两种参与率（5%和10%）进行评估。FedPCD在全部18个配置中获得最高全局精度，在17个配置中获得最高最差10%客户端精度。仅用10%-44%的通信轮数即可达到FedAvg的最终精度。在16/18个配置中以更少轮数达到最强基线的最终性能。组件消融实验验证了历史机制最为关键，去除后性能从74.84%降至59.26%。

Conclusion: FedPCD通过将全局优化目标与客户端保护分离，实现了在不损害全局性能的前提下保护客户端级别性能。其层级化设计保持FedAvg作为优选方向，仅在必要时引入最小方向修正。理论分析建立了O(1/T)收敛率和复合多平稳性保证。实验表明该方法在精度、公平性和通信效率方面均达到先进水平。未来工作包括自适应τ参数、与安全聚合兼容的隐私变体以及多本地步数场景下的扩展。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. Across heterogeneous FL benchmarks, FedPCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the highest global accuracy across all configurations and leading worst-10% client accuracy in nearly all. FedPCD further preserves competitive trade-offs between global accuracy and client performance variability. Beyond this trade-off, FedPCD demonstrates faster empirical convergence, reaching matching or superior performance in substantially fewer communication rounds.

</details>


### [221] [Simulating Training Spikes of Deep Neural Networks by Layer-wise Random Feature Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13524)
*Ran Tian,Courtney Paquette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于幂律随机特征(PLRF)模型的轻量级仿真框架,通过将深度神经网络各层与二次损失随机特征模型对齐,模拟并预测LLM预训练中出现的间歇性"训练尖峰"现象。研究发现重尾分布的幂律指数α是产生尖峰的必要条件,并在1.3B Transformer LM的案例研究中验证了仿真预测能力,同时提出了一种自适应β₂调度方案以缓解尖峰并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练中出现的间歇性loss尖峰是一个理论上和实证上都很神秘的局部现象,对尖峰的敏感性与数据洗牌和模型初始化均有关,这与正常的随机梯度噪声不同。现有理论(如基于全批量梯度下降的"Edge-of-Stability"理论)无法在凸二次模型中复现这种现象,也无法解释为什么DNN在随机优化下会出现尖峰。理解尖峰的产生机制对于改善训练稳定性至关重要。

Method: (1) 引入幂律随机特征(PLRF)模型,证明其可在重尾输入分布(α>0.5)下复现训练尖峰,违反集中性原理;(2) 对DNN损失函数在固定点进行二阶Taylor展开,定义逐层二次损失L;(4) 证明定理3通过构建高维潜在空间将DNN逐层梯度表示为随机特征模型形式;(3) 推导预测5,利用Isserlis定理在D→∞极限下计算逐样本梯度协方差;(4) 设计算法1,在等效批处理因子𝔅下合成伪梯度进行轻量级仿真;(6) 推导SGD发散阈值γ的解析方程;(5) 基于梯度噪声的自相关时间尺度,提出自适应β₂调度公式β₂≈1-√(η_t·T/√N)。

Result: (1) PLRF模型在α=0.9时可复现训练尖峰,而α=0.3时不会;(2) 算法1在PLRF模型上正确捕捉了平均训练轨迹和尖峰行为的定性特征,但在批大小B=1时低估尖峰幅度,B=64时高估;(3) 在1.3B Transformer LM案例研究中,仿真成功预测了Spiky1和Spiky2配置在FFN层的尖峰行为,而Normal配置较为平滑;(4) Prediction 5的预测误差在大部分情况下<5%,即使梯度范数跨多个数量级变化;(5) Spiky训练中前向激活相关矩阵的特征值更重尾;(6) 提出的β₂调度使最终验证损失从2.4421改善到2.4404,优于固定β₂=0.982(2.4405)和β₂=0.992(2.4502)。

Conclusion: 本文首次将训练尖峰与重尾输入分布显式关联,证明了即使在凸二次模型中,随机梯度噪声也能导致尖峰,这与全批量梯度下降理论(EoS)。所开发的轻量级仿真框架能够在不调用DNN反向传播的情况下预测尖峰行为,为研究DNN训练动力学提供了新工具。提出的β₂调度方案可有效避免尖峰并提升模型性能。仿真与实际DNN尖峰存在差异表明逐层二次模型无法完全解释训练动力学,跨层相关性和高阶Taylor展开项在分析中具有意义,这是未来工作的开放方向。

Abstract: Intermittent ``spikes'' in loss, during the pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), remains a mysterious phenomenon both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we show that simple quadratic models with heavy-tailed, power-law distributed inputs can replicate these spikes. We introduce a theoretical framework and simulation algorithm to model per-layer training dynamics of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), using such quadratic models. In a case study on an Adam hyperparameter configuration (where $\beta_2$ is set close to $1$) known to induce spikes in Transformer LMs, our simulation successfully predicts bumps indicating spiky behavior from a given checkpoint. Furthermore, we derive an appropriate $\beta_2$ schedule from observed metrics, which empirically improves performance.

</details>


### [222] [Probabilistic Ship Trajectory Forecasting using Transformer Models on AIS Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13557)
*Frederik E. T. Schöller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对受限水域水面船舶轨迹预测问题，提出基于Transformer和Performer架构的混合模型，结合核密度估计（KDE）生成的位置热力图与卷积神经网络（CNN）进行空间特征提取，并采用分位数损失（quantile loss）实现单次前向推理的95%预测区间输出。模型在丹麦三个海域的AIS数据上训练和测试，结果显示该方法在位移误差和区间覆盖率方面显著优于线性回归、高斯过程及LSTM-GAN等基线方法，且推理速度大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
