Abstract: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [333] [Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13948)
*Alexander Hickey,Joanna Knight,James Bishop*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用"维基百科游戏"作为类比任务，系统评估了26种语言模型（包括句嵌入模型和大语言模型）在10个图数据集（5种语言的维基百科+5个OpenAlex学科领域）上的导航能力。结果显示，没有任何模型显著超越人类水平，但GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B和DeepSeek-R1:70B等最佳模型达到了与人类相当的成功率。模型性能在语言和主题间存在显著差异，句嵌入模型虽无幻觉但策略性不足，LLM存在幻觉问题但更具策略性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型越来越多地用于自动化信息检索任务，特别是处理无法完全索引的大型文档集合时，需要评估它们在专业领域和不同语言下的语义导航能力。维基百科游戏作为一个受控的类比任务，能有效测试模型在图结构中基于语义相似性进行路径规划的能力。

Method: 作者构建了10个大型图数据集（5个语言版本的维基百科+5个OpenAlex学科领域），每个数据集随机生成10,000对可达文章作为游戏关卡。测试了13个句嵌入模型、13个LLM（含5个推理模型），并与TF-IDF基线和人类玩家（109局英语维基百科游戏）进行比较。评估指标包括成功率（100步内到达目标）、步数效率（超出最优路径的步数）以及失败原因分析。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 最佳模型成功率与人类相当（GPT-o3 mini最高），但平均步数多于人类；(2) 句嵌入模型如E5-Small、AllMPNetBase在多个任务上超越大多数LLM且无幻觉问题；(3) LLM性能随参数规模下降而显著恶化，小模型常因幻觉而失败；(4) 推理模型（QwQ:32B、DeepSeek-R1:70B）效率优于同规模非推理模型；(5) 步数分布分析显示模型的步数分布接近几何分布（n≈1），而人类接近负二项分布（n≈3-4.45），表明两者导航策略存在本质差异；(6) 跨语言/跨主题性能不一致，模型在一个领域的表现不能直接迁移到另一个领域。

Conclusion: 结论表明：语言模型已具备足够的语义信息来玩维基百科游戏，但效率仍不及人类。实际应用中，简单的句嵌入模型往往是更优选择，因其计算成本低且无幻觉。模型性能具有领域依赖性，在跨语言或跨学科部署时需谨慎评估。未来的研究方向可包括混合方法（嵌入+LLM）、强化学习微调以及使用更新后的文章测试模型的真实泛化能力。

Abstract: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

</details>


### [334] [On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12466)
*Drew T. Nguyen,William Fithian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对 METR 的 50% 时间水平（time horizon）估计方法进行了统计学重新分析，使用样条函数与项目反应理论（IRT）放宽了"AI 难度与人类时间对数呈线性关系"的假设。基于 228 个任务和 26 个 AI 的数据，作者提出两个新模型（Model 1 和 Model 2），在交叉验证的恰当评分规则下均优于基线方法，并通过诊断图揭示了时间水平的构念效度问题，特别是在 2–30 分钟区间存在平坦区，导致时间水平跳跃的含义不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: METR 的"时间水平"图表被广泛引用为 AI 能力快速增长的关键证据，甚至被比作摩尔定律或基林曲线，影响了政策制定和投资决策。然而，该指标是一个统计估计量而非直接物理测量，其估计方法和构念效度值得严格审视。作者旨在：（1）改进时间水平的点估计；（2）诊断时间水平的构念效度。

Method: 作者将时间水平估计纳入项目反应理论（IRT）框架，提出：
- Model 1：共享单调样条 + 共享斜率，用单调自然三次样条替代 log₂(t) 的线性函数；
- Model 2：解释性 IRT 模型，包含任务族效应（family effects）和过度离散（overdispersion），通过 EM 算法配合 Gauss-Hermite 拟合法拟合；
- 使用 4 种恰当评分规则（边缘对数分数、Brier 分数、q=0.5/0.8 处的基本二元分数 Murphy 图）配合 3 种加权方案（等任务、等族、平方根族），在以任务族为单位的 5 折交叉验证下评估模型；
- 提出两类诊断图：时间-难度转换图（time-to-difficulty conversion plot）和条件成功轨迹图（conditional success trajectory plot）来评估构念效度。

Result: 1. 新模型（Model 1 和 Model 2）在 12 个恰当评分规则指标上均优于基线（共享斜率 logistic），Murphy 图显示在 q>0.4 区间近乎完全支配基线；
2. 拟合的样条函数 f 将人类时间映射到 AI 难度，在 2–30 分钟区间接近平坦，其余区域接近线性。这意味着从 3 分钟到 30 分钟的跳跃比从 30 分钟到 5 小时的跳跃容易得多，尽管倍数相同（10×）；
3. 基线 logistic 模型的隐含估计实际上更接近 Rasch 能力 α/β 而非真正的时间水平；
4. 改进效果集中在时间水平为 2–15 分钟的中等能力 AI 上（GPT-4 时代）；
5. 提出了"预测性"（predictiveness）和"可比性"（comparability）两个构念效度维度。

Conclusion: 1. 应使用 Model 1 或 Model 2 替代基线 logistic 估计，因其在交叉验证中表现更好；
2. 时间水平应与诊断图一起解读，特别是在提出新的基于时间水平的基准或将其扩展到更长任务时；
3. 2–30 分钟区间的平坦区域揭示了显著的构念效度问题：该区域的"时间水平跳跃"不应与其他区域的跳跃同等解释；
4. 若将基准扩展到更长任务，需通过诊断图验证 f 的线性假设是否成立，否则可能错误推断能力增长；
5. 能力锚定（capability anchoring）方法论本身可推广至其他领域（如机器人），但需谨慎选择锚定标注。

Abstract: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.

</details>

### [335] [Ember: Making Unified Virtual Memory Practical for Discrete-Memory GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13408)
*Senad-Leandro Lemes Galera,Michail Georgoulakis Misegiannis,Ferdinand Gruber,Jana Giceva,Dimitrios Stavrakakis*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Ember是一个用于离散GPU的UVM管理框架，通过默认映射到主机内存、按区域精细化管理数据位置，解决了GPU内存超额订阅时UVM性能崩溃的问题，在不需要应用修改或预剖析的情况下实现显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着GPU工作集快速增长（最大模型增~1000倍而GPU内存仅增~5倍），应用必须超额订阅GPU内存。NVIDIA UVM虽支持超额订阅，但一旦数据超过GPU内存，其基于缺页的放置策略会浪费互连带宽并导致严重的性能崩塌（如图1所示，GPU sort在1.5×超额订阅时从4.1s增至1150s）。现有方案要么手动编排数据放置（工作量大、与GPU世代耦合），要么借助profile-guided方法（不稳定、需额外运行），都无法透明支持未修改应用。论文提出核心研究问题：能否在无需placement hints、profiling运行或应用修改的前提下，让UVM超额订阅在现成GPU上变得实用？

Method: Ember引入"默认映射的混合地址空间"作为核心抽象，每条分配的每个region（VA block，2 MiB）在初始时均映射到主机内存，GPU可直接访问而无数据迁移。系统基于三个组件协同工作：(1) 迁移引擎负责混合地址空间，按region粒度执行提升/降级，提升时一次性迁移整个VA block并锁保护，避免小块迁移开销；(2) 访问监控器利用GPU硬件访问计数器（~256个仅覆盖host-resident内存的counter），将通知归因到对应VA block，并通过扩展邻接span（默认64 MiB）补偿counter数量不足的局限，将一个被访问块提升时一起提升其邻居；(3) 策略引擎实现两种策略——阈值提升在内存充裕时按counter阈值提升区域，避免超额订阅时立刻回收；基于衰减的积极回收在GPU占用率达上水位（90%）时按物理chunk执行批回收（每25 ms减半一次需求，按需求+迁移分数排序驱逐），至下水位（85%），并通过迁移感知保护（迁移分数+宽限期机制）防止区域抖动。提出两个实现：Ember-static为用户空间版（在stock CUDA上使用cudaMemAdvise+cudaMemPrefetchAsync固定划分，3个API调用/分配）；Ember-adaptive为内核模块版（打补丁到NVIDIA开源UVM驱动，按counter在线决策，无需修改应用）。使用GPU硬件counter的4 KiB页限制被绕过，并扩大其通知影响范围。

Result: 在三种部署场景的四张GPU（RTX 5080/A40/H200消费级+数据中心卡，以及GH200超芯片）上评估：数据密集型应用（pathfinder、k-means、CNN、双调排序、基数排序、BFS）方面，1.5×超额订阅时Ember-static较stock UVM几何均值加速6.83–10.62×，Ember-adaptive达5.52–8.83×，且性能增益随访问模式不规则性提升（顺序型1.8–10×，随机型11–225×）；LLM推理（Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-32B）方面，在16 GB封顶下超额订阅至1.41×时token生成4.7–16×加速（在手动放置根本无法加载模型的规模）；数据库分析（SSB on Crystal）Ember-adaptive在60组查询-GPU-容量组合的51组中获胜，对UVM加速1.50–2.36×；GH200上由于一致互连，UVM崩溃缓解，Ember加速回落至约3.5×但复用频繁的工作负载（k-means、LLM）仍显著优于UVM-mapped；与profile-guided方案HELM对比，Ember-adaptive无需profiling运行，在kernel时间上以2.1×几何均值领先（5个基准中3个胜出，bfs与gramschm因HELM契合而落后）；Ember-static在稳定热集频繁复用时更快，Ember-adaptive在低复用或单一pass场景下更快，两者在20 GB工作集/1.3×GPU内存下数据迁移量差异为静态版一次性16 GB迁移 vs. 自适应版6.8–65.2 GB。代码改动极少（<5% LOC）。

Conclusion: Ember证明了UVM超额订阅可在不改动硬件、内核或应用的前提下变得实用，通过将映射设为默认、按region粒度组织混合地址空间、利用GPU硬件访问计数器驱动运行时提升、并通过基于衰减的积极批回收保持驱逐远离关键路径。相比于以迁移为默认、映射为后备的方案，Ember将驱逐从超额订阅的固定开销变为可策略控制的决策，在广泛硬件（消费卡到GH200超芯片）和工作负载（数据密集型、LLM推理、数据库分析）上系统性地优于stock UVM、纯映射、预取和profile-guided方案。识别了Ember-adaptive在可观察性（仅知道counter，不能直接观测设备访问）、库内部缓冲区不可见、需要裸金属访问加载内核模块以及多GPU扩展等限制，但整体设计独立于CUDA，可迁移到其他支持驱动控制迁移与映射的栈（如AMD ROCm）。

Abstract: GPU working sets have outgrown GPU memory, so applications must oversubscribe it, keeping only hot data on the GPU. NVIDIA's Unified Virtual Memory (UVM) supports oversubscription, but its performance degrades once data exceeds the GPU's memory. This stems from its fault-driven data placement, wasting interconnect bandwidth, and underutilizing the GPU. This raises the question: can UVM oversubscription become practical on stock GPUs, exploiting GPU memory speed and minimizing wasted interconnect bandwidth, without placement hints, profiling runs, or application changes? To this end, we present Ember, a UVM management framework for oversubscribed workloads. Ember introduces a hybrid address space; allocations start as mapped into host memory, omitting data migration. Ember's counter-driven region promotion uses GPU's hardware counters to fetch hot regions to the GPU, its decay-based eager reclamation proactively evicts cold regions in batches, while via online region re-placement, Ember tracks the hot set at runtime. We implement Ember within NVIDIA's open-source UVM driver for unmodified applications and as a userspace variant on stock CUDA. At 1.5x oversubscription, it is 6.8-10.6x faster than UVM on six applications across three PCIe GPUs, and generates LLM tokens 4.7-16x faster at sizes where manual placement cannot run at all. Without a profiling run, it beats a profile-guided alternative by 2.1x on kernel time.

</details>


### [336] [PredictIO: Decoupling Workload Prediction from OS-Controlled Storage Prefetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12971)
*Jun Lu,Yancan Mao,Zhenya Ma,Sheng Yue,Yongjian Fu,Ju Ren*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: PredictIO是一个Linux框架，将工作负载感知的预测逻辑与操作系统控制的预取执行解耦。它通过事件路径将内核观测和应用程序提示传递给用户空间预测策略，请求路径将统一的页面范围请求交由内核后端异步执行，从而支持应用启动、SQLite范围扫描和LLM模型加载等多种工作负载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 存储停顿仍然是应用延迟的重要来源，即使在快速存储设备上也是如此。Linux现有的readahead机制依赖文件偏移的空间局部性来预测未来访问，但在应用启动时的稀疏访问、数据库B-tree范围扫描、LLM模型加载等场景中，未来访问由工作负载结构而非偏移局部性决定。现有工作负载感知预取器将预测逻辑嵌入应用内部并与应用I/O路径耦合，导致策略难以跨工作负载和系统复用。

Method: PredictIO采用策略-机制分离设计：事件路径通过eBPF探针观测内核可见的文件访问，或通过轻量级适配器接收应用提示（B-tree遍历、张量布局等）；用户空间运行时通过事件适配器和分发器将事件路由到工作负载特定的预测策略；预测策略输出统一的页面范围请求；内核空间执行后端验证请求、对照页面缓存和进行中的I/O进行过滤和限流，并通过异步REQ_RAHEAD BIO填充页面缓存。原型实现了三种预测策略：基于历史Markov模型的应用启动策略、基于B-tree子页面提示的SQLite/LMDB范围扫描策略、以及基于张量布局元数据的LLM加载策略。

Result: 在控制路径开销方面，eBPF事件源可达约500万事件/秒，应用提示路径可达30-50万事件/秒，运行时分发在无策略时为1550-2110万事件/秒。端到端评估中，应用冷启动延迟降低5.3-26.3%（几何平均13.4%），SQLite范围扫描在YCSB风格工作负载上实现最高2.99倍加速，LLM模型加载延迟降低8.8-47.9%（no-mmap路径下Q8模型）。同一B-tree策略在SQLite和LMDB上分别实现34.3%和32.0%的延迟降低。RocksDB顺序扫描迁移后获得约4.6倍加速。跨NVMe SSD、SATA SSD和HDD设备均能保持收益。

Conclusion: PredictIO证明单一的OS抽象可以支持多样化的工作负载感知预测器，同时提供端到端性能提升。用户空间策略可跨存储引擎复用，应用集成的预取策略可迁移至框架而保留选择性，页面缓存管理仍保留在操作系统中。存储设备延迟本身并不决定预取有效性，收益取决于工作负载语义是否能暴露未来访问以及设备能否重叠投机I/O与需求I/O。

Abstract: Storage stalls remain a significant source of application latency even on fast storage devices. Prefetching can hide part of this latency by fetching data before it is demanded, but general-purpose operating-system mechanisms typically infer future accesses from recent file offsets. This approach is ineffective when accesses are determined by workload structure, such as recurring sparse accesses during application launch, logical traversal in database scans, or model-layout metadata in LLM runtimes. Existing workload-aware prefetchers usually embed prediction logic inside individual applications and couple execution to application-level I/O paths, making policies difficult to reuse across workloads and systems. We present PredictIO, a programmable interface that separates workload prediction from prefetch execution. PredictIO delivers kernel-observed accesses and application hints to user-space policies, which express predictions as uniform page-range requests. A kernel-space executor validates, bounds, and filters these requests against cached and in-flight pages before issuing asynchronous prefetch I/O. We implement PredictIO for application launch, SQLite range scans, and LLM model loading. Across these workloads, PredictIO reduces latency by 5.3-26.3%, achieves up to 2.99x speedup for SQLite scans, and reduces LLM loading latency by 8.8-47.9%. We further show that a common prediction policy can be reused across SQLite and LMDB through lightweight adapters, that an application-integrated RocksDB readahead policy can be migrated while preserving its workload selectivity, and that the execution backend determines how much benefit migration provides for different access patterns and storage devices.

</details>


### [337] [Characterizing CPU-GPU Memory Sharing over Unified Memory Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13125)
*Jinrong Yang,Zimeng Wang,Rong Chen,Haibo Chen*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: 本文针对统一内存架构（UMA）下CPU与GPU间的内存共享问题，开展了系统性研究，并构建了跨平台库libumsh。研究将共享操作解构为绑定、发送、接收三个独立可配置阶段，覆盖四个代表性x86/ARM平台，揭示了页大小、缓存策略、一致性方向、内存侧缓存（MSC）以及高并发争用对正确性与性能的耦合影响。基于四项核心发现，libumsh自动选择各平台的最佳实现，在九个真实系统中将数据面传输时间减少16–75%，控制面协调开销降低7–90%，并通过AI辅助的三步工作流成功扩展到支持双向一致性的NVIDIA DGX Spark。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMA虽然提供了CPU-GPU共享物理内存的能力，但其复杂性与不透明性导致主流应用要么退回到低效的数据复制，要么因直接访问实现不当而牺牲正确性或性能。现有框架（PyTorch、vLLM、OpenVINO等）仍在UMA平台上执行冗余拷贝，而渲染引擎等则因缺失缓存刷新导致数据不一致。问题的根源在于硬件差异（Ring vs. NoC、MSC存在与否、单向/双向一致性）、软件栈封闭性（页大小、缓存策略、缓存一致性配置被驱动和运行时隐藏）以及数据面与控制面通信目标的本质冲突。

Method: 研究方法围绕三个维度展开：（1）应用语义——将CPU-GPU通信分为数据面传输（CPU↔GPU）与控制面协调（非对称/对称同步）；（2）实现分解——将每个共享操作解构为独立的发送阶段（Bind-Write-Unbind）和接收阶段（Bind-Read-Unbind），每个阶段沿页大小、缓存策略（WB/UC）、一致性（CC）三个维度配置，可实现为Write-Alone、Write-then-Flush、Write-Bypass及其读取对应物；（3）平台覆盖——评估四个x86/ARM平台：Raptor（Ring互连）、Arrow（无MSC的NoC）、Lunar（含MSC的NoC）、Orin（ARM+NVIDIA GPU）。通过实证测试枚举每个平台上所有正确组合并识别最快者，使用单线程持久GPU内核验证数据可见性。基于发现构建libumsh，提供高层sender-receiver API自动选择实现，并设计AI辅助的三步移植工作流（定位API、验证行为、适配后端）扩展到新平台。

Result: 得出四项关键发现：（1）页大小主导绑定开销，4KB页面比2MB页面绑定开销高近100×，并通过TLB压力降低带宽；推荐启用THP并通过memset预填充以平衡开销与内存浪费。（2）非缓存（UC）内存虽可简化实现（无需代码修改），但CPU写延迟最高增加300×，实际工作负载（如L2优化的GEMM）会损失16% GFLOPS。（3）单向GPU-to-CPU缓存在MSC存在时开销可忽略；无MSC的Arrow平台上，启用CC的GPU写时间为未启用的2.07×。（4）高并发下控制面协调的瓶颈是争用而非访问延迟：块级屏障可处理至1000线程，更高并发需网格级屏障，单线程内核作为安全回退。libumsh在九个真实系统中将数据面时间减少16–75%（模型加载、图像预处理、输出采样、点云处理），控制面开销降低7–90%（混合推理、模型卸载、GPU文件系统、跨设备文件锁）。通过AI辅助工作流扩展到DGX Spark，揭示双向一致性下GPU写仍应优先UC路径（MB级流式传输），GPU读和小型控制标志可使用WB一致性路径；代理服务评估中libumsh使每请求延迟降低9.0–15.9%。

Conclusion: 本文通过系统性的方法论全面表征了UMA平台上CPU-GPU内存共享的正确性与性能，揭示了页大小、缓存策略、一致性、MSC和争用如何共同塑造数据面和控制面表现。研究证明，仅靠直接访问不足以保证正确且高效的共享——实现选择必须同时考虑平台的内存层次结构和每种共享模式的可见性与同步要求。libumsh将平台特定实现封装在高层sender-receiver操作后面，可移植地交付正确且高效的内存共享，并通过NVIDIA DGX Spark扩展验证了该方法对双向一致性平台的可扩展性。所提出的方法论、验证套件和库为通过正确性测试、性能测量和平台特定实现适配来支持新UMA平台提供了可复用方案。

Abstract: Unified Memory Architecture (UMA) enables the CPU and GPU to share a single physical memory. However, its complexity and opacity often drive applications back to inefficient copying or to incorrect direct access that sacrifices performance or even correctness. This paper presents a comprehensive study of CPU-GPU memory sharing on UMA, covering correctness and performance across data-plane transmission and control-plane coordination on four platforms. It yields four findings that guide libumsh, a portable library that delivers correct and efficient memory sharing across platforms and extends to emerging ones (e.g., NVIDIA DGX Spark). Applied to nine real-world systems, libumsh reduces data-plane time by 16-75% and control-plane overhead by 7-90%.

</details>

### [338] [Distributed Datalog at Scale with Worst-Case Optimal Joins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12692)
*Kunting Qi,Yihao Sun,Kristopher Micinski,Thomas Gilray,Sidharth Kumar*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于最坏情况最优连接（WCOJ）的分布式内存Datalog引擎，用于在无共享HPC集群上执行递归不动点评估。该引擎将Hypercube分区从单轮洗牌扩展到迭代半朴素求值，仅对每轮新推导的元组进行重新分区和复制，从而保持WCOJ交集始终在本地。在Aurora和Polaris超级计算机上的实验表明，系统在大多数基准测试中优于现有Datalog引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模关系推理（如社交网络分析、知识图谱推理、程序分析等）通常由循环多路连接主导。传统分布式Datalog系统依赖二元连接链，导致中间结果爆炸式增长，在递归场景下需要反复物化和重分配这些庞大的中间关系，造成严重的通信瓶颈。现有的WCOJ实现仅针对共享内存或一次性非递归查询，无法满足分布式HPC系统上递归评估的需求。

Method: 1. 基于Hypercube分区：选定一组连接变量作为分区键，定义k维逻辑进程网格；关系沿其包含的变量维度进行哈希分区，沿缺失维度进行复制。2. MPI实现：使用MPI_Alltoall+MPI_Alltoallv进行全局重分布，使用MPI_Allgather+MPI_Allgatherv在子立方体通信子中沿缺失维度复制。3. 迭代半朴素求值：每轮仅对新推导的delta元组执行重分布和复制，复用同一分区布局，保证所有WCOJ交集保持rank-local。4. 支持1D/2D/3D分区维度，提供了复制开销的代价模型。

Result: 在Polaris和Aurora超级计算机上使用图挖掘（Peer Influence、Triangle、TC、SG）和程序分析（Andersen指向分析）基准测试评估。从32扩展到2,048进程时，Polaris上最高获得14.3×加速比，Aurora上最高13.4×。在单节点32路并行下，在多数递归和循环基准测试中优于Soufflé、FlowLog和DuckDB。在分布式对比中，TC(USRoad)上比Slog快8.9–11.2×。2D分区在内存允许时运行时最优，3D分区在内存不可行时仍可运行但通信开销更大。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了WCOJ在HPC规模上的实用性，为可扩展图分析、程序分析和神经符号AI奠定了新基础。未来工作包括：用优化的非均匀all-to-all算法替代默认MPI_Alltoallv；集成机器学习驱动的自动调优器；基于代价的分区键和维度选择；偏斜感知的自适应复制；以及与GPU加速的本地连接相结合。

Abstract: Scalable logic-based analytics are frequently dominated by cyclic multi-way joins over large relational datasets. State-of-the-art systems evaluate these joins through chains of binary joins, incurring substantial overhead from large intermediate relations that must be materialized and redistributed across the network. Worst-Case Optimal Joins (WCOJ) offer a provably superior alternative by evaluating joins one variable at a time, eliminating intermediate blowup. However, existing WCOJ implementations target either shared-memory machines or one-shot, non-recursive queries on dataflow and big-data platforms, leaving WCOJ-based recursive evaluation on distributed-memory HPC systems an open problem. We present, to our knowledge, the first distributed-memory Datalog engine that uses WCOJ for recursive fixpoint evaluation. Our design builds on HyperCube partitioning, which hash-partitions relations along variable-aligned grid dimensions and replicates them along missing dimensions, and extends it from a single shuffle to iterative execution: in every semi-naive iteration, only newly derived tuples are repartitioned and re-replicated, using MPI all-to-all collectives and per-dimension all-gathers over subcube communicators, while the same layout is reused across iterations so that all WCOJ intersections remain rank-local. We evaluate our system on the Aurora and Polaris leadership-class supercomputers at Argonne National Laboratory using graph mining and program analysis benchmarks, demonstrating strong scalability, outperforming state-of-the-art Datalog engines on most benchmarks, and characterizing how partition dimensionality trades runtime against memory feasibility.

</details>


### [339] [Semantic Views: Certified Reuse of LLM Labels Across Semantic Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12768)
*Oktie Hassanzadeh,Dharmashankar Subramanian*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SemViews提出了一种认证式语义过滤器，通过重用历史查询的LLM标签（语义视图）、嵌入和辅助模型分数来排序元组，仅用新鲜分层oracle样本进行认证，从而在保证精度和召回率（至少1-δ概率）的前提下，减少28%-45%的oracle调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义查询引擎中每次LLM评估都是昂贵的oracle调用，现有优化方法（如级联、有限样本保证方法）存在权衡困境：信任廉价代理的级联方法常无法满足精度召回目标，有限样本保证方法节省调用有限，且所有方法都丢弃了查询结束时的oracle标签。不同谓词之间的标签重用存在安全风险，相似性缓存和蕴含关系重用因统计包含而非逻辑包含而频繁失败。

Method: SemViews的核心是CertifiedFilter算子，分五个步骤：(1)匹配最相似的k=10个候选视图；(2)在200个元组的shaping样本上拟合L2正则化逻辑回归分数模型，特征包括视图标签指示符、辅助模型分数和32维局部嵌入；(3)在分数边界附近细化分数（最多8轮，每轮标记5%元组）；(4)规划器将元组分为拒绝区X、oracle区O和接受区A，最小化预测调用数；(5)用无放回分层抽样从X和A中抽取认证样本，使用精确超几何边界，结合δ分割（f∈{0.5,0.7,0.9}）进行认证。视图仅用于规划order，oracle样本仅用于决定真伪。

Result: 在四个数据集（PubMed、GoEmotions、DBpedia、Reviews，共725,000条记录oracle标签）上，SemViews在99.63%的查询中满足精度和召回目标，节省28%-45%的oracle调用，而唯一具有相同保证的先前方法BARGAIN需要1.32x-1.71x的调用。视图在相关谓词上额外节省11%-38%调用，在改写问题上节省27%-36%。所有更便宜的方法（相似性缓存、SemWeave、级联）至少在32.4%的查询上未达目标。在10万级关系上的扩展实验证实效率随表规模提升（DBpedia从60%降至34%）。

Conclusion: SemViews证明了语义过滤器可以同时获得认证和低成本：通过将free side information用于排序、将新鲜样本用于认证，可以安全地跨查询重用oracle标签。视图帮助程度与工作负载中谓词相关性成正比，在改写问题上效果最显著，而未经认证的重用（相似性或蕴含）在大量查询上失败。更广泛的启示是，允许side information塑造计划而仅让fresh samples进入边界，可使语义引擎在不冒险保证的情况下利用任何积累的知识。

Abstract: Semantic query engines evaluate natural-language filters with a large language model, and every evaluation is a costly oracle call. Optimizers that reduce these calls face a dilemma: cascades that trust a cheap proxy miss their precision and recall targets on many queries, methods with finite-sample guarantees save little, and all of them discard the oracle's labels when the query ends. We present SemViews, a certified semantic filter that orders tuples by signals that cost no oracle calls (the labels that earlier queries left behind as semantic views, a local embedding, and a helper model's score), refines that order with labels it must pay for anyway, and certifies its answer with fresh stratified oracle samples. The answer meets user precision and recall targets with probability at least $1-\delta$ for every workload and every catalog, so a stale or misleading view can cost oracle calls but never accuracy. On four workloads replayed against 725,000 recorded oracle labels, SemViews meets both targets on 99.63% of queries and saves 28%-45% of the oracle calls, whereas the only prior method in our study with the same guarantee needs 1.32x-1.71x as many calls. When a question returns in different words, views cut its calls by a further 27%-36%, with both targets met on at least 99.8% of such queries; similarity caches and entailment-based reuse meet them on only 17%-47%.

</details>


### [340] [CALQA: Conformal Screening of Forecast-Ensemble Configurations from One Mergeable State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13249)
*Xiufeng Liu,Ruyu Liu,Yusen Liu,Huan Huo,Per Sieverts Nielsen*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: CALQA是一个可合并、可删除的整数聚合状态，用于在权重网格上对分位数平均（Vincentized）集成做保形校准筛选。它无需逐行扫描即可对任意权重向量打分，并通过两阶段搜索（粗筛+精确复核前100名）在604个公开面板组（10⁴候选/组）上达到精确搜索持有方块得分的99.95%，加速1.3–59倍；在约10⁸行的两个真实面板（智能电表、零售销售）上加速44–54倍，持有方块得分达99.98–100.01%，且在相同字节预算下优于块样本筛选。该聚合在保形覆盖保证下被严格证明为渐近最优，但在小/贪心搜索或K=12全支撑场景下不具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AutoML系统为每个分组/时段搜索大量集成权重向量以寻找最窄的保形校准区间；精确校准需逐行扫描，对G组×M候选计算开销达GM次扫描，亟需一种无需读行即可安全筛选的近似方法。

Method: 固定网格N上每个净点存储分箱直方图的状态；通过GROUP BY扩展、减法删除、窗格加权支持合并与回滚；查询时对每个候选w返回min_m(t_m + ½‖w−w_m‖₁)，其中t_m为围点阈值；两阶段计划先用状态粗筛全部候选，再对前k名做精确重检；理论证明其夹逼精确分位移位并转移Barber等人的加权保形覆盖界至每个事后权重向量。

Result: 在5个公开面板604组、10⁴候选下，两阶段（k=100）持有方块Winkler得分达精确搜索的99.95%，加速1.3–59倍，状态单独为100.41%；在约10⁸行的CER智能电表与M5零售面板上加速44–54倍，得分达99.98–100.01%，且在相同字节下优于块样本筛选（遗憾0.25–0.65% vs 1.43–1.88%）；状态内存为|N|(J+1)+1个整数（K=4时约21KB），在DUckDB中筛选比精确SQL快13–2301倍。

Conclusion: CALQA将保形校准转化为可合并、可删除的数据库聚合，作为筛选器匹配精确搜索质量但耗时大幅降低；其大小在其类别内达到渐近最优（Θ_d(Bε^{−(1+d)})），但在小/贪心搜索、充足内存下网外权重或K=12全支撑时无优势；开放问题包括漂移下自适应重校准、一般状态下界与净直方图下界之间的指数缺口、以及随机化摘要。

Abstract: AutoML systems fit ensemble weights over model libraries; a search can score, per category, market or time pane, thousands of weightings of the quantile-averaged (Vincentized) ensemble for the narrowest conformally calibrated interval; exact calibration scores a group's rows per candidate. We present CALQA, a fixed-size integer aggregate per group and pane that stores histograms of normalised block scores at a net of weight vectors. One GROUP BY builds it; it merges by addition, retracts deletions by subtraction and scores any candidate without reading a row. We prove that its score never falls below the exact split-conformal shift and exceeds it by at most the net distance plus a grid gap; that coverage carries over to each fixed weight vector and, for i.i.d. blocks and up to a union-bound slack, to a searched weight vector deployed with the state's shift; and how small any such state can be. The state is thus a screen: it ranks all candidates, and exact recomputation re-checks the top 100. On five public panels (604 groups, 10,000 candidates each) this two-stage plan matches exact search on held-out blocks (99.95% of its Winkler score), 1.3-59 times faster. On two real panels of about $10^8$ rows (smart meters, retail sales) it is 44-54 times faster at 99.98-100.01% of that score and beats sample screens with the same re-check in regret at less total time. Picks deployed with their exact shift need a held-out coverage check. The state does not pay off for small or greedy searches, off-net weights at ample memory or full twelve-member support.

</details>


### [341] [MatQuery: Execution-Grounded Natural-Language Querying over Heterogeneous Materials Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13573)
*Chen Jason Zhang,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: MatQuery是一个用于跨多个异构材料数据库的自然语言查询原型与实验基础设施，通过"语言模型提议+程序步骤检查"的八步流水线，在冻结的六个公共材料数据库本地副本上生成、执行并组装查询，配套有基准生成器与评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料科学家常需跨多个公共材料数据库（如Materials Project、OQMD、AFLOW、JARVIS-DFT、NOMAD、COD）联合检索，但各库schema、字段命名、单位、计算约定各异；现有NL-to-SQL系统（如CHESS、Alpha-SQL）和单库材料代理（如LLaMP、ChatMOF）均未解决跨库异构、科学含义依赖方法约定、以及"执行成功≠可比较"这三个核心问题。

Method: 构建冻结的、自验证的六库本地副本（每库约10,000条记录），建立统一的字段目录与数据库无关的中间查询表示（及每库适配器）；设计八步流水线（字段表→条件提取→逐库字段链接→源选择→规范查询编译→带反馈执行→选择合并算子→结果对账装配），其中模型调用负责"提议"，确定性程序步骤负责"检查/执行/装配"；基准生成器采用"先生成可执行参考查询，再由模型措辞问题，并经回译与评审把关"；评估框架对直接提示、CHESS、Alpha-SQL在同一冻结基础上做执行准确率与源选择准确率比较。

Result: 在800题开发集上：直接生成+3个示例的严格执行准确率达82.4%（无示例56.5%），执行成功率84.4%；低成本源打分器在完整请求上达到85.0%的精确库集合选择（单决策ROC AUC=0.995，校准后ECE=0.0125，5,520次决策成本仅0.032美元）；按组分聚类的跨库审计显示31.6%的带隙差异>0.5 eV；50次澄清会话试点中probe-then-ask策略仅11/50被双评审判为有效，未达预设门槛；300对结构审计中仅115对能完成结构比对，组分链接的设计加权精度约33.1%（部分识别区间8.5–82.8%）。完整流水线尚处冒烟测试阶段，未进行大规模评估。

Conclusion: 跨库材料查询可在相当比例上被转换为与参考答案执行一致的查询，但这只证明查询正确而非科学可比；按组分聚类时数值分歧普遍且组分链接不可靠，身份判定必须依靠结构匹配；简单的probe-and-ask设计因生成路径脆弱且问题针对性差而失败；当前结果仅反映开发集与试点行为，完整流水线的规模化评估以及独立专家评审仍待进行。

Abstract: Materials scientists increasingly combine information from several public databases, each with its own interface, schema, units and calculation conventions. MatQuery is a prototype and experimental infrastructure for studying how a natural-language request can be turned into queries over such databases and how the returned values can be interpreted. This report describes what has been built and the preliminary results obtained so far. The prototype holds frozen, self-verifying local copies of six public materials databases (about 10,000 records each), a catalog of declared fields derived from them, a database-independent query representation with an adapter for each database, and an eight-step pipeline in which a language model proposes and deterministic program steps check, execute and assemble. A benchmark generator produces questions whose reference queries are verified by execution on the frozen copies and whose wording is checked by back-translation and review. An evaluation harness runs direct prompting, CHESS and Alpha-SQL on the same frozen basis. Preliminary experiments on an 800-question development set show that direct generation with three demonstrations reaches 82.4% strict execution accuracy (56.5% without demonstrations), that a low-cost scorer selects the exact set of databases for 85.0% of complete requests with well-calibrated probabilities, and that band gaps differ by more than 0.5 eV in 31.6% of composition-matched cross-database clusters. Two pilots show the limits of the current approach: a probe-then-ask policy gave answers rated valid by both reviewers in only 11 of 50 sessions, and only 115 of 300 sampled record pairs could be compared by structure. The complete pipeline is in smoke testing and has not yet been evaluated at scale.

</details>


### [342] [Time-Varying Favorite-Longshot Bias in Polymarket Weather Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13593)
*Shouchen Qiu,Huaijun Qiu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 该论文研究Polymarket每日最高气温市场中"冷门-热门"偏差(favorite-longshot bias)随时间变化的特征,发现热门端在临近结算时存在显著高估,而冷门端高估主要出现在远期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前跨类别研究表明Polymarket气象市场存在较大定价偏差,但未区分低价冷门与高价热门,也无法揭示偏差随结算临近的演变。本文旨在回答:冷门与热门偏差如何随时间变化,哪一端是气象市场主要错误来源。

Method: 利用10个城市、2189个事件、21697个合约、854万笔交易数据,按结算前48至1小时分为11个时间窗口。方法包括:(1)可靠性图分析;(2)区间偏差D_h(a,b)=mean(y-p),分别定义冷门(0<p≤0.10)与热门(0.75≤p≤0.95);(3)事件级Brier、Log Loss、RPS评分;(4)三次B样条logit重校准(两个内部节点);(5)Buy-NO交易测试,以$10名义价值计算含/不含费用收益,采用事件级bootstrap置信区间。

Result: 核心发现:(1)冷门高估集中在30-48小时远期,临近时减弱甚至转轻微低估;热门高估在最后1-12小时显著增强,事件加权偏差约-0.10(6小时),量级几乎是冷门偏差(-0.009,48小时)的十倍。(2)三种事件级评分在临近峰值时均改善,RPS降幅最大;B样条重校准虽点估计略好,但95%置信区间包含零,无统计显著改善。(3)Buy-NO测试:热门窗口后期费ROI达+50.71%(NO胜率20.7%),置信区间[1.76,102.98]¢;冷门窗口后期费ROI为-0.23%(NO胜率97.8%),置信区间包含零。事件加权与城市等权结果一致,表明非个别城市驱动。

Conclusion: 气象市场的冷门-热门偏差具有强烈的时间不对称性:冷门偏差为远期现象且较温和,热门偏差为临近结算时主导错误来源,量级大一个数量级。整体分布精度在临近时仍提升,说明热门偏差局限在较小的高价子集中。B样条重校准因聚合了所有桶而无法显著改善分数。Buy-NO对比进一步验证热门端高估具有经济一致性且效应更大。局限在于仅覆盖每日最高气温、十个城市及一个月测试期,未来将与公共概率天气预报对比。

Abstract: Prediction-market prices combine traders' judgments about future outcomes, but their errors may be concentrated in particular price ranges and change as settlement approaches. Prior cross-category evidence shows that Polymarket weather markets have larger pricing bias than other major categories, without separating low-price longshots from high-price favorites. This study compares the two ranges at different horizons in daily maximum-temperature markets. Event-level probability scores, cubic B-spline recalibration, and Buy-NO tests are used to examine the form and effect of the bias. Longshot overpricing mainly occurs at distant horizons, whereas favorite overpricing becomes much stronger during the final 1-12 hours and is nearly one order of magnitude larger. Event-level scores improve toward the daily temperature peak, while simple recalibration yields no statistically significant gains. The Buy-NO results in the corresponding time windows also show that the main pricing error is concentrated at the favorite end.

</details>


### [343] [Benchmarking Content-Defined Chunking Algorithms for Data Deduplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13704)
*Marcel Gregoriadis,Leonhard Balduf,Björn Scheuermann,Johan Pouwelse*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了八种基于内容定义分块（CDC）的基础分块算法，在四种真实工作负载下从吞吐量、去重率、平均块大小和块大小方差四个维度进行分析。同时修正了AE算法参数化中长期存在的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数据去重基准测试将基础分块算法和高层技术（如大小归一化、最小/最大阈值、缓存）混为一谈，导致无法识别哪些设计选择真正影响性能。作者旨在解耦这些层次，单独评估基础分块算法，并纠正AE算法参数化中的一个长期错误。

Method: 将CDC算法分解为模块化结构，隔离出基础分块算法层；在四种真实工作负载下评估八种先进基础分块算法；通过吞吐量、去重率、平均块大小和块大小方差四个指标进行衡量；推导出AE、RAM、MII算法参数与期望块大小之间关系的新公式。

Result: 1) 发现AE参数化中存在长期错误，导致生成的块比预期小13-39%，并夸大了其报告的去重率；2) AE是四种指标综合表现最均衡的基础分块算法；3) RAM与AE的相似性在低熵数据上不成立；4) 在面向存储的工作负载中，MII和PCI相对于更简单的替代方案的优势有限。

Conclusion: AE是综合性能最均衡的基础分块算法，但对参数化的修正至关重要；简单的算法在存储工作负载中可能与复杂算法表现相当；该研究强调了对CDC算法进行模块化评估的重要性，并开源了所有实现、数据集和分析脚本以促进可复现性。

Abstract: Data deduplication relies on content-defined chunking (CDC) algorithms to decide where data is split. We observe that most CDC algorithms are modular: a base chunking algorithm fixes the byte-level cut-point condition, while high-level techniques (size normalization, min/max thresholds, caching) layer on top. Existing benchmarks conflate the two, obscuring which design choices actually drive performance. We isolate and evaluate eight state-of-the-art base chunking algorithms across four realistic workloads and four metrics: throughput, deduplication ratio, mean chunk size, and chunk-size variance. Further, we derive new formulas relating algorithm parameters to expected chunk size for AE, RAM, and MII. In doing so, we uncover a longstanding error in the widely-used AE parameterization reproduced across multiple papers and evaluation tools that produces chunks 13-39% smaller than intended and inflates AE's reported deduplication. Across our evaluation, AE is the most balanced base chunking algorithm across all four metrics, RAM's similarity to AE does not carry over to low-entropy data, and MII and PCI show limited advantages over simpler alternatives in storage-oriented workloads. We release all implementations, datasets, and analysis scripts as open source.

</details>


### [344] [ProvQML: Efficient Provenance Capture for Machine Learning as Recursive Aggregate SQL [Extended Version]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13756)
*Nkechi J. Akinwale,Seokki Lee*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: ProvQML是一个基于Apache Spark的递归聚合SQL引擎，通过将ML算法表达为递归聚合SQL查询，高效捕获细粒度的数据来源（provenance），包括局部provenance（每个训练实例对梯度计算的贡献）和全局provenance（模型参数在迭代间的更新序列），以支持ML模型的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统不支持对递归聚合SQL（用于表达ML算法）进行可扩展的provenance捕获，而ML可解释性（如模型验证、调试、特征重要性计算）需要这种细粒度的来源追踪能力。

Method: 1. 将ML查询中复杂的互递归和非线性递归关系通过查询重写（检测+重写两阶段）折叠为标准线性递归；2. 在递归case中使用窗口函数和子查询链（recProv→predProv→Grad）计算并物化局部provenance（Pred_i, Grad_i, Grad）；3. 基于PreM和PCC属性保证重写的语义正确性；4. 优化策略：广播小模型delta关系消除join shuffle、预分区训练数据按I减少reshuffle、delta-based计算将全局provenance内存控制在O(|T|)；5. 在Spark上实现ProvQML引擎。

Result: 在Income、BikeSharing、SpamBase、WebSpam四个真实数据集上，测试了5种ML算法（线性/Lasso/Ridge/Logistic回归、SVM）。端到端运行时随数据规模近似次线性增长；shuffle优化带来最高3.4倍加速；相比Radlog（不捕获provenance），provenance捕获开销最多约5倍；成功在分布式集群上处理WebSpam（138维特征、29M元组）和Income（17M元组）的大规模训练。

Conclusion: ProvQML证明了通过查询重写和优化技术，可以在线捕获ML训练过程的细粒度provenance（局部和全局），且开销可控，为ML模型可解释性、审计、特征贡献分析提供了声明式SQL基础。未来方向包括：provenance摘要技术、神经网络等更复杂ML算法、基于捕获provenance计算Shapley值等新解释。

Abstract: Expressing ML algorithms as recursive aggregate SQL queries over distributed systems enables large-scale declarative data analytics, yet no existing system supports scalable provenance capture, necessary for ML explainability. We present ProvQML, a provenance-aware recursive aggregate SQL engine that efficiently captures fine-grained provenance while evaluating ML algorithms as recursive aggregate queries. We capture two types of provenance: (i) local provenance that records the contribution of each training instance to gradient computation at a specific model state, and (ii) global provenance that encodes the sequence of model parameter updates across the iterations. Extensive experiments on widely used ML datasets demonstrate that our approach efficiently captures both provenance for various ML models over widely used ML datasets.

</details>


### [345] [Same Query, Different Answer: Run-to-Run Variance in Semantic Query Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13823)
*Oktie Hassanzadeh,Dharmashankar Subramanian*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: This paper reveals that semantic query engines (using LLMs to evaluate rows) are not reproducible even at temperature 0. Through 1.2 million logged model calls across SemBench, LRO-Bench, and UDA-Bench, the authors show that 0.07%–10.2% of row-level operator outputs change across executions, and that query plans amplify these changes exponentially—turning a few percent of item changes into most answers changing. About 21% of published benchmark quality results change between executions, and 16 of 28 LRO-Bench implementation recommendations are not statistically settled. The changes concentrate on "contested" items where models disagree with each other, and are predictable from a single execution's decision margin or reasoning length. The authors propose reporting rules for benchmarks and design rules for engines.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Semantic query engines increasingly rely on LLMs as oracles for filtering, mapping, joining, and aggregating rows. Benchmarks assume these oracles are reproducible at temperature 0, treating an execution as a property of the system. However, the LLM endpoints used in practice (hosted APIs and even open-weight deployments) exhibit output variation at temperature 0 due to dynamic batching, floating-point non-associativity, deployment changes, and other factors. The motivation is to quantify what this variance means for query processing—how many outputs change, whether changes survive relational operators, whether benchmark conclusions remain valid, and what causes the changes.

Method: The authors conduct an experimental study using three benchmarks (SemBench, LRO-Bench, UDA-Bench) run through their own harnesses at temperature 0. They log 1.2 million model calls across 8 deployments (6 open-weight models including gpt-oss-120B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen2.5-72B, Mistral-Small-3.1-24B, Granite-3.3-8B; plus GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 5). They develop a possible-worlds probabilistic model that predicts answer reproduction from item-level disagreement distributions and the plan's shape. They measure item flip rates, answer reproduction, quality ranges, decision margins, and reasoning lengths. They also replay voting strategies and calibrated cascade algorithms on recorded outputs without new model calls, and probe causes (temperature control, seeds, concurrency, input order, reasoning effort, deployments).

Result: Key results: (1) Item flip rates span 0.07% to 10.2% over 5 executions at temperature 0 (up to 24% on one task); commercial models also vary. (2) Plans amplify item changes exponentially in the number of items an answer exposes—e.g., on UDA-Bench, a few percent of extracted values change but about two-thirds of SQL answers change. (3) 21% of SemBench's published quality results change between executions, including on deterministic plans; 16 of 28 LRO-Bench implementation recommendations are not statistically settled. (4) Changing items are contested across models (77% of changing items vs. 34% of stable items); identical requests within one execution disagree as often as across executions; one execution's decision margin or reasoning length predicts later changes (AUC up to 1.00). (5) Deployments matter: same model on different stacks returns different answers and variance profiles, and one deployment shifted between campaigns. (6) Voting reduces variance but cannot remove it because changes concentrate on items near decision boundaries; re-asking items flagged by reasoning length achieves most of a full vote's benefit at lower cost. (7) Calibrated cascades keep their statistical guarantees but which rows they return depends on which oracle execution labeled the sample. (8) Recording operator outputs (~39 bytes each) is the remedy that makes an answer reproducible.

Conclusion: The authors conclude that temperature 0 does not make a semantic query reproducible. Item-level changes propagate through query plans in ways predicted by a possible-worlds model, and benchmarks must report quality spreads, answer reproduction, and failure rates rather than single-execution numbers. They provide concrete reporting rules for benchmark designers (per-query quality with spread, answer reproduction, flip rates at stated k, no best-of-N reporting, record per-item outputs, report deployments, only state recommendations that hold across executions) and design rules for engine builders (treat stored semantic columns as one sample from a distribution with its margin; estimate answer stability from item disagreement and plan shape; calibrate optimizers on multiple executions and record labels; record operator outputs to make answers reproducible).

Abstract: Semantic query engines ask a large language model (LLM) to judge individual rows, and benchmarks compare these engines on the quality of a few executions at temperature 0. We measure how much another execution changes. We re-execute the text and tabular workloads of SemBench, LRO-Bench, and UDA-Bench through their own harnesses, log every one of 1.2 million model calls, and reanalyze SemBench's published executions. At temperature 0, between 0.07% and 10.2% of rows change their operator output over five executions, depending on the model, and up to 24.0% on one task. Plans amplify these changes exponentially in the number of rows an answer exposes, as a possible-worlds model predicts: on UDA-Bench, a few percent of extracted values change, but about two thirds of the answers do. In SemBench's published results, 21% of text results change quality between executions, including on engines whose plans are deterministic. Several per-query system comparisons, and 16 of 28 tests of LRO-Bench's implementation recommendations, are not settled by the executions the benchmarks run. Changing rows are rows on which models disagree with each other; identical requests within one execution disagree as often as across executions; and one execution's decision margin or reasoning length predicts which rows change. Voting reduces the variance but does not remove it, and a calibrated cascade keeps its guarantee while the rows it returns change. We derive reporting rules for benchmarks and design rules for engines.

</details>

### [346] [Minions: A Dynamic and Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Built on Idle Apple Silicon Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12970)
*Jianhua Li,Yun Xing,Girisha De Silva,Ryan Flint,Kai Yuan,Sean Suchter*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Minions，一个基于Apple Silicon空闲GPU的分布式推理云平台，通过聚合macOS设备空闲算力解决集中式GPU资源紧缺问题，支持embedding和LLM推理，具备任务容错和动态绑定机制，并将十小时以上队列时间压缩至分钟级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式GPU集群面临成本高、弹性不足、排队时间长的问题，而Apple Silicon设备上的GPU在日常使用中大量闲置，由此产生能否将闲置GPU聚合为共享分布式推理平台的的动机。

Method: 系统采用四组件架构（Minion Server、PostgreSQL元数据存储、Minion Executor、Minion Watchdog），Executor以pull方式通过REST从Server获取子任务，利用PostgreSQL唯一约束原子获取执行权（心跳监测与动态任务绑定优先级），使用S3解耦存储，集成HuggingFace和Ollama分别运行embedding和LLM推理，通过Grafana从数据库 派生观测指标。

Result: 部署实践表明Minions可将推理任务排队时间从超过10小时压缩至分钟级，无需额外GPU采购或基础设施成本，具备有机扩展能力，并支持团队/组织范围部署以保障数据保密性。

Conclusion: Minions验证了闲置macOS设备可作为实用分布式GPU推理平台的，未来扩展到分布式模型训练，并探索跨组织乃至跨社区的闲置GPU安全联邦化为大规模共享GPU资源池的可能性。

Abstract: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon-based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. Minions enables teams to leverage existing hardware without requiring additional GPU procurement. The system provides flexible GPU inference task execution, fault tolerance, and efficient resource utilization. Our experience shows that idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained.

</details>


### [347] [SlackSwap: Bandwidth-Aware Activation Swapping and Recomputation for Memory-Efficient DNN Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13003)
*Hui Feng,Xun Zhou,Yuxin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出SlackSwap，一种面向DNN训练中节省GPU显存的两遍式规划器与运行时策略。它将主机链路时间视为显式资源预算（link budget），结合swap和重计算，在A100上模拟BERT-Large、GPT-2 XL和Llama-7B模型，仅用一半激活内存即可保留96-100%无限制显存吞吐量，性能为最佳基线的1.10-1.11倍，方案接近0.5%遗传搜索结果，规划时间小于0.4秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着GPU算力（Titan X到H100提升141倍）远超CPU-GPU链路带宽（仅提升3.9倍）的增长，传统交换（swapping）方法（如vDNN、SuperNeurons、SwapAdvisor）无视链路承载能力造成传输阻塞，而块检查点（block checkpointing）则闲置链路资源。现有A100仅能隐藏11-38%的Transformer激活数据交换，急需一种协调swap与recomputation的链路感知调度机制。

Method: SlackSwap的核心方法包括：(1) 链路预算（link budget）模型f=min(1, I/β)，其中I为前向FLOPs/保存字节，β为机器的FLOPs per byte/s链路带宽；(2) 两遍规划算法——Pass 1按ρ_t=c_t/s_t降序将最优链路预算分配给最难重计算的tensor，使用FIFO D2H和最早截止期限优先（EDF）H2D调度且无每层同步屏障；Pass 2沿内存剖面覆盖剩余超额部分，选择成本最低的recompute；(3) 基于双DMA队列和最近最久未使用（LRU）回退策略的barrier-free运行时机制；(4) 验证修复通过事件模型重放并迭代优化方案。

Result: 在A100、PCIe 4.0的仿真中，SlackSwap在50%激活内存下对BERT-Large、GPT-2 XL和Llama-7B分别保留96.3%、97.6%和99.6%的理想吞吐，为最佳基线的1.10-1.11倍；30%内存下保留89.7-97.0%为基线1.07-1.16倍；10%内存下（块检查点无法容纳）仍维持79.7-87.3%，且无线性瓶颈停滞。其方案与45秒遗传搜索（6600-14000方案）差距小于0.5%，规划时间仅67-376ms。消融实验表明Barriers-free运行时贡献最大性能。

Conclusion: SlackSwap通过显式建模链路预算，有效解决了GPU算力与主机链路带宽失衡问题，使swap与recompute协同优于单独任一方案。论文揭示了当链路带宽达数百GB/s（一致链路）或长序列场景下，方法自然从recompute偏向swap，为统一内存预取等未来工作提供了原则性框架。其局限在于仅基于仿真，未直接整合ZeRO-Offload梯度流量和共享PCIe场景，并需要GPU分析工具或框架钩子提供单次性能剖析迭代数据。

Abstract: Swapping saved activations to host memory once enabled GPUs to train models that exceeded their device-memory capacity when compute throughput and host-link bandwidth were roughly balanced. For example, on a 2015 Titan X, PCIe bandwidth was sufficient to offload all VGG-16 activations during the forward pass. This balance no longer holds. From the Titan X to the H100, peak training throughput increased by 141x, whereas host-link bandwidth improved by only 3.9x. On an A100, the host link can hide transfers for only 11-38% of the activations in the transformer models we study. Existing swapping approaches, such as vDNN, SuperNeurons, and SwapAdvisor, offload tensors according to memory requirements without explicitly respecting the available link-time budget, resulting in transfer-induced stalls; block checkpointing, in contrast, leaves the host link underutilized. We present SlackSwap, which treats host-link time as an explicit resource budget. Using a single profiled iteration, SlackSwap allocates the forward-pass link budget to tensors that are most expensive to recompute, resolves the remaining memory deficit by recomputing the least expensive tensors, and schedules FIFO offloads and earliest-deadline-first prefetches without per-layer synchronization barriers. In trace-driven simulations of BERT-Large, GPT-2 XL, and a Llama-7B-style model on an A100, SlackSwap retains 96-100% of unlimited-memory GPU throughput while using half the activation memory, achieving 1.10-1.11x the throughput of the best baseline. Its plans are within 0.5% of a genetic search over 6,600-14,000 candidate plans, while requiring less than 0.4 seconds to generate.

</details>


### [348] [Execution-Feasible Dispatch of LLM Pre-training Loads for Renewable-Dominant AI Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13047)
*Xi Tong,Ershun Du,Haiyang Jiang,Long Chen,Qin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对以新能源为主的AI数据中心（特别是LLM预训练负载），提出了一种"执行可行"的调度框架。其核心是将LLM任务描述符映射到checkpoint（检查点）域的工作负载，再进一步映射到满足吞吐量、GPU容量、内存、IT功耗等约束的3D并行（数据/张量/流水线并行）GPU执行模式，并构建checkpoint状态图嵌入日前电力调度MILP模型，实现与电网购电、弃风弃光、储能（BESS）的协调。最后通过2048 GPU的AIDC及两个LLaMA预训练任务（LLaMA-13B和LLaMA-33B）案例验证，相比固定连续训练，运行成本降低20.02%，弃风弃光从1.077 MWh降至0.014 MWh。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将AI数据中心（AIDC）的电力需求视为连续可调或通用可延迟，从而**高估了LLM预训练的灵活性**。LLM预训练是顺序优化过程，时间偏移受checkpoint状态约束，恢复时的功率水平由离散的GPU并行配置决定（而非连续的功率指令）。因此，核心挑战在于如何推导出一种"执行可行"的AIDC负荷模型，使其真实参与电力调度，避免简单平移负荷。

Method: 1. **任务-计算映射**：根据Transformer FLOPs公式（5），由LLM描述符（模型规模、token目标、批次、序列长度等）计算每次迭代工作量、每日tranche迭代次数、日工作量C_j，并将进度划分到K_j^seg个聚合checkpoint段。2. **计算-资源映射**：枚举3D并行配置 a=(p,q,d)，满足整除性（公式16）、GPU内存约束（公式14-15，状态+激活+开销）以及GPU容量上限，筛选可行模式A_j；按Pareto支配（少GPU、低功耗、高吞吐）剪枝得到有效模式A_j^eff。3. **Checkpoint状态图**：构建图G_j=(V_j,E_j)，节点为(时间τ, checkpoint k)，边分两类——等待边（零功耗）、训练边（执行ℓ_{j,a,Δk}个时段，消耗Δk个checkpoint段计算量）。用网络流约束（公式26）保证从源到汇（g_j）的单条可行路径，从而强制checkpoint状态连续性与最终完成。4. **日前调度MILP**：目标函数最小化电网购电、弃风弃光、储能吞吐成本之和；约束包括路径连续（26）、模式解码（27-29）、GPU与AIDC容量（30）、绿色电力母线功率平衡（32）、BESS动态（34，含充放电互斥、SOC上下限、末态复位）。模型为MILP，离散执行可行性通过剪枝后的A_j^eff和图G_j内在保证。

Result: 基于CAISO风光与TOU电价数据，2048 GPU的AIDC（A100，80GB显存，PUE=1.25），两个LLaMA任务（LLaMA-13B：4.9%日分配额，12段/24h；LLaMA-33B：2.02%日分配额）。六种场景对比：S1（固定基准）成本473.03 USD、弃风弃光1.077 MWh、绿电占比63.20%；S4（执行可行checkpoint+3D调度，无储能）成本378.33 USD、降20.02%，弃风弃光降至0.014 MWh，绿电占比66.12%；S6（+BESS）成本377.79 USD、降20.13%，弃风弃光为0，储能吞吐仅0.026 MWh；理想化S3（仅3D无checkpoint连续约束）成本368.99 USD、降21.99%（乐观基准）。S2与S1完全一致，证明checkpoint记录本身不创造灵活性。敏感性分析：12段checkpoint已捕获绝大部分灵活性；GPU容量<1280不可行；风光配比达1.5时成本和弃风弃光反而回升，标志灵活性吸收能力饱和。LLaMA-13B生成135个可行配置、剪枝后12个有效模式、最优解仅激活4个；LLaMA-33B相应为111/21/3个。LLM-B可在某checkpoint等待3小时，再以可行3D模式恢复，所有24h进度100%完成。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种将LLM预训练固有结构（checkpoint与3D并行模式）显式映射为电力系统可行负荷状态的调度框架，揭示"灵活的电网交互能力源于checkpoint等待与执行可行3D模式补偿的结合，而非checkpoint记录本身"。在新能源主导的AIDC中，工作负载整形提供了主导灵活性，BESS仅承担残余平衡。数值结果显示显著的成本和弃风弃光削减效果。未来工作将扩展至多日随机调度、其他AI工作负载（微调/推理）、共享GPU池的空闲机会成本，以及多AIDC协同调度。

Abstract: AI data centers (AIDCs) are emerging as large power-system loads, making their operational flexibility increasingly valuable. Existing studies often treat AIDC demand as continuously adjustable or generically delay-tolerant, which overstating the flexibility of large language model (LLM) pretraining. This paper proposes an execution-feasible dispatch framework for LLM pre-training in renewable-dominant AIDCs. LLM descriptors are first converted into checkpoint-domain daily workloads, then mapped to feasible 3D-parallel GPU modes with explicit throughput, GPU-capacity, memory, and IT-power limits. The resulting checkpoint- and mode-constrained load states are embedded into a day-ahead power dispatch model. Case studies on a 2048 GPUs AIDC with two LLaMA pretraining tasks show that checkpoint-aware 3D dispatch reduces operating cost by 20.02% and renewable curtailment from 1.077 to 0.014 MWh relative to fixed continuous training. Related results also show that checkpoint records alone do not create load flexibility,practical grid-interactive flexibility arises from checkpoint waiting combined with execution-feasible 3D-mode compensation.

</details>


### [349] [Capturing Electrical Windows Through Reconfigurable Optical Networks: Transfer-aware Scheduling of Multi-Region AI Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13061)
*Xi Tong,Zijian Li,Xiaoyi Fan,Cong Zhang,Ershun Du,Qin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多区域AI数据中心的"传输感知"（transfer-aware）算力-电力-网络联合调度框架，通过光路交换（OCS）将checkpoint传输与可再生能源窗口捕获相协调，在五AIDC基准测试中相对静态光网络降低12.50%的实时购电成本并提升2.724个百分点的本地可再生能源利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心跨区域迁移训练负载以利用可再生能源或低电价窗口时，若忽视checkpoint传输时延（即"transfer-blind"），可能高估迁移收益，或导致后续训练无法在窗口期内恢复运行。

Method: 构建紧凑的算力-电力主问题生成候选调度方案，再通过精确多商品流（multicommodity flow）认证来验证checkpoint在共享链路容量约束下的可达性；若不可行则利用更新后的时延估计修正候选方案。集成日前（day-ahead）规划、事件触发日内（intraday）更新与分钟级实时（real-time）调度三级协调方法。采用动态OCS替代固定光路配对，使光路带宽成为可调度资源。

Result: 在五AIDC基准中，Dynamic OCS方案（D）相对静态光网络（C）降低实时购电成本12.50%（49.49% C-to-B成本差距），提升本地RE利用率2.724个百分点。checkpoint迁移平均时长从69.31分钟降至17.10分钟（-75.33%），后继任务就绪延迟从32分钟降至0。最大爬坡降低28.55%，日前-实时偏差降低29.19%。消融分析表明，网络压力是OCS价值的关键放大器，价格/可再生能源再分布单独不产生收益，三者共同作用才产生显著价值。

Conclusion: 可重构光网络能有效缩短checkpoint传输时间、提升本地可再生能源消纳能力，并减少极端电网调节冲击。但收益取决于电网密集度（network pressure）与空间性电价/可再生能源窗口的联合对齐。未来工作将使用运营实测数据，并扩展至潮流约束、备用市场及更大规模的可重构电路组合。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence data centers (AIDCs) can provide spatiotemporal load flexibility by migrating training workloads in response to regional electricity prices and renewable-energy (RE) availability. However, transfer-blind scheduling may overestimate migration benefits by overlooking transfer time or prevent training from resuming within renewable-rich or low-price windows when considering transfer time. This paper proposes a transfer-aware compute-electricity-network scheduling framework that coordinates training placement, checkpoint transmission, and optical circuit switching (OCS) to improve local RE utilization and reduce grid-purchase cost. A compact compute-electricity master problem generates candidate schedules using estimated transfer delays. The framework then schedules optical circuits, verifies checkpoint delivery under shared-link capacity constraints, and revises infeasible schedules using updated delay estimates. It integrates day-ahead planning, event-triggered intraday updates, and real-time dispatch. In a five-AIDC benchmark with equal completed work and network resources, the proposed method reduces the real-time grid purchase cost by 12.50% and increases the local RE utilization by 2.724 percentage points relative to static optical operation. Sensitivity and ablation analyses indicate that OCS is particularly beneficial when renewable-rich or low-price windows shift across sites and network bottlenecks hinder timely checkpoint delivery.

</details>


### [350] [Multi-Source and Multi-Dimensional Information Fusion in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13298)
*Yushi Wang,Zhengxin Yu,Guhan Zheng,Wang Miao,Merouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限边缘网络中多源多维语义信息融合问题，提出了一个统一框架，核心包含Hyper-Slot融合模块和基于Stackelberg-Nash博弈的激励机制，通过迭代token-to-slot分配融合异构语义token并协调终端上传策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G边缘网络中分布式终端持续产生多模态语义信息，但受限于通信与计算资源，边缘服务器仅能接收不完整且在模态、语义粒度、到达时间、信道条件等方面存在异构性的token；现有融合方法难以协同优化选择性上传与多维异构token融合，且独立决策易导致冗余上传或互补信息缺失。

Method: 1) 多源语义通信与开销建模：定义候选token集合、归一化传输质量b_{m,i}∈[0,1]、计算与通信能耗模型；2) Hyper-Slot融合模块：将token属性η_i编码为描述符d_i，与语义嵌入联合计算token-slot亲和度，经sparsemax稀疏分配、GRU迭代更新实现token-to-slot分配与slot-to-token反馈，固定K个slot聚合为紧凑表征；3) 基于贡献的激励机制：以Hyper-Slot分配权重定义融合增益F(b)（覆盖+互补性），终端边际贡献Δ_m(b)=F(b)-F(0_m,b_{-m})，构建双层Stackelberg-Nash博弈——终端侧阻尼最佳响应迭代求解Nash均衡，边缘服务器侧数值梯度上升确定奖励池R；4) 端到端训练含任务损失与多样性正则L_div。

Result: 在COCO2014三模态扩展数据集上mAP达0.7610±0.0239，较最强基线（SCAN/Slot Attention的0.724）提升3.66个百分点；Flickr30K跨模态检索RSum达478.9±3.4，较Slot Attention提升15.9点；参数较Concat+MLP基线减少超80%；25%传输预算下mAP仍领先Top-importance策略5.46个百分点；消融实验证实紧凑瓶颈与迭代依赖建模互补；博弈仿真显示奖励池R*=4.91时服务器效用最大，激励按贡献差异化分配。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够联合协调边缘网络中选择性语义上传与多维异构token融合，Hyper-Slot通过语义内容与属性联合建模实现紧凑鲁棒表征，Stackelberg-Nash博弈实现贡献驱动的资源分配，为6G资源受限边缘智能提供有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-source semantic information fusion enables edge networks to support global inference using observations collected by distributed terminals. However, limited communication and computation resources restrict semantic uploading, leaving the edge server with incomplete tokens that differ in modality, semantic granularity, arrival time, and channel condition. The value of these tokens also depends on the complementary or redundant information provided by other terminals. In this paper, we propose a multi-source and multi-dimensional semantic information fusion framework that coordinates terminal uploading and edge-side fusion under resource constraints. We develop Hyper-Slot to combine semantic content with available token attributes through iterative token-to-slot assignment and slot-to-token feedback, producing a compact representation for global inference. To encourage useful semantic uploading, we further design a contribution-based incentive mechanism that uses Hyper-Slot assignments to evaluate information coverage and cross-type complementarity. A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash game determines the server reward pool and terminal transmission-quality strategies while accounting for computation and communication energy costs. Experiments on a tri-modal extension of COCO2014 and image-text retrieval on Flickr30K show that Hyper-Slot improves mAP by 3.66 percentage points and RSum by 15.9 points over the strongest evaluated baselines, respectively, while reducing the number of parameters by more than 80% compared with a naive concatenation-based fusion baseline.

</details>


### [351] [SnapShare: Isolation-Preserving Deduplication for Serverless Snapshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13318)
*Leonid Kondrashov,Likun Zhang,André Filipe do Pilar de Jesus,Hans Pistor,Marco Cali,Riccardo Mancini,Rodrigo Bruno,Dmitrii Ustiugov*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SnapShare 是面向无服务器计算（AWS Lambda 等）VM 快照的集群级管理系统，在保证跨租户强隔离的同时通过选择性去重将端到端冷启动尾延迟降低 10–29%，远程存储降低 39%，本地缓存占用降低 38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无服务器平台为缩短冷启动普遍采用 VM 快照恢复，但因内容去重会引发跨租户时序侧信道泄露敏感数据，生产平台（如 AWS Lambda）被迫对不同租户的快照实施严格的零共享隔离，导致公共基础设施组件无法去重，浪费 worker 缓存容量并加剧冷启动延迟。论文刻画发现非敏感的共享基础设施约占快照内容 70%、工作集约 50%，存在巨大的安全可利用的共享机会。

Method: 1) 离线分类器：对每个 4KB 快照页计算 MD5，与提供商批准的参考源（基础快照、根文件系统、容器镜像）做完整内容匹配；只有完全匹配才标记为 Shared，任何不匹配标记为 Private。2) 部署时通过 userfaultfd 剖析将页划分为 Working Set（预取）与 Lazy（按需）。3) 远程存储划分为 Shared/Private × Working-Set/Lazy 四象限，共享惰性页用基于内容的标识，私有页用租户+函数版本标识。4) Worker 本地缓存分区：Shared 分区对低基数公共组件做 pinning（<1% 容量），Private 分区按 LRU 淘汰并严格按租户隔离。5) 冷启动时 Controller 复用驻留的共享组件并预取缺失的私有工作集，页错误处理程序对工作集外访问做 4KB 按需取页。实现基于 vHive/Knative/Firecracker。

Result: 在 10 节点 CloudLab 集群、17 个 vSwarm 基准和 700 条 Azure Functions 轨迹上的评估：相对 Sabre 基线，远程存储降低 39%，本地缓存降低 38%（距 unsafe Full-Dedup 仅 6% 和 3%）；P99 尾延迟较 Chunks 基线降 29%、较 Sabre 降 10%；网络获取负载平均降 56%；在 1–10 Gbps 带宽扫描下均接近 unsafe Full-Dedup，最差情况取页延迟最多降低 10×；zstd 与 Intel IAA 硬件解压延迟相当；禁用容器镜像去重（SnapShare-）仍可获得 31% 的缓存节省。

Conclusion: SnapShare 通过"完整内容匹配批准参考源"这一保守且由运营方控制的共享边界，实现了高密度缓存与存储去重而不损害敏感数据隔离；其存储与缓存占用逼近理论上不安全但完全去重的设计，性能接近 unsafe 上界，同时为运营商提供动态策略入口（如 CVE 响应时撤回共享资格）。该方案填补了无服务器快照去重系统在隔离保证方面的空白。

Abstract: The efficiency of serverless computing fundamentally depends on rapid function startup, a challenge increasingly addressed by restoring from virtual machine snapshots. However, because content deduplication techniques can open timing-channel attacks that leak sensitive tenant data, production platforms like AWS Lambda instead enforce strict, zero-sharing isolation between snapshots of different tenants. While secure, this isolation precludes the deduplication of common infrastructure components, wasting per-worker cache capacity and exacerbating cold-start latency through inefficient remote fetching. Our characterization reveals that non-sensitive, shareable infrastructure accounts for roughly 70% of a typical snapshot's contents and, on average, about 50% of its working set. We present SnapShare, a cluster-wide snapshot management system that co-designs storage and caching to exploit this commonality without compromising sensitive data isolation. SnapShare classifies a snapshot page as shareable only when its full content matches that of a page from a provider-approved source; any non-matching content is treated as isolated private content. Common infrastructure components are selectively deduplicated and pinned across the cluster's worker nodes, while private data remains strictly isolated and is eagerly fetched as part of the tracked working set, falling back to on-demand retrieval only for pages that fall outside it. Implemented as an extension to Knative, SnapShare reduces end-to-end tail request slowdowns by 10-29% compared to traditional working-set and chunk-based platforms. It also reduces remote storage requirements by 39% and local cache footprints by 38%, reducing network retrieval payloads and bounding worst-case fetch delays by 10x.

</details>


### [352] [Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13325)
*Mohammad Siavashi,Pascal Schwinte,Ali Banaei,Gerald Q. Maguire Jr.,Marco Chiesa,Dejan Kostić*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GraphTok 是一个 GPU 端分词器，将 BPE 分词的完整流水线（前分词、BPE 合并、token ID 组装）封装为单个可重放的 CUDA Graph，针对智能体 LLM 服务中分词成为瓶颈的场景，在 vLLM 和 NVIDIA Dynamo 中实现了显著的延迟和容量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作负载（如编码代理）反复发送长上下文，但每次只有少量新增。Prefix caching 跳过了大部分 prefill，使得 CPU 分词成为 TTFT 的最大瓶颈。一个为整个 GPU 集群分词的前端限制了它能供给的 GPU 数量。

Method: GraphTok 将整个编码流水线（前分词→BPE 合并→token ID 组装）作为单个可重放的 CUDA Graph 执行。其关键设计包括：(1) 并行前分词器——通过本地字符类和紧凑的运行信息评估每个位置的前分词边界；(2) Warp 协作 BPE——在 warp 内通过 `__reduce_min_sync` 识别下一个最高优先级合并，保持参考合并顺序；(3) 图内可变长度执行——通过分离固定容量和实际占用率，在捕获的图内处理输入相关的工作量；(4) 完整 GPU 路径——支持 host 返回和 device 驻留输出。集成了 vLLM 的分词器工厂和 NVIDIA Dynamo 的 Rust 前端，并保留参考分词器作为回退。

Result: 1. 正确性：在 GPT-2、Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、DeepSeek-V3 和 Gemma 3 上，逐位复现参考分词器的 token ID。
2. 单个分词性能：在 Llama 3 上比最强 CPU 分词器 gigatoken 快 4.7–6.0×，单文档完整调用（包括传输）在 1.7–3.2 ms 内编码 100 万 GPT-2 tokens。
3. vLLM 集成：在 99% prefix 复用下，均值 TTFT 降低 2.1–2.4×。
4. Dynamo 容量：在 2 s P99 目标下，单个前端可承载 518 req/s 的 121k-token 流量（56 个 GPU 的流量），而 gigatoken 为 296，默认分词器为 18.5。
5. 共享主机测试：在与编码代理共享的主机上，比 gigatoken 节省 6.7–8.7× 的主机 CPU。

Conclusion: GraphTok 证明 GPU 分词不需要牺牲准确性。在 CPU 路由交叉点以上，它在独立、批处理和 TokTier 单请求协议上都是测量中最快的引擎。在单个无竞争请求中，快 CPU tokenizers 与 GraphTok 的差距在 3–18% 以内；优势主要体现在容量上——使用 GraphTok 后，Dynamo 自身的请求路径而非分词成为限制。下一阶段是让引擎直接消费设备驻留的 token ID。

Abstract: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.

</details>


### [353] [Stacked Intelligent Metasurface-Based MultiModal Feature Fusion for Collaborative Inference in Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13364)
*Yushi Wang,Zhengxin Yu,Guhan Zheng,Haris Pervaiz,Zheyi Chen,Shunqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出SIM-CI框架，将堆叠智能超表面（SIM）作为物理计算单元，在电磁波传播过程中直接执行多用户多模态协作推理，结合三异构性鲁棒适配器和混合波束成形网络，在6G边缘网络中实现"传输即计算"的新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G边缘协作推理面临计算和通信开销大的核心挑战：多用户多模态中间特征上传消耗大量频谱资源，数字域融合推理引入显著的计算延迟和能耗。现有异构性处理方法（跨模态对齐、自适应推理、波束成形）各自仅解决单一异构源，且依赖灵活的数字域处理，难以适配SIM物理计算范式。

Method: 1）基于GNN的三异构性鲁棒适配器：构建包含kNN约束RBF核的图相似度矩阵，将CSI嵌入作为节点初始特征，结合质量感知对比学习（基于特征提取深度）对齐多模态多层级特征；2）混合波束成形网络：模型驱动分支采用MMSE启发的正则化信道共轭预均衡器执行相位预对齐和幅度预均衡，数据驱动分支采用Transformer编码器学习端到端映射，通过可学习softmax权重融合；3）SIM物理推理引擎：部署在边缘作为线性分类器，接收OTA聚合的空频信号矩阵，在单次波传播中完成空频联合特征融合与分类。

Result: 在COCO2017和SpokenCOCO数据集上，SIM-CI达到mAP 0.723，约为数字域基线BLIP-2（0.733）的98.6%，同时计算能耗降低25%，传输时隙减少75%，计算延迟降低76.1%。消融实验表明信道感知GNN和混合波束成形均对性能有显著贡献；在模型深度异构和模态异构（含语音三模态）场景下，SIM-CI均优于GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE基线，尤其在浅层特征占比增大时优势更明显。

Conclusion: SIM-CI通过将推理任务嵌入物理波传播域，配合信道感知适配器和混合波束成形，有效应对数据、模型和系统三重异构性，以接近数字域基线的精度实现显著的计算能耗、频谱效率和延迟降低，为6G边缘智能提供了可扩展、低延迟的新路径。

Abstract: In navigating the challenges of computational and communication overhead within the 6G-era Collaborative Inference (CI), this paper explores the feasibility of employing Stacked Intelligent Metasurface (SIM) to perform CI, termed SIM-CI. The SIM functions as a physical computing unit, receiving multi-user Over-The-Air (OTA) aggregated features within the same spectrum. It thus executes the necessary spatial-frequency combining and inference in a single physical wave this http URL -CI also incorporates a tri-heterogeneity robustness adapter to address the network heterogeneity, such as multi-modal data and user inference models, as well as a quality-aware contrastive approach that align features from different modalities and extraction levels into a unified feature space. Considering the heterogeneous and dynamic channels, we further integrate Channel State Information (CSI) as an additional input into the adapter design, enabling users' early perception of potential channel states. Moreover, to maximally mitigate the impact of channel variations, we design a new hybrid beamforming network that combines the robustness of model-driven pre-equalization with the adaptability of data-driven learning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our SIM-CI compared to digital-domain inference, achieving 98.6\% accuracy to conversional digital-domain CI approaches under various heterogeneous conditions, while reducing computational energy by 25\% and requiring 75\% fewer transmission time slots.

</details>


### [354] [ShoreKeeper: Accelerating Iterative Data Analytics in the Cloud via Distributed Recovery-Cost-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13396)
*Jongseop Lee,Minsu Sun,Xinyue Ma,Atul Sandur,Myeongjae Jeon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Sheper 是一个面向云端迭代数据分析（如 PageRank、ML 训练等）的分布式缓存管理系统，将集群内存视为统一弹性池，通过全局 MILP 优化同时决定数据块的缓存、放置与复制，以最小化恢复成本。它针对两大挑战——执行器间的恢复成本不均衡与抢占式实例的资源抢占——分别在稳定 VM 和可抢占实例上实现了显著的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式大数据工作负载（如图算法、机器学习）会不断产生大量中间数据，对内存需求极高。现有缓存策略（如 LRC、MRD、Blaze）仅做节点本地决策，假设节点高可用，但在云环境中存在两个关键不足：1）执行器间的恢复成本分布不均（数据倾斜、过滤比例不同、shuffle 重分布等导致部分节点内存压力大而过早驱逐高成本块）；2）抢占式实例的动态资源变化会导致关键缓存丢失，而云原生方案（如 Spark Decommissioner）随机迁移块、忽视恢复成本。论文通过 18 小时 AWS Spot 实例追踪和实验表明，这些问题显著拖慢端到端完成时间（最后一次迭代单节点抢占可增加 30–50% 完成时间）。

Method: akeeper 采用"统一规划器 + 运行时管理器"的清晰分离架构：(1) 离线 profiling 通过小输入 dry-run 初始化 lineage 图、分区大小、计算时间、网络/磁盘带宽；运行时在每个 stage 边界更新状态。(2) 成本模型：将分布式数据流合并为单一图，定义分区 p 在目标执行器 e_t(p) 上的访问成本（内存命中、远端网络传输、本地盘读、远端盘读+网络）和恢复成本（按父节点求和而非取最大值，反映集群整体代价），使用二进制变量 x_{p,e}（缓存位置）和 d_p（落盘）编码决策。(3) 求解器：对所有执行器构建单一 MILP，最小化目标分区集合 J 的总恢复成本 ∑R_p(e_t(p))，约束包括每执行器内存上限 ∑s_p·x_{p,e} ≤ C_e 和每个分区至多一处缓存或落盘。引入两种剪枝技术保证可解性：缓存块边界剪枝（裁剪已缓存块以上的祖先，V=O(ikP) 缩减为仅未缓存 lineage 深度）和 shuffle 近似（消除 shuffle 的 P² 边，将累积 shuffle 成本赋给输出，使 L=O(V)）。求解时间在 16× 分区规模下仍 < 4 秒。(4) 运行时管理器：通过 diff 新旧计划仅传输变化分区；使用异步、批量、流水线传输，仅占用 shuffle 阶段剩余空闲带宽；支持懒内存释放；针对抢占警报按恢复成本降序迁移；对 shuffle 分区进行轻量级主动复制（ρ 可配置，处理罕见的未警报抢占）。

Result: 在 11 节点 r5n.2xlarge（10 worker，20 executor，25GB/个）AWS 集群上，对 PageRank（PR）、Connected Components（CC）、Logistic Regression（LR）、SVD++ 四个基准测试，对比 LRU、LRC、MRD、Flint、Blaze 及 Blaze+D/Blaze+DF。VM 实例：akeeper 相对成本无关方法最高 6.11× 加速，相对 Blaze 最高 2.05× 加速，PR 收益最大（最高跨执行器不均衡）；CC/SVD++ 中等收益；LR 收益最小（工作集小且适配每执行器内存）。抢占实例（AWS Spot 追踪，Low/High 两个窗口）：相对 Blaze+D 最高 2.87× 加速（PR Low 窗口），即便 30 秒短宽限期仍保持优势。组件分解：Low 窗口下统一缓存贡献 ~80% 加速；High 窗口下成本感知降级与主动复制均贡献显著。运行开销：profiling 1.4–2.4%，求解 < 2.7%，迁移 < 0.05%。可扩展性：10→40 executor、输入 0.5×→2× 时相对 Blaze 维持 ~2.1× 加速，执行时间仅增 10.7%。剪枝后目标函数与无剪枝相比偏差 < 2%。与基于 S3 的全 disaggregation 方案相比，akeeper 快 2.02× 且成本低 66.9%。

Conclusion: akeaker 证明了在云端迭代数据分析中跨执行器管理恢复成本的必要性，通过将集群内存视为统一弹性池、MILP 全局优化缓存+放置+复制决策，以及针对抢占环境的成本感知迁移与轻量复制，在稳定 VM 和可抢占实例上均显著优于现有缓存与 checkpointing 系统。其规划与执行分离的设计、对 Spark 的实现（~8k 行代码修改 + Python Gurobi 求解器）、以及低开销特性使其具备实用性；理论上可扩展至 Flink/Ray/Dask 等同样满足"分区不可变 + 依赖图 + 可重计算"三属性的引擎。限制包括：当前仅支持单一资源类型（混合 on-demand+preemptible 集群需少量 on-demand 节点兜底）、离线 profiling 对短作业有启动开销、依赖迭代边界界定求解范围难以扩展至非迭代工作负载。

Abstract: Large-scale data-intensive workloads powered by iterative graph or machine learning processing have an insatiable demand for memory due to the continuous generation of new intermediate data. Although existing caching strategies strive to keep performance-critical data in memory, they often fail in practice because they are limited to node-local memory management and assume high node availability. In this paper, we introduce ShoreKeeper, a framework that maximizes execution efficiency by treating cluster-wide memory as a unified, elastic pool. ShoreKeeper employs a global optimization model that maps distributed dataflows into a single graph abstraction to minimize the recovery cost of data evicted from cache across the cluster. To handle memory working sets and cluster capacities that fluctuate over time, ShoreKeeper employs a graph-pruning technique that permits the fast refinement of the caching plan. These optimizations allow ShoreKeeper to work seamlessly whether deployed on highly available VMs or cost-effective preemptible instances in the cloud. Our experiments show that ShoreKeeper consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems.

</details>


### [355] [CompileMask: Bridging the Gap Between Expressiveness and Efficiency in Attention Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13474)
*Hongzheng Li,Jiacheng Wan,Zhaolong Xing,Zhida Jiang,Yuanhang Yang,Junhua Shu,Jiaxing Wang,Xupeng Miao,Yingxia Shao,Zhen Chen,Ke Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: CompileMask 是一种用于高效注意力执行的系统，通过离线编译器将表达性强的掩码规范与高效的运行时表示相结合，解决注意力掩码中表达性与效率之间的权衡问题，最高可实现 3.8 倍的速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代注意力工作负载需要多样化的掩码模式，其边界依赖于运行时元数据，而高效注意力内核仅支持少量固定模式。现有方法面临表达性与效率的权衡：基于谓词的方法表达性强但开销大，基于区间的方法执行高效但表达性受限。本研究旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: CompileMask 采用两阶段流水线：(1) 离线阶段，符号编译器分析用户提供的 MaskSpec（基于区域的 DSL，每对查询行范围和可见性谓词）并生成掩码特定的预处理内核；(2) 在线阶段，预处理内核读取批次元数据，生成紧凑的 Execution Descriptor（包含 Interval Table 和 Tile-State Bitmaps），注意力内核通过将元素索引与预计算的端点进行比较来高效检查可见性。对于无法编译为区间的规则，回退到在线谓词求值以保持表达性。

Result: 在 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 上的实验表明，在 HSTU、共享前缀奖励模型和 CLEAR 等掩码模式下，CompileMask 在单算子和端到端训练吞吐量方面均优于 FlexAttention 和 FlashMask 等先进方法。在 Qwen3-8B 上使用 HSTU 掩码的真实 KuaiRand 数据上，CompileMask 实现了 3.83 倍和 1.33 倍的端到端训练吞吐量提升。CompileMask 支持 FlashMask 四向量格式无法表达的掩码（如 CLEAR 多模态掩码），并在因果注意力上保持接近原生 FlashAttention-4 的性能。

Conclusion: CompileMask 通过将表达性掩码规范与高效注意力执行分离并由离线编译器连接，解决了注意力掩码中的表达性-效率权衡。实验验证了该系统在单算子和端到端训练吞吐量上的改进，同时保持了掩码表达性，显著减少了用户编写代码量和开发时间。

Abstract: Modern attention workloads require diverse masking patterns whose boundaries depend on runtime metadata, yet efficient attention kernels natively support only a small set of patterns. Existing methods for supporting custom masks in these kernels face an expressiveness-efficiency trade-off. Predicate-based methods are expressive but incur substantial preprocessing and execution overhead, whereas interval-based methods execute efficiently but restrict expressiveness through a predefined interval count. We present CompileMask, which addresses this trade-off by connecting expressive mask specifications with efficient attention execution. We design a compiler that analyzes visibility rules during the offline stage and generates a mask-specific preprocess kernel. We further propose MaskSpec, a region-based DSL that lets users express these rules. During the online stage, the generated kernel reads batch metadata and produces a compact Execution Descriptor that lets the attention kernel efficiently check visibility by comparing element indices against precomputed endpoints. Experiments show that CompileMask achieves up to $3.8\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [356] [GPU-resident Execution for Timing-predictable Sensor Processing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13809)
*Soham Sinha,Rahul Choudhury,Shekhar Dwivedi,Gregory Lee,Gigon Bae,Anisha Goel,Elena Agostini,Patrick O'Grady,Yosi Levi,Mahdi Azizian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出"GPU常驻执行"(GPU-resident Execution),一种新的执行模式,通过将I/O与GPU执行置于长生命周期的设备常驻循环中,消除每帧主机的唤醒与CUDA调用,从而显著降低实时传感器处理闭环系统的端到端延迟抖动。在工业级1080p 60Hz相机到显示流水线中,光到显示抖动从4.83ms降至0.66ms(7.3倍),软件处理抖动从1.70ms降至0.01ms(170倍)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于GPU加速的实时传感器处理系统仍由CPU主机作为每帧迭代的主控方,主机需观察传感器输入、提交CUDA任务、等待完成并提交执行动作。这种主机介导的闭环路径即使采用GPU内存RDMA或CPU核隔离等缓解措施,仍受I/O中断、主机调度和CUDA API开销的影响,难以保证时间可预测性。

Method: 1. 将传感器处理应用建模为有向无环图(DAG)的GPU常驻算子;2. 使用CUDA Graph while条件节点(WHL)或设备图尾自启动(DVG)将整个DAG封装为单一GPU常驻CUDA Graph,由主机仅启动一次;3. 在设备端实现数据就绪处理器(data-ready handler)轮询NIC接收完成队列或传感器元数据,无需主机唤醒即可触发处理流水线;4. 控制器核将数据就绪标志转换为if条件谓词,决定是否执行算子DAG;5. 端标记核完成单次迭代并重置标志;6. 结合GPUDirect RDMA(GPU内存RDMA)与DOCA GPUNetIO(GPU驱动I/O),实现传感器数据直接写入GPU可见内存,执行结果直接提交到设备可见输出端点。

Result: 在RTX A6000、IGX Orin和IGX Thor等多平台上评估:1. 单阶段推理微基准测试:对MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50等模型,标准差和绝对抖动降低1.4-2.4倍;2. 主机侧争用测试:在后台I/O和CPU负载下,CPU驱动基线抖动扩展至1.05-9.7.99ms(出现罕见长尾),而GPU常驻执行保持在9-86μs;3. 多环并发扩展性测试:10个并发环时,GPU常驻执行不预留CPU核,标准差从29.3μs降至7.6μs,p99.9从1113.6μs降至50.2μs,最大延迟从1850.3μs降至404.5μs;4. 框架开销:各图组件转换开销在0.05-13.67μs之间;5. IMX274相机到显示工业级案例(1080p 60Hz):光到显示抖动从4.83ms降至0.66ms(7.3倍),软件处理抖动从1.70ms降至0.01ms(170倍),最坏情况延迟从18.83ms降至13.35ms。

Conclusion: GPU常驻执行通过设计层面消除主机在稳态闭环中的参与,将端到端响应路径仅由设备侧图执行和算子成本组成,从根本上避免了Linux内核、驱动和CUDA API调度的延迟尾部。实验表明该架构在工业级实时传感器处理应用中显著收紧延迟分布并大幅降低抖动,为Linux托管GPU平台上的实时ML驱动传感器系统提供了时序可预测的系统基础。未来工作将扩展至更广泛的GPU驱动I/O支持(SPI、GPIO、I2C等)和更完整的感知-思考-动作闭环,以及GPU原生动作模型在实时控制回路中的部署。

Abstract: Real-time embedded systems increasingly place GPU-accelerated processing of high-bandwidth sensor streams inside closed-loop systems, but the CPU (the host) remains the primary orchestrator of each iteration. The host observes sensor inputs, submits CUDA work, waits for completion, and commits actuation. This host-mediated path exposes the closed-loop end-to-end latency to I/O interrupts, host scheduler decisions, and CUDA API overheads even after common host-side mitigations such as GPU-memory RDMA or CPU core isolation. This paper presents GPU-resident Execution, a new execution model for real-time sensor processing pipelines that keeps I/O and GPU execution in a long-lived device-resident loop. Sensor inputs arrive in GPU memory, trigger GPU-side processing, and reach GPU-visible output endpoints without any host wakeups. We implement the model in the NVIDIA Holoscan C++ framework and provide reference components for building GPU-resident applications. We evaluate our system on NVIDIA GPUs and SoCs with inference, host-contention, multi-loop, and streaming camera workloads. On an industry-grade 1080p, 60 Hz real-time camera-to-display application, GPU-resident Execution reduces photon-to-display jitter from 4.83 ms to 0.66 ms (7.3x) relative to a CPU-driven GPU-memory RDMA baseline and reduces software-processing jitter from 1.70 ms to 0.01 ms (170x).

</details>


### [357] [Scheduling in Cloud,Fog, and Edge Computing: A Comparative Analysis and Decision Framework for Technique Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13830)
*Rana Ghazali,Douglas G.Down*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对云-雾-边计算环境中任务、作业及工作流调度的综述性研究，涵盖启发式、元启发式、基于学习和混合方法，系统比较其在不同范式下的权衡，并提出指导技术选择的决策框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云、雾、边计算的异构性和动态性使调度问题日益复杂，现有综述在计算环境、调度粒度或技术族方面覆盖较为零散，难以为具体需求下的方法选择提供有效指导。

Method: 对2020至2026年间发表的研究，从调度粒度、计算环境、优化目标、约束条件、性能指标和评估工具等维度，对启发式、元启发式、学习型和混合方法进行系统性比较分析，并据此构建决策框架。

Result: 启发式方法计算开销低，适合相对稳定的调度场景；元启发式适用于复杂多目标优化；学习方法对动态不确定环境适应性更强，但引入数据、训练、推理和收敛方面的新需求；混合方法能力互补但复杂度和实现成本更高。

Conclusion: 不同调度方法在计算效率、优化能力、适应性和实现复杂度之间存在明确权衡；所提出的决策框架可依据工作负载特征、环境条件、优化目标、资源约束和计算需求辅助选择最合适的技术。

Abstract: The increasing heterogeneity and dynamism of cloud, fog, and edge computing make scheduling a challenging problem involving diverse resource capabilities, workload characteristics, latency and energy constraints, and competing optimization objectives. Although numerous scheduling methods have been proposed, existing reviews often provide fragmented coverage of computing environments, scheduling granularities, or technique families, offering limited guidance on selecting an appropriate approach for specific requirements. This review presents a comparative analysis of task, job, and workflow scheduling across the cloud, fog, and edge paradigms, covering heuristic, metaheuristic, learning-based, and hybrid techniques. Studies published between 2020 and 2026 are analyzed according to scheduling granularity, computing environment, optimization objectives, constraints, performance metrics, and evaluation tools. The analysis highlights trade-offs among computational efficiency, optimization capability, adaptability, and implementation complexity across technique families. Heuristic methods offer low computational overhead for relatively stable scheduling conditions, whereas metaheuristic methods are suited to complex and multi-objective optimization problems. Learning-based methods provide greater adaptability to dynamic and uncertain environments but introduce data, training, inference, and convergence requirements. Hybrid methods combine complementary capabilities but generally increase computational and implementation complexity. Based on these findings, a decision framework is developed to guide technique selection according to workload characteristics, environmental conditions, optimization objectives, resource constraints, and computational requirements.

</details>


<div id='cs.DS'></div>
